### Task 7: `packages/spec` 基礎：定義、輔助函式、meta、寫法規則

目的：建立 `@tzuchi/tceditor-spec`（`packages/spec`），提供撰寫區塊規格的 `defineBlockSpec`、`definePageRoot`，7 個欄位輔助函式（`choice`、`style`、`token`、`link`、`richText`、`slot`、`image`），`x-*` meta 的宣告，JSON Schema 產生與走訪，欄位種類判斷、放置區位置、範例頁面產生，以及檢查規格 §4.3 寫法規則的 `checkSpecRules`。同時把 zod 鎖在 4.6.5（scoped override）、讓 `pnpm typecheck` 改走 turbo、在 root ESLint 設定寫入 C.4 的全部規則、把 `packages/spec` 納入 audit gate。Task 8–9 的轉換器與驗證器、Task 10 的 8 個區塊都建在這個 task 之上；測試專用規格 `src/__fixtures__/test-specs.ts` 也在這裡建立。

**執行位置**：主工作目錄 `/Users/kaellim/Desktop/projects/puck`，分支 `s2/block-spec`。

**設計決定與說明**：
- **取用 core 的方式**：`packages/spec` 以 `"@tzuchi/tceditor": "workspace:*"` 取用 core 的 `dist`（Global Constraints），只 import `@tzuchi/tceditor/rules`（Task 5）。`turbo.json` 的 `test` 與新的 `typecheck` 都加 `dependsOn: ["^build"]`（`build` 本來就有），所以 `pnpm test`、`pnpm typecheck` 會先 build core，不會讀到過期的 `dist`（gaps #1、#20）。`@tzuchi/tceditor#test` 這筆專屬設定沒有 `dependsOn`，core 也沒有需要先 build 的 workspace 依賴，所以不動。
- **jest**：設定照抄 core（`ts-jest/presets/js-with-ts-esm`），只把 `testEnvironment` 改成 `node`、拿掉 CSS mapper 與 `transformIgnorePatterns`。實測：jest 沒有 `--experimental-vm-modules`，所以實際以 CommonJS 執行，`zod` 經 `require` 條件載入 `index.cjs`，`@tzuchi/tceditor/rules` 載入 Task 5 的 `dist/rules.js`，兩者都正常（gaps #5）。`packages/tsconfig/base.json` 設了 `isolatedModules: true`，ts-jest 29.4.9 因此只轉譯不檢查型別（core 也一樣），所以型別錯誤由 `pnpm typecheck` 抓：spec 的 `tsconfig.json` 把 `src` 全部（含 `__tests__`、`__fixtures__`、`__typetests__`）與 `jest.config.ts` 都納入。
- **tsconfig**：extends `../tsconfig/base.json`（`skipLibCheck: true`，避開 zod `.d.cts` 參照 DOM `URL` 的錯誤，zod-ajv §3 末段），`moduleResolution: "bundler"`（gaps #4），`lib`／`target` 為 ES2022，`types: ["node", "jest"]`。`@types/node` 自行宣告 `24.13.2`，不吃 root hoist 的 17.0.45（gaps #59，`structuredClone` 需要較新的型別）。
- **依賴版本**：新增依賴一律精確版本：`zod` `4.6.5`；devDependencies 用 lockfile 已解析的版本 `jest` `29.7.0`、`ts-jest` `29.4.9`、`@types/jest` `29.5.14`、`typescript` `5.9.3`、`eslint` `9.39.4`（repo-infra §6），不會引入新版本。`ts-node`（jest 讀 `jest.config.ts` 用）由 `autoInstallPeers` 解析到既有的 10.9.2。
- **zod override**：`pnpm-workspace.yaml` 加 `"zod@^4": "4.6.5"`。只改 zod 4，chromium-bidi 的 `^3.24.1` 維持 zod 3（gaps C4、zod-ajv §0.3）。實測 install 後 `pnpm why zod -r` 只剩 `zod 4.6.5`（eslint-plugin-react-hooks、zod-validation-error 的 peer）與 `zod 3.25.76`（chromium-bidi），lockfile 不再有 `zod@4.4.3`。
- **meta 與拼錯的 key**：`GlobalMeta` augmentation 只能檢查已宣告 key 的值型別（zod-ajv §3，規格 §18 #2），所以拼錯的 key（例如 `"x-lables"`）由 `checkSpecRules` 的 `"meta-keys"` 規則抓：JSON Schema 每個節點的 key 只能是 `SCHEMA_KEYWORDS`（zod 對允許的寫法會輸出的 JSON Schema 關鍵字）或 `META_KEYS`。實測 zod 4.6.5 會把非 JSON 的 meta 值悄悄轉成 `null`，所以「值必須是 JSON」（規則 6）改在 `GlobalMeta` 加 `examples?: JsonValue[]` 由 tsc 把關；其他 meta key 的值型別本來就已宣告。
- **meta 只能放 title、description、examples、deprecated 與 `x-*`（規則 6）**：`GlobalMeta` 有 index signature，`.meta({ additionalProperties: false })`、`.meta({ type: "number" })` 都能編譯，而且會蓋掉 zod 產生的值（一般 `z.object` 因此通過 `strict-objects`，卻仍會丟掉多餘的 key；JSON Schema 說 number、zod 說 string）。`checkSpecRules` 因此再用 `metadata: z.registry()`（空的 registry）產生一份「沒有任何 meta」的 JSON Schema，逐節點比對：`.meta()` 加的 key 必須在 `META_KEYS`，zod 產生的關鍵字不能被改。`type` 是陣列（`.nullable()`、基本型別的 union）也算違規：一個欄位只能有一種 JSON 型別，Task 8 的 `fieldKindOf` 也無法判斷這種節點。
- **只屬於 helper 的 key**：converters 與驗證器信任 `x-slot`、`x-richtext`、`x-image`、`x-link`、`x-lost-checks`（例如 `x-richtext.features` 決定編輯器開放哪些格式，`x-lost-checks` 告訴 MCP 與資料庫哪些檢查只有伺服器做）。作者自己寫這些 key 會讓編輯器與 zod 不一致（例如把 `features` 改大，編輯器開放標題，zod 卻刪掉標題，就是 B-01 那類資料遺失）。所以 `GlobalMeta` 把它們宣告成 `?: never`，`.meta()` 寫到就 tsc 失敗；helper 以 `HelperMeta` 寫入後 cast。繞過型別的寫法（JavaScript、`as`）由 `checkSpecRules` 擋：`x-slot` 必須掛在 `slot()` 的陣列上（`"slot-shape"`），`x-link`／`x-image`／`x-richtext` 一個節點最多一個、JSON 型別要對、`x-lost-checks` 必須剛好是那個 helper 的那一項（`"meta-keys"`）。只有「從 helper 原樣抄一份 meta 再蓋上去」這種刻意的寫法還擋不住，型別已經禁止。
- **`Object.prototype` 的名稱**：欄位名稱是 `constructor`、`toString` 這類名稱時，頁面資料沒有這個 prop，zod 就會讀到 `Object.prototype` 上的函式（`expected string, received function`，不會套用預設值），Puck 的 `props[name]` 也一樣（CLAUDE.md「以資料為 key 的物件」同一類問題）。`"reserved-name"` 因此也擋 `Object.prototype` 自己的屬性名稱；`RESERVED_FIELD_NAMES` 維持 C.2 的 4 個。
- **輔助函式**（全部只用 `import * as z from "zod"`，zod-ajv §9）：
  - `link()`：必填版 `min(1)`（讓 Ajv 也擋得下空字串，gaps #21）、`max(2048)`、`refine(isSafeHref)`、`.prefault("")`（缺少時在 `href` 得到錯誤，zod-ajv §6、§11）；選填版允許空字串、`.default("")`。長度檢查帶 `abort: true`，讓空字串只回報 `too_small`、超長只回報 `too_big`，不會同時多一筆語意不符的 `unsafe_href`（zod-ajv §4.1）。不合格時只帶 `params: { code: "unsafe_href" }`、不設 `message`，因為 helper 內的 message 會蓋掉驗證器傳入的中文 error map（zod-ajv §7）。
  - `richText()`：`z.looseObject({ type: z.literal("doc") }).overwrite(v => fitRichTextToTypes(normalizeRichText(v), richTextFeaturesToTypes(features)))`，再 cast 成 `z.ZodType<RichTextDoc, RichTextDoc>`（zod-ajv §4.4，規格 §18 #24）。`richTextFeaturesToTypes` 的 `textAlign: false` 讓對齊一律被移除（規格 §18 #10：刪掉 paragraph／heading 的 `attrs.textAlign`，`attrs` 變空就整個拿掉，與沒有 TextAlign 的編輯器 `getJSON()` 形狀相同）。字串會被拒絕，和 JSON Schema 的 `type: "object"` 一致。`removes text alignment, leaving no attrs` 斷言清理後的段落沒有 `attrs`。
  - `slot()`：`z.array(z.strictObject({ type, props: z.record(...) })).default(() => [])`，預設值寫成函式（zod-ajv §4.5、§5）。allow／disallow 擇一、至少一個名稱，並複製一份，避免呼叫端之後改動陣列。
  - `image()`：物件層 `refine` 加 `path: ["alt"]`、`params: { code: "alt_required" }`，再 `.prefault(() => ({ assetId: "", alt: "", decorative: false }))`，缺少圖片時在 `assetId`（與 `alt`）得到錯誤（zod-ajv §6）。
  - `style()`／`token()` 在內層 enum 掛 `x-style`／`x-token`，作者之後的 `.default().meta({ title, "x-labels" })` 會和它合併輸出到同一個 JSON 節點（zod-ajv §2 p02c）。`choice`／`style`／`token` 拒絕空陣列、空字串與重複值；`richText` 拒絕未知或重複的功能名稱。
  - 回傳型別都是具體的 zod 類別（見 Interfaces），作者可以再接 `.default()`、`.meta()`，`z.output` 也正確；`src/__typetests__/output-types.ts` 用 tsc 驗證測試規格的 `z.output`、`z.input` 與作者常用的鏈式寫法。
- **`toJsonSchema`**：以 `spec.props` 為 key 存在 `WeakMap`，回傳深層凍結的物件。實測 zod 產生 JSON Schema 時會複製預設值與 meta，凍結不會影響 parse 的結果或作者的 meta 物件。
- **`eachField`**：深度優先、依屬性順序；進入一般物件的 `properties` 與物件陣列 `items.properties`（路徑段 `"[]"`）；放置區、富文字、圖片是葉節點（只走訪本身）。`checkSpecRules` 的欄位規則（title、名稱、保留字、放置區結構）都用它；非欄位節點（陣列 items、record、union）另由規則內部的完整走訪處理。
- **`checkSpecRules`**：13 種 `SpecRuleId` 各有一個反例測試，`Record<SpecRuleId, …>` 讓新增規則卻沒加測試時 tsc 失敗；`"meta-keys"` 與 `"reserved-name"` 的補強（見上面兩點）另有專屬測試。`"strict-objects"` 跳過 `slot()` 內部（子區塊的 `props` record）與 `richText()` 的 looseObject。`"slot-shape"`（規格 §4.3 規則 8）把每個欄位算成「放置區結構簽章」（`slot`、`{name:…}`、`array<{name:…}>`，不含放置區時為 null），同一個欄位名稱只要有一處含放置區，所有區塊與根節點裡同名欄位的簽章都必須相同；例如 `columns` 在 Pair 是 `array<{content:slot}>`，另一個區塊寫成 `array<{body:slot}>` 就違規。「每個 example 都通過驗證」不在這裡（會和驗證器循環依賴），由 Task 9、10 的測試負責。
- **`exampleToPageData`**：頂層 id `${type}-ex${index + 1}`；子區塊 id 是「父節點 id + 放置區的資料路徑 + 子區塊在陣列中的索引（從 0 起算）」以 `-` 相接，例如 Pair 的範例得到 `Pair-ex1-columns-1-content-0`。因為只拿到一份規格，子區塊（含孫區塊）以結構辨認放置區：非空陣列、每一項都恰好是 `{ type, props }`。輸出是新物件，不和規格的範例共用參照；不補預設值（驗證器負責）。
- **ESLint（C.4）**：全部寫在 root `eslint.config.mjs`（各 package 從自己的目錄執行 `eslint` 時也用 root 設定，gaps C1）。flat config 中後面的同名規則會整個取代前面的設定，所以每個區塊都重複列出仍要生效的 selector：全域的「import `@heroui/react` 必須 `'use client'`」、四個新套件／app 的 zod 匯入規則、`packages/spec` 的執行期匯入限制、`spec.ts` 的 refine 類方法與匯入限制、公開頁與 view 的匯入限制。zod 規則用 `no-restricted-syntax` 擋 `"zod"` 與 `"zod/v4"` 的預設匯入與值的具名匯入（`zod/v4` 同樣會打包全部語系，zod-ajv §9；`no-restricted-imports` 的 `importNames` 會連 `import * as z` 一起擋，所以不用它），用 `no-restricted-imports` 的 pattern 擋 `zod/v4/locales/*` 等；另外擋 `z.config(…)`、`z.locales` 與 `zod/compile`，對應 Global Constraints「不修改 zod 的全域設定」。`spec.ts` 除了 C.4 的 7 個方法，另外擋 `z.preprocess`、`.catch`、`.toLowerCase`、`.toUpperCase`、`.normalize`（JSON Schema 表達不了、會悄悄改值或吞掉錯誤），以及「在 `.meta()` 的結果上再呼叫方法」（`.meta().default()`、`.meta().meta()`；規格 §4.3 規則 1–2：`.meta()` 放在最後、只呼叫一次）。`PUBLIC_IMPORTS` 維持 C.4 的三個路徑名稱：Task 11 會以它的結尾為錨點，替 `render-config.tsx` 補上 `./editor-config`、`./image/editor`。目標路徑大多還不存在，Step 18 用暫時的探針檔確認每條規則都會觸發。
- **`packages/spec` 的執行期匯入限制**（規格 §3.1、§3.2：spec 是純 TypeScript，只依賴 zod 與 rules 入口；C.4 沒有列，這裡補上）：`packages/spec/src` 的非測試檔以 `no-restricted-imports`（`SPEC_PACKAGE_IMPORTS`）擋 `react`、`react-dom` 與它們的子路徑、core 主入口 `@tzuchi/tceditor`（`allowTypeImports: true`：`convert/puck-fields.ts` 要 `import type` 編輯器欄位型別）、`rules` 以外的 core 子路徑（pattern `["@tzuchi/tceditor/*", "!@tzuchi/tceditor/rules"]`）、`@heroui/*`、`@tzuchi/tokens`、`@tzuchi/tceditor-blocks`，以及只給測試用的 devDependency `ajv`。測試檔（`__tests__`、`__helpers__`、`__fixtures__`、`__typetests__`）以 `ignores` 排除，它們只套用 zod 區塊。這個區塊排在 zod 區塊之後、同樣比對 `packages/spec/src` 的檔案，會整個取代 zod 區塊的 `no-restricted-imports`，所以 `patterns` 最後再帶上 `ZOD_IMPORT_PATTERNS`；`no-restricted-syntax` 不在這個區塊裡，zod 區塊的 selector 照常生效。Task 8、9 的非測試檔對主入口都只有 `import type`，不會被擋（實測：Task 9 結束時的 `packages/spec` lint 沒有 problem）。
- **audit gate**：Task 6 已把 `packages/blocks` 加進 `GATED_IMPORTERS` 並改了註解，本 task 以 Task 6 的文字為錨點，在最後加 `packages/spec`；zod 是 `dependency`，不需要 `BUNDLED_DEV_DEPENDENCIES`（gaps #47）。實測：出貨版本比 Task 6 結束時多 3 個（110 → 113）。其中 `@tzuchi/tceditor@0.1.0` 與 `zod@4.6.5` 是 `packages/spec` 出貨的；`@types/node@17.0.45` 則是 Step 2 的 install 帶來的：加入新的 importer 後，pnpm 把 lockfile 中 `@types/ws@8.18.1`（core 的 `happy-dom` 的依賴）與 jest 系列 snapshot 的 `@types/node` 從 25.8.0 改解析成 17.0.45。這些都只是型別套件，core 的 `typecheck` 照樣通過。

- **測試專用規格**：`src/__fixtures__/test-specs.ts` 的內容就是 Step 4 的程式碼（依 Prettier 2 的換行與結尾逗號排版，`pnpm format:check` 要求）。KitchenSink `body` 的預設值是 `fitRichTextToTypes(textToRichText("內文"), richTextFeaturesToTypes(["bold", "link"]))`。原因：zod 的 `.default()` 不經過 `.overwrite()`（zod-ajv §4.5），預設值原樣進入輸出；只有已清理的形狀，第二次驗證時才不會再被改動。因為 `textAlign: false` 會移除 `attrs.textAlign`（`attrs` 變空就拿掉），這個值是沒有 `attrs` 的段落 `{ type: "doc", content: [{ type: "paragraph", content: [{ type: "text", text: "內文" }] }] }`，是不動點（`helpers.spec.ts` 的 `keeps the test spec's default body on a second parse` 斷言這個字面值與冪等）；Task 10 的 Paragraph 也這樣寫，Task 9 Step 1 會 grep 這一行。Task 8、9 依賴這個檔案。

  - `@tzuchi/tceditor-spec`（`exports`：`"."` → `./src/index.ts`，`"./validator"` → `./src/validator/index.ts`，後者由 Task 9 建立；`"sideEffects": false`）。

  - `src/define.ts`：`BlockExample`、`BlockSpec`、`AnyBlockSpec`、`PageRootSpec`、`BlockProps`、`BLOCK_TYPE_PATTERN`、`DESCRIPTION_MAX_LENGTH`、`defineBlockSpec`、`definePageRoot`，簽名與 C.2 相同。
  - `src/helpers.ts`：
    ```ts
    export const LINK_MAX_LENGTH = 2048;
    export const ASSET_ID_PATTERN: RegExp; // /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$/
    export const IMAGE_ALT_MAX_LENGTH = 200;
    export type ImageValue = { assetId: string; alt: string; decorative: boolean };
    export type SlotItem = { type: string; props: Record<string, unknown> };
    export type SlotItemSchema = z.ZodObject<{ type: z.ZodString; props: z.ZodRecord<z.ZodString, z.ZodUnknown> }, z.core.$strict>;
    export type SlotSchema = z.ZodDefault<z.ZodArray<SlotItemSchema>>;
    export type ImageSchema = z.ZodPrefault<z.ZodObject<{ assetId: z.ZodString; alt: z.ZodString; decorative: z.ZodBoolean }, z.core.$strict>>;
    export type RichTextSchema = z.ZodType<RichTextDoc, RichTextDoc>;
    export function choice<const V extends readonly [string, ...string[]]>(values: V): z.ZodEnum<{ [K in V[number]]: K }>;
    export function style<const V extends readonly [string, ...string[]]>(component: string, key: string, values: V): z.ZodEnum<{ [K in V[number]]: K }>;
    export function token<const V extends readonly [string, ...string[]]>(group: string, values: V): z.ZodEnum<{ [K in V[number]]: K }>;
    export function link(options?: { optional?: false }): z.ZodPrefault<z.ZodString>;
    export function link(options: { optional: true }): z.ZodDefault<z.ZodString>;
    export function richText(options: { features: readonly RichTextFeature[] }): RichTextSchema;
    export function slot(rule: SlotRule): SlotSchema;
    export function image(): ImageSchema;
    ```
    issue 慣例：不安全連結 → `code: "custom"`、`params: { code: "unsafe_href" }`；圖片缺替代文字 → `code: "custom"`、`path` 結尾 `"alt"`、`params: { code: "alt_required" }`；兩者都不帶自訂 message。

```yaml
  yaml: ">=2.8.3"
```

```ts
};
```

````markdown
# @tzuchi/tceditor-spec

撰寫 tceditor 區塊規格的工具：以 zod 4.6.5 宣告每個區塊的 props，再由同一份規格產生 JSON Schema、編輯器欄位、Storybook 控制項、MCP 元件目錄與整頁驗證器。

這個套件是 `private`，以原始碼提供（`exports` 指向 `.ts`），沒有 build 步驟。只依賴 `zod` 與 `@tzuchi/tceditor/rules`，不依賴 React 與 uikit。

    href: link().meta({ title: "連結網址" }),
  }),
  examples: [{ name: "主要按鈕", props: { href: "/register" } }],
});
````

```ts
import * as z from "zod";
import {
  fitRichTextToTypes,
  richTextFeaturesToTypes,
  textToRichText,
} from "@tzuchi/tceditor/rules";
import { defineBlockSpec, definePageRoot } from "../define";
import { choice, image, link, richText, slot, style, token } from "../helpers";

/** 只有一段文字。 */
export const leafSpec = defineBlockSpec({
  type: "Leaf",
  label: "葉",
  category: "測試",
  description: "只有一段文字的測試區塊。",
  version: 1,
  props: z.strictObject({
    text: z.string().min(1).max(20).default("葉子").meta({ title: "文字" }),
  }),
  examples: [{ name: "預設", props: {} }],
});

/** 可以無限巢狀（用來做 33 層與 5,001 個區塊的反例）。 */
export const boxSpec = defineBlockSpec({
  type: "Box",
  label: "盒子",
  category: "測試",
  description: "可以無限巢狀的測試區塊。",
  version: 1,
  props: z.strictObject({
    content: slot({ allow: ["Box", "Leaf"] }).meta({ title: "內容" }),
  }),
  examples: [
    {
      name: "含一片葉子",
      props: { content: [{ type: "Leaf", props: { text: "葉" } }] },
    },
  ],
});

/** 清單裡的放置區（Columns 的測試版）。 */
export const pairSpec = defineBlockSpec({
  type: "Pair",
  label: "兩欄",
  category: "測試",
  description: "清單裡放置區的測試區塊。",
  version: 1,
  props: z.strictObject({
    columns: z
      .array(
        z.strictObject({
          content: slot({ disallow: ["Pair"] }).meta({ title: "內容" }),
        })
      )
      .min(2)
      .max(3)
      .default(() => [{ content: [] }, { content: [] }])
      .meta({ title: "欄", "x-item-label": "第 {n} 欄" }),
  }),
  examples: [
    {
      name: "兩欄各一片葉子",
      props: {
        columns: [
          { content: [{ type: "Leaf", props: { text: "左" } }] },
          { content: [{ type: "Leaf", props: { text: "右" } }] },
        ],
      },
    },
  ],
});

/** 涵蓋 11 種欄位。href 與 picture 的預設值刻意不完整（和 Button、Image 一樣）。 */
export const kitchenSinkSpec = defineBlockSpec({
  type: "KitchenSink",
  label: "全欄位",
  category: "測試",
  description: "涵蓋 11 種欄位的測試區塊。",
  version: 1,
  props: z.strictObject({
    title: z
      .string()
      .min(1)
      .max(40)
      .default("標題")
      .meta({ title: "標題", "x-inline": true }),
    note: z
      .string()
      .max(200)
      .default("")
      .meta({ title: "備註", "x-field": "textarea" }),
    count: z.number().int().min(1).max(10).default(3).meta({ title: "數量" }),
    tone: choice(["calm", "bright", "dark", "warm", "cool"])
      .default("calm")
      .meta({
        title: "色調",
        "x-labels": {
          calm: "沉穩",
          bright: "明亮",
          dark: "深色",
          warm: "暖色",
          cool: "冷色",
        },
      }),
    size: style("button", "size", ["sm", "md", "lg"])
      .default("md")
      .meta({ title: "大小", "x-labels": { sm: "小", md: "中", lg: "大" } }),
    space: token("space", ["16", "32"])
      .default("16")
      .meta({ title: "間距", "x-labels": { "16": "小", "32": "大" } }),
    enabled: z.boolean().default(true).meta({ title: "啟用" }),
    href: link().meta({ title: "連結網址" }),
    moreHref: link({ optional: true }).meta({ title: "更多連結" }),
    // zod 的 .default() 不經過 .overwrite()，所以預設值要先清理成 richText() 的輸出形狀
    body: richText({ features: ["bold", "link"] })
      .default(() =>
        fitRichTextToTypes(
          textToRichText("內文"),
          richTextFeaturesToTypes(["bold", "link"])
        )
      )
      .meta({ title: "內文" }),
    items: z
      .array(
        z.strictObject({
          label: z.string().min(1).max(20).meta({ title: "名稱" }),
        })
      )
      .min(1)
      .max(5)
      .default(() => [{ label: "一" }])
      .meta({ title: "項目", "x-item-label": "{label}" }),
    group: z
      .strictObject({
        caption: z.string().max(40).default("").meta({ title: "說明" }),
        level: z
          .number()
          .int()
          .min(0)
          .max(3)
          .default(0)
          .meta({ title: "層級" }),
      })
      .default(() => ({ caption: "", level: 0 }))
      .meta({ title: "群組" }),
    content: slot({ allow: ["Leaf"] }).meta({ title: "內容" }),
    picture: image().meta({ title: "圖片" }),
  }),
  examples: [
    {
      name: "填好必填欄位",
      props: {
        href: "/register",
        picture: { assetId: "demo-1", alt: "示意圖", decorative: false },
        content: [{ type: "Leaf", props: { text: "子" } }],
      },
    },
  ],
});

export const testBlocks = [
  kitchenSinkSpec,
  boxSpec,
  leafSpec,
  pairSpec,
] as const;

export const testRoot = definePageRoot({
  props: z.strictObject({
    title: z
      .string()
      .min(1)
      .max(80)
      .default("未命名頁面")
      .meta({ title: "頁面標題" }),
    description: z
      .string()
      .max(160)
      .default("")
      .meta({ title: "頁面說明", "x-field": "textarea" }),
  }),
});
```

建立 `packages/spec/src/__tests__/define.spec.ts`：

```ts
import * as z from "zod";
import { defineBlockSpec, definePageRoot } from "../define";

const props = z.strictObject({
  text: z.string().default("字").meta({ title: "文字" }),
});

const valid = {
  type: "Sample",
  label: "範例",
  category: "測試",
  description: "說明",
  version: 1,
  props,
  examples: [{ name: "預設", props: {} }],
} as const;

describe("defineBlockSpec", () => {
  it("returns a frozen spec with deprecated defaulting to false", () => {
    const spec = defineBlockSpec(valid);

    expect(spec).toEqual({
      kind: "block",
      type: "Sample",
      label: "範例",
      category: "測試",
      description: "說明",
      version: 1,
      deprecated: false,
      props,
      examples: [{ name: "預設", props: {} }],
    });
    expect(Object.isFrozen(spec)).toBe(true);
    expect(Object.isFrozen(spec.examples)).toBe(true);
    expect(defineBlockSpec({ ...valid, deprecated: true }).deprecated).toBe(
      true
    );
  });

  it("accepts type names of 1 to 27 characters", () => {
    expect(defineBlockSpec({ ...valid, type: "A" }).type).toBe("A");
    expect(
      defineBlockSpec({ ...valid, type: `A${"b".repeat(26)}` }).type
    ).toHaveLength(27);
  });

  it.each([
    ["a lowercase first letter", "button"],
    ["a dash", "My-Block"],
    ["28 characters", `A${"b".repeat(27)}`],
    ["an empty name", ""],
  ])("rejects a type name with %s", (_case, type) => {
    expect(() => defineBlockSpec({ ...valid, type })).toThrow(
      /defineBlockSpec: type .* must match/
    );
  });

  it("reserves Root for the page root", () => {
    expect(() => defineBlockSpec({ ...valid, type: "Root" })).toThrow(
      'type "Root" is reserved'
    );
  });

  it("rejects an empty label or category", () => {
    expect(() => defineBlockSpec({ ...valid, label: " " })).toThrow(
      "label must not be empty"
    );
    expect(() => defineBlockSpec({ ...valid, category: "" })).toThrow(
      "category must not be empty"
    );
  });

  it("limits the description to 4,096 characters", () => {
    expect(
      defineBlockSpec({ ...valid, description: "字".repeat(4096) }).description
    ).toHaveLength(4096);
    expect(() =>
      defineBlockSpec({ ...valid, description: "字".repeat(4097) })
    ).toThrow("description must be a string of at most 4096 characters");
  });

  it.each([0, -1, 1.5, Number.NaN])("rejects version %p", (version) => {
    expect(() => defineBlockSpec({ ...valid, version })).toThrow(
      "version must be a positive integer"
    );
  });

  it("needs at least one example", () => {
    expect(() =>
      defineBlockSpec({
        ...valid,
        examples: [] as unknown as typeof valid.examples,
      })
    ).toThrow("at least one example is required");
  });

  it.each([
    ["z.object", z.object({ text: z.string().meta({ title: "文字" }) })],
    [
      "z.looseObject",
      z.looseObject({ text: z.string().meta({ title: "文字" }) }),
    ],
  ])("rejects props built with %s", (_case, loose) => {
    expect(() =>
      defineBlockSpec({
        ...valid,
        props: loose,
        examples: [{ name: "x", props: { text: "a" } }],
      })
    ).toThrow("props must be a z.strictObject");
  });

  it("throws TypeError", () => {
    expect(() => defineBlockSpec({ ...valid, type: "x" })).toThrow(TypeError);
  });
});

describe("definePageRoot", () => {
  it("defaults the label to 頁面", () => {
    const root = definePageRoot({ props });

    expect(root).toEqual({ kind: "root", label: "頁面", props });
    expect(Object.isFrozen(root)).toBe(true);
    expect(definePageRoot({ label: "活動頁", props }).label).toBe("活動頁");
  });

  it("rejects an empty label and non-strict props", () => {
    expect(() => definePageRoot({ label: "", props })).toThrow(TypeError);
    expect(() => definePageRoot({ props: z.object({}) })).toThrow(
      "props must be a z.strictObject"
    );
  });
});
```

建立 `packages/spec/src/__tests__/helpers.spec.ts`：

```ts
import * as z from "zod";
import type { RichTextFeature, RichTextNode } from "@tzuchi/tceditor/rules";
import { choice, image, link, richText, slot, style, token } from "../helpers";
import type { SlotRule } from "../meta";
import { toJsonSchema } from "../json-schema";
import { kitchenSinkSpec } from "../__fixtures__/test-specs";

const OPTIONS = {
  target: "draft-2020-12",
  io: "input",
  reused: "inline",
  cycles: "ref",
} as const;

/** The JSON Schema of one field, as it appears inside a props object. */
const fieldSchema = (schema: z.ZodType) =>
  (
    z.toJSONSchema(z.strictObject({ f: schema }), OPTIONS) as unknown as {
      properties: { f: Record<string, unknown> };
    }
  ).properties.f;

const issuesOf = (schema: z.ZodType, value: unknown) => {
  const result = z
    .strictObject({ f: schema })
    .safeParse(value === undefined ? {} : { f: value });

  return result.success
    ? []
    : result.error.issues.map((issue) => ({
        code: issue.code,
        path: issue.path,
        ...("params" in issue && issue.params ? { params: issue.params } : {}),
      }));
};

const KITCHEN_SINK = toJsonSchema(kitchenSinkSpec) as {
  properties: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>>;
};

describe("choice, style and token", () => {
  it("emit an enum and keep the helper meta under the author's meta", () => {
    expect(KITCHEN_SINK.properties.tone).toEqual({
      default: "calm",
      title: "色調",
      "x-labels": {
        calm: "沉穩",
        bright: "明亮",
        dark: "深色",
        warm: "暖色",
        cool: "冷色",
      },
      type: "string",
      enum: ["calm", "bright", "dark", "warm", "cool"],
    });
    expect(KITCHEN_SINK.properties.size).toMatchObject({
      enum: ["sm", "md", "lg"],
      "x-style": { component: "button", key: "size" },
      "x-labels": { sm: "小", md: "中", lg: "大" },
    });
    expect(KITCHEN_SINK.properties.space).toMatchObject({
      enum: ["16", "32"],
      "x-token": { group: "space" },
    });
  });

  it("parse only the listed values", () => {
    const size = style("button", "size", ["sm", "md"]);

    expect(size.parse("md")).toBe("md");
    expect(issuesOf(size, "xl")).toEqual([
      { code: "invalid_value", path: ["f"] },
    ]);
  });

  it("reject empty or duplicate values", () => {
    expect(() => choice([""])).toThrow(TypeError);
    expect(() => choice(["a", "a"])).toThrow("duplicate value");
    expect(() => style("", "size", ["sm"])).toThrow(TypeError);
    expect(() => token("", ["16"])).toThrow(TypeError);
  });
});

describe("link", () => {
  const UNSAFE = [
    "javascript:alert(1)",
    "JaVaScRiPt:alert(1)",
    " javascript:alert(1)",
    "java\tscript:alert(1)",
    "&#106;avascript:alert(1)",
    "data:text/html,<b>x</b>",
    "vbscript:msgbox(1)",
  ];

  it("emits the required link as a non-empty string with an empty default", () => {
    expect(KITCHEN_SINK.properties.href).toEqual({
      "x-link": { optional: false },
      "x-lost-checks": ["safe-href"],
      title: "連結網址",
      default: "",
      type: "string",
      minLength: 1,
      maxLength: 2048,
    });
  });

  it("emits the optional link without minLength", () => {
    expect(KITCHEN_SINK.properties.moreHref).toEqual({
      default: "",
      "x-link": { optional: true },
      "x-lost-checks": ["safe-href"],
      title: "更多連結",
      type: "string",
      maxLength: 2048,
    });
  });

  it("accepts http, https, mailto, tel and relative links", () => {
    for (const href of [
      "/register",
      "https://tzuchi.org.tw",
      "http://example.org/a?b#c",
      "mailto:info@tzuchi.org.tw",
      "tel:+886-3-856-1825",
      "#top",
    ]) {
      expect(issuesOf(link(), href)).toEqual([]);
      expect(issuesOf(link({ optional: true }), href)).toEqual([]);
    }
  });

  it.each(UNSAFE)("rejects %j with the unsafe_href code", (href) => {
    const expected = [
      { code: "custom", path: ["f"], params: { code: "unsafe_href" } },
    ];

    expect(issuesOf(link(), href)).toEqual(expected);
    expect(issuesOf(link({ optional: true }), href)).toEqual(expected);
  });

  it("reports a missing or empty required link once, as too_small", () => {
    expect(issuesOf(link(), undefined)).toEqual([
      { code: "too_small", path: ["f"] },
    ]);
    expect(issuesOf(link(), "")).toEqual([{ code: "too_small", path: ["f"] }]);
  });

  it("reports a link over 2,048 characters once, as too_big", () => {
    const long = `/${"a".repeat(2048)}`;

    expect(issuesOf(link(), long)).toEqual([{ code: "too_big", path: ["f"] }]);
    expect(issuesOf(link({ optional: true }), long)).toEqual([
      { code: "too_big", path: ["f"] },
    ]);
    expect(issuesOf(link(), `/${"a".repeat(2047)}`)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("lets the optional link be empty or missing", () => {
    const schema = z.strictObject({ f: link({ optional: true }) });

    expect(schema.parse({})).toEqual({ f: "" });
    expect(schema.parse({ f: "" })).toEqual({ f: "" });
  });

  it("leaves the message to the caller's error map", () => {
    const result = z
      .strictObject({ f: link() })
      .safeParse({ f: "javascript:alert(1)" }, { error: () => "自訂訊息" });

    expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    expect(result.error?.issues[0].message).toBe("自訂訊息");
  });
});

describe("richText", () => {
  const bodyOnly = () => richText({ features: ["bold", "link"] });

  const collect = (nodes: RichTextNode[] | undefined, out: RichTextNode[]) => {
    for (const node of nodes ?? []) {
      out.push(node);
      collect(node.content, out);
    }

    return out;
  };

  const INPUT = {
    type: "doc",
    content: [
      {
        type: "heading",
        attrs: { level: 2, textAlign: "center" },
        content: [{ type: "text", text: "標題" }],
      },
      {
        type: "paragraph",
        attrs: { textAlign: "right" },
        content: [
          { type: "text", text: "粗", marks: [{ type: "bold" }] },
          { type: "text", text: "斜", marks: [{ type: "italic" }] },
          {
            type: "text",
            text: "壞連結",
            marks: [{ type: "link", attrs: { href: "javascript:alert(1)" } }],
          },
          {
            type: "text",
            text: "好連結",
            marks: [{ type: "link", attrs: { href: "https://tzuchi.org.tw" } }],
          },
        ],
      },
      {
        type: "blockquote",
        content: [
          { type: "paragraph", content: [{ type: "text", text: "引言" }] },
        ],
      },
      { type: "evil", content: [{ type: "text", text: "怪" }] },
    ],
    evil: true,
  };

  it("emits an object with the features and the lost check", () => {
    expect(fieldSchema(bodyOnly())).toEqual({
      type: "object",
      properties: { type: { type: "string", const: "doc" } },
      required: ["type"],
      additionalProperties: {},
      "x-richtext": { features: ["bold", "link"] },
      "x-lost-checks": ["richtext-normalize"],
    });
  });

  it("normalizes, then keeps only the listed features", () => {
    const output = bodyOnly().parse(INPUT);
    const nodes = collect(output.content, []);

    expect(Object.keys(output)).toEqual(["type", "content"]);
    // The heading and the blockquote become paragraphs, the unknown node keeps
    // its text.
    expect(output.content?.map((node) => node.type)).toEqual([
      "paragraph",
      "paragraph",
      "paragraph",
      "paragraph",
    ]);
    expect(
      [...new Set(nodes.map((node) => node.type))].sort((a, b) =>
        a.localeCompare(b)
      )
    ).toEqual(["paragraph", "text"]);
    // italic and the unsafe link are dropped, so their texts merge.
    expect(output.content?.[1].content).toEqual([
      { type: "text", marks: [{ type: "bold" }], text: "粗" },
      { type: "text", text: "斜壞連結" },
      {
        type: "text",
        marks: [
          {
            type: "link",
            attrs: {
              href: "https://tzuchi.org.tw",
              target: "_blank",
              rel: "noopener noreferrer nofollow",
              class: null,
              title: null,
            },
          },
        ],
        text: "好連結",
      },
    ]);
    expect(
      nodes
        .filter((node) => node.type === "text")
        .map((node) => node.text)
        .join("")
    ).toBe("標題粗斜壞連結好連結引言怪");
  });

  it("removes text alignment, leaving no attrs", () => {
    const output = bodyOnly().parse(INPUT);

    // The shape an editor without TextAlign emits: textAlign is removed, and
    // so is the attrs object it leaves empty.
    for (const node of output.content ?? []) {
      expect(node).not.toHaveProperty("attrs");
    }
  });

  it("keeps a document it has already cleaned as it is", () => {
    const once = bodyOnly().parse(INPUT);

    expect(bodyOnly().parse(once)).toEqual(once);
  });

  it("keeps the test spec's default body on a second parse", () => {
    // .default() skips .overwrite(), so the default must already be clean.
    const once = kitchenSinkSpec.props.parse(kitchenSinkSpec.examples[0].props);

    expect(once.body).toStrictEqual({
      type: "doc",
      content: [
        { type: "paragraph", content: [{ type: "text", text: "內文" }] },
      ],
    });
    expect(kitchenSinkSpec.props.parse(once)).toEqual(once);
  });

  it("rejects strings and documents of another type", () => {
    expect(issuesOf(bodyOnly(), "<b>legacy</b>")).toEqual([
      { code: "invalid_type", path: ["f"] },
    ]);
    expect(issuesOf(bodyOnly(), { type: "paragraph" })).toEqual([
      { code: "invalid_value", path: ["f", "type"] },
    ]);
  });

  it("rejects unknown or duplicate features", () => {
    expect(() =>
      richText({ features: ["bold", "italics" as RichTextFeature] })
    ).toThrow(TypeError);
    expect(() => richText({ features: ["bold", "bold"] })).toThrow(
      "duplicate feature"
    );
  });
});

describe("slot", () => {
  it("emits an array of { type, props } items with an empty default", () => {
    expect(KITCHEN_SINK.properties.content).toEqual({
      default: [],
      "x-slot": { allow: ["Leaf"] },
      title: "內容",
      type: "array",
      items: {
        type: "object",
        properties: {
          type: { type: "string" },
          props: {
            type: "object",
            propertyNames: { type: "string" },
            additionalProperties: {},
          },
        },
        required: ["type", "props"],
        additionalProperties: false,
      },
    });
  });

  it("defaults to a new empty array and passes child props through", () => {
    const schema = z.strictObject({ content: slot({ allow: ["Leaf"] }) });
    const first = schema.parse({});
    const child = { type: "Leaf", props: { id: "a", text: "x" } };
    const parsed = schema.parse({ content: [child] });

    expect(first).toEqual({ content: [] });
    expect(schema.parse({}).content).not.toBe(first.content);
    expect(parsed.content).toEqual([child]);
    expect(parsed.content[0].props).not.toBe(child.props);
  });

  it("rejects other keys on a child", () => {
    expect(
      issuesOf(slot({ allow: ["Leaf"] }), [
        { type: "Leaf", props: {}, readOnly: {} },
      ])
    ).toEqual([{ code: "unrecognized_keys", path: ["f", 0] }]);
  });

  it("needs exactly one non-empty allow or disallow list", () => {
    expect(() =>
      slot({ allow: ["Leaf"], disallow: ["Box"] } as unknown as SlotRule)
    ).toThrow(TypeError);
    expect(() => slot({} as SlotRule)).toThrow(TypeError);
    expect(() => slot({ allow: [] })).toThrow(TypeError);
    expect(() => slot({ disallow: [""] })).toThrow(TypeError);
  });

  it("copies the rule", () => {
    const allow = ["Leaf"];
    const schema = slot({ allow });

    allow.push("Box");
    expect(fieldSchema(schema)["x-slot"]).toEqual({ allow: ["Leaf"] });
  });
});

describe("image", () => {
  it("emits a strict object with the incomplete default", () => {
    expect(KITCHEN_SINK.properties.picture).toEqual({
      "x-image": true,
      "x-lost-checks": ["alt-required"],
      title: "圖片",
      default: { assetId: "", alt: "", decorative: false },
      type: "object",
      properties: {
        assetId: {
          type: "string",
          pattern: "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$",
          title: "圖片",
        },
        alt: { type: "string", maxLength: 200, title: "替代文字" },
        decorative: { type: "boolean", title: "裝飾用圖片" },
      },
      required: ["assetId", "alt", "decorative"],
      additionalProperties: false,
    });
  });

  it("fails a missing image at assetId and alt", () => {
    expect(issuesOf(image(), undefined)).toEqual([
      { code: "invalid_format", path: ["f", "assetId"] },
      { code: "custom", path: ["f", "alt"], params: { code: "alt_required" } },
    ]);
  });

  it("requires alt text unless the image is decorative", () => {
    expect(
      issuesOf(image(), { assetId: "demo-1", alt: "示意圖", decorative: false })
    ).toEqual([]);
    expect(
      issuesOf(image(), { assetId: "demo-1", alt: "", decorative: true })
    ).toEqual([]);
    expect(
      issuesOf(image(), { assetId: "demo-1", alt: "  ", decorative: false })
    ).toEqual([
      { code: "custom", path: ["f", "alt"], params: { code: "alt_required" } },
    ]);
  });

  it("checks the asset id, the alt length and unknown keys", () => {
    expect(
      issuesOf(image(), { assetId: "bad id!", alt: "a", decorative: false })
    ).toEqual([{ code: "invalid_format", path: ["f", "assetId"] }]);
    expect(
      issuesOf(image(), {
        assetId: "a".repeat(65),
        alt: "a",
        decorative: false,
      })
    ).toEqual([{ code: "invalid_format", path: ["f", "assetId"] }]);
    expect(
      issuesOf(image(), {
        assetId: "demo-1",
        alt: "字".repeat(201),
        decorative: false,
      })
    ).toEqual([{ code: "too_big", path: ["f", "alt"] }]);
    expect(
      issuesOf(image(), {
        assetId: "demo-1",
        alt: "a",
        decorative: false,
        src: "https://evil.example",
      })
    ).toEqual([{ code: "unrecognized_keys", path: ["f"] }]);
  });
});
```

```ts
import * as z from "zod";
import { defineBlockSpec } from "../define";
import {
  JSON_SCHEMA_OPTIONS,
  eachField,
  fieldPathKey,
  toJsonSchema,
} from "../json-schema";
import type { JsonSchema } from "../json-schema";
import {
  kitchenSinkSpec,
  pairSpec,
  testRoot,
} from "../__fixtures__/test-specs";

const visits = (schema: JsonSchema) => {
  const out: {
    key: string;
    name: string;
    required: boolean;
    title: unknown;
  }[] = [];

  eachField(schema, ({ path, name, node, parentRequired }) => {
    out.push({
      key: fieldPathKey(path),
      name,
      required: parentRequired,
      title: node.title,
    });
  });

  return out;
};

describe("toJsonSchema", () => {
  it("uses the spec §5.1 settings", () => {
    expect(JSON_SCHEMA_OPTIONS).toEqual({
      target: "draft-2020-12",
      io: "input",
      reused: "inline",
      cycles: "ref",
    });
    expect(toJsonSchema(testRoot)).toEqual({
      $schema: "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
      type: "object",
      properties: {
        title: {
          default: "未命名頁面",
          title: "頁面標題",
          type: "string",
          minLength: 1,
          maxLength: 80,
        },
        description: {
          default: "",
          title: "頁面說明",
          "x-field": "textarea",
          type: "string",
          maxLength: 160,
        },
      },
      additionalProperties: false,
    });
  });

  it("returns the same deeply frozen object on every call", () => {
    const schema = toJsonSchema(kitchenSinkSpec);
    const properties = schema.properties as Record<string, JsonSchema>;

    expect(toJsonSchema(kitchenSinkSpec)).toBe(schema);
    expect(Object.isFrozen(schema)).toBe(true);
    expect(Object.isFrozen(properties.items.items)).toBe(true);
    expect(Object.isFrozen(properties.picture.default)).toBe(true);
    expect(() => {
      properties.title = {};
    }).toThrow(TypeError);
  });

  it("lists only the fields without defaults as required", () => {
    const spec = defineBlockSpec({
      type: "Required",
      label: "必填",
      category: "測試",
      description: "",
      version: 1,
      props: z.strictObject({
        name: z.string().meta({ title: "名稱" }),
        note: z.string().default("").meta({ title: "備註" }),
      }),
      examples: [{ name: "x", props: { name: "a" } }],
    });

    expect(toJsonSchema(spec).required).toEqual(["name"]);
    expect(toJsonSchema(kitchenSinkSpec).required).toBeUndefined();
  });
});

describe("eachField", () => {
  it("visits fields depth-first and does not enter slots, rich text or images", () => {
    expect(visits(toJsonSchema(kitchenSinkSpec))).toEqual([
      { key: "title", name: "title", required: false, title: "標題" },
      { key: "note", name: "note", required: false, title: "備註" },
      { key: "count", name: "count", required: false, title: "數量" },
      { key: "tone", name: "tone", required: false, title: "色調" },
      { key: "size", name: "size", required: false, title: "大小" },
      { key: "space", name: "space", required: false, title: "間距" },
      { key: "enabled", name: "enabled", required: false, title: "啟用" },
      { key: "href", name: "href", required: false, title: "連結網址" },
      { key: "moreHref", name: "moreHref", required: false, title: "更多連結" },
      { key: "body", name: "body", required: false, title: "內文" },
      { key: "items", name: "items", required: false, title: "項目" },
      { key: "items[].label", name: "label", required: true, title: "名稱" },
      { key: "group", name: "group", required: false, title: "群組" },
      { key: "group.caption", name: "caption", required: false, title: "說明" },
      { key: "group.level", name: "level", required: false, title: "層級" },
      { key: "content", name: "content", required: false, title: "內容" },
      { key: "picture", name: "picture", required: false, title: "圖片" },
    ]);
  });

  it("gives array items the [] path segment", () => {
    const paths: (readonly string[])[] = [];

    eachField(toJsonSchema(pairSpec), ({ path }) => paths.push(path));
    expect(paths).toEqual([["columns"], ["columns", "[]", "content"]]);
  });

  it("joins paths for messages", () => {
    expect(fieldPathKey(["columns", "[]", "content"])).toBe(
      "columns[].content"
    );
    expect(fieldPathKey(["group", "level"])).toBe("group.level");
    expect(fieldPathKey([])).toBe("");
  });
});
```

```ts
import type { RichTextFeature } from "@tzuchi/tceditor/rules";

/**
 * The `x-*` keys a spec may put in `.meta()`. Converters read them from the
 * JSON Schema (never from zod objects), and the page validator's Ajv tests
 * register exactly this list as keywords.
 */
export const X_KEYS = [
  "x-labels",
  "x-inline",
  "x-field",
  "x-item-label",
  "x-style",
  "x-token",
  "x-slot",
  "x-richtext",
  "x-image",
  "x-link",
  "x-lost-checks",
] as const;

export type XKey = (typeof X_KEYS)[number];

/** Every key `.meta()` may set. `id` is left out on purpose: it turns the node into a `$ref`. */
export const META_KEYS = [
  "title",
  "description",
  "examples",
  "deprecated",
  ...X_KEYS,
] as const;

export type MetaKey = (typeof META_KEYS)[number];

/**
 * Checks that JSON Schema cannot express. A helper lists the checks it adds in
 * `x-lost-checks`, so the MCP catalog and the database know that only the
 * server-side validator enforces them.
 */
export const LOST_CHECKS = [
  "safe-href",
  "alt-required",
  "richtext-normalize",
] as const;

export type LostCheck = (typeof LOST_CHECKS)[number];

/** A value that survives JSON.stringify unchanged. */
export type JsonValue =
  | string
  | number
  | boolean
  | null
  | JsonValue[]
  | { [key: string]: JsonValue };

/** Which block types a slot accepts: either an allow list or a disallow list. */
export type SlotRule = { allow: string[] } | { disallow: string[] };

/**
 * The meta that only slot(), richText(), image() and link() write. The
 * converters and the page validator trust these keys, so GlobalMeta types
 * them as `never`: a spec that writes them in .meta() fails to compile, and
 * checkSpecRules reports the ones that get past the types.
 */
export type HelperMeta = {
  "x-slot"?: SlotRule;
  "x-richtext"?: { features: RichTextFeature[] };
  "x-image"?: true;
  "x-link"?: { optional: boolean };
  "x-lost-checks"?: LostCheck[];
};

// zod's JSONSchemaMeta has an index signature, so this only types the values
// of these keys: a misspelled key still compiles. checkSpecRules catches it
// with the "meta-keys" rule. zod turns other non-JSON meta values into null
// without an error, so `examples` is typed here as well.
declare module "zod" {
  interface GlobalMeta {
    examples?: JsonValue[];
    "x-labels"?: Record<string, string>;
    "x-inline"?: true;
    "x-field"?: "textarea";
    "x-item-label"?: string;
    "x-style"?: { component: string; key: string };
    "x-token"?: { group: string };
    // Written by the helpers only (HelperMeta).
    "x-slot"?: never;
    "x-richtext"?: never;
    "x-image"?: never;
    "x-link"?: never;
    "x-lost-checks"?: never;
  }
}
```

```ts
import type * as z from "zod";

export type BlockExample<P extends z.ZodObject = z.ZodObject> = {
  name: string;
  props: z.input<P>;
};

export type BlockSpec<
  T extends string = string,
  P extends z.ZodObject = z.ZodObject
> = Readonly<{
  kind: "block";
  type: T;
  label: string;
  category: string;
  description: string;
  version: number;
  deprecated: boolean;
  props: P;
  examples: readonly BlockExample<P>[];
}>;

export type AnyBlockSpec = BlockSpec<string, z.ZodObject>;

export type PageRootSpec<P extends z.ZodObject = z.ZodObject> = Readonly<{
  kind: "root";
  label: string;
  props: P;
}>;

export type BlockProps<S extends AnyBlockSpec | PageRootSpec> = z.output<
  S["props"]
>;

/**
 * Block type names. At most 27 characters, because the editor creates ids as
 * `${type}-${uuid}` (type length + 37) and node ids are limited to 64.
 */
export const BLOCK_TYPE_PATTERN = /^[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]{0,26}$/;

/** Longest allowed `description`, in characters. */
export const DESCRIPTION_MAX_LENGTH = 4096;

const fail = (fn: string, message: string): never => {
  throw new TypeError(`${fn}: ${message}`);
};

const isNonEmptyString = (value: unknown): value is string =>
  typeof value === "string" && value.trim() !== "";

/** True for a schema built with z.strictObject (an object whose catchall is z.never()). */
const isStrictObject = (schema: unknown): boolean => {
  const def = (
    schema as {
      def?: { type?: unknown; catchall?: { def?: { type?: unknown } } };
    }
  )?.def;

  return def?.type === "object" && def.catchall?.def?.type === "never";
};

/**
 * Declares a block. Checks at definition time that the type name matches
 * BLOCK_TYPE_PATTERN and is not "Root", that label and category are not
 * empty, that the description has at most 4,096 characters, that version is a
 * positive integer, that there is at least one example, and that props is a
 * z.strictObject. Throws a TypeError otherwise. The rules that need the JSON
 * Schema or the other blocks are in checkSpecRules.
 */
export function defineBlockSpec<
  const T extends string,
  P extends z.ZodObject
>(input: {
  type: T;
  label: string;
  category: string;
  description: string;
  version: number;
  deprecated?: boolean;
  props: P;
  examples: readonly [BlockExample<P>, ...BlockExample<P>[]];
}): BlockSpec<T, P> {
  const fn = "defineBlockSpec";
  const { type } = input;

  if (typeof type !== "string" || !BLOCK_TYPE_PATTERN.test(type)) {
    fail(fn, `type ${JSON.stringify(type)} must match ${BLOCK_TYPE_PATTERN}`);
  }
  if (type === "Root") fail(fn, `type "Root" is reserved for the page root`);
  if (!isNonEmptyString(input.label)) {
    fail(fn, `${type}: label must not be empty`);
  }
  if (!isNonEmptyString(input.category)) {
    fail(fn, `${type}: category must not be empty`);
  }
  if (
    typeof input.description !== "string" ||
    input.description.length > DESCRIPTION_MAX_LENGTH
  ) {
    fail(
      fn,
      `${type}: description must be a string of at most ${DESCRIPTION_MAX_LENGTH} characters`
    );
  }
  if (!Number.isInteger(input.version) || input.version < 1) {
    fail(fn, `${type}: version must be a positive integer`);
  }
  if (!isStrictObject(input.props)) {
    fail(fn, `${type}: props must be a z.strictObject`);
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(input.examples) || input.examples.length === 0) {
    fail(fn, `${type}: at least one example is required`);
  }

  return Object.freeze({
    kind: "block",
    type,
    label: input.label,
    category: input.category,
    description: input.description,
    version: input.version,
    deprecated: input.deprecated ?? false,
    props: input.props,
    examples: Object.freeze([...input.examples]),
  });
}

/** Declares the page root (page title, description, …). `label` defaults to "頁面". */
export function definePageRoot<P extends z.ZodObject>(input: {
  label?: string;
  props: P;
}): PageRootSpec<P> {
  const fn = "definePageRoot";
  const label = input.label ?? "頁面";

  if (!isNonEmptyString(label)) fail(fn, "label must not be empty");
  if (!isStrictObject(input.props)) {
    fail(fn, "props must be a z.strictObject");
  }

  return Object.freeze({ kind: "root", label, props: input.props });
}
```

```ts
import * as z from "zod";
import {
  fitRichTextToTypes,
  isRichTextFeature,
  isSafeHref,
  normalizeRichText,
  richTextFeaturesToTypes,
} from "@tzuchi/tceditor/rules";
import type { RichTextDoc, RichTextFeature } from "@tzuchi/tceditor/rules";
import type { HelperMeta, SlotRule } from "./meta";

/** Longest link, in characters. */
export const LINK_MAX_LENGTH = 2048;
/** Asset ids, as stored in image values. */
export const ASSET_ID_PATTERN = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$/;
/** Longest image alt text, in characters. */
export const IMAGE_ALT_MAX_LENGTH = 200;

export type ImageValue = { assetId: string; alt: string; decorative: boolean };
export type SlotItem = { type: string; props: Record<string, unknown> };

type EnumValues = readonly [string, ...string[]];
type EnumOf<V extends EnumValues> = z.ZodEnum<{ [K in V[number]]: K }>;

/** The schema of a slot item: the page validator checks the child itself. */
export type SlotItemSchema = z.ZodObject<
  { type: z.ZodString; props: z.ZodRecord<z.ZodString, z.ZodUnknown> },
  z.core.$strict
>;
export type SlotSchema = z.ZodDefault<z.ZodArray<SlotItemSchema>>;
export type ImageSchema = z.ZodPrefault<
  z.ZodObject<
    { assetId: z.ZodString; alt: z.ZodString; decorative: z.ZodBoolean },
    z.core.$strict
  >
>;
export type RichTextSchema = z.ZodType<RichTextDoc, RichTextDoc>;

const fail = (helper: string, message: string): never => {
  throw new TypeError(`${helper}(): ${message}`);
};

/** GlobalMeta types the helper-only keys as never, so the helpers cast. */
const helperMeta = (meta: HelperMeta) => meta as z.GlobalMeta;

function enumOf<const V extends EnumValues>(
  helper: string,
  values: V
): EnumOf<V> {
  if (!Array.isArray(values) || values.length === 0) {
    fail(helper, "needs at least one value");
  }
  for (const value of values) {
    if (typeof value !== "string" || value === "") {
      fail(helper, "values must be non-empty strings");
    }
  }
  if (new Set(values).size !== values.length) {
    fail(helper, `duplicate value in ${JSON.stringify(values)}`);
  }

  return z.enum(values);
}

/** A fixed set of options, for example an image ratio. Add the labels with `x-labels`. */
export function choice<const V extends EnumValues>(values: V): EnumOf<V> {
  return enumOf("choice", values);
}

/**
 * Options picked from a uikit component's style variants, for example
 * style("button", "variant", ["primary", "outline"]). Records
 * `x-style: { component, key }`; the blocks tests check the options against
 * the uikit snapshot.
 */
export function style<const V extends EnumValues>(
  component: string,
  key: string,
  values: V
): EnumOf<V> {
  if (component === "" || key === "") {
    fail("style", "component and key must not be empty");
  }

  return enumOf("style", values).meta({ "x-style": { component, key } });
}

/**
 * Options that name a design token shared across components, for example
 * token("space", ["16", "32"]) for --tc-space-16 and --tc-space-32. Records
 * `x-token: { group }`.
 */
export function token<const V extends EnumValues>(
  group: string,
  values: V
): EnumOf<V> {
  if (group === "") fail("token", "group must not be empty");

  return enumOf("token", values).meta({ "x-token": { group } });
}

const unsafeHref = { params: { code: "unsafe_href" } };

/**
 * A link: at most 2,048 characters that isSafeHref accepts (http, https,
 * mailto, tel and relative URLs). The required version rejects "" and uses
 * `.prefault("")`, so a page that leaves the link out fails on this field
 * instead of passing with an empty link. The optional version accepts "" (no
 * link) and defaults to it.
 *
 * Length errors stop the checks (`abort`), so "" only reports too_small and
 * a 3,000-character value only too_big. An unsafe value reports a "custom"
 * issue with `params: { code: "unsafe_href" }` and no message: the page
 * validator writes the message.
 */
export function link(options?: {
  optional?: false;
}): z.ZodPrefault<z.ZodString>;
export function link(options: { optional: true }): z.ZodDefault<z.ZodString>;
export function link(
  options: { optional?: boolean } = {}
): z.ZodPrefault<z.ZodString> | z.ZodDefault<z.ZodString> {
  const optional = options.optional === true;
  const meta = helperMeta({
    "x-link": { optional },
    "x-lost-checks": ["safe-href"],
  });

  if (optional) {
    return z
      .string()
      .max(LINK_MAX_LENGTH, { abort: true })
      .refine((value) => value === "" || isSafeHref(value), unsafeHref)
      .default("")
      .meta(meta);
  }

  return z
    .string()
    .min(1, { abort: true })
    .max(LINK_MAX_LENGTH, { abort: true })
    .refine((value) => isSafeHref(value), unsafeHref)
    .prefault("")
    .meta(meta);
}

/**
 * Rich text stored as Tiptap JSON. The value goes through normalizeRichText,
 * then fitRichTextToTypes with the listed features: anything else, including
 * text alignment, becomes plain text. paragraph, text and doc are always on.
 * A string is rejected (convert legacy HTML with richtext-migrate first), so
 * zod agrees with the JSON Schema's `type: "object"`.
 */
export function richText(options: {
  features: readonly RichTextFeature[];
}): RichTextSchema {
  const features = [...(options?.features ?? [])];

  for (const feature of features) {
    if (!isRichTextFeature(feature)) {
      fail("richText", `unknown feature ${JSON.stringify(feature)}`);
    }
  }
  if (new Set(features).size !== features.length) {
    fail("richText", `duplicate feature in ${JSON.stringify(features)}`);
  }

  const types = richTextFeaturesToTypes(features);
  // The cast gives z.output = RichTextDoc; without it zod infers the
  // looseObject shape { type: "doc"; [k: string]: unknown }.
  const schema = z
    .looseObject({ type: z.literal("doc") })
    .overwrite((value) =>
      fitRichTextToTypes(normalizeRichText(value), types)
    ) as unknown as RichTextSchema;

  return schema.meta(
    helperMeta({
      "x-richtext": { features },
      "x-lost-checks": ["richtext-normalize"],
    })
  );
}

const validateSlotRule = (rule: SlotRule): SlotRule => {
  const value = rule as Partial<Record<"allow" | "disallow", unknown>>;
  const hasAllow =
    value !== null && typeof value === "object" && "allow" in value;
  const hasDisallow =
    value !== null && typeof value === "object" && "disallow" in value;

  if (hasAllow === hasDisallow) {
    fail("slot", "pass exactly one of allow and disallow");
  }

  const names = hasAllow ? value.allow : value.disallow;

  if (
    !Array.isArray(names) ||
    names.length === 0 ||
    names.some((name) => typeof name !== "string" || name === "")
  ) {
    fail("slot", "the list needs at least one block type name");
  }

  return hasAllow
    ? { allow: [...(names as string[])] }
    : { disallow: [...(names as string[])] };
};

/**
 * A slot: an array of `{ type, props }` children, empty by default. The page
 * validator checks each child with its own block spec and the allow or
 * disallow rule (`x-slot`). The names must be registered block types
 * (checkSpecRules, rule "slot-targets").
 */
export function slot(rule: SlotRule): SlotSchema {
  const xSlot = validateSlotRule(rule);
  const item: SlotItemSchema = z.strictObject({
    type: z.string(),
    props: z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()),
  });

  return z
    .array(item)
    .default(() => [])
    .meta(helperMeta({ "x-slot": xSlot }));
}

/**
 * An image: `{ assetId, alt, decorative }`. assetId must match
 * ASSET_ID_PATTERN (S2 does not check that the asset exists), alt has at most
 * 200 characters, and alt must not be blank unless decorative is true (a
 * "custom" issue at `alt` with `params: { code: "alt_required" }`). The
 * default is deliberately incomplete and goes through `.prefault()`, so a page
 * that leaves the image out fails at `assetId`.
 */
export function image(): ImageSchema {
  return z
    .strictObject({
      assetId: z.string().regex(ASSET_ID_PATTERN).meta({ title: "圖片" }),
      alt: z.string().max(IMAGE_ALT_MAX_LENGTH).meta({ title: "替代文字" }),
      decorative: z.boolean().meta({ title: "裝飾用圖片" }),
    })
    .refine((value) => value.decorative || value.alt.trim() !== "", {
      path: ["alt"],
      params: { code: "alt_required" },
    })
    .prefault(() => ({ assetId: "", alt: "", decorative: false }))
    .meta(helperMeta({ "x-image": true, "x-lost-checks": ["alt-required"] }));
}
```

```ts
import * as z from "zod";
import type { AnyBlockSpec, PageRootSpec } from "./define";

/** The zod JSON Schema settings for the editor, Storybook and the MCP catalog (spec §5.1). */
export const JSON_SCHEMA_OPTIONS = {
  target: "draft-2020-12",
  io: "input",
  reused: "inline",
  cycles: "ref",
} as const;

export type JsonSchema = { [keyword: string]: unknown };

export type FieldVisit = {
  /** Field names from the props root; "[]" stands for "every item", e.g. ["columns", "[]", "content"]. */
  path: readonly string[];
  name: string;
  node: JsonSchema;
  /** Whether the object that holds this field lists it in `required`. */
  parentRequired: boolean;
};

const hasOwn = (value: object, key: string): boolean =>
  Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(value, key);

export const isJsonSchemaNode = (value: unknown): value is JsonSchema =>
  typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);

function deepFreeze<T>(value: T): T {
  if (typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Object.isFrozen(value)) {
    Object.freeze(value);
    for (const key of Object.keys(value)) {
      deepFreeze((value as Record<string, unknown>)[key]);
    }
  }

  return value;
}

const cache = new WeakMap<z.ZodObject, JsonSchema>();

/**
 * The JSON Schema of a spec's props (JSON_SCHEMA_OPTIONS). Cached per props
 * schema and deeply frozen: callers that need to change it must structuredClone
 * it first.
 */
export function toJsonSchema(spec: AnyBlockSpec | PageRootSpec): JsonSchema {
  const cached = cache.get(spec.props);

  if (cached) return cached;

  const schema = deepFreeze(
    z.toJSONSchema(spec.props, JSON_SCHEMA_OPTIONS) as JsonSchema
  );

  cache.set(spec.props, schema);

  return schema;
}

/** Joins a field path for messages and keys: ["columns", "[]", "content"] → "columns[].content". */
export function fieldPathKey(path: readonly string[]): string {
  let key = "";

  for (const segment of path) {
    key += segment === "[]" ? "[]" : key === "" ? segment : `.${segment}`;
  }

  return key;
}

/** Slot, rich text and image fields are leaves: their inner schema is not made of fields. */
const isLeafField = (node: JsonSchema): boolean =>
  hasOwn(node, "x-slot") ||
  hasOwn(node, "x-richtext") ||
  hasOwn(node, "x-image");

function eachProperty(
  object: JsonSchema,
  prefix: readonly string[],
  visit: (field: FieldVisit) => void
) {
  const { properties } = object;

  if (!isJsonSchemaNode(properties)) return;

  const required = Array.isArray(object.required) ? object.required : [];

  for (const name of Object.keys(properties)) {
    const node = properties[name];

    if (!isJsonSchemaNode(node)) continue;

    const path = [...prefix, name];

    visit({ path, name, node, parentRequired: required.indexOf(name) !== -1 });

    if (isLeafField(node)) continue;

    if (node.type === "object") {
      eachProperty(node, path, visit);
    } else if (
      node.type === "array" &&
      isJsonSchemaNode(node.items) &&
      node.items.type === "object"
    ) {
      eachProperty(node.items, [...path, "[]"], visit);
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Visits every field depth-first in property order: the root's properties,
 * the properties of object fields and of the items of array fields. Slot,
 * rich text and image fields are visited but not entered.
 */
export function eachField(
  schema: JsonSchema,
  visit: (field: FieldVisit) => void
): void {
  eachProperty(schema, [], visit);
}
```

```ts
import { fieldKindOf } from "../field-kind";
import type { FieldKind } from "../field-kind";
import { toJsonSchema } from "../json-schema";
import type { JsonSchema } from "../json-schema";
import { kitchenSinkSpec } from "../__fixtures__/test-specs";

const properties = toJsonSchema(kitchenSinkSpec).properties as Record<
  string,
  JsonSchema
>;

describe("fieldKindOf", () => {
  it("covers all 11 kinds with the test spec", () => {
    const kinds = Object.fromEntries(
      Object.entries(properties).map(([name, node]) => [
        name,
        fieldKindOf(node),
      ])
    );

    expect(kinds).toEqual({
      title: "text",
      note: "textarea",
      count: "number",
      tone: "choice",
      size: "choice",
      space: "choice",
      enabled: "boolean",
      href: "link",
      moreHref: "link",
      body: "richtext",
      items: "array",
      group: "object",
      content: "slot",
      picture: "image",
    });
    expect(new Set(Object.values(kinds)).size).toBe(11);
  });

  it("reads nested fields too", () => {
    const items = properties.items.items as {
      properties: Record<string, JsonSchema>;
    };
    const group = properties.group as {
      properties: Record<string, JsonSchema>;
    };

    expect(fieldKindOf(items.properties.label)).toBe<FieldKind>("text");
    expect(fieldKindOf(group.properties.level)).toBe<FieldKind>("number");
  });

  it("checks the x- markers before the JSON type", () => {
    expect(fieldKindOf({ type: "string", enum: ["a"], "x-link": {} })).toBe(
      "link"
    );
    expect(fieldKindOf({ type: "number" })).toBe("number");
  });

  it("throws for nodes it cannot map", () => {
    expect(() => fieldKindOf({ type: ["string", "null"] })).toThrow(TypeError);
    expect(() => fieldKindOf({ anyOf: [{ type: "string" }] })).toThrow(
      "fieldKindOf: unsupported schema node"
    );
  });
});
```

```ts
import type { JsonSchema } from "./json-schema";

export type FieldKind =
  | "text"
  | "textarea"
  | "number"
  | "choice"
  | "boolean"
  | "link"
  | "richtext"
  | "array"
  | "object"
  | "slot"
  | "image";

const hasOwn = (value: object, key: string): boolean =>
  Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(value, key);

/**
 * The field kind of a JSON Schema property (spec §4.2). Checked in this
 * order: x-slot, x-image, x-richtext, x-link, enum, string with
 * x-field "textarea", string, integer or number, boolean, array, object.
 * Throws a TypeError for anything else, for example a nullable field.
 */
export function fieldKindOf(node: JsonSchema): FieldKind {
  if (hasOwn(node, "x-slot")) return "slot";
  if (hasOwn(node, "x-image")) return "image";
  if (hasOwn(node, "x-richtext")) return "richtext";
  if (hasOwn(node, "x-link")) return "link";
  if (Array.isArray(node.enum)) return "choice";

  switch (node.type) {
    case "string":
      return node["x-field"] === "textarea" ? "textarea" : "text";
    case "integer":
    case "number":
      return "number";
    case "boolean":
      return "boolean";
    case "array":
      return "array";
    case "object":
      return "object";
  }

  throw new TypeError(
    `fieldKindOf: unsupported schema node with type ${JSON.stringify(
      node.type
    )}`
  );
}
```

建立 `packages/spec/src/slots.ts`：

```ts
import type { AnyBlockSpec } from "./define";
import { eachField, fieldPathKey, toJsonSchema } from "./json-schema";
import type { SlotRule } from "./meta";

export type SlotLocation = {
  /** Field path, e.g. ["columns", "[]", "content"]. */
  path: readonly string[];
  /** The path as a string, e.g. "content" or "columns[].content". */
  key: string;
  rule: SlotRule;
};

/** Every slot of a block, in field order (read from the JSON Schema's `x-slot`). */
export function slotLocations(spec: AnyBlockSpec): readonly SlotLocation[] {
  const locations: SlotLocation[] = [];

  eachField(toJsonSchema(spec), ({ path, node }) => {
    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(node, "x-slot")) {
      locations.push({
        path,
        key: fieldPathKey(path),
        rule: node["x-slot"] as SlotRule,
      });
    }
  });

  return Object.freeze(locations);
}
```

建立 `packages/spec/src/page-data.ts`：

```ts
import type { AnyBlockSpec } from "./define";

export type BlockNode = {
  type: string;
  props: { id: string } & Record<string, unknown>;
};

export type PageData = {
  root: { props: Record<string, unknown> };
  content: BlockNode[];
};

type Item = { type: string; props: Record<string, unknown> };

const isRecord = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> =>
  typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);

const isSlotItem = (value: unknown): value is Item =>
  isRecord(value) &&
  Object.keys(value).length === 2 &&
  typeof value.type === "string" &&
  isRecord(value.props);

/** Children are recognised by shape: a non-empty array whose items are all exactly `{ type, props }`. */
const isSlotValue = (value: unknown): value is Item[] =>
  Array.isArray(value) && value.length > 0 && value.every(isSlotItem);

function withIds(
  value: unknown,
  ownerId: string,
  path: readonly (string | number)[]
): unknown {
  if (isSlotValue(value)) {
    return value.map((item, index) => ({
      type: item.type,
      props: nodeProps(item.props, [ownerId, ...path, index].join("-")),
    }));
  }
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    return value.map((item, index) => withIds(item, ownerId, [...path, index]));
  }
  if (isRecord(value)) {
    return Object.fromEntries(
      Object.entries(value).map(([key, item]) => [
        key,
        withIds(item, ownerId, [...path, key]),
      ])
    );
  }

  return value;
}

function nodeProps(
  props: Record<string, unknown>,
  id: string
): BlockNode["props"] {
  const rest = Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(props)
      .filter(([key]) => key !== "id")
      .map(([key, value]) => [key, withIds(value, id, [key])])
  );

  return { id, ...rest };
}

/**
 * A page that holds only `spec.examples[index]`, with deterministic ids: the
 * block is `${type}-ex${index + 1}`, and a child in a slot is its parent's id,
 * the data path to the slot and the child's index (from 0), joined with "-":
 * "Columns-ex1-columns-0-content-1" is the second child of the first column.
 * An `id` already in a child's props is replaced. The props are copied, not
 * shared with the spec, and defaults are not filled in (the page validator
 * does that).
 */
export function exampleToPageData(
  spec: AnyBlockSpec,
  index: number,
  rootProps: Record<string, unknown> = {}
): PageData {
  const example = Number.isInteger(index) ? spec.examples[index] : undefined;

  if (!example) {
    throw new RangeError(
      `exampleToPageData: ${spec.type} has no example at index ${index}`
    );
  }

  return {
    root: { props: structuredClone(rootProps) },
    content: [
      {
        type: spec.type,
        props: nodeProps(
          example.props as Record<string, unknown>,
          `${spec.type}-ex${index + 1}`
        ),
      },
    ],
  };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 14: 實作 spec-rules.ts**

建立 `packages/spec/src/spec-rules.ts`：

```ts
import * as z from "zod";
import { BLOCK_TYPE_PATTERN } from "./define";
import type { AnyBlockSpec, PageRootSpec } from "./define";
import {
  JSON_SCHEMA_OPTIONS,
  eachField,
  fieldPathKey,
  isJsonSchemaNode,
  toJsonSchema,
} from "./json-schema";
import type { JsonSchema } from "./json-schema";
import { META_KEYS } from "./meta";
import type { LostCheck } from "./meta";

export type SpecRuleId =
  | "type-name"
  | "unique-type"
  | "root-object"
  | "no-ref"
  | "strict-objects"
  | "object-arrays"
  | "title-required"
  | "field-name"
  | "reserved-name"
  | "meta-keys"
  | "slot-shape"
  | "slot-targets"
  | "example-count";

export type SpecRuleViolation = {
  rule: SpecRuleId;
  /** The block type, or "root" for the page root. */
  type: string;
  /** Where in the props schema, e.g. "columns[].content"; "" for the spec itself. */
  path: string;
  message: string;
};

export const RESERVED_FIELD_NAMES = [
  "id",
  "puck",
  "editMode",
  "children",
] as const;

/** The intersection of Puck's field names and MCP's property key rules. */
export const FIELD_NAME_PATTERN = /^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,63}$/;

/**
 * JSON Schema keywords that zod emits for the constructs a spec may use.
 * Anything else on a schema node (a misspelled meta key, `anyOf` from a union,
 * `format` from `z.email()`, …) breaks the "meta-keys" rule, and so does one of
 * these keywords when .meta() sets it.
 */
export const SCHEMA_KEYWORDS = [
  "$schema",
  "type",
  "properties",
  "required",
  "additionalProperties",
  "items",
  "enum",
  "const",
  "default",
  "minLength",
  "maxLength",
  "pattern",
  "minimum",
  "maximum",
  "exclusiveMinimum",
  "exclusiveMaximum",
  "multipleOf",
  "minItems",
  "maxItems",
  "propertyNames",
] as const;

const ALLOWED_KEYS = new Set<string>([...SCHEMA_KEYWORDS, ...META_KEYS]);
const META_KEY_SET = new Set<string>(META_KEYS);
const REF_KEYS = ["$ref", "$defs", "definitions"];
const NESTED_KEYS = ["additionalProperties", "propertyNames"];
const LIST_KEYS = ["anyOf", "oneOf", "allOf", "prefixItems"];
const RESERVED = new Set<string>(RESERVED_FIELD_NAMES);

/** The key that link(), image() and richText() write, the check they list in x-lost-checks and their JSON type. */
const HELPER_KEYS: readonly (readonly [string, LostCheck, string])[] = [
  ["x-link", "safe-href", "string"],
  ["x-image", "alt-required", "object"],
  ["x-richtext", "richtext-normalize", "object"],
];

const hasOwn = (value: object, key: string): boolean =>
  Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(value, key);

const childPath = (path: string, segment: string) =>
  path === "" ? segment : `${path}.${segment}`;

const sameJson = (a: unknown, b: unknown) =>
  JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b);

type Report = (rule: SpecRuleId, path: string, message: string) => void;

/**
 * x-link, x-image, x-richtext and x-lost-checks come from link(), image() and
 * richText() only (GlobalMeta types them as never): a node carries at most one
 * of the three helper keys, with the helper's JSON type and exactly the
 * helper's lost check.
 */
function checkHelperKeys(node: JsonSchema, path: string, report: Report) {
  const helpers = HELPER_KEYS.filter(([key]) => hasOwn(node, key));

  if (helpers.length === 0 && !hasOwn(node, "x-lost-checks")) return;

  const [helper] = helpers;

  if (
    helpers.length !== 1 ||
    node.type !== helper[2] ||
    !sameJson(node["x-lost-checks"], [helper[1]])
  ) {
    report(
      "meta-keys",
      path,
      "x-link, x-image, x-richtext and x-lost-checks are written by link(), image() and richText(); do not set them in .meta()"
    );
  }
}

/**
 * Compares a props schema with the one zod generates without any metadata
 * (`bare`): .meta() may only add META_KEYS. It must not add a JSON Schema
 * keyword or change one that zod generates, for example additionalProperties
 * on a z.object or type on a z.string.
 */
function checkMeta(
  withMeta: unknown,
  bare: unknown,
  path: string,
  report: Report
) {
  if (!isJsonSchemaNode(withMeta) || !isJsonSchemaNode(bare)) return;
  // A $ref (from .meta({ id })) is reported by "no-ref".
  if (hasOwn(withMeta, "$ref")) return;

  for (const key of Object.keys(withMeta)) {
    const value = withMeta[key];
    const bareValue = bare[key];

    if (!hasOwn(bare, key)) {
      // Keys outside ALLOWED_KEYS are reported by checkNode.
      if (ALLOWED_KEYS.has(key) && !META_KEY_SET.has(key)) {
        report("meta-keys", path, `.meta() may not set "${key}"`);
      }
    } else if (
      key === "properties" &&
      isJsonSchemaNode(value) &&
      isJsonSchemaNode(bareValue) &&
      sameJson(Object.keys(value), Object.keys(bareValue))
    ) {
      for (const name of Object.keys(value)) {
        checkMeta(value[name], bareValue[name], childPath(path, name), report);
      }
    } else if (
      key === "items" &&
      isJsonSchemaNode(value) &&
      isJsonSchemaNode(bareValue)
    ) {
      checkMeta(value, bareValue, `${path}[]`, report);
    } else if (
      NESTED_KEYS.indexOf(key) !== -1 &&
      isJsonSchemaNode(value) &&
      isJsonSchemaNode(bareValue)
    ) {
      checkMeta(value, bareValue, `${path}{${key}}`, report);
    } else if (
      LIST_KEYS.indexOf(key) !== -1 &&
      Array.isArray(value) &&
      Array.isArray(bareValue) &&
      value.length === bareValue.length
    ) {
      bareValue.forEach((item, index) =>
        checkMeta(value[index], item, `${path}{${key}[${index}]}`, report)
      );
    } else if (!sameJson(value, bareValue)) {
      report("meta-keys", path, `.meta() may not change "${key}"`);
    }
  }
}

function checkSlotNode(
  node: JsonSchema,
  path: string,
  registered: ReadonlySet<string>,
  report: Report
) {
  const items = node.items;
  const shellOk =
    node.type === "array" &&
    isJsonSchemaNode(items) &&
    items.type === "object" &&
    items.additionalProperties === false &&
    isJsonSchemaNode(items.properties) &&
    Object.keys(items.properties).sort().join(",") === "props,type";

  if (!shellOk) {
    report(
      "slot-shape",
      path,
      "x-slot is only valid on the array that slot() creates"
    );
  }

  const rule = node["x-slot"];
  const names = isJsonSchemaNode(rule)
    ? Array.isArray(rule.allow)
      ? rule.allow
      : rule.disallow
    : undefined;

  if (!Array.isArray(names)) {
    report("slot-targets", path, "x-slot needs an allow or disallow list");

    return;
  }

  for (const name of names) {
    if (typeof name !== "string" || !registered.has(name)) {
      report(
        "slot-targets",
        path,
        `slot rule names ${JSON.stringify(
          name
        )}, which is not a registered block type`
      );
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Checks one node of a props schema and the nodes under it, including the
 * ones that are not fields (array items, records, unions), in document order.
 */
function checkNode(
  node: JsonSchema,
  path: string,
  registered: ReadonlySet<string>,
  report: Report
) {
  for (const key of REF_KEYS) {
    if (hasOwn(node, key)) {
      report(
        "no-ref",
        path,
        `${key} is not allowed: remove .meta({ id }) and use inline schemas`
      );
    }
  }

  for (const key of Object.keys(node)) {
    if (REF_KEYS.indexOf(key) === -1 && !ALLOWED_KEYS.has(key)) {
      report(
        "meta-keys",
        path,
        `"${key}" is not an allowed JSON Schema keyword or meta key`
      );
    }
  }

  // .nullable() and unions of plain types give type: ["string", "null"].
  if (Array.isArray(node.type)) {
    report(
      "meta-keys",
      path,
      "a field has one JSON type: nullable fields and unions are not allowed"
    );
  }

  checkHelperKeys(node, path, report);

  if (hasOwn(node, "x-slot")) {
    // The item shell's props record is open on purpose: the page validator
    // checks each child with its own spec.
    checkSlotNode(node, path, registered, report);

    return;
  }

  // richText() is a looseObject on purpose: zod normalizes the document.
  if (hasOwn(node, "x-richtext")) return;

  if (node.type === "object" && node.additionalProperties !== false) {
    report(
      "strict-objects",
      path,
      "objects must be z.strictObject (additionalProperties: false)"
    );
  }

  if (
    node.type === "array" &&
    !(isJsonSchemaNode(node.items) && node.items.type === "object")
  ) {
    report(
      "object-arrays",
      path,
      'arrays must hold objects, e.g. [{ label: "志工" }] instead of ["志工"]'
    );
  }

  const children: [JsonSchema, string][] = [];

  if (isJsonSchemaNode(node.properties)) {
    for (const name of Object.keys(node.properties)) {
      const child = node.properties[name];

      if (isJsonSchemaNode(child))
        children.push([child, childPath(path, name)]);
    }
  }
  if (isJsonSchemaNode(node.items)) children.push([node.items, `${path}[]`]);

  for (const key of ["additionalProperties", "propertyNames"]) {
    const child = node[key];

    if (isJsonSchemaNode(child)) children.push([child, `${path}{${key}}`]);
  }

  for (const key of ["anyOf", "oneOf", "allOf", "prefixItems"]) {
    const list = node[key];

    if (Array.isArray(list)) {
      list.forEach((child, index) => {
        if (isJsonSchemaNode(child)) {
          children.push([child, `${path}{${key}[${index}]}`]);
        }
      });
    }
  }

  for (const [child, childKey] of children) {
    checkNode(child, childKey, registered, report);
  }
}

/** Where the slots are inside a field: "slot", "{name:…}" or "array<{name:…}>"; null when it holds none. */
function slotSignature(node: JsonSchema): string | null {
  if (hasOwn(node, "x-slot")) return "slot";
  if (hasOwn(node, "x-richtext") || hasOwn(node, "x-image")) return null;
  if (node.type === "object") return objectSignature(node);
  if (
    node.type === "array" &&
    isJsonSchemaNode(node.items) &&
    node.items.type === "object"
  ) {
    const inner = objectSignature(node.items);

    return inner === null ? null : `array<${inner}>`;
  }

  return null;
}

function objectSignature(node: JsonSchema): string | null {
  const { properties } = node;

  if (!isJsonSchemaNode(properties)) return null;

  const parts: string[] = [];

  for (const name of Object.keys(properties).sort()) {
    const child = properties[name];
    const signature = isJsonSchemaNode(child) ? slotSignature(child) : null;

    if (signature !== null) parts.push(`${name}:${signature}`);
  }

  return parts.length > 0 ? `{${parts.join(",")}}` : null;
}

type FieldUse = { type: string; path: string; signature: string | null };

/**
 * Checks the writing rules of spec §4.3 on a set of block specs and the page
 * root: type names, unique types, props that convert to an inline
 * `type: "object"` schema, strict objects (except the slot item's props and
 * rich text), arrays of objects only, a title on every field, field names and
 * reserved names (including Object.prototype's), keys limited to
 * SCHEMA_KEYWORDS and META_KEYS with .meta() adding META_KEYS only, one JSON
 * type per node, helper-only keys left to the helpers, the same structure for
 * every field name that holds slots (rule 8), slot rules that name registered
 * blocks, and at least one example.
 *
 * It only looks at the specs: "every example passes the page validator" is
 * tested with the validator. A spec that zod cannot convert to JSON Schema
 * (for example z.custom()) makes it throw zod's error.
 */
export function checkSpecRules(input: {
  blocks: readonly AnyBlockSpec[];
  root: PageRootSpec;
}): SpecRuleViolation[] {
  const violations: SpecRuleViolation[] = [];
  const registered = new Set(input.blocks.map((spec) => spec.type));
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const fieldUses = new Map<string, FieldUse[]>();

  const checkProps = (type: string, spec: AnyBlockSpec | PageRootSpec) => {
    const report: Report = (rule, path, message) =>
      violations.push({ rule, type, path, message });
    const schema = toJsonSchema(spec);

    if (schema.type !== "object" || hasOwn(schema, "$ref")) {
      report(
        "root-object",
        "",
        'props must convert to an inline schema of type "object"'
      );
    }

    checkNode(schema, "", registered, report);
    checkMeta(
      schema,
      z.toJSONSchema(spec.props, {
        ...JSON_SCHEMA_OPTIONS,
        metadata: z.registry(),
      }),
      "",
      report
    );

    eachField(schema, ({ path, name, node }) => {
      const key = fieldPathKey(path);

      if (typeof node.title !== "string" || node.title.trim() === "") {
        report("title-required", key, `field "${name}" needs a title`);
      }
      if (!FIELD_NAME_PATTERN.test(name)) {
        report(
          "field-name",
          key,
          `field name "${name}" must match ${FIELD_NAME_PATTERN}`
        );
      }
      // Object.prototype names (constructor, toString, …) would read the
      // inherited value when the prop is missing.
      if (RESERVED.has(name) || hasOwn(Object.prototype, name)) {
        report("reserved-name", key, `field name "${name}" is reserved`);
      }

      const uses = fieldUses.get(name) ?? [];

      uses.push({ type, path: key, signature: slotSignature(node) });
      fieldUses.set(name, uses);
    });
  };

  for (const spec of input.blocks) {
    const { type } = spec;

    if (
      typeof type !== "string" ||
      !BLOCK_TYPE_PATTERN.test(type) ||
      type === "Root"
    ) {
      violations.push({
        rule: "type-name",
        type: String(type),
        path: "",
        message: `type must match ${BLOCK_TYPE_PATTERN} and must not be "Root"`,
      });
    }
    if (seen.has(type)) {
      violations.push({
        rule: "unique-type",
        type,
        path: "",
        message: `block type "${type}" is registered more than once`,
      });
    }
    seen.add(type);

    if (!Array.isArray(spec.examples) || spec.examples.length === 0) {
      violations.push({
        rule: "example-count",
        type,
        path: "",
        message: "a block needs at least one example",
      });
    }

    checkProps(type, spec);
  }

  checkProps("root", input.root);

  for (const [name, uses] of fieldUses) {
    if (uses.every((use) => use.signature === null)) continue;

    const [first, ...rest] = uses;

    for (const use of rest) {
      if (use.signature !== first.signature) {
        violations.push({
          rule: "slot-shape",
          type: use.type,
          path: use.path,
          message: `field "${name}" holds slots, so it must have the same structure in every block: ${
            first.type
          } (${first.path}) is ${
            first.signature ?? "not a slot"
          }, this one is ${use.signature ?? "not a slot"}`,
        });
      }
    }
  }

  return violations;
}
```
