- [ ] **Step 17: `pnpm typecheck` 改走 turbo**

修改 root `package.json` 的 `typecheck`：

舊：

```json
    "typecheck": "pnpm --filter ./packages/core typecheck",
```

新：

```json
    "typecheck": "turbo run typecheck",
```

修改 `turbo.json`：

舊：

```json
    "lint": {},
    "test": {},
```

新：

```json
    "lint": {
      "inputs": ["$TURBO_DEFAULT$", "$TURBO_ROOT$/eslint.config.mjs"]
    },
    "test": {
      "dependsOn": ["^build"]
    },
    "typecheck": {
      "dependsOn": ["^build"]
    },
```

`lint` 加 `inputs`：每個套件的 lint 都讀 root `eslint.config.mjs`，turbo 預設不把它算進 hash（`--dry=json` 實測：只改 root 設定時 `@tzuchi/tceditor#lint` 的 hash 不變），所以本 task 與 Task 11、15 修改這個檔之後，沒改到檔案的套件會重播舊的 lint 結果。列出它之後，root 設定一改，每個套件的 lint 都會重跑。

Run: `pnpm typecheck`

Expected：exit 0，turbo 最後印出 `Tasks:    3 successful, 3 total`（`@tzuchi/tceditor#build`、`@tzuchi/tceditor#typecheck`、`@tzuchi/tceditor-spec#typecheck`）。

```js
import custom from "eslint-config-custom";

const TS_FILES = ["**/*.ts", "**/*.tsx"];
const ZOD_PACKAGES = [
  "packages/spec",
  "packages/blocks",
  "apps/showcase",
  "apps/storybook",
];

// @heroui/react exports client components, so a file that imports it must be
// a client component too; a server component that imports it directly only
// builds with Turbopack (spec §6.6, §16).
const USE_CLIENT_FOR_HEROUI_REACT = {
  selector:
    "Program:not(:has(ExpressionStatement[directive='use client'])) ImportDeclaration[source.value=/^@heroui\\/react/]",
  message: "Files that import @heroui/react must start with 'use client'.",
};

// `import { z }` and `import z` (from "zod" or "zod/v4") make esbuild bundle
// every zod locale (about 93 KB gzip instead of 28 KB), which breaks the 60 KB
// edge validator limit. The global config stays untouched: messages go
// through safeParse's `error`.
const ZOD_SYNTAX = [
  {
    selector:
      "ImportDeclaration[source.value=/^zod(\\/v4)?$/] > ImportDefaultSpecifier",
    message: 'Import zod as a namespace: import * as z from "zod".',
  },
  {
    selector:
      "ImportDeclaration[source.value=/^zod(\\/v4)?$/][importKind='value'] > ImportSpecifier[importKind='value']",
    message: 'Import zod as a namespace: import * as z from "zod".',
  },
  {
    selector: "MemberExpression[object.name='z'][property.name='locales']",
    message: "Do not use z.locales: it bundles every zod locale.",
  },
  {
    selector:
      "CallExpression[callee.object.name='z'][callee.property.name='config']",
    message:
      "Do not change zod's global config; pass messages to safeParse instead.",
  },
];

const ZOD_IMPORT_PATTERNS = [
  {
    group: [
      "zod/locales",
      "zod/locales/*",
      "zod/v4/locales",
      "zod/v4/locales/*",
    ],
    message:
      "Do not import zod locales: the page validator writes its own messages.",
  },
  {
    group: ["zod/compile"],
    message: "zod/compile changes zod's global config.",
  },
];

// The rules a block spec.ts must follow (spec §4.3 rules 1-2 and 9, §3.3).
const SPEC_FILE_SYNTAX = [
  {
    // C.4's seven methods, plus the ones that silently change or swallow a
    // value (z.preprocess, .catch, the string case and normalize transforms).
    selector:
      "CallExpression[callee.property.name=/^(refine|superRefine|overwrite|transform|trim|check|pipe|preprocess|catch|toLowerCase|toUpperCase|normalize)$/]",
    message:
      "spec.ts must not use checks that JSON Schema cannot express; add a packages/spec helper and list the check in x-lost-checks.",
  },
  {
    // A call on the result of .meta(): .meta().default(), .meta().meta(), …
    selector:
      "MemberExpression > CallExpression.object[callee.type='MemberExpression'][callee.property.name='meta']",
    message:
      ".meta() must be the last call of a field and is called once (spec §4.3 rules 1-2).",
  },
];

const SPEC_FILE_IMPORTS = {
  paths: [
    { name: "react", message: "spec.ts must not import React." },
    { name: "react-dom", message: "spec.ts must not import React." },
    {
      name: "@tzuchi/tceditor",
      allowTypeImports: true,
      message: "Use @tzuchi/tceditor/rules in spec.ts.",
    },
  ],
  patterns: [
    { group: ["@heroui/*"], message: "spec.ts must not import uikit." },
    ...ZOD_IMPORT_PATTERNS,
  ],
};

// packages/spec is plain TypeScript (spec §3.1, §3.2): at run time it uses
// only zod and @tzuchi/tceditor/rules, and the core main entry only for
// types. Its tests, test helpers, fixtures and type tests are exempt.
const SPEC_PACKAGE_IMPORTS = {
  paths: [
    { name: "react", message: "packages/spec must not depend on React." },
    { name: "react-dom", message: "packages/spec must not depend on React." },
    {
      name: "@tzuchi/tceditor",
      allowTypeImports: true,
      message: "packages/spec may only use @tzuchi/tceditor/rules at run time.",
    },
  ],
  patterns: [
    {
      group: ["react/*", "react-dom/*"],
      message: "packages/spec must not depend on React.",
    },
    {
      group: ["@tzuchi/tceditor/*", "!@tzuchi/tceditor/rules"],
      message: "packages/spec may only use @tzuchi/tceditor/rules at run time.",
    },
    {
      group: [
        "@heroui/*",
        "@tzuchi/tokens",
        "@tzuchi/tokens/*",
        "@tzuchi/tceditor-blocks",
        "@tzuchi/tceditor-blocks/*",
      ],
      message: "packages/spec must not depend on uikit or the blocks.",
    },
    {
      group: ["ajv", "ajv/*"],
      message: "ajv is a devDependency of packages/spec: use it in tests only.",
    },
    ...ZOD_IMPORT_PATTERNS,
  ],
};

// Code that runs on the public pages must not pull in the editor.
const PUBLIC_IMPORTS = {
  paths: [
    {
      name: "@tzuchi/tceditor",
      allowTypeImports: true,
      message:
        "Public pages may only use @tzuchi/tceditor/rsc and @tzuchi/tceditor/rules.",
    },
    {
      name: "@tzuchi/tceditor-blocks/editor",
      message: "Public pages must not import the editor config.",
    },
    {
      name: "../editor-config",
      message: "Public pages must not import the editor config.",
    },
    {
      name: "./editor",
      message: "Views must not import the editor-only image picker.",
    },
  ],
  patterns: ZOD_IMPORT_PATTERNS,
};

const config = [
  {
    ignores: [
      "vendor/**",
      "**/storybook-static/**",
      "apps/storybook/.home/**",
      "apps/showcase/.data/**",
    ],
  },
  ...custom,
  {
    settings: {
      next: {
        rootDir: ["apps/*/"],
      },
    },
    rules: {
      "react-hooks/exhaustive-deps": "off",
      "no-restricted-syntax": ["error", USE_CLIENT_FOR_HEROUI_REACT],
    },
  },
  // In flat config a later block replaces a rule's options instead of merging
  // them, so every block below repeats the selectors that still apply.
  {
    files: ZOD_PACKAGES.flatMap((dir) =>
      TS_FILES.map((glob) => `${dir}/${glob}`)
    ),
    rules: {
      "no-restricted-imports": ["error", { patterns: ZOD_IMPORT_PATTERNS }],
      "no-restricted-syntax": [
        "error",
        USE_CLIENT_FOR_HEROUI_REACT,
        ...ZOD_SYNTAX,
      ],
    },
  },
  {
    files: ["packages/spec/src/**/*.ts", "packages/spec/src/**/*.tsx"],
    ignores: [
      "packages/spec/src/**/__tests__/**",
      "packages/spec/src/**/__helpers__/**",
      "packages/spec/src/**/__fixtures__/**",
      "packages/spec/src/**/__typetests__/**",
    ],
    rules: {
      "no-restricted-imports": ["error", SPEC_PACKAGE_IMPORTS],
    },
  },
  {
    files: ["packages/blocks/src/**/spec.ts"],
    rules: {
      "no-restricted-imports": ["error", SPEC_FILE_IMPORTS],
      "no-restricted-syntax": [
        "error",
        USE_CLIENT_FOR_HEROUI_REACT,
        ...ZOD_SYNTAX,
        ...SPEC_FILE_SYNTAX,
      ],
    },
  },
  {
    files: [
      "packages/blocks/src/**/view.tsx",
      "packages/blocks/src/render-config.tsx",
      "apps/showcase/app/(public)/**/*.ts",
      "apps/showcase/app/(public)/**/*.tsx",
    ],
    rules: {
      "no-restricted-imports": ["error", PUBLIC_IMPORTS],
    },
  },
];

export default config;
```

### Task 8: 轉換器：Puck 欄位、argTypes、catalog、外殼 schema、資料契約

目的：Task 7 已經能把每個規格轉成 JSON Schema（`toJsonSchema`），並以 `x-*` 標出欄位種類。本 task 從這份 JSON Schema 產生四種產物，供 Task 10–15 使用：
- 編輯器的 Puck `fields` 與 `defaultProps`（`toPuckFields`、`toDefaultProps`）；
- Storybook 的 `argTypes` 與 `args`（`toArgTypes`、`toStoryArgs`）；
- 給 S4 的 MCP 元件目錄（`buildCatalog`）；
- 給 S3 的 draft-07 資料庫外殼 schema（`buildPageShellSchema`）。

另外產生每個版本的資料契約，並提供相容性比對（`toDataContract`、`diffContracts`）。轉換器只讀 JSON Schema 與 `x-*`，不讀 zod 的內部結構。全部以 Task 7 的測試專用規格（`src/__fixtures__/test-specs.ts`）驗證，再加上 Ajv 編譯檢查：catalog 用 2020-12，外殼用 draft-07。

**執行位置**：主工作目錄 `/Users/kaellim/Desktop/projects/puck`，分支 `s2/block-spec`。

**設計決定與說明**：

讀取方式
- **只讀 JSON Schema 與 `x-*`。** 欄位種類一律交給 Task 7 的 `fieldKindOf` 判斷。原因（facts/zod-ajv.md §2）：
  - `.meta()` 不在鏈的最後時，外層 schema 執行期的 `.meta()` 會回傳 `undefined`；
  - helper 設的 `x-style` 會被攤平到 JSON 節點上，從 zod 物件反而讀不到。
- `toPuckFields` 自己遞迴 `properties` 與清單的 `items.properties`，沒有用 `eachField`。原因：Puck 的 `arrayFields`／`objectFields` 需要巢狀結構，而 `eachField` 只提供扁平的走訪。
- catalog 與契約要處理所有 schema 節點，不只欄位，所以用新的 `convert/schema-utils.ts` 依 schema 結構走訪：
  - 只把 `properties`、`items`、`additionalProperties`……這些位置的物件當成 schema；
  - `default`、`examples`、`enum`、`x-labels` 這類資料值只深拷貝。
- **不能對整棵 JSON 直接刪 key**：欄位本身可以叫 `title`、`description`（KitchenSink 與頁面根節點都有），直接刪會把欄位一起刪掉。
- `toJsonSchema` 的結果是凍結、共用的（C.2），所有轉換都產生新物件，不修改它。

Puck 欄位（規格 §4.2、C.2、與規格的差異 #4、#18）
- 欄位種類的對應：
  - `text` → `text`；有 `x-inline` 時加 `contentEditable: true`；
  - `textarea` → `textarea`（同樣處理 `x-inline`）；
  - `link` → `text`；
  - `number` → `number`，帶 `min`、`max`，`integer` 再加 `step: 1`；
  - `choice` → 4 個選項以內用 `radio`，否則用 `select`；選項依 enum 順序，標籤取 `x-labels` 的自有屬性；
  - `boolean` → `radio`，選項為 `是`／`否`。radio 可以用布林值，見 core-puck-api §3.3；
  - `richtext` → `{ type: "richtext", contentEditable: true, options: richTextFeaturesToOptions(features) }`。Task 4 已把 richtext 的 `contentEditable` 預設改成 `false`，所以這裡要明確設 `true`；`options` 用 rules 入口的同一個函式產生，見 gaps #15；
  - `array` → `array`，`arrayFields` 遞迴產生，帶 `min`、`max`、`defaultItemProps`、`getItemSummary`；
  - `object` → `object`，`objectFields` 遞迴產生；
  - `slot` → `slot`，`allow`／`disallow` 複製一份。來源陣列是凍結的，複製後編輯器修改也不會出錯；
  - `image` → 呼叫 `factories.image({ name, label })`。`packages/spec` 不得依賴 React，自訂欄位由 blocks 提供（gaps #14）；沒提供時拋 `TypeError`。
- zod 的 `int()` 沒設上下限時，會輸出 `±Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`（zod-ajv §1）。這種值視為沒有上下限，否則 Storybook 會出現範圍 ±9×10¹⁵ 的 range。只讀 `minimum`／`maximum`，因為規格只用 `.min()`／`.max()`。
- **`defaultItemProps`**：
  - Puck 新增清單項目時，只會把放置區子欄位補成 `[]`，其他子欄位不補預設值（core-puck-api §3.3），所以要從項目 schema 的 `default` 組出 `defaultItemProps`；
  - 寫成函式、每次深拷貝。原因：Puck 的 `walkField` 不會複製沒有欄位描述的值，例如圖片物件，如果用同一個物件，多個項目會共用它。
- **`getItemSummary`**：依 `x-item-label` 樣板產生，細節見上方「契約補充」第 6 點。Puck 傳入從 0 起算的 index（core-puck-api §3.3）。
- **型別**：
  - `toPuckFields` 回傳 `Fields<z.output<S["props"]>>`。core-puck-api §3.4 驗證過：型別寫成 `Record<string, Field>` 會無法 `satisfies Fields<Props>`；
  - 內部先組成 `Record<string, Field>`，最後再轉型；
  - 只 `import type` 自 `@tzuchi/tceditor`，因為主入口含編輯器的執行期程式；執行期只 import `@tzuchi/tceditor/rules`。
- **`toDefaultProps`**：
  - 取頂層欄位的 `default`。在 `io: "input"` 下，`prefault` 也會輸出成 `default`（zod-ajv §6），所以 `href` 的 `""` 與 `picture` 的不完整預設值都會出現；
  - 用 `structuredClone` 深拷貝，因為 zod 的 `.default()` 只做淺拷貝（zod-ajv §4.5），而且 JSON Schema 是共用的凍結物件。
  - 不清理富文字。zod 的 `.default()` 不經過 `.overwrite()`，所以規格寫的富文字預設值本身就必須是 `richText()` 輸出的形狀。Task 7 的 KitchenSink `body` 預設值是 `fitRichTextToTypes(textToRichText("內文"), richTextFeaturesToTypes(["bold", "link"]))`；`textAlign: false` 會移除 `attrs.textAlign`，`attrs` 變空就拿掉，所以測試期望的段落沒有 `attrs`。

argTypes（規格 §4.2 最右欄、§5.3）
- 形狀依 frameworks.md §3.5 實測過的 CSF：`options` 加上 `control: { type: "select", labels }`。檔案不 import Storybook 的型別。
- 只處理頂層欄位，key 與規格的欄位名稱相同（§5.5 #4）。
- `range` 只用在兩端都有界的數字。`richtext`、`slot`、`image` 設 `control: false`；`array`、`object` 用 `object`。
- `step` 依序取 `multipleOf`、整數的 `1`、兩端都有界的小數的 `(max - min) / 100`。Storybook 10.6.0 的 `RangeControl` 預設 `step = 1`（`storybook/dist/core-server/presets/common-manager.js`），`{ type: "range", min: 0, max: 1 }` 只能拉到 0 或 1。

catalog（規格 §5.4）
- `props` 去掉 `$schema`、`x-inline`、`x-field`、`x-item-label`、`x-style`、`x-token`、`x-slot`。保留 `x-labels`、`x-lost-checks`、`x-richtext`、`x-image`、`x-link`，讓 AI 知道選項的意思，以及伺服器會另外檢查哪些規則。
- 只要出現 `$ref`、`oneOf`、`anyOf`、`allOf` 就拋 `TypeError`。例如 nullable 的物件會產生 `anyOf`（zod-ajv §2 E）。
- **必填的 `link()` 與 `image()` 加進 `required`**（共用介面 C.2 的 catalog 一項）：
  - 這兩個 helper 用 `.prefault()`（與規格的差異 #3）。在 `io: "input"` 下，prefault 的 key 不列入 `required`，卻會輸出成 `default`（zod-ajv §6）；
  - 預設值刻意不合格：`href` 的 `""` 違反 `minLength: 1`，`picture` 的 `assetId: ""` 違反 pattern；
  - S4 的 AI 或 MCP SDK 的 Ajv（不帶 `useDefaults`）如果照 JSON Schema 原樣讀，會以為可以省略這兩個欄位，送到伺服器才被拒絕；
  - 判斷依據是 `x-link.optional === false` 或有 `x-image`（`schema-utils.ts` 的 `hasFailingDefault`），適用每一層物件，包括清單項目。
- `slots` 把 `allow`／`disallow` 展開：只列已登記、未 `deprecated` 的區塊，依登記順序排列。`deprecated` 的區塊仍然列在 `blocks`，因為既有頁面還能顯示它。
- `examples` 原樣深拷貝，不補預設值。
- `nodeIdPattern` 與 `limits` 來自 `limits.ts`。
- 測試用 `ajv/dist/2020` 的 `Ajv2020({ strict: true })` 編譯，並以 `addVocabulary(X_KEYS)` 註冊所有 `x-*`。strict 模式遇到未註冊的 `x-*` 會拋錯，而且沒有萬用字元（zod-ajv §10.1）。

外殼 schema（規格 §6.5，結構見 zod-ajv §10.2）
- 從所有區塊的 `slotLocations` 收集兩種放置區：直接欄位（`content`），以及物件清單項目裡的欄位（`columns[].content`）。`props` 定義只列 `id` 與這些名稱，其餘一律放行（`additionalProperties: true`）。
- 外殼依名稱辨認放置區（規格 §4.3 rule 8），對所有區塊一體適用。所以要用 Task 7 的 `eachField` 走過每個區塊的欄位，確認同名的欄位在其他區塊也是同樣的結構。否則，例如另一個區塊有 `content: z.string()`，它的合格資料會被外殼拒絕。`buildPageShellSchema` 是獨立的公開 API，不能假設呼叫端已經跑過 `checkSpecRules`。
- 清單項目裡的放置區不設 `required`。驗證器會把缺少的放置區補成 `[]`（Review Focus #4），外殼只做結構檢查，不能比 zod 驗證器更嚴格。
- `type` 的 enum 依登記順序，包含 `deprecated` 區塊。
- 放置區名稱排序，讓產物穩定。每個 `$ref` 單獨成一個物件，因為 draft-07 會忽略 `$ref` 旁邊的關鍵字。不使用任何組合子。
- `zones` 寫成 `{ "type": "object", "maxProperties": 0 }`。
- 外殼不限制巢狀深度。Ajv 的遞迴在 1,500 到 2,000 層之間會拋 `RangeError`，所以深度一律由 zod 驗證器先擋（zod-ajv §10.2）。
- 測試用 ajv 的預設 class（draft-07）以 `strict: true` 編譯。`$schema` 的版本必須和 class 相符（zod-ajv §10.1）。

資料契約（規格 §4.6）
- 去掉 C.2 列的 key，集合排序，物件 key 排序。
- `diffContracts` 的判準是「舊資料在新版會不會被拒絕」：
  - `removed-property`：舊有的欄位不見了；
  - `type-changed`：新的 `type` 沒有涵蓋舊的，但 `integer → number` 不算；
  - `kind-changed`：`fieldKindOf` 的結果改變，但 `choice → text` 是放寬，不算；
  - `enum-value-removed`：移除選項；`const` 也視為只有一個值的 enum；
  - `limit-tightened`：下限變大、上限變小、新出現的上下限或 `uniqueItems`、`multipleOf` 從 b 改成 a 而 b 不是 a 的倍數（舊值都是 b 的倍數，只有 b 是 a 的倍數時才全都是 a 的倍數），或原本不限值、改成限定值；
  - `pattern-changed`：新增或修改 `pattern`／`format`；
  - `new-required`：新出現在 `required` 的 key；另外，新出現的必填 `link()`／`image()` 也算。它們用 prefault，不在 `required` 裡，契約又去掉了 `default`，所以只看 `required` 會判斷為相容。實際上，缺少這個欄位的舊資料會在不合格的預設值上失敗，正是規格 §4.6 列為不相容的「新增沒有預設值的必填欄位」。已有的欄位從選填 `link` 改成必填，由新出現的 `minLength` 回報為 `limit-tightened`；
  - `slot-narrowed`：`allow` 少了類型、`disallow` 多了類型、`allow` 的類型被改成 `disallow`；從 `disallow` 改成 `allow` 時無法證明沒有收窄，一律回報；
  - `richtext-features-removed`：減少富文字功能；
  - `strictness-changed`：`additionalProperties` 變成 `false`。
- 型別或種類已經改變時，不再往下比較。

其他
- 測試用明確的 `toEqual`，不用 inline snapshot。清單欄位的函式在比較時寫成 `expect.any(Function)`，另外呼叫它們檢查結果。
- 型別測試放在 `src/__typetests__/fields.ts`，由 spec 的 `typecheck` 檢查，jest 不會執行它。
  - 前兩項（`toPuckFields` 的結果、加上自訂 `picture` 的結果）是任務要求的 `satisfies` 檢查。`toPuckFields` 的回傳型別就是 `Fields<z.output<…>>`，所以它們只確認這個型別和 `BlockProps` 一致；
  - 真正的負向檢查有兩個 `// @ts-expect-error`：一個是拼錯的欄位名稱 `hreff`；另一個是少了必填欄位 `href` 的欄位表，對應與規格的差異 #4（`Fields<Props>` 也檢查必填欄位是否存在，Task 11 的 `{ ...toPuckFields(spec), picture }` 依賴這一點）；
  - Step 6 會逐一拿掉兩個註解，確認它們都是必要的。
- Ajv 只在測試中使用，加成 `packages/spec` 的 devDependency，版本精確寫成 `8.20.0`。audit gate 不檢查 devDependency，而 spec 沒有 tsup build，也不會把它打包進產物。

建立 `packages/spec/src/convert/__tests__/puck-fields.spec.ts`：

```ts
import type { ArrayField, Field } from "@tzuchi/tceditor";
import * as z from "zod";
import { defineBlockSpec } from "../../define";
import {
  boxSpec,
  kitchenSinkSpec,
  leafSpec,
  pairSpec,
  testRoot,
} from "../../__fixtures__/test-specs";
import { toDefaultProps, toPuckFields } from "../puck-fields";

const imageField: Field = {
  type: "custom",
  label: "圖片",
  render: () => {
    throw new Error("not rendered in this test");
  },
};

const arrayFieldOf = (field: Field | undefined): ArrayField => {
  if (field?.type !== "array") throw new Error("expected an array field");
  return field as ArrayField;
};

describe("toPuckFields", () => {
  it("maps every field kind of KitchenSink", () => {
    const image = jest.fn(() => imageField);
    const fields = toPuckFields(kitchenSinkSpec, { image });

    expect(fields).toEqual({
      title: { type: "text", label: "標題", contentEditable: true },
      note: { type: "textarea", label: "備註" },
      count: { type: "number", label: "數量", min: 1, max: 10, step: 1 },
      tone: {
        type: "select",
        label: "色調",
        options: [
          { label: "沉穩", value: "calm" },
          { label: "明亮", value: "bright" },
          { label: "深色", value: "dark" },
          { label: "暖色", value: "warm" },
          { label: "冷色", value: "cool" },
        ],
      },
      size: {
        type: "radio",
        label: "大小",
        options: [
          { label: "小", value: "sm" },
          { label: "中", value: "md" },
          { label: "大", value: "lg" },
        ],
      },
      space: {
        type: "radio",
        label: "間距",
        options: [
          { label: "小", value: "16" },
          { label: "大", value: "32" },
        ],
      },
      enabled: {
        type: "radio",
        label: "啟用",
        options: [
          { label: "是", value: true },
          { label: "否", value: false },
        ],
      },
      href: { type: "text", label: "連結網址" },
      moreHref: { type: "text", label: "更多連結" },
      body: {
        type: "richtext",
        label: "內文",
        contentEditable: true,
        options: {
          italic: false,
          underline: false,
          strike: false,
          code: false,
          bulletList: false,
          orderedList: false,
          blockquote: false,
          heading: false,
          horizontalRule: false,
          hardBreak: false,
          codeBlock: false,
          listItem: false,
          textAlign: false,
        },
      },
      items: {
        type: "array",
        label: "項目",
        min: 1,
        max: 5,
        arrayFields: { label: { type: "text", label: "名稱" } },
        getItemSummary: expect.any(Function),
      },
      group: {
        type: "object",
        label: "群組",
        objectFields: {
          caption: { type: "text", label: "說明" },
          level: { type: "number", label: "層級", min: 0, max: 3, step: 1 },
        },
      },
      content: { type: "slot", label: "內容", allow: ["Leaf"] },
      picture: imageField,
    });
    expect(image).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(image).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ name: "picture", label: "圖片" });
  });

  it("maps Box, Leaf, Pair and the page root", () => {
    expect(toPuckFields(boxSpec)).toEqual({
      content: { type: "slot", label: "內容", allow: ["Box", "Leaf"] },
    });
    expect(toPuckFields(leafSpec)).toEqual({
      text: { type: "text", label: "文字" },
    });
    expect(toPuckFields(pairSpec)).toEqual({
      columns: {
        type: "array",
        label: "欄",
        min: 2,
        max: 3,
        arrayFields: {
          content: { type: "slot", label: "內容", disallow: ["Pair"] },
        },
        defaultItemProps: expect.any(Function),
        getItemSummary: expect.any(Function),
      },
    });
    expect(toPuckFields(testRoot)).toEqual({
      title: { type: "text", label: "頁面標題" },
      description: { type: "textarea", label: "頁面說明" },
    });
  });

  it("summarises array items with the x-item-label template", () => {
    const columns = arrayFieldOf(toPuckFields(pairSpec).columns);
    expect(columns.getItemSummary?.({ content: [] }, 0)).toBe("第 1 欄");
    expect(columns.getItemSummary?.({ content: [] }, 1)).toBe("第 2 欄");
    expect(columns.getItemSummary?.({ content: [] })).toBe("第 欄");

    const items = arrayFieldOf(
      toPuckFields(kitchenSinkSpec, { image: () => imageField }).items
    );
    expect(items.getItemSummary?.({ label: "志工" }, 0)).toBe("志工");
    expect(items.getItemSummary?.({ label: "" }, 2)).toBe("第 3 項");
    expect(items.getItemSummary?.({}, 0)).toBe("第 1 項");
    // 只讀項目自己的屬性，不會讀到 Object.prototype
    const tricky = defineBlockSpec({
      type: "Tricky",
      label: "測試",
      category: "測試",
      description: "x-item-label 指到 Object.prototype 的名稱。",
      version: 1,
      props: z.strictObject({
        rows: z
          .array(
            z.strictObject({
              label: z.string().default("").meta({ title: "名稱" }),
            })
          )
          .default(() => [])
          .meta({ title: "列", "x-item-label": "{constructor}{label}" }),
      }),
      examples: [{ name: "預設", props: {} }],
    });
    const rows = arrayFieldOf(toPuckFields(tricky).rows);
    expect(rows.getItemSummary?.({ label: "甲" }, 0)).toBe("甲");
  });

  it("builds fresh default item props from the item schema", () => {
    const columns = arrayFieldOf(toPuckFields(pairSpec).columns);
    const make = columns.defaultItemProps as (index: number) => unknown;
    const first = make(0);
    expect(first).toEqual({ content: [] });
    expect(make(1)).not.toBe(first);
  });

  it("copies the slot rule so the editor can never mutate the spec", () => {
    const fields = toPuckFields(boxSpec);
    const content = fields.content as { allow?: string[] };
    content.allow?.push("Pair");
    expect(toPuckFields(boxSpec).content).toEqual({
      type: "slot",
      label: "內容",
      allow: ["Box", "Leaf"],
    });
  });

  it("requires an image factory when the spec has an image field", () => {
    expect(() => toPuckFields(kitchenSinkSpec)).toThrow(TypeError);
    expect(() => toPuckFields(kitchenSinkSpec)).toThrow(
      'toPuckFields: "KitchenSink.picture" is an image field; pass factories.image'
    );
  });

  it("treats zod's safe-integer bounds as no bounds", () => {
    const numbers = defineBlockSpec({
      type: "Numbers",
      label: "數字",
      category: "測試",
      description: "沒有上下限的數字。",
      version: 1,
      props: z.strictObject({
        whole: z.number().int().default(0).meta({ title: "整數" }),
        ratio: z.number().default(1.5).meta({ title: "比例" }),
        floor: z.number().int().min(0).default(0).meta({ title: "下限" }),
      }),
      examples: [{ name: "預設", props: {} }],
    });
    expect(toPuckFields(numbers)).toEqual({
      whole: { type: "number", label: "整數", step: 1 },
      ratio: { type: "number", label: "比例" },
      floor: { type: "number", label: "下限", min: 0, step: 1 },
    });
  });
});

describe("toDefaultProps", () => {
  it("returns every default, including the prefaulted href and picture", () => {
    expect(toDefaultProps(kitchenSinkSpec)).toEqual({
      title: "標題",
      note: "",
      count: 3,
      tone: "calm",
      size: "md",
      space: "16",
      enabled: true,
      href: "",
      moreHref: "",
      // fixture 的預設值已依 bold、link 清理：textAlign 被移除，段落沒有 attrs
      body: {
        type: "doc",
        content: [
          { type: "paragraph", content: [{ type: "text", text: "內文" }] },
        ],
      },
      items: [{ label: "一" }],
      group: { caption: "", level: 0 },
      content: [],
      picture: { assetId: "", alt: "", decorative: false },
    });
    expect(toDefaultProps(pairSpec)).toEqual({
      columns: [{ content: [] }, { content: [] }],
    });
    expect(toDefaultProps(boxSpec)).toEqual({ content: [] });
    expect(toDefaultProps(leafSpec)).toEqual({ text: "葉子" });
    expect(toDefaultProps(testRoot)).toEqual({
      title: "未命名頁面",
      description: "",
    });
  });

  it("deep-clones, so changing one result never changes the next", () => {
    const first = toDefaultProps(kitchenSinkSpec);
    if (!first.items || !first.group) throw new Error("missing defaults");
    expect(Object.isFrozen(first.group)).toBe(false);
    first.items[0].label = "改過";
    first.group.level = 3;
    const second = toDefaultProps(kitchenSinkSpec);
    expect(second.items).toEqual([{ label: "一" }]);
    expect(second.group).toEqual({ caption: "", level: 0 });
  });
});
```

```ts
      },

        table: { defaultValue: { summary: "true" } },
      },
      href: {
        name: "連結網址",
```

```ts
/** 在任意 JSON 值裡找出名為 keys 的 key，回傳它們的路徑。 */
function findKeys(
  value: unknown,
  keys: readonly string[],
  path = ""
): string[] {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    return value.flatMap((item, index) =>
      findKeys(item, keys, `${path}[${index}]`)
    );
  }
  if (typeof value === "object" && value !== null) {
    return Object.entries(value).flatMap(([key, child]) => [
      ...(keys.includes(key) ? [`${path}.${key}`] : []),
      ...findKeys(child, keys, `${path}.${key}`),
    ]);
  }
  return [];
}
```

```ts
import Ajv from "ajv";
import * as z from "zod";
import { defineBlockSpec } from "../../define";
import { slot } from "../../helpers";
import { exampleToPageData } from "../../page-data";
import {
  boxSpec,
  kitchenSinkSpec,
  leafSpec,
  pairSpec,
  testBlocks,
} from "../../__fixtures__/test-specs";
import { buildPageShellSchema } from "../page-shell";

/** 在任意 JSON 值裡找出所有物件，交給 visit。 */
function eachObject(
  value: unknown,
  visit: (object: Record<string, unknown>) => void
): void {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    value.forEach((item) => eachObject(item, visit));
  } else if (typeof value === "object" && value !== null) {
    visit(value as Record<string, unknown>);
    Object.values(value).forEach((child) => eachObject(child, visit));
  }
}

const NODE_LIST = { $ref: "#/definitions/nodeList" };

describe("buildPageShellSchema", () => {
  const shell = buildPageShellSchema({ blocks: testBlocks });
  const ajv = new Ajv({ strict: true, allErrors: true });
  const validate = ajv.compile(shell);

  const validPage = () => ({
    root: { props: { title: "首頁" } },
    content: [
      ...exampleToPageData(kitchenSinkSpec, 0).content,
      ...exampleToPageData(boxSpec, 0).content,
      ...exampleToPageData(leafSpec, 0).content,
      ...exampleToPageData(pairSpec, 0).content,
    ],
    zones: {},
  });

  const errorsOf = (page: unknown) => {
    expect(validate(page)).toBe(false);
    return (validate.errors ?? []).map(
      (error) => `${error.instancePath} ${error.keyword}`
    );
  };

  it("is the draft-07 shell generalised from the registered slot names", () => {
    expect(shell).toEqual({
      $schema: "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
      title: "tceditor page shell",
      type: "object",
      required: ["root", "content"],
      additionalProperties: false,
      properties: {
        root: {
          type: "object",
          required: ["props"],
          additionalProperties: false,
          properties: { props: { type: "object" } },
        },
        content: NODE_LIST,
        zones: { type: "object", maxProperties: 0 },
      },
      definitions: {
        nodeList: { type: "array", items: { $ref: "#/definitions/node" } },
        node: {
          type: "object",
          required: ["type", "props"],
          additionalProperties: false,
          properties: {
            type: {
              type: "string",
              enum: ["KitchenSink", "Box", "Leaf", "Pair"],
            },
            props: { $ref: "#/definitions/props" },
          },
        },
        props: {
          type: "object",
          required: ["id"],
          additionalProperties: true,
          properties: {
            id: {
              type: "string",
              pattern: "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$",
              not: { const: "root" },
            },
            columns: {
              type: "array",
              items: { $ref: "#/definitions/item_columns" },
            },
            content: NODE_LIST,
          },
        },
        item_columns: {
          type: "object",
          additionalProperties: true,
          properties: { content: NODE_LIST },
        },
      },
    });
  });

  it("uses no combinators and keeps every $ref alone in its object", () => {
    eachObject(shell, (object) => {
      for (const keyword of ["oneOf", "anyOf", "allOf"]) {
        expect(keyword in object).toBe(false);
      }
      if ("$ref" in object) expect(Object.keys(object)).toEqual(["$ref"]);
    });
  });

  it("accepts a valid page with or without empty zones", () => {
    expect(validate(validPage())).toBe(true);
    const { zones: _zones, ...withoutZones } = validPage();
    expect(validate(withoutZones)).toBe(true);
  });

  it("rejects unknown block types at every level", () => {
    const page = validPage();
    page.content[0].type = "Nope";
    expect(errorsOf(page)).toEqual(["/content/0/type enum"]);

    const proto = validPage();
    proto.content[1].type = "constructor";
    expect(errorsOf(proto)).toEqual(["/content/1/type enum"]);

    const nested = validPage();
    const columns = nested.content[3].props.columns as {
      content: { type: string }[];
    }[];
    columns[0].content[0].type = "__proto__";
    expect(errorsOf(nested)).toEqual([
      "/content/3/props/columns/0/content/0/type enum",
    ]);

    const inBox = validPage();
    (inBox.content[1].props.content as { type: string }[])[0].type = "Nope";
    expect(errorsOf(inBox)).toEqual(["/content/1/props/content/0/type enum"]);
  });

  it("rejects bad, reserved and missing ids", () => {
    const bad = validPage();
    bad.content[0].props.id = "bad id";
    expect(errorsOf(bad)).toEqual(["/content/0/props/id pattern"]);

    const reserved = validPage();
    reserved.content[0].props.id = "root";
    expect(errorsOf(reserved)).toEqual(["/content/0/props/id not"]);

    const missing = validPage();
    delete (missing.content[2].props as { id?: string }).id;
    expect(errorsOf(missing)).toEqual(["/content/2/props required"]);
  });

  it("rejects legacy zones, extra top-level keys and extra node keys", () => {
    expect(
      errorsOf({ ...validPage(), zones: { "Box-ex1:content": [] } })
    ).toEqual(["/zones maxProperties"]);
    expect(errorsOf({ ...validPage(), extra: 1 })).toEqual([
      " additionalProperties",
    ]);
    const readOnly = validPage();
    Object.assign(readOnly.content[0], { readOnly: {} });
    expect(errorsOf(readOnly)).toEqual(["/content/0 additionalProperties"]);
    expect(
      errorsOf({ ...validPage(), root: { props: {}, title: "x" } })
    ).toEqual(["/root additionalProperties"]);
    expect(errorsOf({ root: { props: {} } })).toEqual([" required"]);
  });

  it("covers every slot name of the registered blocks", () => {
    const panesSpec = defineBlockSpec({
      type: "Panes",
      label: "窗格",
      category: "測試",
      description: "直接欄位與清單項目各有一個放置區。",
      version: 1,
      props: z.strictObject({
        aside: slot({ allow: ["Leaf"] }).meta({ title: "側欄" }),
        panes: z
          .array(
            z.strictObject({
              main: slot({ allow: ["Leaf"] }).meta({ title: "主要" }),
              extra: slot({ allow: ["Leaf"] }).meta({ title: "附加" }),
            })
          )
          .default(() => [])
          .meta({ title: "窗格" }),
      }),
      examples: [{ name: "預設", props: {} }],
    });
    const generalised = buildPageShellSchema({
      blocks: [leafSpec, panesSpec],
    });
    const definitions = generalised.definitions as Record<
      string,
      { properties: Record<string, unknown> }
    >;
    expect(definitions.props.properties).toEqual({
      id: {
        type: "string",
        pattern: "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$",
        not: { const: "root" },
      },
      aside: NODE_LIST,
      panes: { type: "array", items: { $ref: "#/definitions/item_panes" } },
    });
    expect(definitions.item_panes.properties).toEqual({
      extra: NODE_LIST,
      main: NODE_LIST,
    });
    expect(new Ajv({ strict: true }).compile(generalised)).toBeInstanceOf(
      Function
    );
  });

  it("refuses slot names that mean different structures (spec §4.3 rule 8)", () => {
    const listSpec = defineBlockSpec({
      type: "ListOfSlots",
      label: "清單",
      category: "測試",
      description: "把 content 用成清單。",
      version: 1,
      props: z.strictObject({
        content: z
          .array(
            z.strictObject({
              inner: slot({ allow: ["Leaf"] }).meta({ title: "內" }),
            })
          )
          .default(() => [])
          .meta({ title: "內容" }),
      }),
      examples: [{ name: "預設", props: {} }],
    });
    expect(() =>
      buildPageShellSchema({ blocks: [boxSpec, leafSpec, listSpec] })
    ).toThrow('"content" is a slot in one block and a list of slots');
  });

  it("refuses a field that is not a slot but has a slot's name", () => {
    const noteSpec = defineBlockSpec({
      type: "Note",
      label: "備註",
      category: "測試",
      description: "把 content 用成文字。",
      version: 1,
      props: z.strictObject({
        content: z.string().default("").meta({ title: "內容" }),
      }),
      examples: [{ name: "預設", props: {} }],
    });
    expect(() =>
      buildPageShellSchema({ blocks: [boxSpec, leafSpec, noteSpec] })
    ).toThrow('Note.content is not a slot, but another block uses "content"');

    const tagsSpec = defineBlockSpec({
      type: "Tags",
      label: "標籤",
      category: "測試",
      description: "把 columns 用成字串清單。",
      version: 1,
      props: z.strictObject({
        columns: z
          .array(z.string())
          .default(() => [])
          .meta({ title: "標籤" }),
      }),
      examples: [{ name: "預設", props: {} }],
    });
    expect(() =>
      buildPageShellSchema({ blocks: [leafSpec, pairSpec, tagsSpec] })
    ).toThrow("Tags.columns is not a list of objects, but another block");

    const rowsSpec = defineBlockSpec({
      type: "Rows",
      label: "列",
      category: "測試",
      description: "清單項目的 content 是文字。",
      version: 1,
      props: z.strictObject({
        columns: z
          .array(
            z.strictObject({
              content: z.string().default("").meta({ title: "內容" }),
            })
          )
          .default(() => [])
          .meta({ title: "列" }),
      }),
      examples: [{ name: "預設", props: {} }],
    });
    expect(() =>
      buildPageShellSchema({ blocks: [leafSpec, pairSpec, rowsSpec] })
    ).toThrow("Rows.columns[].content is not a slot, but another block uses");
  });

  it("refuses a slot nested in a group", () => {
    const groupSpec = defineBlockSpec({
      type: "Grouped",
      label: "群組",
      category: "測試",
      description: "放置區放在群組裡。",
      version: 1,
      props: z.strictObject({
        group: z
          .strictObject({
            inner: slot({ allow: ["Leaf"] }).meta({ title: "內" }),
          })
          .default(() => ({ inner: [] }))
          .meta({ title: "群組" }),
      }),
      examples: [{ name: "預設", props: {} }],
    });
    expect(() =>
      buildPageShellSchema({ blocks: [leafSpec, groupSpec] })
    ).toThrow(/Grouped has a slot at/);
  });
});
```

```ts
import * as z from "zod";
import { defineBlockSpec } from "../../define";
import { choice, image, link, richText, slot } from "../../helpers";
import type { JsonSchema } from "../../json-schema";
import { kitchenSinkSpec } from "../../__fixtures__/test-specs";
import { diffContracts, toDataContract } from "../contract";

/** 第 1 版的欄位；每個測試只改其中一個。 */
const baseShape = {
  text: z.string().min(1).max(10).default("字").meta({ title: "文字" }),
  tone: choice(["a", "b"])
    .default("a")
    .meta({ title: "色調", "x-labels": { a: "甲", b: "乙" } }),
  count: z.number().int().min(0).max(5).default(0).meta({ title: "數量" }),
  href: link({ optional: true }).meta({ title: "連結" }),
  body: richText({ features: ["bold", "link"] }).meta({ title: "內文" }),
  content: slot({ allow: ["Leaf", "Box"] }).meta({ title: "內容" }),
  rest: slot({ disallow: ["Pair", "Box"] }).meta({ title: "其他" }),
  items: z
    .array(
      z.strictObject({ label: z.string().max(20).meta({ title: "名稱" }) })
    )
    .max(5)
    .default(() => [])
    .meta({ title: "項目" }),
};

const probe = (shape: z.core.$ZodLooseShape) =>
  defineBlockSpec({
    type: "Probe",
    label: "探針",
    category: "測試",
    description: "契約比對用的測試區塊。",
    version: 1,
    props: z.strictObject(shape),
    examples: [{ name: "預設", props: {} }],
  });

const base = toDataContract(probe(baseShape));
const changed = (shape: z.core.$ZodLooseShape) =>
  toDataContract(probe({ ...baseShape, ...shape }));
const without = (key: keyof typeof baseShape) => {
  const shape: z.core.$ZodLooseShape = { ...baseShape };
  delete shape[key];
  return toDataContract(probe(shape));
};
const kinds = (previous: JsonSchema, next: JsonSchema) =>
  diffContracts(previous, next).map((item) => `${item.path} ${item.kind}`);

describe("toDataContract", () => {
  it("drops labels, descriptions, examples, defaults and editor-only keys", () => {
    const contract = toDataContract(kitchenSinkSpec);
    const text = JSON.stringify(contract);
    for (const key of [
      "$schema",
      '"title":"',
      '"description":"',
      '"examples"',
      '"default"',
      '"deprecated"',
      "x-labels",
      "x-item-label",
      "x-inline",
      "x-field",
      "x-style",
      "x-token",
    ]) {
      expect(text).not.toContain(key);
    }
    const properties = contract.properties as Record<string, JsonSchema>;
    // 欄位名稱 title 不是 meta 的 title，必須保留
    expect(properties.title).toEqual({
      maxLength: 40,
      minLength: 1,
      type: "string",
    });
    expect(properties.href).toEqual({
      maxLength: 2048,
      minLength: 1,
      type: "string",
      "x-link": { optional: false },
      "x-lost-checks": ["safe-href"],
    });
    expect(properties.content["x-slot"]).toEqual({ allow: ["Leaf"] });
    expect(properties.body["x-richtext"]).toEqual({
      features: ["bold", "link"],
    });
    expect(Object.keys(properties)).toEqual(Object.keys(properties).sort());
  });

  it("ignores option order, labels, titles and defaults", () => {
    expect(
      changed({
        tone: choice(["b", "a"]).default("b").meta({ title: "改過的標籤" }),
        content: slot({ allow: ["Box", "Leaf"] }).meta({ title: "內容" }),
      })
    ).toEqual(base);
    expect(
      changed({
        text: z
          .string()
          .min(1)
          .max(10)
          .default("另一個預設值")
          .meta({ title: "新標題", description: "新說明" }),
      })
    ).toEqual(base);
  });
});

describe("diffContracts", () => {
  it("finds nothing between identical contracts", () => {
    expect(diffContracts(base, base)).toEqual([]);
    const kitchen = toDataContract(kitchenSinkSpec);
    expect(diffContracts(kitchen, structuredClone(kitchen))).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("accepts compatible changes", () => {
    const compatible = changed({
      text: z.string().min(0).max(20).default("字").meta({ title: "文字" }),
      tone: choice(["a", "b", "c"]).default("a").meta({ title: "色調" }),
      content: slot({ allow: ["Leaf", "Box", "Pair"] }).meta({ title: "內容" }),
      rest: slot({ disallow: ["Pair"] }).meta({ title: "其他" }),
      body: richText({ features: ["bold", "link", "italic"] }).meta({
        title: "內文",
      }),
      extraOptional: z.string().optional().meta({ title: "選填" }),
      extraDefaulted: z.boolean().default(false).meta({ title: "有預設值" }),
    });
    expect(diffContracts(base, compatible)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("reports a removed property", () => {
    expect(kinds(base, without("count"))).toEqual(["count removed-property"]);
  });

  it("reports a changed type", () => {
    expect(
      kinds(
        base,
        changed({ text: z.number().default(1).meta({ title: "文字" }) })
      )
    ).toEqual(["text type-changed"]);
    expect(
      kinds(
        base,
        changed({
          count: z.number().min(0).max(5).default(0).meta({ title: "數量" }),
        })
      )
    ).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("reports a removed enum value", () => {
    expect(
      kinds(
        base,
        changed({ tone: choice(["a"]).default("a").meta({ title: "色調" }) })
      )
    ).toEqual(["tone enum-value-removed"]);
  });

  it("reports tightened limits", () => {
    expect(
      kinds(
        base,
        changed({
          text: z
            .string()
            .min(2)
            .max(10)
            .default("字字")
            .meta({ title: "文字" }),
        })
      )
    ).toEqual(["text limit-tightened"]);
    expect(
      kinds(
        base,
        changed({
          items: z
            .array(
              z.strictObject({
                label: z.string().max(10).meta({ title: "名稱" }),
              })
            )
            .max(3)
            .default(() => [])
            .meta({ title: "項目" }),
        })
      )
    ).toEqual(["items limit-tightened", "items[].label limit-tightened"]);
  });

  it("compares multipleOf by divisibility", () => {
    const step = (value: number) =>
      toDataContract(
        probe({
          ...baseShape,
          count: z
            .number()
            .int()
            .min(0)
            .max(5)
            .multipleOf(value)
            .default(0)
            .meta({ title: "數量" }),
        })
      );
    // 舊值都是 2 的倍數，不一定是 4 的倍數；反過來則一定是
    expect(kinds(step(2), step(4))).toEqual(["count limit-tightened"]);
    expect(kinds(step(4), step(2))).toEqual([]);
    expect(kinds(base, step(2))).toEqual(["count limit-tightened"]);
  });

  it("reports a changed pattern", () => {
    expect(
      kinds(
        base,
        changed({
          text: z
            .string()
            .min(1)
            .max(10)
            .regex(/^[a-z]+$/)
            .default("a")
            .meta({ title: "文字" }),
        })
      )
    ).toEqual(["text pattern-changed"]);
  });

  it("reports a new required property", () => {
    expect(
      kinds(base, changed({ need: z.string().meta({ title: "必填" }) }))
    ).toEqual(["need new-required"]);
    expect(
      kinds(base, changed({ href: link().meta({ title: "連結" }) }))
    ).toEqual(["href limit-tightened"]);
  });

  it("reports a new required link or image, whose default fails", () => {
    expect(
      kinds(base, changed({ cta: link().meta({ title: "按鈕連結" }) }))
    ).toEqual(["cta new-required"]);
    expect(
      kinds(base, changed({ photo: image().meta({ title: "照片" }) }))
    ).toEqual(["photo new-required"]);
    expect(
      kinds(
        base,
        changed({ more: link({ optional: true }).meta({ title: "更多" }) })
      )
    ).toEqual([]);
    // 清單項目裡新增必填連結，舊的項目同樣會被拒絕
    expect(
      kinds(
        base,
        changed({
          items: z
            .array(
              z.strictObject({
                label: z.string().max(20).meta({ title: "名稱" }),
                href: link().meta({ title: "網址" }),
              })
            )
            .max(5)
            .default(() => [])
            .meta({ title: "項目" }),
        })
      )
    ).toEqual(["items[].href new-required"]);
  });

  it("reports a narrowed slot", () => {
    expect(
      kinds(
        base,
        changed({ content: slot({ allow: ["Leaf"] }).meta({ title: "內容" }) })
      )
    ).toEqual(["content slot-narrowed"]);
    expect(
      kinds(
        base,
        changed({
          rest: slot({ disallow: ["Pair", "Box", "Leaf"] }).meta({
            title: "其他",
          }),
        })
      )
    ).toEqual(["rest slot-narrowed"]);
    expect(
      kinds(
        base,
        changed({
          content: slot({ disallow: ["Box"] }).meta({ title: "內容" }),
        })
      )
    ).toEqual(["content slot-narrowed"]);
    expect(
      kinds(
        base,
        changed({ rest: slot({ allow: ["Leaf"] }).meta({ title: "其他" }) })
      )
    ).toEqual(["rest slot-narrowed"]);
  });

  it("reports removed richtext features", () => {
    expect(
      kinds(
        base,
        changed({
          body: richText({ features: ["bold"] }).meta({ title: "內文" }),
        })
      )
    ).toEqual(["body richtext-features-removed"]);
  });

  it("reports an object that became strict", () => {
    const loose = structuredClone(base);
    loose.additionalProperties = true;
    expect(kinds(loose, base)).toEqual([" strictness-changed"]);
    expect(kinds(base, loose)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("reports a changed field kind", () => {
    expect(
      kinds(base, changed({ text: link().meta({ title: "文字" }) }))
    ).toEqual(["text kind-changed"]);
    expect(
      kinds(
        base,
        changed({ text: choice(["字"]).default("字").meta({ title: "文字" }) })
      )
    ).toEqual(["text kind-changed"]);
    // 反過來（選項 → 任意文字）只是放寬
    expect(
      kinds(
        base,
        changed({ tone: z.string().default("a").meta({ title: "色調" }) })
      )
    ).toEqual([]);
    expect(
      kinds(
        base,
        changed({
          content: z
            .array(
              z.strictObject({
                type: z.string(),
                props: z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()),
              })
            )
            .default(() => [])
            .meta({ title: "內容" }),
        })
      )
    ).toEqual(["content kind-changed"]);
  });

  it("describes each break", () => {
    expect(
      diffContracts(
        base,
        changed({
          text: z.string().min(1).max(5).default("字").meta({ title: "文字" }),
        })
      )
    ).toEqual([
      { path: "text", kind: "limit-tightened", detail: "maxLength 10 → 5" },
    ]);
  });
});
```

建立 `packages/spec/src/convert/schema-utils.ts`（內部模組，不從 index 匯出）：

```ts
import type { JsonSchema } from "../json-schema";

/** 選項數量在這個值以內用 radio，超過用 select（規格 §4.2）。 */
export const RADIO_MAX_OPTIONS = 4;

/** 值是單一 schema 的關鍵字。 */
const SCHEMA_KEYWORDS: readonly string[] = [
  "items",
  "additionalItems",
  "additionalProperties",
  "propertyNames",
  "contains",
  "not",
  "if",
  "then",
  "else",
  "unevaluatedItems",
  "unevaluatedProperties",
];

/** 值是 schema 陣列的關鍵字。 */
const SCHEMA_LIST_KEYWORDS: readonly string[] = [
  "prefixItems",
  "allOf",
  "anyOf",
  "oneOf",
];

/** 值是「名稱 → schema」的關鍵字。名稱是欄位名稱或定義名稱，不是關鍵字。 */
const SCHEMA_MAP_KEYWORDS: readonly string[] = [
  "properties",
  "patternProperties",
  "$defs",
  "definitions",
  "dependentSchemas",
];

export const isSchemaObject = (value: unknown): value is JsonSchema =>
  typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);

export const hasOwn = (target: object, key: string): boolean =>
  Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(target, key);

/** 物件 schema 的 properties；沒有時回傳空物件。 */
export function propertiesOf(node: JsonSchema): Record<string, JsonSchema> {
  const properties = node.properties;
  if (!isSchemaObject(properties)) return {};
  return Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(properties).filter((entry): entry is [string, JsonSchema] =>
      isSchemaObject(entry[1])
    )
  );
}

export function requiredOf(node: JsonSchema): string[] {
  return Array.isArray(node.required)
    ? node.required.filter((key): key is string => typeof key === "string")
    : [];
}

/**
 * 必填的 link() 與 image()。它們用 .prefault()，在 io "input" 下不列入 required，
 * 預設值（""、assetId ""）卻刻意不合格，所以省略它們的資料會被拒絕。
 */
export function hasFailingDefault(node: JsonSchema): boolean {
  const link = node["x-link"];
  return (
    hasOwn(node, "x-image") || (isSchemaObject(link) && link.optional === false)
  );
}

/** 欄位的中文名稱（meta 的 title），沒有時用欄位名稱。 */
export const titleOf = (node: JsonSchema, name: string): string =>
  typeof node.title === "string" && node.title !== "" ? node.title : name;

/**
 * 數字欄位的上下限。zod 的 int() 沒設上下限時會輸出 ±Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER，
 * 這種值視為沒有上下限。
 */
export function numberBound(
  node: JsonSchema,
  keyword: "minimum" | "maximum"
): number | undefined {
  const value = node[keyword];
  return typeof value === "number" &&
    Number.isFinite(value) &&
    Math.abs(value) !== Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER
    ? value
    : undefined;
}

export function enumValues(
  node: JsonSchema
): (string | number | boolean | null)[] {
  return Array.isArray(node.enum)
    ? node.enum.filter(
        (value): value is string | number | boolean | null =>
          value === null ||
          ["string", "number", "boolean"].includes(typeof value)
      )
    : [];
}

/** 選項的中文名稱：取 x-labels 的自有屬性，沒有時用值本身。 */
export function optionLabel(
  node: JsonSchema,
  value: string | number | boolean | null
): string {
  const labels = node["x-labels"];
  const key = String(value);
  if (isSchemaObject(labels) && hasOwn(labels, key)) {
    const label = labels[key];
    if (typeof label === "string") return label;
  }
  return key;
}

const escapePointer = (segment: string) =>
  segment.replace(/~/g, "~0").replace(/\//g, "~1");

/**
 * 由下而上重建 schema：先重建每個子 schema，再把重建好的節點交給 rewrite。
 * 只有 schema 位置的物件會交給 rewrite；default、examples、enum、x-* 這類資料值只深拷貝。
 * 不修改輸入（toJsonSchema 的結果是凍結的）。
 */
export function rewriteSchema(
  node: JsonSchema,
  rewrite: (node: JsonSchema) => JsonSchema
): JsonSchema {
  const rebuild = (value: unknown): unknown =>
    isSchemaObject(value)
      ? rewriteSchema(value, rewrite)
      : structuredClone(value);

  return rewrite(
    Object.fromEntries(
      Object.entries(node).map(([keyword, value]) => {
        if (SCHEMA_KEYWORDS.includes(keyword)) {
          return [
            keyword,
            Array.isArray(value) ? value.map(rebuild) : rebuild(value),
          ];
        }
        if (SCHEMA_LIST_KEYWORDS.includes(keyword) && Array.isArray(value)) {
          return [keyword, value.map(rebuild)];
        }
        if (SCHEMA_MAP_KEYWORDS.includes(keyword) && isSchemaObject(value)) {
          return [
            keyword,
            Object.fromEntries(
              Object.entries(value).map(([name, sub]) => [name, rebuild(sub)])
            ),
          ];
        }
        return [keyword, structuredClone(value)];
      })
    )
  );
}

/** 依序走訪每個 schema 節點（含根節點）。pointer 是 JSON Pointer，例如 "/properties/columns/items"。 */
export function walkSchema(
  node: JsonSchema,
  visit: (node: JsonSchema, pointer: string) => void,
  pointer = ""
): void {
  visit(node, pointer);
  for (const [keyword, value] of Object.entries(node)) {
    const here = `${pointer}/${escapePointer(keyword)}`;
    if (
      SCHEMA_KEYWORDS.includes(keyword) ||
      SCHEMA_LIST_KEYWORDS.includes(keyword)
    ) {
      if (isSchemaObject(value)) walkSchema(value, visit, here);
      if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        value.forEach((sub, index) => {
          if (isSchemaObject(sub)) walkSchema(sub, visit, `${here}/${index}`);
        });
      }
    } else if (SCHEMA_MAP_KEYWORDS.includes(keyword) && isSchemaObject(value)) {
      for (const [name, sub] of Object.entries(value)) {
        if (isSchemaObject(sub)) {
          walkSchema(sub, visit, `${here}/${escapePointer(name)}`);
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

/** 回傳 schema 節點中出現指定關鍵字的位置（JSON Pointer）。 */
export function findKeywords(
  node: JsonSchema,
  keywords: readonly string[]
): string[] {
  const found: string[] = [];
  walkSchema(node, (sub, pointer) => {
    for (const keyword of keywords) {
      if (hasOwn(sub, keyword)) {
        found.push(`${pointer}/${escapePointer(keyword)}`);
      }
    }
  });
  return found;
}

/** 回傳去掉指定 key 的新物件。 */
export const omitKeys = (
  node: JsonSchema,
  keys: readonly string[]
): JsonSchema =>
  Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(node).filter(([key]) => !keys.includes(key))
  );
```

建立 `packages/spec/src/convert/puck-fields.ts`：

```ts
import type {
  ArrayField,
  Field,
  Fields,
  NumberField,
  SlotField,
} from "@tzuchi/tceditor";
import { richTextFeaturesToOptions } from "@tzuchi/tceditor/rules";
import type { RichTextFeature } from "@tzuchi/tceditor/rules";
import type * as z from "zod";
import type { AnyBlockSpec, PageRootSpec } from "../define";
import { fieldKindOf } from "../field-kind";
import { toJsonSchema, type JsonSchema } from "../json-schema";
import {
  RADIO_MAX_OPTIONS,
  enumValues,
  hasOwn,
  isSchemaObject,
  numberBound,
  optionLabel,
  propertiesOf,
  titleOf,
} from "./schema-utils";

export type FieldFactories = {
  /** 產生圖片欄位（Puck 的 custom 欄位）。name 是欄位名稱，label 是欄位的 title。 */
  image?: (ctx: { name: string; label: string }) => Field;
};

/** x-item-label 樣板中的 {欄位名} 與 {n}。 */
const ITEM_LABEL_PLACEHOLDER = /\{([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,63})\}/g;

/**
 * 依 x-item-label 樣板產生清單項目的摘要：{n} 代入從 1 起算的序號，
 * {欄位名} 代入項目的自有屬性（只接受字串與數字）。結果為空字串時改用「第 n 項」。
 */
export function formatItemLabel(
  template: string,
  item: unknown,
  index: number | undefined
): string {
  const label = template
    .replace(ITEM_LABEL_PLACEHOLDER, (_placeholder, key: string) => {
      if (key === "n") return index === undefined ? "" : String(index + 1);
      if (typeof item !== "object" || item === null || !hasOwn(item, key)) {
        return "";
      }
      const value = (item as Record<string, unknown>)[key];
      return typeof value === "string" || typeof value === "number"
        ? String(value)
        : "";
    })
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim();
  if (label === "" && index !== undefined) return `第 ${index + 1} 項`;
  return label;
}

/** 物件 schema 中有 default 的欄位，值深拷貝。 */
function defaultsOf(node: JsonSchema): Record<string, unknown> {
  return Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(propertiesOf(node))
      .filter(([, property]) => hasOwn(property, "default"))
      .map(([name, property]) => [name, structuredClone(property.default)])
  );
}

function featuresOf(node: JsonSchema, where: string): RichTextFeature[] {
  const richtext = node["x-richtext"];
  if (
    !isSchemaObject(richtext) ||
    !Array.isArray(richtext.features) ||
    !richtext.features.every((feature) => typeof feature === "string")
  ) {
    throw new TypeError(`${where}: x-richtext must be { features: string[] }`);
  }
  return richtext.features as RichTextFeature[];
}

function numberField(node: JsonSchema, label: string): NumberField {
  const field: NumberField = { type: "number", label };
  const min = numberBound(node, "minimum");
  const max = numberBound(node, "maximum");
  if (min !== undefined) field.min = min;
  if (max !== undefined) field.max = max;
  if (node.type === "integer") field.step = 1;
  return field;
}

function choiceField(node: JsonSchema, label: string): Field {
  const options = enumValues(node).map((value) => ({
    label: optionLabel(node, value),
    value,
  }));
  return options.length <= RADIO_MAX_OPTIONS
    ? { type: "radio", label, options }
    : { type: "select", label, options };
}

function slotField(node: JsonSchema, label: string, where: string): SlotField {
  const rule = node["x-slot"];
  if (isSchemaObject(rule) && Array.isArray(rule.allow)) {
    return { type: "slot", label, allow: rule.allow.map(String) };
  }
  if (isSchemaObject(rule) && Array.isArray(rule.disallow)) {
    return { type: "slot", label, disallow: rule.disallow.map(String) };
  }
  throw new TypeError(`${where}: x-slot must be { allow } or { disallow }`);
}

function arrayField(
  node: JsonSchema,
  label: string,
  where: string,
  factories: FieldFactories
): ArrayField {
  const items = node.items;
  if (!isSchemaObject(items) || fieldKindOf(items) !== "object") {
    throw new TypeError(`${where}: array items must be objects`);
  }
  const field: ArrayField = {
    type: "array",
    label,
    arrayFields: fieldsOf(items, `${where}[]`, factories),
  };
  if (typeof node.minItems === "number") field.min = node.minItems;
  if (typeof node.maxItems === "number") field.max = node.maxItems;
  const itemDefaults = defaultsOf(items);
  if (Object.keys(itemDefaults).length > 0) {
    field.defaultItemProps = () => structuredClone(itemDefaults);
  }
  const template = node["x-item-label"];
  if (typeof template === "string") {
    field.getItemSummary = (item, index) =>
      formatItemLabel(template, item, index);
  }
  return field;
}

function toField(
  node: JsonSchema,
  name: string,
  where: string,
  factories: FieldFactories
): Field {
  const label = titleOf(node, name);
  const inline = node["x-inline"] === true;
  switch (fieldKindOf(node)) {
    case "text":
      return inline
        ? { type: "text", label, contentEditable: true }
        : { type: "text", label };
    case "textarea":
      return inline
        ? { type: "textarea", label, contentEditable: true }
        : { type: "textarea", label };
    case "link":
      return { type: "text", label };
    case "number":
      return numberField(node, label);
    case "choice":
      return choiceField(node, label);
    case "boolean":
      return {
        type: "radio",
        label,
        options: [
          { label: "是", value: true },
          { label: "否", value: false },
        ],
      };
    case "richtext":
      return {
        type: "richtext",
        label,
        contentEditable: true,
        options: richTextFeaturesToOptions(featuresOf(node, where)),
      };
    case "array":
      return arrayField(node, label, where, factories);
    case "object":
      return {
        type: "object",
        label,
        objectFields: fieldsOf(node, where, factories),
      };
    case "slot":
      return slotField(node, label, where);
    case "image":
      if (!factories.image) {
        throw new TypeError(
          `toPuckFields: "${where}" is an image field; pass factories.image`
        );
      }
      return factories.image({ name, label });
  }
}

function fieldsOf(
  node: JsonSchema,
  where: string,
  factories: FieldFactories
): Record<string, Field> {
  return Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(propertiesOf(node)).map(([name, property]) => [
      name,
      toField(property, name, `${where}.${name}`, factories),
    ])
  );
}

/** 依規格的 JSON Schema 產生 Puck 的 fields（規格 §4.2、§5.2）。 */
export function toPuckFields<S extends AnyBlockSpec | PageRootSpec>(
  spec: S,
  factories: FieldFactories = {}
): Fields<z.output<S["props"]>> {
  const owner = spec.kind === "block" ? spec.type : "root";
  return fieldsOf(toJsonSchema(spec), owner, factories) as Fields<
    z.output<S["props"]>
  >;
}

/** 規格的預設值（JSON Schema 的 default，含 prefault），深拷貝後回傳。 */
export function toDefaultProps<S extends AnyBlockSpec | PageRootSpec>(
  spec: S
): Partial<z.output<S["props"]>> {
  return defaultsOf(toJsonSchema(spec)) as Partial<z.output<S["props"]>>;
}
```

```ts
import type { AnyBlockSpec } from "../define";
import { fieldKindOf } from "../field-kind";
import { toJsonSchema, type JsonSchema } from "../json-schema";
import { toDefaultProps } from "./puck-fields";
import {
  RADIO_MAX_OPTIONS,
  enumValues,
  numberBound,
  optionLabel,
  propertiesOf,
  titleOf,
} from "./schema-utils";

/** Storybook argTypes 的子集合。刻意不 import Storybook 的型別，讓 spec 不依賴 Storybook。 */
export type ArgTypeSpec = {
  name: string;
  description?: string;
  control:
    | false
    | {
        type:
          | "text"
          | "number"
          | "range"
          | "boolean"
          | "radio"
          | "select"
          | "object";
        min?: number;
        max?: number;
        step?: number;
        labels?: Record<string, string>;
      };
  options?: readonly string[];
  table?: { category?: string; defaultValue?: { summary: string } };
};

type Control = Exclude<ArgTypeSpec["control"], false>;

function numberControl(node: JsonSchema): Control {
  const min = numberBound(node, "minimum");
  const max = numberBound(node, "maximum");
  const control: Control = {
    type: min !== undefined && max !== undefined ? "range" : "number",
  };
  if (min !== undefined) control.min = min;
  if (max !== undefined) control.max = max;
  if (typeof node.multipleOf === "number") {
    control.step = node.multipleOf;
  } else if (node.type === "integer") {
    control.step = 1;
  } else if (min !== undefined && max !== undefined) {
    // Storybook 的 range 預設 step 為 1，小數範圍要自己給
    control.step = (max - min) / 100;
  }
  return control;
}

function toArgType(name: string, node: JsonSchema): ArgTypeSpec {
  const argType: ArgTypeSpec = { name: titleOf(node, name), control: false };
  if (typeof node.description === "string") {
    argType.description = node.description;
  }
  switch (fieldKindOf(node)) {
    case "text":
    case "textarea":
    case "link":
      argType.control = { type: "text" };
      break;
    case "number":
      argType.control = numberControl(node);
      break;
    case "choice": {
      const values = enumValues(node).map(String);
      argType.options = values;
      argType.control = {
        type: values.length <= RADIO_MAX_OPTIONS ? "radio" : "select",
        labels: Object.fromEntries(
          values.map((value) => [value, optionLabel(node, value)])
        ),
      };
      break;
    }
    case "boolean":
      argType.control = { type: "boolean" };
      break;
    case "array":
    case "object":
      argType.control = { type: "object" };
      break;
    case "richtext":
    case "slot":
    case "image":
      argType.control = false;
      break;
  }
  const value = node.default;
  if (
    typeof value === "string" ||
    typeof value === "number" ||
    typeof value === "boolean"
  ) {
    argType.table = { defaultValue: { summary: JSON.stringify(value) } };
  }
  return argType;
}

/** 依規格產生 Storybook 的 argTypes（規格 §4.2 最右欄、§5.3）。key 與規格的欄位名稱相同。 */
export function toArgTypes(spec: AnyBlockSpec): Record<string, ArgTypeSpec> {
  return Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(propertiesOf(toJsonSchema(spec))).map(([name, node]) => [
      name,
      toArgType(name, node),
    ])
  );
}

/** story 的 args：規格的預設值（與 toDefaultProps 相同）。 */
export function toStoryArgs(spec: AnyBlockSpec): Record<string, unknown> {
  return toDefaultProps(spec);
}
```
