建立 `packages/spec/src/convert/catalog.ts`：

```ts
import type { AnyBlockSpec, PageRootSpec } from "../define";
import { toJsonSchema, type JsonSchema } from "../json-schema";
import { DEFAULT_LIMITS, NODE_ID_PATTERN } from "../limits";
import type { SlotRule } from "../meta";
import { slotLocations } from "../slots";
import {
  findKeywords,
  hasFailingDefault,
  omitKeys,
  propertiesOf,
  requiredOf,
  rewriteSchema,
} from "./schema-utils";

export const CATALOG_VERSION = 1;

export type CatalogBlock = {
  type: string;
  label: string;
  category: string;
  description: string;
  version: number;
  deprecated: boolean;
  /**
   * JSON Schema 2020-12，去掉 $schema 與只給編輯器、Storybook 用的 x-*。
   * 必填的 link()（x-link.optional 為 false）與 image()（x-image）列在 required，
   * 因為它們的預設值不合格。
   */
  props: JsonSchema;
  /** key 同 SlotLocation.key；值為展開後、排除 deprecated 區塊、依登記順序排列的類型清單。 */
  slots: Record<string, string[]>;
  examples: { name: string; props: Record<string, unknown> }[];
};

export type Catalog = {
  catalogVersion: 1;
  nodeIdPattern: string;
  limits: { maxBytes: number; maxDepth: number; maxBlocks: number };
  blocks: CatalogBlock[];
  root: { label: string; props: JsonSchema };
};

/** catalog 的 props 要去掉的 key（規格 §5.4）。x-labels、x-lost-checks、x-richtext、x-image、x-link 保留。 */
const STRIPPED_KEYS = [
  "$schema",
  "x-inline",
  "x-field",
  "x-item-label",
  "x-style",
  "x-token",
  "x-slot",
];

/** MCP 端不支援的關鍵字（規格 §5.4）。 */
const FORBIDDEN_KEYWORDS = ["$ref", "oneOf", "anyOf", "allOf"];

/**
 * 把必填的 link() 與 image() 加進該層的 required。它們用 prefault，在 io "input" 下
 * 不列入 required，預設值卻不合格；AI 或不補預設值的 Ajv 不能以為可以省略它們。
 */
function requirePrefaulted(node: JsonSchema): JsonSchema {
  const names = Object.entries(propertiesOf(node))
    .filter(([, property]) => hasFailingDefault(property))
    .map(([name]) => name);
  if (names.length === 0) return node;
  return { ...node, required: [...new Set([...requiredOf(node), ...names])] };
}

function catalogProps(schema: JsonSchema, owner: string): JsonSchema {
  const props = rewriteSchema(schema, (node) =>
    requirePrefaulted(omitKeys(node, STRIPPED_KEYS))
  );
  const forbidden = findKeywords(props, FORBIDDEN_KEYWORDS).join(", ");
  if (forbidden !== "") {
    throw new TypeError(
      `buildCatalog: ${owner} props use ${forbidden}; catalog props must not contain $ref, oneOf, anyOf or allOf`
    );
  }
  return props;
}

/** 把 allow／disallow 展開成明確的類型清單：只列已登記、未 deprecated 的區塊，依登記順序。 */
function expandSlotRule(
  rule: SlotRule,
  blocks: readonly AnyBlockSpec[]
): string[] {
  const usable = blocks.filter((spec) => !spec.deprecated);
  const allowed =
    "allow" in rule
      ? usable.filter((spec) => rule.allow.includes(spec.type))
      : usable.filter((spec) => !rule.disallow.includes(spec.type));
  return allowed.map((spec) => spec.type);
}

/** 產生 MCP 元件目錄（規格 §5.4）。 */
export function buildCatalog(input: {
  blocks: readonly AnyBlockSpec[];
  root: PageRootSpec;
}): Catalog {
  const { blocks, root } = input;
  return {
    catalogVersion: CATALOG_VERSION,
    nodeIdPattern: NODE_ID_PATTERN.source,
    limits: {
      maxBytes: DEFAULT_LIMITS.maxBytes,
      maxDepth: DEFAULT_LIMITS.maxDepth,
      maxBlocks: DEFAULT_LIMITS.maxBlocks,
    },
    blocks: blocks.map((spec) => ({
      type: spec.type,
      label: spec.label,
      category: spec.category,
      description: spec.description,
      version: spec.version,
      deprecated: spec.deprecated,
      props: catalogProps(toJsonSchema(spec), spec.type),
      slots: Object.fromEntries(
        slotLocations(spec).map((location) => [
          location.key,
          expandSlotRule(location.rule, blocks),
        ])
      ),
      examples: spec.examples.map((example) => ({
        name: example.name,
        props: structuredClone(example.props) as Record<string, unknown>,
      })),
    })),
    root: {
      label: root.label,
      props: catalogProps(toJsonSchema(root), "root"),
    },
  };
}
```

建立 `packages/spec/src/convert/page-shell.ts`：

```ts
import type { AnyBlockSpec } from "../define";
import { eachField, toJsonSchema, type JsonSchema } from "../json-schema";
import { NODE_ID_PATTERN } from "../limits";
import { slotLocations } from "../slots";
import { hasOwn, isSchemaObject } from "./schema-utils";

const NODE_LIST = { $ref: "#/definitions/nodeList" };

/** 清單裡放置區的項目定義名稱，例如 columns → "item_columns"。 */
const itemDefinition = (name: string) => `item_${name}`;

/**
 * 產生資料庫用的外殼 schema（draft-07，規格 §6.5）。
 * - 只檢查結構：content 是節點陣列、type 是已登記的區塊、props.id 符合格式且不是 "root"、
 *   放置區（依欄位名稱辨認，規格 §4.3 rule 8）裡是節點陣列。不依區塊類型檢查其他 props。
 * - 不用 oneOf/anyOf/allOf；每個 $ref 單獨成一個物件（draft-07 會忽略 $ref 旁邊的關鍵字）。
 * - 只支援兩種放置區位置：區塊的直接欄位（例如 content），以及物件清單項目裡的欄位（例如 columns[].content）。
 */
export function buildPageShellSchema(input: {
  blocks: readonly AnyBlockSpec[];
}): JsonSchema {
  if (input.blocks.length === 0) {
    throw new TypeError("buildPageShellSchema: no blocks");
  }
  const directSlots = new Set<string>();
  const slotLists = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  for (const spec of input.blocks) {
    for (const location of slotLocations(spec)) {
      const [name, marker, inner] = location.path;
      if (location.path.length === 1) {
        directSlots.add(name);
      } else if (location.path.length === 3 && marker === "[]") {
        const inners = slotLists.get(name) ?? new Set<string>();
        inners.add(inner);
        slotLists.set(name, inners);
      } else {
        throw new TypeError(
          `buildPageShellSchema: ${spec.type} has a slot at "${location.key}"; only a direct prop or a prop of an array item can be a slot`
        );
      }
    }
  }
  for (const name of directSlots) {
    if (slotLists.has(name)) {
      throw new TypeError(
        `buildPageShellSchema: "${name}" is a slot in one block and a list of slots in another (spec §4.3 rule 8)`
      );
    }
  }
  // 外殼依名稱辨認放置區（規格 §4.3 rule 8），所以同名的欄位在其他區塊也必須是同樣的結構，
  // 否則那些區塊的合格資料會被外殼拒絕
  for (const spec of input.blocks) {
    eachField(toJsonSchema(spec), ({ path, node }) => {
      const [name, marker, inner] = path;
      const isSlot = hasOwn(node, "x-slot");
      const clash = (where: string, problem: string) =>
        new TypeError(
          `buildPageShellSchema: ${spec.type}.${where} ${problem}, but another block uses "${where}" for slots (spec §4.3 rule 8)`
        );
      if (path.length === 1 && directSlots.has(name) && !isSlot) {
        throw clash(name, "is not a slot");
      }
      if (
        path.length === 1 &&
        slotLists.has(name) &&
        !(
          node.type === "array" &&
          isSchemaObject(node.items) &&
          node.items.type === "object"
        )
      ) {
        throw clash(name, "is not a list of objects");
      }
      if (
        path.length === 3 &&
        marker === "[]" &&
        (slotLists.get(name)?.has(inner) ?? false) &&
        !isSlot
      ) {
        throw clash(`${name}[].${inner}`, "is not a slot");
      }
    });
  }

  const slotNames = [...directSlots, ...slotLists.keys()].sort();
  const props: JsonSchema = {
    type: "object",
    required: ["id"],
    additionalProperties: true,
    properties: Object.fromEntries([
      [
        "id",
        {
          type: "string",
          pattern: NODE_ID_PATTERN.source,
          not: { const: "root" },
        },
      ],
      ...slotNames.map((name) => [
        name,
        directSlots.has(name)
          ? { ...NODE_LIST }
          : {
              type: "array",
              items: { $ref: `#/definitions/${itemDefinition(name)}` },
            },
      ]),
    ]),
  };
  const itemDefinitions = [...slotLists.keys()].sort().map((name) => [
    itemDefinition(name),
    {
      type: "object",
      additionalProperties: true,
      properties: Object.fromEntries(
        [...(slotLists.get(name) ?? [])]
          .sort()
          .map((inner) => [inner, { ...NODE_LIST }])
      ),
    },
  ]);

  return {
    $schema: "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
    title: "tceditor page shell",
    type: "object",
    required: ["root", "content"],
    additionalProperties: false,
    properties: {
      root: {
        type: "object",
        required: ["props"],
        additionalProperties: false,
        properties: { props: { type: "object" } },
      },
      content: { ...NODE_LIST },
      zones: { type: "object", maxProperties: 0 },
    },
    definitions: Object.fromEntries([
      ["nodeList", { type: "array", items: { $ref: "#/definitions/node" } }],
      [
        "node",
        {
          type: "object",
          required: ["type", "props"],
          additionalProperties: false,
          properties: {
            type: {
              type: "string",
              enum: input.blocks.map((spec) => spec.type),
            },
            props: { $ref: "#/definitions/props" },
          },
        },
      ],
      ["props", props],
      ...itemDefinitions,
    ]),
  };
}
```

建立 `packages/spec/src/convert/contract.ts`：

```ts
import type { AnyBlockSpec } from "../define";
import { fieldKindOf } from "../field-kind";
import { toJsonSchema, type JsonSchema } from "../json-schema";
import {
  hasFailingDefault,
  hasOwn,
  isSchemaObject,
  omitKeys,
  propertiesOf,
  requiredOf,
  rewriteSchema,
} from "./schema-utils";

/** 契約不含的 key：中文標籤、說明、範例、預設值與只影響編輯器或畫面的 x-*（規格 §4.6）。 */
const CONTRACT_STRIPPED_KEYS = [
  "$schema",
  "title",
  "description",
  "examples",
  "default",
  "deprecated",
  "x-labels",
  "x-item-label",
  "x-inline",
  "x-field",
  "x-style",
  "x-token",
];

const compareJson = (a: unknown, b: unknown) => {
  const left = JSON.stringify(a);
  const right = JSON.stringify(b);
  return left < right ? -1 : left > right ? 1 : 0;
};

const sortedStrings = (value: unknown): unknown =>
  Array.isArray(value) ? [...value].sort(compareJson) : value;

/** 值是「集合」的地方一律排序，順序改變不算契約改變。 */
function canonicalNode(node: JsonSchema): JsonSchema {
  const result = omitKeys(node, CONTRACT_STRIPPED_KEYS);
  if (Array.isArray(result.enum)) result.enum = sortedStrings(result.enum);
  if (Array.isArray(result.required)) {
    result.required = sortedStrings(result.required);
  }
  const slot = result["x-slot"];
  if (isSchemaObject(slot)) {
    result["x-slot"] = Object.fromEntries(
      Object.entries(slot).map(([key, names]) => [key, sortedStrings(names)])
    );
  }
  const richtext = result["x-richtext"];
  if (isSchemaObject(richtext)) {
    result["x-richtext"] = {
      ...richtext,
      features: sortedStrings(richtext.features),
    };
  }
  if (Array.isArray(result["x-lost-checks"])) {
    result["x-lost-checks"] = sortedStrings(result["x-lost-checks"]);
  }
  return result;
}

function sortKeysDeep(value: unknown): unknown {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(sortKeysDeep);
  if (isSchemaObject(value)) {
    return Object.fromEntries(
      Object.keys(value)
        .sort()
        .map((key) => [key, sortKeysDeep(value[key])])
    );
  }
  return value;
}

/**
 * 區塊的資料契約：規格 JSON Schema 去掉標籤、說明、範例、預設值後的結構，
 * enum、required、x-slot、x-richtext.features、x-lost-checks 排序，物件 key 排序（規格 §4.6）。
 */
export function toDataContract(spec: AnyBlockSpec): JsonSchema {
  return sortKeysDeep(
    rewriteSchema(toJsonSchema(spec), canonicalNode)
  ) as JsonSchema;
}

export type ContractBreak = {
  /** 欄位路徑，例如 "count"、"group.level"、"columns[].content"；根節點是 "" */
  path: string;
  kind:
    | "removed-property"
    | "type-changed"
    | "enum-value-removed"
    | "limit-tightened"
    | "pattern-changed"
    | "new-required"
    | "slot-narrowed"
    | "richtext-features-removed"
    | "strictness-changed"
    | "kind-changed";
  detail: string;
};

/** 下限類關鍵字：數值變大或新出現時算收緊。 */
const LOWER_LIMITS = [
  "minLength",
  "minimum",
  "exclusiveMinimum",
  "minItems",
  "minProperties",
];
/** 上限類關鍵字：數值變小或新出現時算收緊。 */
const UPPER_LIMITS = [
  "maxLength",
  "maximum",
  "exclusiveMaximum",
  "maxItems",
  "maxProperties",
];

const join = (path: string, key: string) =>
  path === "" ? key : `${path}.${key}`;

const kindOf = (node: JsonSchema): string => {
  try {
    return fieldKindOf(node);
  } catch {
    return "unknown";
  }
};

const typesOf = (node: JsonSchema): string[] =>
  typeof node.type === "string"
    ? [node.type]
    : Array.isArray(node.type)
    ? node.type.map(String)
    : [];

/** next 的 type 是否涵蓋 previous 的每個 type（integer 被 number 涵蓋；沒有 type 表示不限）。 */
function typesCovered(previous: string[], next: string[]): boolean {
  if (next.length === 0) return true;
  if (previous.length === 0) return false;
  return previous.every(
    (type) =>
      next.includes(type) || (type === "integer" && next.includes("number"))
  );
}

const valuesOf = (node: JsonSchema): unknown[] | undefined =>
  Array.isArray(node.enum)
    ? node.enum
    : hasOwn(node, "const")
    ? [node.const]
    : undefined;

const stringList = (value: unknown): string[] =>
  Array.isArray(value) ? value.map(String) : [];

function compareValues(
  previous: JsonSchema,
  next: JsonSchema,
  path: string,
  out: ContractBreak[]
) {
  const before = valuesOf(previous);
  const after = valuesOf(next);
  if (after === undefined) return;
  if (before === undefined) {
    out.push({
      path,
      kind: "limit-tightened",
      detail: `now restricted to ${JSON.stringify(after)}`,
    });
    return;
  }
  for (const value of before) {
    if (!after.some((candidate) => compareJson(candidate, value) === 0)) {
      out.push({
        path,
        kind: "enum-value-removed",
        detail: `${JSON.stringify(value)} removed`,
      });
    }
  }
}

function compareLimits(
  previous: JsonSchema,
  next: JsonSchema,
  path: string,
  out: ContractBreak[]
) {
  const check = (
    keyword: string,
    tighter: (a: number, b: number) => boolean
  ) => {
    const before = previous[keyword];
    const after = next[keyword];
    if (typeof after !== "number") return;
    if (typeof before !== "number" || tighter(after, before)) {
      const from = typeof before === "number" ? String(before) : "(none)";
      out.push({
        path,
        kind: "limit-tightened",
        detail: `${keyword} ${from} → ${after}`,
      });
    }
  };
  for (const keyword of LOWER_LIMITS) check(keyword, (a, b) => a > b);
  for (const keyword of UPPER_LIMITS) check(keyword, (a, b) => a < b);
  // 舊值都是 b 的倍數；只有 b 也是 a 的倍數時，舊值才全都是 a 的倍數
  check("multipleOf", (a, b) => b % a !== 0);
  if (next.uniqueItems === true && previous.uniqueItems !== true) {
    out.push({ path, kind: "limit-tightened", detail: "uniqueItems added" });
  }
}

function comparePatterns(
  previous: JsonSchema,
  next: JsonSchema,
  path: string,
  out: ContractBreak[]
) {
  for (const keyword of ["pattern", "format"]) {
    const before = previous[keyword];
    const after = next[keyword];
    if (after !== undefined && after !== before) {
      const from = before === undefined ? "(none)" : JSON.stringify(before);
      out.push({
        path,
        kind: "pattern-changed",
        detail: `${keyword} ${from} → ${JSON.stringify(after)}`,
      });
    }
  }
}

function compareSlots(
  previous: JsonSchema,
  next: JsonSchema,
  path: string,
  out: ContractBreak[]
) {
  const before = previous["x-slot"];
  const after = next["x-slot"];
  if (!isSchemaObject(before) || !isSchemaObject(after)) return;
  const narrowed = (detail: string) =>
    out.push({ path, kind: "slot-narrowed", detail });
  if (hasOwn(before, "allow") && hasOwn(after, "allow")) {
    const removed = stringList(before.allow).filter(
      (type) => !stringList(after.allow).includes(type)
    );
    if (removed.length > 0) narrowed(`no longer allows ${removed.join(", ")}`);
  } else if (hasOwn(before, "disallow") && hasOwn(after, "disallow")) {
    const added = stringList(after.disallow).filter(
      (type) => !stringList(before.disallow).includes(type)
    );
    if (added.length > 0) narrowed(`now disallows ${added.join(", ")}`);
  } else if (hasOwn(before, "allow") && hasOwn(after, "disallow")) {
    const blocked = stringList(before.allow).filter((type) =>
      stringList(after.disallow).includes(type)
    );
    if (blocked.length > 0) narrowed(`now disallows ${blocked.join(", ")}`);
  } else {
    narrowed("changed from disallow to allow");
  }
}

function compareRichText(
  previous: JsonSchema,
  next: JsonSchema,
  path: string,
  out: ContractBreak[]
) {
  const before = previous["x-richtext"];
  const after = next["x-richtext"];
  if (!isSchemaObject(before) || !isSchemaObject(after)) return;
  const removed = stringList(before.features).filter(
    (feature) => !stringList(after.features).includes(feature)
  );
  if (removed.length > 0) {
    out.push({
      path,
      kind: "richtext-features-removed",
      detail: `removed ${removed.join(", ")}`,
    });
  }
}

function compareObjects(
  previous: JsonSchema,
  next: JsonSchema,
  path: string,
  out: ContractBreak[]
) {
  const before = propertiesOf(previous);
  const after = propertiesOf(next);
  for (const key of Object.keys(before)) {
    if (!hasOwn(after, key)) {
      out.push({
        path: join(path, key),
        kind: "removed-property",
        detail: "property removed",
      });
    }
  }
  const wasRequired = requiredOf(previous);
  for (const key of requiredOf(next)) {
    if (!wasRequired.includes(key)) {
      out.push({
        path: join(path, key),
        kind: "new-required",
        detail: hasOwn(before, key)
          ? "existing property became required"
          : "new required property without a default",
      });
    }
  }
  // 必填的 link() 與 image() 不在 required 裡（prefault），預設值卻不合格
  for (const key of Object.keys(after)) {
    if (
      !hasOwn(before, key) &&
      !requiredOf(next).includes(key) &&
      hasFailingDefault(after[key])
    ) {
      out.push({
        path: join(path, key),
        kind: "new-required",
        detail: "new required link or image; its default does not pass",
      });
    }
  }
  if (
    next.additionalProperties === false &&
    previous.additionalProperties !== false
  ) {
    out.push({
      path,
      kind: "strictness-changed",
      detail: "additional properties are no longer allowed",
    });
  }
  for (const key of Object.keys(before)) {
    if (hasOwn(after, key)) {
      compareNode(before[key], after[key], join(path, key), out);
    }
  }
}

function compareNode(
  previous: JsonSchema,
  next: JsonSchema,
  path: string,
  out: ContractBreak[]
): void {
  const typesBefore = typesOf(previous);
  const typesAfter = typesOf(next);
  if (!typesCovered(typesBefore, typesAfter)) {
    out.push({
      path,
      kind: "type-changed",
      detail: `${typesBefore.join("|") || "any"} → ${typesAfter.join("|")}`,
    });
    return;
  }
  const kindBefore = kindOf(previous);
  const kindAfter = kindOf(next);
  // choice → text 只是拿掉選項限制（放寬），其餘種類改變一律不相容
  if (
    kindBefore !== kindAfter &&
    !(kindBefore === "choice" && kindAfter === "text")
  ) {
    out.push({
      path,
      kind: "kind-changed",
      detail: `${kindBefore} → ${kindAfter}`,
    });
    return;
  }
  compareValues(previous, next, path, out);
  compareLimits(previous, next, path, out);
  comparePatterns(previous, next, path, out);
  compareSlots(previous, next, path, out);
  compareRichText(previous, next, path, out);
  compareObjects(previous, next, path, out);
  if (isSchemaObject(previous.items) && isSchemaObject(next.items)) {
    compareNode(previous.items, next.items, `${path}[]`, out);
  }
}

/**
 * 比較兩版資料契約，列出「舊資料在新版會被拒絕」的不相容差異（規格 §4.6）。
 * 新增選填或有合格預設值的欄位、放寬上下限、新增選項、新增 allow 的類型都不算；
 * 新增必填的 link() 或 image() 算（預設值不合格）。
 */
export function diffContracts(
  previous: JsonSchema,
  next: JsonSchema
): ContractBreak[] {
  const breaks: ContractBreak[] = [];
  compareNode(previous, next, "", breaks);
  return breaks;
}
```

### Task 9: 整頁驗證器

目的：在 `packages/spec/src/validator/` 實作規格 §6.2 的整頁驗證器 `createPageValidator`，產生 `validatePage` 與 `validatePageJson`。它依序做 §6.2 的 12 項檢查：UTF-8 位元組大小、JSON、頁面外形與舊 `zones`、節點外形與 `readOnly`、已登記類型、id、巢狀層數與區塊數、每個區塊 props 的 zod 檢查與補預設值、放置規則、富文字清理提示、root props；錯誤全部收集（最多 `maxIssues` 筆），每筆有穩定的 `code`、`path` 與說出區塊名稱、欄位名稱、允許範圍的中文訊息。通過時回傳只含 `root` 與 `content`、已補齊預設值並清理過富文字的新物件。本 task 只用 Task 7 的測試專用規格（`src/__fixtures__/test-specs.ts`）驗證，綁定 8 個區塊是 Task 10 的事；另外以 Ajv 2020-12（區塊 schema）加 Ajv draft-07（Task 8 的外殼 schema）做 §13.1 的雙層一致性測試。

**執行位置**：主工作目錄 `/Users/kaellim/Desktop/projects/puck`，分支 `s2/block-spec`。

**設計決定與說明**：
- **模組切分**（都在 `packages/spec/src/validator/`）：`types.ts`（`ValidateResult`，並轉出 Task 8 `src/limits.ts` 的 `ValidatorLimits`，不另外定義一份）、`issues.ts`（`ISSUE_CODES`、`Issue`、`formatPathText`、內部的 `IssueList`）、`messages.ts`（每個 code 一個中文訊息函式）、`values.ts`（讀取不可信資料的工具）、`registry.ts`（由規格算出驗證要用的資料）、`describe.ts`（zod issue → code 與中文訊息，也就是 per-call error map）、`richtext.ts`（判斷富文字是否被清理）、`props.ts`（zod 檢查）、`walk.ts`（整頁流程）、`index.ts`（`createPageValidator` 與公開匯出）。驗證器只 import `zod`（僅型別）、`@tzuchi/tceditor/rules` 與 `packages/spec` 內部的 `define`、`json-schema`、`slots`、`spec-rules`、`page-data`、`limits`，**不 import `convert/*`**（C.2；Step 7 用 grep 檢查）。zod 的執行期程式碼經由規格本身（`spec.props`）與 `json-schema.ts` 進來。
- **三個階段，順序與 §6.2 相同**：
  - 第 1 段（#3）頂層：`root`、`content`、`zones` 以外的 key → `invalid_shape`；`root` 必須是只有 `props`（與會被移除的 `readOnly`）的物件；`zones` 不存在或是空物件，非空 → `legacy_zones`，不是物件 → `invalid_shape`；`content` 必須是陣列。
  - 第 2 段（#4–#7）結構走訪：用明確的 stack（不遞迴）依頁面順序（前序）走訪 `content` 與每個已登記區塊的放置區。每個節點檢查外形（只能有 `type`、`props`、`readOnly`）、類型、id、層數與總數。`content` 頂層是第 1 層，放在第 n 層區塊放置區裡的是第 n+1 層（「與規格的差異」#21）；超過 32 層的區塊回報 `too_deep`（path 是那個區塊）而且不再進入；第 5,001 個區塊回報 `too_many_blocks`（path 是那個區塊，例如 `content[5000]`）並停止走訪。
  - 第 3 段：依頁面順序對每個區塊跑 zod（#8、#9）、放置規則（#10，重用 rules 入口的 `isComponentAllowed`，規則來自 `slotLocations(spec)`）、富文字提示（#11）；最後是 root props（#12）。全部通過才組出輸出。
  - 結果是錯誤依「階段 → 頁面順序」排列，測試 `collects every error in the order of spec §6.2` 固定這個順序。
- **不依頁面深度遞迴（§6.2 #7）**：2 MB 內可以寫出約 4 萬層的頁面（實測 40,000 層 2,028,948 bytes），所以整條路徑都不能隨輸入的深度遞迴：
  - 無效頁面會經過的程式：`JSON.parse`（V8 的實作不遞迴）、第 2 段的明確 stack、`formatPathText` 與 `fieldAt`（迴圈）、訊息函式（只用字串參數）。超過 32 層的區塊只讀它的 `type` 來寫 `too_deep` 訊息，不進入、不複製，所以第 3 段的 zod、放置規則與富文字比較都碰不到第 33 層以下的資料。驗證器任何地方都不複製整頁（不用 `structuredClone`，也不先遞迴計算區塊數）。
  - 通過的頁面最多 32 層區塊，`assemble` 從前序清單尾端往前組，也是迴圈；zod 拿到的 props 已把放置區換成 `[]`（見「zod 的輸入與輸出」），遞迴深度只跟規格的欄位深度有關，與頁面層數無關；富文字的比較另有深度上限（見「富文字清理」），`normalizeRichText` 取出過深節點的文字也不遞迴（2 MB 內約 59,000 層的 blockquote 實測只得到 `richtext_cleaned`）。
  - 每個待走訪的節點都複製一份上層的 path，記憶體與層數的平方成正比，所以 `limits.maxDepth` 只適合規格的 32 這種小數字。
  - 測試 `stops at level 33 of a 30,000-level page without overflowing the stack` 用 `chainPageJson(30_000)`（約 1.5 MB；直接組字串，不經過會遞迴的 `JSON.stringify`）確認 `validatePageJson` 與 `validatePage` 都只回報第 33 層的 `too_deep`，約 20 ms。實測在 `walkPage` 開頭加上 `structuredClone(data)`，或先遞迴計算全頁區塊數，這個測試都會以 `RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded` 失敗。若它失敗，要改實作（找出依輸入深度遞迴的地方），不要減少層數。
- **id（#6）**：依序檢查存在、是字串、符合 `NODE_ID_PATTERN`、不是 `"root"`（`"root"` 符合 pattern，所以 root 要另外判斷）、整頁不重複。重複時 path 是第二次出現的位置，訊息帶出第一次出現的 `pathText`。已用過的 id 放在 `Map`（不是一般物件，所以 `__proto__` 這種 id 不會碰到 prototype）。
- **類型查表（#5）**：`Object.create(null)` 的表加 `Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call`（`registry.ts` 的 `lookupEntry`），`constructor`、`__proto__`、`toString`、`hasOwnProperty` 都是 `unknown_type`（CLAUDE.md 的安全規則；facts zod-ajv §9 的 edge 探針也用 own-property 查表）。
- **zod 的輸入與輸出（#8、#9）**：
  - 先取出 `props.id`（區塊 schema 不宣告 id，「與規格的差異」#8、gaps #12），用 null-prototype 複本交給 zod；JSON 解析出的 own `__proto__` key 因此和其他 key 一樣得到 `unrecognized_keys` → `unknown_prop`（facts zod-ajv §7「Prototype safety」）。
  - **放置區陣列先換成 `[]`**：子區塊由走訪逐一檢查。若讓 zod 看到子區塊，`readOnly` 會變成 `unrecognized_keys`，子區塊外形錯誤會重複回報兩次，而且 `z.record` 會靜默丟掉子區塊 props 的 `__proto__`（facts zod-ajv §5、§7）。zod 仍會檢查「放置區是陣列」與缺少時補 `[]`（Review Focus #4）。
  - 輸出：每個區塊的 props 是 `{ id, ...zod 的輸出 }`，再把子區塊的輸出放回對應的放置區位置；從前序清單的尾端往前組，子區塊一定先組好。zod 的輸出都是新物件（物件與陣列預設值都是函式，「與規格的差異」#3），測試確認改動輸出不會影響之後的預設值。
- **zod issue → IssueCode**（C.2）：`unrecognized_keys` 依 key 拆成多筆 `unknown_prop`（path 加上 key）；`custom` 且 `params.code` 是 `unsafe_href` 或 `alt_required` → 該 code；其他 → `invalid_value`。補充兩條規則：同一 path 只留第一筆（防禦性措施：Task 7 的 `link()` 以 `.min(1, { abort: true }).max(2048, { abort: true })` 讓空字串只產生一筆 `too_small`，目前的 helper 不會在同一 path 產生兩筆）；富文字欄位內部的 path（例如 `body.type`）截到欄位本身。
- **中文訊息只透過 per-call error map**：`entry.props.safeParse(input, { error: errorMapFor(entry) })`，不碰 `z.config`（Global Constraints）。zod 在第一次讀 `result.error.issues` 時才呼叫 error map（facts zod-ajv §7「Issues are finalised lazily」），所以 `checkProps` 在同一個函式內立刻讀取；error map 是綁定該區塊的閉包。helper 若自己設了 `message` 會蓋過 error map（facts §7），所以 Task 7 的 helper 只設 `params`；`messages.spec.ts` 斷言 `unsafe_href` 的訊息是中文，也斷言驗證後 `z.config()` 沒變、zod 的預設訊息仍是英文。
- **訊息寫法**（C.2）：`messages.ts` 的 `MESSAGES` 用 mapped type 宣告成「每個 `IssueCode` 一個函式」，少寫一個 code 就 typecheck 失敗。區塊用 `label`，欄位用 JSON Schema 的 `title`，巢狀欄位以「／」連接（例如「兩欄的『欄／內容』」）；選項顯示 `x-labels` 的中文並附上存進資料庫的值，例如「沉穩（calm）」，AI 才知道要填哪個值；長度單位「字」、數量單位「項」，數字顯示範圍，例如「必須是 1 到 10 的整數。」；圖片的 `assetId` 錯誤說成「還沒有選擇圖片」或「圖片代號格式不正確」。頁面資料裡的值（未知的 key、type、id）最多顯示 64 字。規格範例的訊息格式（「按鈕的『連結網址』只接受 http、https、mailto、tel 或站內路徑。」）由 KitchenSink 版本「全欄位的『連結網址』只接受 http、https、mailto、tel 或站內路徑。」逐字斷言。
- **富文字清理（#11）**：清理本身在 Task 7 的 `richText()` 裡（`normalizeRichText` 再 `fitRichTextToTypes`，`textAlign` 一律關閉，「與規格的差異」#10、#24）。`textAlign: false` 的效果是**移除** paragraph／heading 的 `attrs.textAlign`，`attrs` 變空就整個拿掉（Task 2；與 ProseMirror `toJSON()` 省略空 attrs 的形狀相同），所以本 task 測試裡清理後的段落一律沒有 `attrs`。驗證器只判斷「有沒有被改」：對每個 `x-richtext` 欄位（路徑由 `eachField` 找出，陣列項目用 `"[]"`），輸入是物件時，比較輸入與輸出的 canonical `stableStringify`：
  - canonical 是先去掉值為 `null` 的 attrs 與空的 `attrs`／`content`／`marks`（`richtext.ts` 的 `isRichTextChanged`，Task 10 也依賴它）。原因：帶 `attrs: { textAlign: null }` 的資料（Review Focus #1 明列的編輯器資料、舊資料、`textToRichText` 的輸出）會被 fit 拿掉 `attrs`，直接比會誤報 `richtext_cleaned`；編輯器沒有 TextAlign 時送出的段落本來就沒有 `attrs`，輸出與輸入相同。
  - normalize 補上缺少的屬性（link 的 `target`／`rel`、heading 的 `level`、orderedList 的 `start`）、合併相鄰的同格式文字或移除空的文字節點時，資料確實變了，也算清理並提示。所以 `richtext_cleaned` 的訊息不只說「移除」，寫成「已依這個欄位允許的格式自動整理：不支援的格式與不安全的連結只保留文字，對齊方式會移除，缺少的屬性會補上預設值。」測試 `notes a link that only had its default attributes filled in` 固定這個行為。
  - 比較用的複本有深度上限（`2 × RICHTEXT_MAX_DEPTH + 8`），太深或循環參照的輸入直接算「被清理」，所以 1 萬層的 blockquote 也不會堆疊溢位。
  - 輸入缺少時用預設值，不算清理；不是物件時 zod 已回報 `invalid_value`（「與規格的差異」#24：字串會被拒絕）。
  - **富文字預設值必須是已 fit 的形狀**：zod 的 `.default()` 不經過 `.overwrite()`（facts zod-ajv §4.5），預設值原樣存進輸出。若預設值帶 `attrs: { textAlign: null }`，第二次驗證會把它移除，冪等就不成立。所以 fixture 的 KitchenSink `body` 預設值寫成 `fitRichTextToTypes(textToRichText("內文"), richTextFeaturesToTypes(["bold", "link"]))`（Task 7；Step 1 確認）。
- **大小（#1）與 JSON（#2）**：`validatePageJson` 收到字串時，先比 `length`（每個 UTF-16 code unit 至少 1 個 UTF-8 位元組，超過就不必編碼），再用 `TextEncoder` 量位元組；收到位元組時比 `byteLength`，再用 `TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true })` 解碼，不合法的 UTF-8 是 `invalid_json`。判斷位元組用 `ArrayBuffer.isView` 加 `Object.prototype.toString`，因為 jest 與 Node `Buffer` 的 `Uint8Array` 可能來自另一個 realm，`instanceof` 會失敗。剛好 2,097,152 bytes 不因大小被拒（Review Focus #2）。`validatePage` 收到的是已解析的資料，不量大小。
- **上限**：錯誤收到 `maxIssues`（預設 100）筆就停止走訪並截斷；notices 另外最多 `maxIssues` 筆。`limits` 可以覆寫，每一項都必須是正整數，否則 `createPageValidator` 拋 `TypeError`。
- **deprecated 區塊**：仍然通過驗證（§4.1：既有頁面仍能顯示與編輯），但不出現在 `unknown_type`、`not_allowed_here` 訊息「可以用／可以放」的清單裡。清單與「不能放…」裡的區塊一律寫成「名稱（類型）」，例如「全欄位（KitchenSink）」：名稱給編輯者看，類型給 AI 填值。
- **root 規格不能有放置區**：驗證器只走訪 `content`，root 的放置區裡的區塊會在沒檢查的情況下存進去，所以 `rootEntry` 遇到 `x-slot` 直接拋 `TypeError("The page root spec must not have slot fields")`。`checkSpecRules` 不擋這種規格（實測），測試 `throws when the page root spec has a slot field` 固定這個行為。
- **雙層一致性測試**（§13.1，`dual-layer.spec.ts`）：Ajv2020 用 `{ strict: true, allErrors: true, useDefaults: true }` 並以 `addVocabulary(X_KEYS)` 註冊所有 `x-*`（facts zod-ajv §10.1、gaps #21）；每個區塊的 props 先去掉 `id`（gaps #12）再交給該類型的 `toJsonSchema(spec)`；外殼用 Task 8 的 `buildPageShellSchema({ blocks: testBlocks })` 與 draft-07 `Ajv`。兩個方向的定義（這是偏離規格 §13.1 的地方，即「與規格的差異」#25）：
  - 「Ajv 接受、zod 拒絕」：規格只允許 x-lost-checks 對應的 `unsafe_href`、`alt_required`。外殼 schema 依 §6.5 只檢查結構，facts zod-ajv §10.2 實測 33 層、5,000 個區塊外殼都接受，id 重複與放置規則 JSON Schema 也表達不了，所以允許清單另加整頁規則 `duplicate_id`、`not_allowed_here`、`too_deep`、`too_many_blocks`，並斷言實際出現的反方向 code 恰好是這六個。`x-lost-checks` 的值以 `Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(LOST_CHECK_CODES, check)` 對應到 code（CLAUDE.md：以資料為 key 查一般物件時不用 `in`，`"constructor" in {}` 是 true；Task 12 的 `dual-layer.spec.ts` 用同一寫法）。
  - 「zod 接受 ⇒ Ajv 接受」：對外殼檢查的是**驗證器的輸出**（存進資料庫的資料），對區塊 props 則同時檢查輸入與輸出。輸入帶 `readOnly` 時外殼會拒絕、zod 卻接受，因為驗證器會把它移除；缺少的放置區 key 也由驗證器補齊。
  - 另外實測 zod 4.6.5 的 `min`／`max` 以 Unicode code point 計算長度（`node_modules/zod/v4/core/checks.js` 的 `$ZodCheckMaxLength`：「Strings are measured in Unicode code points」），和 Ajv 的預設相同，所以語料放了「20 個 emoji 通過、21 個兩邊都拒絕」。
- **效能（實測）**：5,000 個區塊、1.9 MB 的頁面在 jest 中 `validatePageJson` 約 150 ms；5,000 個都有錯的區塊在第 100 筆錯誤後停止，約 10 ms。
- **測試輔助檔放在 `__helpers__/`**：jest 預設把 `__tests__/` 裡的每個檔都當成測試，所以共用的頁面產生器放在 `src/validator/__helpers__/pages.ts`（與 core 的 `__helpers__` 慣例相同）。`packages/spec` 的 `tsc` 會檢查測試檔，所以測試也要能通過 strict 型別檢查。

```ts
import { testBlocks, testRoot } from "../../__fixtures__/test-specs";
import { createPageValidator, type ValidateResult } from "../index";

export const validator = createPageValidator({
  blocks: testBlocks,
  root: testRoot,
});

export const page = (
  content: unknown[],
  extra: Record<string, unknown> = {}
): Record<string, unknown> => ({
  root: { props: { title: "測試頁" } },
  content,
  ...extra,
});

export const leaf = (id: string, text = "葉"): TestNode => ({
  type: "Leaf",
  props: { id, text },
});

export const box = (id: string, content: unknown[] = []): TestNode => ({
  type: "Box",
  props: { id, content },
});

export const pair = (id: string, columns: unknown[][]): TestNode => ({
  type: "Pair",
  props: { id, columns: columns.map((content) => ({ content })) },
});

/** The required KitchenSink fields, filled in */
export const FILLED = {
  href: "/register",
  picture: { assetId: "demo-1", alt: "示意圖", decorative: false },
};

export const kitchenSink = (
  id: string,
  props: Record<string, unknown> = {}
): TestNode => ({ type: "KitchenSink", props: { id, ...FILLED, ...props } });

/** A chain of `levels` blocks: Boxes, with a Leaf as the deepest block. */
export const chain = (levels: number): TestNode => {
  let node = leaf(`n${levels}`);

  for (let level = levels - 1; level >= 1; level--) {
    node = box(`n${level}`, [node]);
  }

  return node;
};

/** The path of the deepest block of chain(levels) at content[0]. */
export const chainPath = (levels: number): (string | number)[] => {
  const path: (string | number)[] = ["content", 0];

  for (let level = 2; level <= levels; level++) {
    path.push("props", "content", 0);
  }

  return path;
};

/**
 * The JSON text of page([chain(levels)]), built as a string: a page tens of
 * thousands of levels deep needs no recursive JSON.stringify.
 */
export const chainPageJson = (levels: number): string => {
  const boxes: string[] = [];

  for (let level = 1; level < levels; level++) {
    boxes.push(`{"type":"Box","props":{"id":"n${level}","content":[`);
  }

  const deepest = `{"type":"Leaf","props":{"id":"n${levels}","text":"葉"}}`;

  return `{"root":{"props":{"title":"測試頁"}},"content":[${boxes.join(
    ""
  )}${deepest}${"]}}".repeat(levels - 1)}]}`;
};

/** [pathText, code] of every error, or [] when the page passed. */
export const errorsOf = (result: ValidateResult): [string, string][] =>
  result.ok ? [] : result.errors.map((issue) => [issue.pathText, issue.code]);

/** Builds a JSON text of exactly `bytes` UTF-8 bytes, mostly 3-byte Chinese text. */
export const jsonOfBytes = (bytes: number): string => {
  const head = '{"root":{"props":{"title":"';
  const tail = '"}},"content":[]}';
  const room = bytes - head.length - tail.length;
  const chinese = Math.floor(room / 3);

  return head + "中".repeat(chinese) + "a".repeat(room - chinese * 3) + tail;
};

/** What the editor emits (Review Focus #1): zones {}, uuid ids, no root id, getJSON() rich text. */
export const editorPage = (): Record<string, unknown> => ({
  root: { props: { title: "淨灘活動", description: "" } },
  content: [
    {
      type: "KitchenSink",
      props: {
        id: "KitchenSink-1b9d6bcd-bbfd-4b2d-9b5d-ab8dfbbd4bed",
        title: "一起去淨灘",
        note: "",
        count: 3,
        tone: "calm",
        size: "md",
        space: "16",
        enabled: true,
        href: "https://example.org/register",
        moreHref: "",
        body: {
          type: "doc",
          content: [
            {
              type: "paragraph",
              attrs: { textAlign: null },
              content: [
                { type: "text", text: "報名請按" },
                {
                  type: "text",
                  marks: [
                    {
                      type: "link",
                      attrs: {
                        href: "/register",
                        target: "_blank",
                        rel: "noopener noreferrer nofollow",
                        class: null,
                        title: null,
                      },
                    },
                  ],
                  text: "這裡",
                },
              ],
            },
            {
              type: "paragraph",
              content: [
                { type: "text", marks: [{ type: "bold" }], text: "免費" },
              ],
            },
          ],
        },
        items: [{ label: "一" }],
        group: { caption: "", level: 0 },
        content: [
          {
            type: "Leaf",
            props: {
              id: "Leaf-0d3c8a59-5f0e-4b7a-9a43-2f6b1c7e9d10",
              text: "子",
            },
          },
        ],
        picture: { assetId: "demo-1", alt: "海灘", decorative: false },
      },
    },
    {
      type: "Pair",
      props: {
        id: "Pair-7c9e6679-7425-40de-944b-e07fc1f90ae7",
```

建立 `packages/spec/src/validator/__tests__/validator.spec.ts`（正例、反例、上限、Review Focus #2 與 #3）：

```ts
import * as z from "zod";
import { leafSpec, testBlocks, testRoot } from "../../__fixtures__/test-specs";
import { definePageRoot } from "../../define";
import { slot } from "../../helpers";
import * as specPackage from "../../index";
import { exampleToPageData } from "../../page-data";
import {
  box,
  chain,
  chainPageJson,
  chainPath,
  editorPage,
  errorsOf,
  FILLED,
  jsonOfBytes,
  kitchenSink,
  leaf,
  page,
  pair,
  validator,
} from "../__helpers__/pages";
import {
  createPageValidator,
  DEFAULT_LIMITS,
  formatPathText,
  ISSUE_CODES,
  NODE_ID_PATTERN,
  type ValidateResult,
} from "../index";

type Accepted = Extract<ValidateResult, { ok: true }>;

const accepted = (result: ValidateResult): Accepted => {
  if (!result.ok) {
    throw new Error(
      `Expected the page to pass:\n${JSON.stringify(result.errors, null, 2)}`
    );
  }

  return result;
};

const leaves = (count: number, text = "葉") =>
  Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => leaf(`l${i}`, text));

describe("createPageValidator", () => {
  it("uses the limits of spec §6.2", () => {
    expect(DEFAULT_LIMITS).toEqual({
      maxBytes: 2_097_152,
      maxDepth: 32,
      maxBlocks: 5000,
      maxIssues: 100,
    });
    expect(NODE_ID_PATTERN.source).toBe("^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$");
  });

  it("is exported from the package root", () => {
    expect(specPackage.createPageValidator).toBe(createPageValidator);
    expect(specPackage.DEFAULT_LIMITS).toBe(DEFAULT_LIMITS);
    expect(specPackage.NODE_ID_PATTERN).toBe(NODE_ID_PATTERN);
    expect(specPackage.ISSUE_CODES).toBe(ISSUE_CODES);
    expect(specPackage.formatPathText).toBe(formatPathText);
  });

  it("lists the block types in registration order", () => {
    expect(validator.blockTypes).toEqual([
      "KitchenSink",
      "Box",
      "Leaf",
      "Pair",
    ]);
  });

  it("throws when the specs break the authoring rules", () => {
    expect(() =>
      createPageValidator({ blocks: [leafSpec, leafSpec], root: testRoot })
    ).toThrow(/unique-type/);
  });

  it("rejects limits that are not positive integers", () => {
    expect(() =>
      createPageValidator({
        blocks: testBlocks,
        root: testRoot,
        limits: { maxDepth: 0 },
      })
    ).toThrow(TypeError);
    expect(() =>
      createPageValidator({
        blocks: testBlocks,
        root: testRoot,
        limits: { maxIssues: 1.5 },
      })
    ).toThrow("limits.maxIssues must be a positive integer, got 1.5");
  });

  it("throws when the page root spec has a slot field", () => {
    expect(() =>
      createPageValidator({
        blocks: testBlocks,
        root: definePageRoot({
          props: z.strictObject({
            content: slot({ allow: ["Leaf"] }).meta({ title: "內容" }),
          }),
        }),
      })
    ).toThrow("The page root spec must not have slot fields");
  });
});

describe("valid pages", () => {
  const examples = testBlocks.flatMap((spec) =>
    spec.examples.map((example, index) => ({
      spec,
      index,
      number: index + 1,
      name: example.name,
    }))
  );

  it.each(examples)(
    "accepts example $number of $spec.type ($name)",
    ({ spec, index }) => {
      const result = accepted(
        validator.validatePage(exampleToPageData(spec, index))
      );

      expect(result.notices).toEqual([]);
      expect(result.data.content[0].type).toBe(spec.type);
    }
  );

  it("accepts data exactly as the editor emits it", () => {
    const input = editorPage();
    const result = accepted(validator.validatePage(input));

    expect(result.notices).toEqual([]);
    expect(Object.keys(result.data)).toEqual(["root", "content"]);
    expect(result.data.root).toEqual({
      props: { title: "淨灘活動", description: "" },
    });
    expect(result.data.content.map((node) => node.props.id)).toEqual([
      "KitchenSink-1b9d6bcd-bbfd-4b2d-9b5d-ab8dfbbd4bed",
      "Pair-7c9e6679-7425-40de-944b-e07fc1f90ae7",
    ]);
    // TextAlign is off in this field: the null textAlign of the first
    // paragraph is removed, without a notice, and no paragraph gets attrs
    expect(result.data.content[0].props.body).toEqual({
      type: "doc",
      content: [
        {
          type: "paragraph",
          content: [
            { type: "text", text: "報名請按" },
            {
              type: "text",
              marks: [
                {
                  type: "link",
                  attrs: {
                    href: "/register",
                    target: "_blank",
                    rel: "noopener noreferrer nofollow",
                    class: null,
                    title: null,
                  },
                },
              ],
              text: "這裡",
            },
          ],
        },
        {
          type: "paragraph",
          content: [{ type: "text", marks: [{ type: "bold" }], text: "免費" }],
        },
      ],
    });
  });

  it("is idempotent", () => {
    const pages = [
      editorPage(),
      ...testBlocks.flatMap((spec) =>
        spec.examples.map((_, index) => exampleToPageData(spec, index))
      ),
    ];

    for (const input of pages) {
      const first = accepted(validator.validatePage(input));
      const second = accepted(validator.validatePage(first.data));

      expect(second.data).toEqual(first.data);
      expect(second.notices).toEqual([]);
    }
  });

  it("fills missing props with their defaults", () => {
    const result = accepted(
      validator.validatePage(
        page([
          { type: "Leaf", props: { id: "l" } },
          { type: "Box", props: { id: "b" } },
          { type: "Pair", props: { id: "p", columns: [{}, { content: [] }] } },
          { type: "Pair", props: { id: "p2" } },
          kitchenSink("k"),
        ])
      )
    );
    const [leafNode, boxNode, pairNode, defaultPair, sink] =
      result.data.content;

    expect(leafNode.props).toEqual({ id: "l", text: "葉子" });
    expect(boxNode.props).toEqual({ id: "b", content: [] });
    expect(pairNode.props).toEqual({
      id: "p",
      columns: [{ content: [] }, { content: [] }],
    });
    expect(defaultPair.props).toEqual({
      id: "p2",
      columns: [{ content: [] }, { content: [] }],
    });
    expect(sink.props).toEqual({
      id: "k",
      title: "標題",
      note: "",
      count: 3,
      tone: "calm",
      size: "md",
      space: "16",
      enabled: true,
      href: "/register",
      moreHref: "",
      body: {
        type: "doc",
        content: [
          { type: "paragraph", content: [{ type: "text", text: "內文" }] },
        ],
      },
      items: [{ label: "一" }],
      group: { caption: "", level: 0 },
      content: [],
      picture: FILLED.picture,
    });
    expect(result.data.root.props).toEqual({
      title: "測試頁",
      description: "",
    });
  });

  it("removes readOnly and returns new objects", () => {
    const input = page([
      { ...leaf("a"), readOnly: { text: true } },
      box("b", [{ ...leaf("c"), readOnly: {} }]),
    ]);
    (input.root as Record<string, unknown>).readOnly = { title: true };
    const before = JSON.stringify(input);
    const result = accepted(validator.validatePage(input));

    expect(JSON.stringify(input)).toBe(before);
    expect(result.data).toEqual({
      root: { props: { title: "測試頁", description: "" } },
      content: [
        { type: "Leaf", props: { id: "a", text: "葉" } },
        { type: "Box", props: { id: "b", content: [leaf("c")] } },
      ],
    });
    expect(result.data.content[0]).not.toBe((input.content as unknown[])[0]);

    // Changing the output must not change the defaults of later pages
    const filled = accepted(validator.validatePage(page([kitchenSink("k")])));
    (filled.data.content[0].props.items as { label: string }[]).push({
      label: "改",
    });
    const again = accepted(validator.validatePage(page([kitchenSink("k")])));
    expect(again.data.content[0].props.items).toEqual([{ label: "一" }]);
  });

  it("keeps text that looks like a character reference as plain text", () => {
    const title = "&#x6A;avascript:alert(1)";
    const result = accepted(
      validator.validatePage(page([kitchenSink("k", { title })]))
    );

    expect(result.data.content[0].props.title).toBe(title);
  });

  it("accepts 32 levels, 5,000 blocks and ids of 64 characters", () => {
    expect(errorsOf(validator.validatePage(page([chain(32)])))).toEqual([]);
    expect(errorsOf(validator.validatePage(page(leaves(5000))))).toEqual([]);
    expect(
      errorsOf(validator.validatePage(page([leaf("a".repeat(64))])))
    ).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("accepts a block that a slot allows", () => {
    expect(
      errorsOf(
        validator.validatePage(
          page([
            box("b1", [box("b2", [leaf("l1")])]),
            kitchenSink("k", { content: [leaf("l2")] }),
            pair("p", [[box("b3")], [kitchenSink("k2")]]),
          ])
        )
      )
    ).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe("invalid pages", () => {
  it.each([
    "javascript:alert(1)",
    "JAVASCRIPT:alert(1)",
    "JaVaScRiPt:alert(1)",
    "   javascript:alert(1)",

  it("rejects an unknown prop", () => {

    expect(

  it.each(["Button", "constructor", "__proto__", "toString", "hasOwnProperty"])(

    expect(

    ).toEqual([["content[0].props.content[0].props.id", "duplicate_id"]]);

  it.each([
    ["root", "root"],

  it("rejects a block without an id", () => {

  it("rejects 33 levels of nesting", () => {

  it("stops at level 33 of a 30,000-level page without overflowing the stack", () => {
    // Spec §6.2 #7: no recursion over the page. Recursing into the whole

    expect(chainPageJson(3)).toBe(JSON.stringify(page([chain(3)])));

    const json = chainPageJson(30_000);
    const expected = [[formatPathText(chainPath(33)), "too_deep"]];

    expect(new TextEncoder().encode(json).byteLength).toBeLessThan(

    expect(errorsOf(validator.validatePage(JSON.parse(json)))).toEqual(

describe("Review Focus", () => {
  it("measures the 2 MB limit in UTF-8 bytes", () => {
    const encoder = new TextEncoder();
    const atLimit = jsonOfBytes(2_097_152);
    const over = jsonOfBytes(2_097_153);

    expect(encoder.encode(atLimit).byteLength).toBe(2_097_152);
    expect(atLimit.length).toBeLessThan(800_000);
    // Not too large: it fails later, because the title is too long
    expect(errorsOf(validator.validatePageJson(atLimit))).toEqual([
      ["root.props.title", "invalid_value"],
    ]);
    expect(
      errorsOf(validator.validatePageJson(encoder.encode(atLimit)))
    ).toEqual([["root.props.title", "invalid_value"]]);
    expect(errorsOf(validator.validatePageJson(over))).toEqual([
      ["", "too_large"],
    ]);

    // About 700,000 Chinese characters: fewer than 2,097,152 characters, but
    // about 2.1 MB in UTF-8
    const chinese = JSON.stringify(page([], {})).replace(
      "測試頁",
      "中".repeat(700_000)
    );

    expect(chinese.length).toBeLessThan(2_097_152);
    expect(errorsOf(validator.validatePageJson(chinese))).toEqual([
      ["", "too_large"],
    ]);

    // Text limits count characters, not bytes
    expect(
      errorsOf(
        validator.validatePage(
          page([kitchenSink("k", { title: "慈".repeat(40) })])
        )
      )
    ).toEqual([]);
    expect(
      errorsOf(
        validator.validatePage(
          page([kitchenSink("k", { title: "慈".repeat(41) })])
        )
      )
    ).toEqual([["content[0].props.title", "invalid_value"]]);
  });

  it("rejects prototype keys at every level without polluting Object.prototype", () => {
    const prototypeKeys = Object.getOwnPropertyNames(Object.prototype).sort();
    const json = `{
      "root": { "props": { "title": "頁", "__proto__": { "polluted": "root" } } },
      "content": [
        {
          "type": "KitchenSink",
          "props": {
            "id": "k",
            "href": "/x",
            "__proto__": { "polluted": "props" },
            "items": [{ "label": "一", "__proto__": { "polluted": "item" } }],
            "group": { "caption": "", "level": 0, "prototype": { "polluted": "group" } },
            "picture": { "assetId": "a", "alt": "b", "decorative": false, "constructor": { "polluted": "image" } },
            "content": [
              { "type": "Leaf", "props": { "id": "l", "text": "子", "constructor": { "prototype": { "polluted": "child" } } } }
            ]
          }
        }
      ]
    }`;
    const result = validator.validatePageJson(json);

    expect(errorsOf(result).sort()).toEqual(
      [
        ["content[0].props.__proto__", "unknown_prop"],
        ["content[0].props.items[0].__proto__", "unknown_prop"],
        ["content[0].props.group.prototype", "unknown_prop"],
        ["content[0].props.picture.constructor", "unknown_prop"],
        ["content[0].props.content[0].props.constructor", "unknown_prop"],
        ["root.props.__proto__", "unknown_prop"],
      ].sort()
    );
    expect(({} as Record<string, unknown>).polluted).toBeUndefined();
    expect(Object.getOwnPropertyNames(Object.prototype).sort()).toEqual(
      prototypeKeys
    );

    // Inside rich text the keys are cleaned away instead
    const cleaned = accepted(
      validator.validatePageJson(
        `{"root":{"props":{}},"content":[{"type":"KitchenSink","props":{"id":"k","href":"/x","picture":{"assetId":"a","alt":"b","decorative":false},"body":{"type":"doc","__proto__":{"polluted":1},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","constructor":{"polluted":2},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"字"}]}]}}}]}`
      )
    );

    expect(cleaned.notices.map((notice) => notice.pathText)).toEqual([
      "content[0].props.body",
    ]);
    expect(JSON.stringify(cleaned.data)).not.toMatch(
      /__proto__|constructor|polluted/
    );
    expect(Object.getPrototypeOf(cleaned.data.content[0].props)).toBe(
      Object.prototype
    );
    expect(({} as Record<string, unknown>).polluted).toBeUndefined();
  });
});
```

建立 `packages/spec/src/validator/__tests__/richtext-cleaning.spec.ts`（§6.2 #11）：

```ts
import { errorsOf, kitchenSink, page, validator } from "../__helpers__/pages";
import type { ValidateResult } from "../index";

const paragraph = (content: unknown[], textAlign: string | null = null) =>
  textAlign === null
    ? { type: "paragraph", content }
    : { type: "paragraph", attrs: { textAlign }, content };

const text = (value: string, marks?: unknown[]) =>
  marks ? { type: "text", marks, text: value } : { type: "text", text: value };

const doc = (...content: unknown[]) => ({ type: "doc", content });

const withBody = (body: unknown): ValidateResult =>
  validator.validatePage(page([kitchenSink("k", { body })]));

/** The cleaned body and the paths of the notices. */
const clean = (body: unknown) => {
  const result = withBody(body);

  if (!result.ok) throw new Error(JSON.stringify(result.errors, null, 2));

  return {
    body: result.data.content[0].props.body,
    notices: result.notices.map((notice) => [
      notice.pathText,
      notice.code,
      notice.blockType,
    ]),
  };
};

const NOTICE = [["content[0].props.body", "richtext_cleaned", "KitchenSink"]];

describe("rich text cleaning (spec §6.2 #11)", () => {
  it("keeps the text of an unknown node", () => {
    expect(
      clean(
        doc({
          type: "mention",
          attrs: { id: "u1" },
          content: [text("@志工")],
        })
      )
    ).toEqual({ body: doc(paragraph([text("@志工")])), notices: NOTICE });
  });

  it("turns a heading the field does not allow into a paragraph", () => {
    expect(
      clean(
        doc({
          type: "heading",
          attrs: { textAlign: null, level: 2 },
          content: [text("活動說明")],
        })
      )
    ).toEqual({ body: doc(paragraph([text("活動說明")])), notices: NOTICE });
  });

  it("keeps only the text of a javascript: link", () => {
    expect(
      clean(
        doc(
          paragraph([
            text("點我", [
              { type: "link", attrs: { href: "javascript:alert(1)" } },
            ]),
          ])
        )
      )
    ).toEqual({ body: doc(paragraph([text("點我")])), notices: NOTICE });
  });

  it("removes text alignment", () => {
    expect(clean(doc(paragraph([text("置中")], "center")))).toEqual({
      body: doc(paragraph([text("置中")])),
      notices: NOTICE,
    });
  });

  it("removes a mark the field does not allow", () => {
    expect(clean(doc(paragraph([text("斜體", [{ type: "italic" }])])))).toEqual(
      {
        body: doc(paragraph([text("斜體")])),
        notices: NOTICE,
      }
    );
  });

  it("flattens rich text nested far too deep", () => {
    let node: unknown = paragraph([text("底")]);

    for (let i = 0; i < 10_000; i++) {
      node = { type: "blockquote", content: [node] };
    }

    expect(clean(doc(node))).toEqual({
      body: doc(paragraph([text("底")])),
      notices: NOTICE,
    });
  });

  it("does not report editor output that needs no cleaning", () => {
    const link = {
      type: "link",
      attrs: {
        href: "https://example.org",
        target: "_blank",
        rel: "noopener noreferrer nofollow",
        class: null,
        title: null,
      },
    };

    // Without attrs (TextAlign is off in this field) and with a null textAlign
    for (const body of [
      doc(paragraph([text("粗", [{ type: "bold" }]), text("連結", [link])])),
      doc({
        type: "paragraph",
        attrs: { textAlign: null },
        content: [text("attrs 只有 null")],
      }),
      doc({ type: "paragraph" }),
      { type: "doc" },
    ]) {
      expect(clean(body).notices).toEqual([]);
    }
  });

  it("notes a link that only had its default attributes filled in", () => {
    expect(
      clean(
        doc(
          paragraph([text("報名", [{ type: "link", attrs: { href: "/x" } }])])
        )
      )
    ).toEqual({
      body: doc(
        paragraph([
          text("報名", [
            {
              type: "link",
              attrs: {
                href: "/x",
                target: "_blank",
                rel: "noopener noreferrer nofollow",
                class: null,
                title: null,
              },
            },
          ]),
        ])
      ),
      notices: NOTICE,
    });
  });

  it("uses the default without a notice when the field is missing", () => {
    const result = validator.validatePage(page([kitchenSink("k")]));

    expect(result.ok && result.notices).toEqual([]);
  });

  it.each([
    ["a string", "<p>舊的 HTML</p>"],
    ["another node", paragraph([text("段落")])],
    ["an array", [paragraph([text("段落")])]],
    ["null", null],
  ])("rejects %s instead of cleaning it", (_, body) => {
    expect(errorsOf(withBody(body))).toEqual([
      ["content[0].props.body", "invalid_value"],
    ]);
  });
});
```

```ts
    expect(config.customError).toBeUndefined();
```

建立 `packages/spec/src/validator/__tests__/dual-layer.spec.ts`（§13.1 雙層一致性）：

```ts
import Ajv, { type ValidateFunction } from "ajv";
import Ajv2020 from "ajv/dist/2020";
import { testBlocks, testRoot } from "../../__fixtures__/test-specs";
import { buildPageShellSchema } from "../../convert/page-shell";
import { toJsonSchema, type JsonSchema } from "../../json-schema";
import { X_KEYS } from "../../meta";
import { exampleToPageData } from "../../page-data";
import { slotLocations } from "../../slots";
import {
  box,
  chain,
  editorPage,
  kitchenSink,
  leaf,
  page,
  pair,
  validator,
} from "../__helpers__/pages";
import type { IssueCode } from "../index";

// Ajv the way S3 and S4 will run it: strict, every x-* keyword registered,
// defaults filled in like zod does (facts zod-ajv §10.1, gaps #21).
const ajv2020 = new Ajv2020({
  strict: true,
  allErrors: true,
  useDefaults: true,
});
ajv2020.addVocabulary([...X_KEYS]);

const compile = (schema: JsonSchema): ValidateFunction =>
  ajv2020.compile(structuredClone(schema));

const propsSchemas = new Map<string, ValidateFunction>(
  testBlocks.map((spec) => [spec.type, compile(toJsonSchema(spec))])
);
const rootSchema = compile(toJsonSchema(testRoot));
const shellSchema = new Ajv({ strict: true, allErrors: true }).compile(
  buildPageShellSchema({ blocks: testBlocks })
);
const specs = new Map<string, (typeof testBlocks)[number]>(
  testBlocks.map((spec) => [spec.type, spec])
);

type AnyRecord = Record<string, unknown>;

const isRecord = (value: unknown): value is AnyRecord =>
  typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);

const valuesAt = (value: unknown, segments: readonly string[]): unknown[] => {
  let found = [value];

  for (const segment of segments) {
    found = found.flatMap((item) =>
      segment === "[]"
        ? Array.isArray(item)
          ? item
          : []
        : isRecord(item) && segment in item
        ? [item[segment]]
        : []
    );
  }

  return found;
};

const blocksOf = (content: unknown, out: AnyRecord[] = []): AnyRecord[] => {
  if (!Array.isArray(content)) return out;

  for (const node of content) {
    if (!isRecord(node) || !isRecord(node.props)) continue;

    out.push(node);

    const spec =
      typeof node.type === "string" ? specs.get(node.type) : undefined;

    for (const slot of spec ? slotLocations(spec) : []) {
      for (const children of valuesAt(node.props, slot.path)) {
        blocksOf(children, out);
      }
    }
  }

  return out;
};

/** Per-block props (without id) and root props against the 2020-12 schemas, as MCP sees them. */
const propsAccepted = (input: unknown): boolean => {
  const data: unknown = structuredClone(input);

  if (!isRecord(data) || !isRecord(data.root)) return false;
  if (!rootSchema(data.root.props)) return false;

  return blocksOf(data.content).every((node) => {
    const check =
      typeof node.type === "string" ? propsSchemas.get(node.type) : undefined;
    const props = { ...(node.props as AnyRecord) };

    delete props.id;

    return check !== undefined && check(props);
  });
};

/** The draft-07 shell plus the per-block schemas. */
const ajvAccepts = (input: unknown): boolean =>
  shellSchema(structuredClone(input)) && propsAccepted(input);

type Case = { name: string; input: unknown };

const sink = (props: AnyRecord) => page([kitchenSink("k", props)]);

const corpus: Case[] = [
  ...testBlocks.flatMap((spec) =>
    spec.examples.map((example, index) => ({
      name: `example ${spec.type} ${example.name}`,
      input: exampleToPageData(spec, index),
    }))
  ),
  { name: "editor output", input: editorPage() },
  {
    name: "missing props and slots",
    input: page([
      { type: "Leaf", props: { id: "l" } },
      { type: "Box", props: { id: "b" } },
      { type: "Pair", props: { id: "p", columns: [{}, {}] } },
      kitchenSink("k"),
    ]),
  },
  {
    name: "rich text to clean",
    input: sink({
      body: {
        type: "doc",
        content: [
          {
            type: "heading",
            attrs: { level: 2 },
            content: [{ type: "text", text: "標" }],
          },
        ],
      },
    }),
  },
  { name: "32 levels", input: page([chain(32)]) },
  { name: "40 Chinese characters", input: sink({ title: "慈".repeat(40) }) },
  // zod 4.6.5 and Ajv both count code points: 20 emoji are 40 UTF-16 units
  { name: "20 emoji", input: page([leaf("l", "😀".repeat(20))]) },
  { name: "unknown prop", input: sink({ foo: 1 }) },
  { name: "title too long", input: sink({ title: "慈".repeat(41) }) },
  { name: "21 emoji", input: page([leaf("l", "😀".repeat(21))]) },
  { name: "unknown option", input: sink({ tone: "loud" }) },
  { name: "number too big", input: sink({ count: 11 }) },
  { name: "rich text as a string", input: sink({ body: "<p>x</p>" }) },
  {
    name: "unknown type",
    input: page([{ type: "Button", props: { id: "a" } }]),
  },
  { name: "id root", input: page([leaf("root")]) },
  { name: "legacy zones", input: page([], { zones: { "b:content": [] } }) },
  {
    name: "defaults only",
    input: page([{ type: "KitchenSink", props: { id: "k" } }]),
  },
  {
    name: "bad assetId",
    input: sink({
      picture: { assetId: "bad id", alt: "x", decorative: false },
    }),
  },
  { name: "extra block key", input: page([{ ...leaf("a"), zones: {} }]) },
  { name: "javascript: link", input: sink({ href: "javascript:alert(1)" }) },
  {
    name: "missing alt",
    input: sink({ picture: { assetId: "a", alt: " ", decorative: false } }),
  },
  { name: "duplicate id", input: page([leaf("a"), leaf("a")]) },
  {
    name: "not allowed here",
    input: page([pair("p", [[pair("q", [[], []])], []])]),
  },
  { name: "33 levels", input: page([chain(33)]) },
  {
    name: "5,001 blocks",
    input: page(Array.from({ length: 5001 }, (_, i) => leaf(`l${i}`))),
  },
];

// x-lost-checks entries that the validator reports as a rejection
const LOST_CHECK_CODES: Record<string, IssueCode> = {
  "safe-href": "unsafe_href",
  "alt-required": "alt_required",
};

// Whole-page rules that no JSON Schema layer checks: the shell only checks
// structure (spec §6.5) and per-block schemas see one block at a time.
const PAGE_RULE_CODES: IssueCode[] = [
  "duplicate_id",
  "not_allowed_here",
  "too_deep",
  "too_many_blocks",
];

const lostCheckCodes = (): IssueCode[] => {
  const codes = new Set<IssueCode>();
  const stack: unknown[] = [...testBlocks, testRoot].map((spec) =>
    toJsonSchema(spec)
  );

  while (stack.length > 0) {
    const node = stack.pop();

    if (Array.isArray(node)) {
      stack.push(...node);
    } else if (isRecord(node)) {
      const checks = node["x-lost-checks"];

      if (Array.isArray(checks)) {
        for (const check of checks) {
          // Own keys only: "constructor" in {} is true
          if (
            typeof check === "string" &&
            Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(LOST_CHECK_CODES, check)
          ) {
            codes.add(LOST_CHECK_CODES[check]);
          }
        }
      }

      stack.push(...Object.values(node));
    }
  }

  return [...codes].sort();
};

describe("dual-layer consistency (spec §13.1)", () => {
  it("never accepts with zod what Ajv rejects", () => {
    const failures: string[] = [];

    for (const { name, input } of corpus) {
      const result = validator.validatePage(structuredClone(input));

      if (!result.ok) continue;

      // MCP checks the block props it sends; the database checks what is stored
      if (!propsAccepted(input)) failures.push(`${name}: input props`);
      if (!ajvAccepts(result.data)) failures.push(`${name}: stored data`);
    }

    expect(failures).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("only rejects what Ajv accepts for x-lost-checks and whole-page rules", () => {
    const allowed = new Set<IssueCode>([
      ...lostCheckCodes(),
      ...PAGE_RULE_CODES,
    ]);
    const seen = new Set<IssueCode>();
    const unexpected: string[] = [];

    for (const { name, input } of corpus) {
      const result = validator.validatePage(structuredClone(input));

      if (result.ok || !ajvAccepts(input)) continue;

      for (const issue of result.errors) {
        seen.add(issue.code);
        if (!allowed.has(issue.code)) unexpected.push(`${name}: ${issue.code}`);
      }
    }

    expect(lostCheckCodes()).toEqual(["alt_required", "unsafe_href"]);
    expect(unexpected).toEqual([]);
    expect([...seen].sort()).toEqual([
      "alt_required",
      "duplicate_id",
      "not_allowed_here",
      "too_deep",
      "too_many_blocks",
      "unsafe_href",
    ]);
  });

  it("rejects with both layers everything else in the corpus", () => {
    const bothReject = corpus
      .filter(({ input }) => {
        const result = validator.validatePage(structuredClone(input));

        return !result.ok && !ajvAccepts(input);
      })
      .map(({ name }) => name);

    expect(bothReject).toEqual([
      "unknown prop",
      "title too long",
      "21 emoji",
      "unknown option",
      "number too big",
      "rich text as a string",
      "unknown type",
      "id root",
      "legacy zones",
      "defaults only",
      "bad assetId",
      "extra block key",
    ]);
  });

  it("stores data the shell accepts when the input has readOnly", () => {
    const input = page([
      { ...box("b", [leaf("l")]), readOnly: { content: true } },
    ]);
    const result = validator.validatePage(input);

    expect(result.ok && JSON.stringify(result.data)).not.toMatch(/readOnly/);
    expect(result.ok && ajvAccepts(result.data)).toBe(true);
  });
});
```

建立 `packages/spec/src/validator/issues.ts`：

```ts
/**
 * The codes the page validator reports, in the order of the checks in spec
 * §6.2. richtext_cleaned only appears in notices.
 */
export const ISSUE_CODES = [
  "too_large",
  "invalid_json",
  "invalid_shape",
  "legacy_zones",
  "unknown_type",
  "invalid_id",
  "duplicate_id",
  "too_deep",
  "too_many_blocks",
  "unknown_prop",
  "invalid_value",
  "unsafe_href",
  "alt_required",
  "not_allowed_here",
  "richtext_cleaned",
] as const;

export type IssueCode = (typeof ISSUE_CODES)[number];

export type Issue = {
  /** From the page root, for example ["content", 0, "props", "href"] */
  path: (string | number)[];
  /** The same path as text, for example "content[0].props.href" */
  pathText: string;
  /** The registered type of the block the issue is in */
  blockType?: string;
  code: IssueCode;
  /** In Chinese; names the block and the field */
  message: string;
};

const SIMPLE_KEY = /^[A-Za-z_$][\w$-]*$/;

/**
 * ["content", 0, "props", "href"] → "content[0].props.href". Keys that are
 * not simple names are written as quoted brackets, for example ["a b"].
 */
export function formatPathText(path: readonly (string | number)[]): string {
  let text = "";

  for (const segment of path) {
    if (typeof segment === "number") {
      text += `[${segment}]`;
    } else if (SIMPLE_KEY.test(segment)) {
      text += text === "" ? segment : `.${segment}`;
    } else {
      text += `[${JSON.stringify(segment)}]`;
    }
  }

  return text;
}

/** Collects issues until `limit` is reached; later issues are dropped. */
export class IssueList {
  readonly items: Issue[] = [];
  private readonly limit: number;

  constructor(limit: number) {
    this.limit = limit;
  }

  get full(): boolean {
    return this.items.length >= this.limit;
  }

  add(
    code: IssueCode,
    path: (string | number)[],
    message: string,
    blockType?: string
  ): void {
    if (this.full) return;

    const pathText = formatPathText(path);

    this.items.push(
      blockType === undefined
        ? { path, pathText, code, message }
        : { path, pathText, blockType, code, message }
    );
  }
}
```

建立 `packages/spec/src/validator/messages.ts`：

```ts
import type { IssueCode } from "./issues";

/** The block (or page root) label and the field titles joined with "／". */
export type Place = { label: string; field: string };

export type ShapeProblem =
  | { kind: "page" }
  | { kind: "page-key"; key: string }
  | { kind: "root" }
  | { kind: "root-key"; key: string }
  | { kind: "root-props" }
  | { kind: "content" }
  | { kind: "zones" }
  | { kind: "node" }
  | { kind: "node-key"; label: string; key: string }
  | { kind: "node-type" }
  | { kind: "node-props"; label: string };

export type ValueKind =
  | "text"
  | "number"
  | "integer"
  | "boolean"
  | "list"
  | "object"
  | "richtext"
  | "slot"
  | "image";

export type ValueProblem =
  | { kind: "required" }
  | { kind: "type"; expected: ValueKind; range?: readonly [number, number] }
  | { kind: "too-short"; minimum: number; unit: "字" | "項" }
  | { kind: "too-long"; maximum: number; unit: "字" | "項" }
  | { kind: "too-small"; minimum: number; inclusive: boolean }
  | { kind: "too-big"; maximum: number; inclusive: boolean }
  | { kind: "choice"; options: readonly string[] }
  | { kind: "no-image" }
  | { kind: "image-id" }
  | { kind: "format" }
  | { kind: "other" };

export type IdProblem =
  | { kind: "missing" }
  | { kind: "type" }
  | { kind: "format"; id: string }
  | { kind: "root" };

export type MessageParams = {
  too_large: { maxBytes: number };
  invalid_json: { reason: "syntax" | "encoding" | "input" };
  invalid_shape: ShapeProblem;
  legacy_zones: { count: number };
  unknown_type: { type: string; known: readonly string[] };
  invalid_id: { label: string; problem: IdProblem };
  duplicate_id: { label: string; id: string; first: string };
  too_deep: { label: string; depth: number; maxDepth: number };
  too_many_blocks: { maxBlocks: number };
  unknown_prop: Place & { key: string };
  invalid_value: Place & { problem: ValueProblem };
  unsafe_href: Place;
  alt_required: Place;
  not_allowed_here: Place & { child: string; allowed: readonly string[] };
  richtext_cleaned: Place;
};

const SHOWN_LENGTH = 64;

/** Shortens a value from the page data so that it cannot blow up a message. */
function quote(text: string): string {
  if (text.length <= SHOWN_LENGTH) return text;

  const code = text.charCodeAt(SHOWN_LENGTH - 1);
  // Do not cut a surrogate pair in half
  const end =
    code >= 0xd800 && code <= 0xdbff ? SHOWN_LENGTH - 1 : SHOWN_LENGTH;

  return `${text.slice(0, end)}…`;
}

/** 2097152 → "2,097,152" */
const groupDigits = (value: number): string =>
  String(value).replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ",");

const MEBIBYTE = 1024 * 1024;

const formatBytes = (bytes: number): string =>
  bytes % MEBIBYTE === 0
    ? `${bytes / MEBIBYTE} MB（${groupDigits(bytes)} 位元組）`
    : `${groupDigits(bytes)} 位元組`;

const at = ({ label, field }: Place): string =>
  field === "" ? label : `${label}的『${field}』`;

const typePhrase = (
  expected: ValueKind,
  range: readonly [number, number] | undefined
): string => {
  switch (expected) {
    case "text":
      return "必須是文字。";
    case "number":
      return range
        ? `必須是 ${range[0]} 到 ${range[1]} 的數字。`
        : "必須是數字。";
    case "integer":
      return range
        ? `必須是 ${range[0]} 到 ${range[1]} 的整數。`
        : "必須是整數。";
    case "boolean":
      return "必須是 true 或 false。";
    case "list":
      return "必須是清單（陣列）。";
    case "object":
      return "必須是物件。";
    case "richtext":
      return '必須是富文字文件（type 為 "doc" 的物件）。';
    case "slot":
      return "必須是區塊陣列。";
    case "image":
      return "必須是圖片物件（含 assetId、alt、decorative）。";
  }
};

const valuePhrase = (problem: ValueProblem): string => {
  switch (problem.kind) {
    case "required":
      return "必須填寫。";
    case "type":
      return typePhrase(problem.expected, problem.range);
    case "too-short":
      return problem.unit === "字" && problem.minimum <= 1
        ? "不能空白。"
        : `至少要 ${problem.minimum} ${problem.unit}。`;
    case "too-long":
      return `最多 ${problem.maximum} ${problem.unit}。`;
    case "too-small":
      return problem.inclusive
        ? `不能小於 ${problem.minimum}。`
        : `必須大於 ${problem.minimum}。`;
    case "too-big":
      return problem.inclusive
        ? `不能大於 ${problem.maximum}。`
        : `必須小於 ${problem.maximum}。`;
    case "choice":
      return `只能是：${problem.options.join("、")}。`;
    case "no-image":
      return "還沒有選擇圖片。";
    case "image-id":
      return "的圖片代號格式不正確。";
    case "format":
      return "格式不正確。";
    case "other":
      return "不正確。";
  }
};

const shapeMessage = (problem: ShapeProblem): string => {
  switch (problem.kind) {
    case "page":
      return "頁面資料必須是物件，包含 root 與 content。";
    case "page-key":
      return `頁面資料只能有 root、content、zones，不能有『${quote(
        problem.key
      )}』。`;
    case "root":
      return "root 必須是物件，而且只有 props。";
    case "root-key":
      return `root 只能有 props，不能有『${quote(problem.key)}』。`;
    case "root-props":
      return "root.props 必須是物件。";
    case "content":
      return "content 必須是區塊陣列。";
    case "zones":
      return "zones 只能省略，或是空物件。";
    case "node":
      return "每個區塊都必須是物件，包含 type 與 props。";
    case "node-key":
      return `${problem.label}只能有 type 與 props，不能有『${quote(
        problem.key
      )}』。`;
    case "node-type":
      return "區塊缺少 type，或 type 不是文字。";
    case "node-props":
      return `${problem.label}的 props 必須是物件。`;
  }
};

const idMessage = (label: string, problem: IdProblem): string => {
  switch (problem.kind) {
    case "missing":
      return `${label}缺少 id。`;
    case "type":
      return `${label}的 id 必須是文字。`;
    case "format":
      return `${label}的 id『${quote(
        problem.id
      )}』不合規則：只能用英文字母、數字、底線與連字號，長度 1 到 64 字。`;
    case "root":
      return `${label}的 id 不能是「root」。`;
  }
};

// The notice covers every change normalize and the field's types make: content
// the field does not allow becomes text, alignment is removed, and missing
// attributes (a link's target and rel, a heading's level) get their defaults.
const RICHTEXT_CLEANED =
  "已依這個欄位允許的格式自動整理：不支援的格式與不安全的連結只保留文字，對齊方式會移除，缺少的屬性會補上預設值。";

/** One message builder per issue code. */
export const MESSAGES: {
  readonly [Code in IssueCode]: (params: MessageParams[Code]) => string;
} = {
  too_large: ({ maxBytes }) =>
    `頁面資料超過上限：最多 ${formatBytes(maxBytes)}，以 UTF-8 計算。`,
  invalid_json: ({ reason }) =>
    reason === "encoding"
      ? "頁面資料不是合法的 UTF-8 文字。"
      : reason === "input"
      ? "頁面資料必須是 JSON 字串或 UTF-8 位元組。"
      : "頁面資料不是合法的 JSON。",
  invalid_shape: shapeMessage,
  legacy_zones: ({ count }) =>
    `頁面含有舊格式的 zones（${count} 個 DropZone）。請把這些區塊改放在區塊的放置區欄位裡。`,
  unknown_type: ({ type, known }) =>
    `區塊類型『${quote(type)}』不存在。可以用的類型：${known.join("、")}。`,
  invalid_id: ({ label, problem }) => idMessage(label, problem),
  duplicate_id: ({ label, id, first }) =>
    `${label}的 id『${quote(id)}』和 ${first} 重複；同一頁的 id 不能重複。`,
  too_deep: ({ label, depth, maxDepth }) =>
    `${label}位在第 ${depth} 層放置區，最多只能有 ${maxDepth} 層。`,
  too_many_blocks: ({ maxBlocks }) =>
    `頁面最多只能有 ${groupDigits(maxBlocks)} 個區塊。`,
  unknown_prop: (params) =>
    `${at(params)}沒有『${quote(params.key)}』這個欄位。`,
  invalid_value: (params) => `${at(params)}${valuePhrase(params.problem)}`,
  unsafe_href: (params) =>
    `${at(params)}只接受 http、https、mailto、tel 或站內路徑。`,
  alt_required: (params) => `${at(params)}不能空白；只有裝飾用圖片可以不填。`,
  not_allowed_here: (params) =>
    params.allowed.length === 0
      ? `${at(params)}不能放${params.child}，這裡不能放任何區塊。`
      : `${at(params)}不能放${params.child}。可以放：${params.allowed.join(
          "、"
        )}。`,
  richtext_cleaned: (params) => `${at(params)}${RICHTEXT_CLEANED}`,
};
```

建立 `packages/spec/src/validator/values.ts`：

```ts
/** Helpers for reading page data, which is untrusted and may be any value. */

export type Segment = string | number;
export type UnknownRecord = Record<string, unknown>;

export const isRecord = (value: unknown): value is UnknownRecord =>
  typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);

export const hasOwn = (value: object, key: string): boolean =>
  Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(value, key);

/** Reads an own property only, so "constructor" or "__proto__" never reach the prototype. */
export const own = (value: UnknownRecord, key: string): unknown =>
  hasOwn(value, key) ? value[key] : undefined;

/** A null-prototype copy of the own enumerable properties, optionally without one key. */
export function copyRecord(
  value: UnknownRecord,
  without?: string
): UnknownRecord {
  const copy: UnknownRecord = Object.create(null);

  for (const key of Object.keys(value)) {
    if (key !== without) copy[key] = value[key];
  }

  return copy;
}

/**
 * Calls `visit` for every value at `segments` inside `value`, where "[]"
 * stands for every item of an array, with the concrete path of that value
 * (array indexes as numbers). Missing keys and non-arrays are skipped.
 */
export function eachValueAt(
  value: unknown,
  segments: readonly string[],
  visit: (found: unknown, path: Segment[]) => void,
  index = 0,
  path: Segment[] = []
): void {
  if (index === segments.length) {
    visit(value, path);
    return;
  }

  const segment = segments[index];

  if (segment === "[]") {
    if (!Array.isArray(value)) return;

    value.forEach((item: unknown, i) =>
      eachValueAt(item, segments, visit, index + 1, [...path, i])
    );
    return;
  }

  if (isRecord(value) && hasOwn(value, segment)) {
    eachValueAt(value[segment], segments, visit, index + 1, [...path, segment]);
  }
}

/**
 * Returns `value` with every value at `segments` replaced by `replace(found)`.
 * Only the records and arrays on the way are copied; `value` is not changed.
 */
export function replaceAt(
  value: unknown,
  segments: readonly string[],
  replace: (found: unknown) => unknown,
  index = 0
): unknown {
  if (index === segments.length) return replace(value);

  const segment = segments[index];

  if (segment === "[]") {
    return Array.isArray(value)
      ? value.map((item: unknown) =>
          replaceAt(item, segments, replace, index + 1)
        )
      : value;
  }

  if (!isRecord(value) || !hasOwn(value, segment)) return value;

  const copy = copyRecord(value);

  copy[segment] = replaceAt(value[segment], segments, replace, index + 1);

  return copy;
}

/** Follows a concrete path through validated data. */
export function valueAt(value: unknown, path: readonly Segment[]): unknown {
  let current = value;

  for (const segment of path) {
    if (typeof segment === "number" && Array.isArray(current)) {
      current = current[segment];
    } else if (typeof segment === "string" && isRecord(current)) {
      current = own(current, segment);
    } else {
      return undefined;
    }
  }

  return current;
}

/** Sets a value at a concrete path whose containers already exist. */
export function setAt(
  target: UnknownRecord,
  path: readonly Segment[],
  value: unknown
): void {
  const container = valueAt(target, path.slice(0, -1));
  const key = path[path.length - 1];

  if (typeof key === "number" && Array.isArray(container)) {
    container[key] = value;
  } else if (typeof key === "string" && isRecord(container)) {
    container[key] = value;
  } else {
    throw new Error(`Cannot set a value at ${path.join(".")}`);
  }
}
```

```ts
import type * as z from "zod";
import type { AnyBlockSpec, PageRootSpec } from "../define";
import { eachField, toJsonSchema, type JsonSchema } from "../json-schema";
import { slotLocations, type SlotLocation } from "../slots";

/** What the validator needs to know about a block spec or the page root spec. */
export type Entry = {
  /** The block type; undefined for the page root */
  blockType: string | undefined;
  label: string;
  props: z.ZodObject;
  schema: JsonSchema;
  slots: readonly SlotLocation[];
  /** Paths of the rich text fields, "[]" standing for array items */
  richText: readonly (readonly string[])[];
};

export type BlockEntry = Entry & { blockType: string; deprecated: boolean };

const richTextPaths = (schema: JsonSchema) => {
  const paths: (readonly string[])[] = [];

  eachField(schema, ({ path, node }) => {
    if (node["x-richtext"] !== undefined) paths.push(path);
  });

  return paths;
};

export function blockEntry(spec: AnyBlockSpec): BlockEntry {
  const schema = toJsonSchema(spec);

  return {
    blockType: spec.type,
    deprecated: spec.deprecated,
    label: spec.label,
    props: spec.props,
    schema,
    slots: slotLocations(spec),
    richText: richTextPaths(schema),
  };
}

export function rootEntry(spec: PageRootSpec): Entry {
  const schema = toJsonSchema(spec);
  let hasSlot = false;

  eachField(schema, ({ node }) => {
    if (node["x-slot"] !== undefined) hasSlot = true;
  });

  // The validator only walks the blocks of `content`; blocks in a root slot
  // would be stored without being checked.
  if (hasSlot) {
    throw new TypeError("The page root spec must not have slot fields");
  }

  return {
    blockType: undefined,
    label: spec.label,
    props: spec.props,
    schema,
    slots: [],
    richText: richTextPaths(schema),
  };
}

/** Looks a block type up by own property, so "constructor" and "__proto__" are unknown. */
export const lookupEntry = (
  registry: Readonly<Record<string, BlockEntry>>,
  type: string
): BlockEntry | undefined =>
  Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(registry, type)
    ? registry[type]
    : undefined;
```
