```ts
import type * as z from "zod";
import type { JsonSchema } from "../json-schema";
import type { IssueCode } from "./issues";
import { MESSAGES, type ValueKind, type ValueProblem } from "./messages";
import type { Entry } from "./registry";
import { hasOwn, isRecord, type Segment } from "./values";

/** What a zod issue path points at in the JSON Schema of the props. */
export type FieldAt = {
  /** The issue path; a path into a rich text document stops at its field */
  path: Segment[];
  /** Field titles joined with "／"; "" for the props object itself */
  field: string;
  node: JsonSchema | undefined;
  /** True for the assetId of an image() value */
  imageId: boolean;
};

const toSegment = (key: PropertyKey): Segment =>
  typeof key === "symbol" ? String(key) : key;

const isWholeValue = (node: JsonSchema) =>
  node["x-richtext"] !== undefined || node["x-slot"] !== undefined;

export function fieldAt(
  schema: JsonSchema,
  path: readonly PropertyKey[]
): FieldAt {
  const titles: string[] = [];
  const segments: Segment[] = [];
  let node: JsonSchema | undefined = schema;
  let parent: JsonSchema | undefined;

  for (const key of path) {
    if (node !== undefined && isWholeValue(node)) break;

    const segment = toSegment(key);

    segments.push(segment);
    parent = node;

    if (typeof segment === "number") {
      node = node && isRecord(node.items) ? node.items : undefined;
    } else {
      const properties: unknown = node?.properties;
      const child =
        isRecord(properties) && hasOwn(properties, segment)
          ? properties[segment]
          : undefined;

      node = isRecord(child) ? child : undefined;
      titles.push(
        node !== undefined && typeof node.title === "string"
          ? node.title
          : segment
      );
    }
  }

  const imageId =
    parent?.["x-image"] !== undefined &&
    segments[segments.length - 1] === "assetId";

  // "No image chosen" is about the image field, not its assetId
  if (imageId) titles.pop();

  return { path: segments, field: titles.join("／"), node, imageId };
}

/** The parts of a zod issue (raw or final) that the validator reads. */
export type ZodIssueLike = {
  code: string;
  path?: readonly PropertyKey[];
  input?: unknown;
  expected?: string;
  origin?: string;
  minimum?: number | bigint;
  maximum?: number | bigint;
  inclusive?: boolean;
  values?: readonly unknown[];
  keys?: readonly string[];
  params?: Record<string, unknown>;
};

export type Classified =
  | {
      code: Extract<IssueCode, "unknown_prop" | "unsafe_href" | "alt_required">;
    }
  | { code: "invalid_value"; problem: ValueProblem };

const MAX_SHOWN_BOUND = Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;

const rangeOf = (
  node: JsonSchema | undefined
): readonly [number, number] | undefined => {
  const minimum = node?.minimum;
  const maximum = node?.maximum;

  return typeof minimum === "number" &&
    typeof maximum === "number" &&
    Math.abs(minimum) < MAX_SHOWN_BOUND &&
    Math.abs(maximum) < MAX_SHOWN_BOUND
    ? [minimum, maximum]
    : undefined;
};

const typeProblem = (
  expected: string | undefined,
  node: JsonSchema | undefined
): ValueProblem => {
  const kinds: Record<string, ValueKind> = {
    string: "text",
    boolean: "boolean",
    array: "list",
    object: "object",
    record: "object",
  };

  if (expected === "number" || expected === "int") {
    return {
      kind: "type",
      expected:
        expected === "int" || node?.type === "integer" ? "integer" : "number",
      range: rangeOf(node),
    };
  }

  const kind =
    expected !== undefined && hasOwn(kinds, expected)
      ? kinds[expected]
      : undefined;

  return kind ? { kind: "type", expected: kind } : { kind: "other" };
};

const optionLabel = (value: unknown, node: JsonSchema | undefined) => {
  const labels: unknown = node?.["x-labels"];
  const text = String(value);

  if (isRecord(labels) && hasOwn(labels, text)) {
    const label = labels[text];

    if (typeof label === "string") return `${label}（${text}）`;
  }

  return text;
};

const valueProblem = (issue: ZodIssueLike, at: FieldAt): ValueProblem => {
  const { node } = at;

  if (at.imageId) {
    return issue.input === "" || issue.input === undefined
      ? { kind: "no-image" }
      : { kind: "image-id" };
  }

  if (node?.["x-richtext"] !== undefined) {
    return { kind: "type", expected: "richtext" };
  }

  if (node?.["x-slot"] !== undefined) {
    return { kind: "type", expected: "slot" };
  }

  switch (issue.code) {
    case "invalid_type":
      if (issue.input === undefined) return { kind: "required" };
      if (node?.["x-image"] !== undefined) {
        return { kind: "type", expected: "image" };
      }
      return typeProblem(issue.expected, node);
    case "too_small": {
      const minimum = Number(issue.minimum);

      if (issue.origin === "string" || issue.origin === "array") {
        return {
          kind: "too-short",
          minimum,
          unit: issue.origin === "string" ? "字" : "項",
        };
      }

      return {
        kind: "too-small",
        minimum,
        inclusive: issue.inclusive !== false,
      };
    }
    case "too_big": {
      const maximum = Number(issue.maximum);

      if (issue.origin === "string" || issue.origin === "array") {
        return {
          kind: "too-long",
          maximum,
          unit: issue.origin === "string" ? "字" : "項",
        };
      }

      return { kind: "too-big", maximum, inclusive: issue.inclusive !== false };
    }
    case "invalid_value":
      return {
        kind: "choice",
        options: (issue.values ?? []).map((value) => optionLabel(value, node)),
      };
    case "invalid_format":
      return { kind: "format" };
    default:
      return { kind: "other" };
  }
};

/** Maps a zod issue to an IssueCode (spec §6.2, contract C.2). */
export function classify(issue: ZodIssueLike, at: FieldAt): Classified {
  if (issue.code === "unrecognized_keys") return { code: "unknown_prop" };

  if (issue.code === "custom") {
    const tag = issue.params?.code;

    if (tag === "unsafe_href" || tag === "alt_required") return { code: tag };
  }

  return { code: "invalid_value", problem: valueProblem(issue, at) };
}

/** The Chinese message for a zod issue; used as the per-call error map. */
export function describeIssue(entry: Entry, issue: ZodIssueLike): string {
  const at = fieldAt(entry.schema, issue.path ?? []);
  const place = { label: entry.label, field: at.field };
  const classified = classify(issue, at);

  switch (classified.code) {
    case "invalid_value":
      return MESSAGES.invalid_value({ ...place, problem: classified.problem });
    case "unsafe_href":
      return MESSAGES.unsafe_href(place);
    case "alt_required":
      return MESSAGES.alt_required(place);
    case "unknown_prop":
      // The validator reports one issue per key and builds those messages itself
      return MESSAGES.unknown_prop({ ...place, key: issue.keys?.[0] ?? "" });
  }
}

/** A zod error map bound to one block; zod calls it when issues are read. */
export const errorMapFor =
  (entry: Entry) =>
  (issue: z.core.$ZodRawIssue): string =>
    describeIssue(entry, issue);
```

```ts
import { RICHTEXT_MAX_DEPTH, stableStringify } from "@tzuchi/tceditor/rules";
import { isRecord, type UnknownRecord } from "./values";

// Nodes and their content arrays alternate, plus marks and attrs below the
// deepest node that normalizeRichText keeps.
const DEPTH_LIMIT = 2 * RICHTEXT_MAX_DEPTH + 8;

/**
 * A copy for comparison only: attributes that are null and empty attrs,
 * content and marks are left out, because they carry no meaning. The editor
 * leaves attributes out when an extension (such as TextAlign) is off, and
 * normalizeRichText writes them as null.
 */
function canonical(value: unknown, depth: number): unknown {
  if (depth > DEPTH_LIMIT) {
    throw new RangeError("Rich text is nested too deeply to compare");
  }

  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    return value.map((item: unknown) => canonical(item, depth + 1));
  }

  if (!isRecord(value)) return value;

  const result: UnknownRecord = Object.create(null);

  for (const key of Object.keys(value)) {
    const item = value[key];

    if (key === "attrs" && isRecord(item)) {
      const attrs: UnknownRecord = Object.create(null);

      for (const name of Object.keys(item)) {
        if (item[name] !== null) attrs[name] = canonical(item[name], depth + 2);
      }

      if (Object.keys(attrs).length > 0) result[key] = attrs;
    } else if (
      (key === "content" || key === "marks") &&
      Array.isArray(item) &&
      item.length === 0
    ) {
      continue;
    } else {
      result[key] = canonical(item, depth + 1);
    }
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * True when cleaning changed the meaning of a rich text value: a node, a
 * mark, a link or an attribute was removed or changed. Values too deep or
 * cyclic to compare count as changed (normalizeRichText flattens them).
 */
export function isRichTextChanged(before: unknown, after: unknown): boolean {
  try {
    return (
      stableStringify(canonical(before, 0)) !==
      stableStringify(canonical(after, 0))
    );
  } catch {
    return true;
  }
}
```

```ts
import { classify, errorMapFor, fieldAt } from "./describe";
import { formatPathText, type IssueList } from "./issues";
import { MESSAGES } from "./messages";
import type { Entry } from "./registry";
import { isRichTextChanged } from "./richtext";
import {
  copyRecord,
  eachValueAt,
  isRecord,
  replaceAt,
  valueAt,
  type Segment,
  type UnknownRecord,
} from "./values";

const emptySlot = (found: unknown) => (Array.isArray(found) ? [] : found);

/**
 * Checks props with the spec's zod schema (spec §6.2 #8, #9, #12) and returns
 * the parsed props with defaults filled, or undefined when there are errors.
 *
 * - `props.id` is taken out first (block schemas do not declare it).
 * - Slot arrays are emptied first: the blocks inside them are checked one by
 *   one by the walk, so zod only checks that each slot is an array.
 * - zod gets a null-prototype copy, so an own "__proto__" key is reported as
 *   an unknown prop like any other key.
 */
export function checkProps(
  entry: Entry,
  props: UnknownRecord,
  base: Segment[],
  errors: IssueList,
  omitId: boolean
): UnknownRecord | undefined {
  let input: unknown = copyRecord(props, omitId ? "id" : undefined);

  for (const slot of entry.slots) {
    input = replaceAt(input, slot.path, emptySlot);
  }

  const result = entry.props.safeParse(input, { error: errorMapFor(entry) });

  if (result.success) {
    return isRecord(result.data) ? result.data : undefined;
  }

  const reported = new Set<string>();

  // Reading `issues` runs the error map, while `entry` is still in scope.
  for (const issue of result.error.issues) {
    if (errors.full) break;

    const at = fieldAt(entry.schema, issue.path);

    if (issue.code === "unrecognized_keys") {
      for (const key of issue.keys) {
        if (errors.full) break;

        errors.add(
          "unknown_prop",
          [...base, ...at.path, key],
          MESSAGES.unknown_prop({ label: entry.label, field: at.field, key }),
          entry.blockType
        );
      }
      continue;
    }

    const path = [...base, ...at.path];
    const pathText = formatPathText(path);

    // One issue per field: zod also runs the safe-link check on an empty
    // required link, but "不能空白" is the message that helps.
    if (reported.has(pathText)) continue;
    reported.add(pathText);

    errors.add(classify(issue, at).code, path, issue.message, entry.blockType);
  }

  return undefined;
}

/** Adds a richtext_cleaned notice for every rich text field that cleaning changed (spec §6.2 #11). */
export function richTextNotices(
  entry: Entry,
  props: UnknownRecord,
  parsed: UnknownRecord,
  base: Segment[],
  notices: IssueList
): void {
  for (const fieldPath of entry.richText) {
    eachValueAt(props, fieldPath, (before, path) => {
      // Missing values got the default; other non-objects failed in zod
      if (!isRecord(before)) return;

      if (isRichTextChanged(before, valueAt(parsed, path))) {
        notices.add(
          "richtext_cleaned",
          [...base, ...path],
          MESSAGES.richtext_cleaned({
            label: entry.label,
            field: fieldAt(entry.schema, path).field,
          }),
          entry.blockType
        );
      }
    });
  }
}
```

```ts
import { isComponentAllowed } from "@tzuchi/tceditor/rules";
import { NODE_ID_PATTERN } from "../limits";
import type { BlockNode, PageData } from "../page-data";
import type { SlotLocation } from "../slots";
import { fieldAt } from "./describe";
import { formatPathText, IssueList } from "./issues";
import { MESSAGES, type IdProblem } from "./messages";
import { checkProps, richTextNotices } from "./props";
import { lookupEntry, type BlockEntry, type Entry } from "./registry";
import type { ValidateResult, ValidatorLimits } from "./types";
import {
  eachValueAt,
  hasOwn,
  isRecord,
  own,
  setAt,
  type Segment,
  type UnknownRecord,
} from "./values";

export type WalkContext = {
  /** Null-prototype table of the registered block types */
  registry: Readonly<Record<string, BlockEntry>>;
  root: Entry;
  limits: ValidatorLimits;
  /** "Type（label）" of every registered block, for messages */
  known: readonly string[];
};

/** One concrete slot array of a block, for example columns[1].content. */
type SlotInstance = {
  owner: Visit;
  slot: SlotLocation;
  /** Path inside the owner's props */
  path: Segment[];
  items: unknown[];
  children: Visit[];
};

type Visit = {
  path: Segment[];
  /** Undefined when the type is not registered */
  entry: BlockEntry | undefined;
  props: UnknownRecord;
  id: string;
  /** The slot the block is in; undefined at the top level */
  placement: SlotInstance | undefined;
  slots: SlotInstance[];
  parsed?: UnknownRecord;
  output?: BlockNode;
};

type Pending = {
  value: unknown;
  path: Segment[];
  depth: number;
  placement: SlotInstance | undefined;
  into: Visit[];
};

const READ_ONLY = "readOnly";

function checkId(
  props: UnknownRecord,
  path: Segment[],
  entry: BlockEntry | undefined,
  ids: Map<string, string>,
  errors: IssueList
): string {
  const idPath = [...path, "props", "id"];
  const label = entry?.label ?? "區塊";
  const report = (problem: IdProblem) =>
    errors.add(
      "invalid_id",
      idPath,
      MESSAGES.invalid_id({ label, problem }),
      entry?.blockType
    );

  if (!hasOwn(props, "id")) {
    report({ kind: "missing" });
    return "";
  }

  const id = props.id;

  if (typeof id !== "string") {
    report({ kind: "type" });
    return "";
  }

  if (!NODE_ID_PATTERN.test(id)) {
    report({ kind: "format", id });
    return "";
  }

  if (id === "root") {
    report({ kind: "root" });
    return "";
  }

  const first = ids.get(id);

  if (first !== undefined) {
    errors.add(
      "duplicate_id",
      idPath,
      MESSAGES.duplicate_id({ label, id, first }),
      entry?.blockType
    );
  } else {
    ids.set(id, formatPathText(path));
  }

  return id;
}

/** Spec §6.2 #4–#6 for one block. Returns undefined when it is not even an object with props. */
function checkNode(
  pending: Pending,
  context: WalkContext,
  ids: Map<string, string>,
  errors: IssueList
): Visit | undefined {
  const { value, path } = pending;

  if (!isRecord(value)) {
    errors.add("invalid_shape", path, MESSAGES.invalid_shape({ kind: "node" }));
    return undefined;
  }

  const type = own(value, "type");
  const entry =
    typeof type === "string" ? lookupEntry(context.registry, type) : undefined;
  const label = entry?.label ?? "區塊";

  for (const key of Object.keys(value)) {
    if (key !== "type" && key !== "props" && key !== READ_ONLY) {
      errors.add(
        "invalid_shape",
        [...path, key],
        MESSAGES.invalid_shape({ kind: "node-key", label, key }),
        entry?.blockType
      );
    }
  }

  if (typeof type !== "string") {
    errors.add(
      "invalid_shape",
      [...path, "type"],
      MESSAGES.invalid_shape({ kind: "node-type" })
    );
  } else if (entry === undefined) {
    errors.add(
      "unknown_type",
      [...path, "type"],
      MESSAGES.unknown_type({ type, known: context.known })
    );
  }

  const props = own(value, "props");

  if (!isRecord(props)) {
    errors.add(
      "invalid_shape",
      [...path, "props"],
      MESSAGES.invalid_shape({ kind: "node-props", label }),
      entry?.blockType
    );
    return undefined;
  }

  return {
    path,
    entry,
    props,
    id: checkId(props, path, entry, ids, errors),
    placement: pending.placement,
    slots: [],
  };
}

/**
 * Spec §6.2 #4–#7: walks every block with an explicit stack (no recursion),
 * in document order. Blocks deeper than maxDepth are reported and not
 * entered; the walk stops at the first block over maxBlocks.
 */
function walkBlocks(
  content: unknown[],
  context: WalkContext,
  errors: IssueList
): { visits: Visit[]; top: Visit[] } {
  const { maxDepth, maxBlocks } = context.limits;
  const visits: Visit[] = [];
  const top: Visit[] = [];
  const ids = new Map<string, string>();
  const stack: Pending[] = [];
  let count = 0;

  for (let i = content.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    stack.push({
      value: content[i],
      path: ["content", i],
      depth: 1,
      placement: undefined,
      into: top,
    });
  }

  while (stack.length > 0 && !errors.full) {
    const pending = stack.pop() as Pending;

    count += 1;

    if (count > maxBlocks) {
      errors.add(
        "too_many_blocks",
        pending.path,
        MESSAGES.too_many_blocks({ maxBlocks })
      );
      break;
    }

    if (pending.depth > maxDepth) {
      const type = isRecord(pending.value)
        ? own(pending.value, "type")
        : undefined;
      const entry =
        typeof type === "string"
          ? lookupEntry(context.registry, type)
          : undefined;

      errors.add(
        "too_deep",
        pending.path,
        MESSAGES.too_deep({
          label: entry?.label ?? "區塊",
          depth: pending.depth,
          maxDepth,
        }),
        entry?.blockType
      );
      continue;
    }

    const visit = checkNode(pending, context, ids, errors);

    if (visit === undefined) continue;

    visits.push(visit);
    pending.into.push(visit);

    if (visit.entry === undefined) continue;

    for (const slot of visit.entry.slots) {
      eachValueAt(visit.props, slot.path, (found, path) => {
        if (Array.isArray(found)) {
          visit.slots.push({
            owner: visit,
            slot,
            path,
            items: found,
            children: [],
          });
        }
      });
    }

    // Pushed in reverse so that they are popped in document order
    for (let s = visit.slots.length - 1; s >= 0; s--) {
      const instance = visit.slots[s];

      for (let i = instance.items.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        stack.push({
          value: instance.items[i],
          path: [...visit.path, "props", ...instance.path, i],
          depth: pending.depth + 1,
          placement: instance,
          into: instance.children,
        });
      }
    }
  }

  return { visits, top };
}

/** Spec §6.2 #10 */
function checkPlacement(
  visit: Visit,
  entry: BlockEntry,
  context: WalkContext,
  errors: IssueList
): void {
  const instance = visit.placement;

  if (instance === undefined || instance.owner.entry === undefined) return;

  const { rule } = instance.slot;

  if (isComponentAllowed(entry.blockType, rule)) return;

  const owner = instance.owner.entry;
  const allowed = Object.keys(context.registry)
    .filter(
      (type) =>
        !context.registry[type].deprecated && isComponentAllowed(type, rule)
    )
    .map((type) => `${context.registry[type].label}（${type}）`);

  errors.add(
    "not_allowed_here",
    visit.path,
    MESSAGES.not_allowed_here({
      label: owner.label,
      field: fieldAt(owner.schema, instance.path).field,
      child: `${entry.label}（${entry.blockType}）`,
      allowed,
    }),
    entry.blockType
  );
}

const outputOf = (visit: Visit): BlockNode => {
  if (visit.output === undefined) {
    throw new Error(`No output for the block at ${formatPathText(visit.path)}`);
  }

  return visit.output;
};

/** Builds the cleaned page from the parsed props, children first. */
function assemble(
  visits: Visit[],
  top: Visit[],
  rootProps: UnknownRecord
): PageData {
  for (let i = visits.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const visit = visits[i];

    if (visit.entry === undefined || visit.parsed === undefined) {
      throw new Error(`Unchecked block at ${formatPathText(visit.path)}`);
    }

    const props: BlockNode["props"] = { id: visit.id, ...visit.parsed };

    for (const instance of visit.slots) {
      setAt(props, instance.path, instance.children.map(outputOf));
    }

    visit.output = { type: visit.entry.blockType, props };
  }

  return { root: { props: rootProps }, content: top.map(outputOf) };
}

/** Spec §6.2 #3: returns root.props when the root is an object with props. */
function checkRoot(
  data: UnknownRecord,
  errors: IssueList
): UnknownRecord | undefined {
  if (!hasOwn(data, "root") || !isRecord(data.root)) {
    errors.add(
      "invalid_shape",
      ["root"],
      MESSAGES.invalid_shape({ kind: "root" })
    );
    return undefined;
  }

  const root = data.root;

  for (const key of Object.keys(root)) {
    if (key !== "props" && key !== READ_ONLY) {
      errors.add(
        "invalid_shape",
        ["root", key],
        MESSAGES.invalid_shape({ kind: "root-key", key })
      );
    }
  }

  const props = own(root, "props");

  if (!isRecord(props)) {
    errors.add(
      "invalid_shape",
      ["root", "props"],
      MESSAGES.invalid_shape({ kind: "root-props" })
    );
    return undefined;
  }

  return props;
}

/** validatePage: spec §6.2 #3–#12 on data that is already parsed. */
export function walkPage(data: unknown, context: WalkContext): ValidateResult {
  const errors = new IssueList(context.limits.maxIssues);
  const notices = new IssueList(context.limits.maxIssues);

  if (!isRecord(data)) {
    errors.add("invalid_shape", [], MESSAGES.invalid_shape({ kind: "page" }));
    return { ok: false, errors: errors.items };
  }

  for (const key of Object.keys(data)) {
    if (key !== "root" && key !== "content" && key !== "zones") {
      errors.add(
        "invalid_shape",
        [key],
        MESSAGES.invalid_shape({ kind: "page-key", key })
      );
    }
  }

  const rootProps = checkRoot(data, errors);

  if (hasOwn(data, "zones")) {
    const zones = data.zones;

    if (!isRecord(zones)) {
      errors.add(
        "invalid_shape",
        ["zones"],
        MESSAGES.invalid_shape({ kind: "zones" })
      );
    } else if (Object.keys(zones).length > 0) {
      errors.add(
        "legacy_zones",
        ["zones"],
        MESSAGES.legacy_zones({ count: Object.keys(zones).length })
      );
    }
  }

  const content = own(data, "content");
  let walked: { visits: Visit[]; top: Visit[] } = { visits: [], top: [] };

  if (Array.isArray(content)) {
    walked = walkBlocks(content, context, errors);
  } else {
    errors.add(
      "invalid_shape",
      ["content"],
      MESSAGES.invalid_shape({ kind: "content" })
    );
  }

  for (const visit of walked.visits) {
    if (errors.full) break;

    const { entry } = visit;

    if (entry === undefined) continue;

    const base = [...visit.path, "props"];
    const parsed = checkProps(entry, visit.props, base, errors, true);

    if (parsed !== undefined) {
      visit.parsed = parsed;
      richTextNotices(entry, visit.props, parsed, base, notices);
    }

    checkPlacement(visit, entry, context, errors);
  }

  let rootParsed: UnknownRecord | undefined;

  if (rootProps !== undefined && !errors.full) {
    const base = ["root", "props"];

    rootParsed = checkProps(context.root, rootProps, base, errors, false);

    if (rootParsed !== undefined) {
      richTextNotices(context.root, rootProps, rootParsed, base, notices);
    }
  }

  if (errors.items.length > 0 || rootParsed === undefined) {
    return { ok: false, errors: errors.items };
  }

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: assemble(walked.visits, walked.top, rootParsed),
    notices: notices.items,
  };
}
```

建立 `packages/spec/src/validator/index.ts`：

```ts
import type { AnyBlockSpec, PageRootSpec } from "../define";
import { DEFAULT_LIMITS } from "../limits";
import { checkSpecRules } from "../spec-rules";
import type { IssueCode } from "./issues";
import { MESSAGES } from "./messages";
import { blockEntry, rootEntry, type BlockEntry } from "./registry";
import type { ValidateResult, ValidatorLimits } from "./types";
import { walkPage, type WalkContext } from "./walk";

export { DEFAULT_LIMITS, NODE_ID_PATTERN } from "../limits";
export type { Issue, IssueCode } from "./issues";
export { ISSUE_CODES, formatPathText } from "./issues";
export type { ValidateResult, ValidatorLimits } from "./types";

export type PageValidator = {
  validatePage(data: unknown): ValidateResult;
  /** Checks the size in UTF-8 bytes (strings through TextEncoder), then JSON.parse, then validatePage */
  validatePageJson(raw: string | Uint8Array): ValidateResult;
  blockTypes: readonly string[];
};

const LIMIT_KEYS = ["maxBytes", "maxDepth", "maxBlocks", "maxIssues"] as const;

function resolveLimits(
  overrides: Partial<ValidatorLimits> = {}
): ValidatorLimits {
  const limits: ValidatorLimits = {
    maxBytes: overrides.maxBytes ?? DEFAULT_LIMITS.maxBytes,
    maxDepth: overrides.maxDepth ?? DEFAULT_LIMITS.maxDepth,
    maxBlocks: overrides.maxBlocks ?? DEFAULT_LIMITS.maxBlocks,
    maxIssues: overrides.maxIssues ?? DEFAULT_LIMITS.maxIssues,
  };

  for (const key of LIMIT_KEYS) {
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(limits[key]) || limits[key] < 1) {
      throw new TypeError(
        `limits.${key} must be a positive integer, got ${String(limits[key])}`
      );
    }
  }

  return Object.freeze(limits);
}

// Cross-realm safe (jest, Node Buffer): instanceof would fail for a
// Uint8Array made in another realm.
const isBytes = (value: unknown): value is Uint8Array =>
  ArrayBuffer.isView(value) &&
  Object.prototype.toString.call(value) === "[object Uint8Array]";

const pageError = (code: IssueCode, message: string): ValidateResult => ({
  ok: false,
  errors: [{ path: [], pathText: "", code, message }],
});

/**
 * Builds the page validator of spec §6.2 for a set of block specs. Throws
 * when the specs break the authoring rules (checkSpecRules).
 */
export function createPageValidator(options: {
  blocks: readonly AnyBlockSpec[];
  root: PageRootSpec;
  limits?: Partial<ValidatorLimits>;
}): PageValidator {
  const violations = checkSpecRules({
    blocks: options.blocks,
    root: options.root,
  });

  if (violations.length > 0) {
    throw new Error(
      [
        "The block specs break the authoring rules:",
        ...violations.map(
          (violation) =>
            `- [${violation.rule}] ${violation.type} ${violation.path}: ${violation.message}`
        ),
      ].join("\n")
    );
  }

  const limits = resolveLimits(options.limits);
  const registry: Record<string, BlockEntry> = Object.create(null);

  for (const spec of options.blocks) {
    registry[spec.type] = blockEntry(spec);
  }

  const context: WalkContext = {
    registry,
    root: rootEntry(options.root),
    limits,
    known: options.blocks
      .filter((spec) => !spec.deprecated)
      .map((spec) => `${spec.label}（${spec.type}）`),
  };
  const encoder = new TextEncoder();
  const tooLarge = () =>
    pageError("too_large", MESSAGES.too_large({ maxBytes: limits.maxBytes }));

  const validatePage = (data: unknown): ValidateResult =>
    walkPage(data, context);

  const validatePageJson = (raw: string | Uint8Array): ValidateResult => {
    let text: string;

    if (typeof raw === "string") {
      // A UTF-16 code unit is never less than one UTF-8 byte, so a longer
      // string is too large without encoding it.
      if (
        raw.length > limits.maxBytes ||
        encoder.encode(raw).byteLength > limits.maxBytes
      ) {
        return tooLarge();
      }

      text = raw;
    } else if (isBytes(raw)) {
      if (raw.byteLength > limits.maxBytes) return tooLarge();

      try {
        text = new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true }).decode(raw);
      } catch {
        return pageError(
          "invalid_json",
          MESSAGES.invalid_json({ reason: "encoding" })
        );
      }
    } else {
      return pageError(
        "invalid_json",
        MESSAGES.invalid_json({ reason: "input" })
      );
    }

    let data: unknown;

    try {
      data = JSON.parse(text);
    } catch {
      return pageError(
        "invalid_json",
        MESSAGES.invalid_json({ reason: "syntax" })
      );
    }

    return validatePage(data);
  };

  return {
    validatePage,
    validatePageJson,
    blockTypes: Object.freeze(options.blocks.map((spec) => spec.type)),
  };
}
```

### Task 10: `packages/blocks`：8 個規格、根節點、驗證器綁定

目的：在 `packages/blocks` 寫出 8 個示範區塊（標題、段落、按鈕、卡片、標籤列、區段、多欄、圖片）與頁面根節點的 zod 規格，依規格 §8 與「與規格的差異」設定每個欄位的名稱、種類、上下限、預設值、白名單與中文標籤；在 `src/specs.ts` 依編輯器順序登記，並在 `src/validator.ts` 把 Task 9 的整頁驗證器綁定到這 8 個區塊。測試證明：規格符合寫法規則、每個範例都通過驗證、只有預設值的按鈕與圖片會在指定欄位失敗、編輯器實際送出的資料原封不動通過且不產生提示（Review Focus #1）、多欄缺 `content` 時補成空陣列（Review Focus #4）、按鈕文字 40／41 個中文字的邊界（Review Focus #2），以及 Task 13 會重用的 32 筆驗證案例 `validator-cases.json`。

**執行位置**：主工作目錄 `/Users/kaellim/Desktop/projects/puck`，分支 `s2/block-spec`。

**設計決定與說明**：
- **欄位以規格 §8 為準，加上「與規格的差異」的更正**：
  - Button 的 `href` 用 `link()`、Image 的 `image` 用 `image()`。這兩個 helper 內建 `.prefault()`（更正 #3），所以只有 id 的按鈕與圖片會在 `href`、`image.assetId` 得到錯誤，JSON Schema 仍帶 `default` 給編輯器用（zod-ajv §6）。按鈕只有一筆 `invalid_value`（Task 9 同一欄位只回報一筆）；圖片另有一筆 `image.alt` 的 `alt_required`，因為 `image()` 的物件層檢查在 `assetId` 的格式失敗後仍會執行（zod-ajv §6；Task 9 的驗證器照實回報這兩筆）。兩個測試都完整比對錯誤清單。
  - 物件與陣列的預設值一律寫成函式，例如 `.default(() => [{ label: "志工" }, { label: "環保" }])`，因為 zod 的 `.default()` 只做淺拷貝（zod-ajv §4.5）。
  - `x-item-label` 用樣板字串（更正 #18）：TagList 是 `"{label}"`，Columns 是 `"第 {n} 欄"`。
  - Columns 的 `columns` 是 2–3 項、預設 2 欄，每項只有一個 `content` 放置區。
  - 放置區的白名單：Section 的 `content` 是 `disallow: ["Section"]`；Card 的 `content` 是 `allow: ["Paragraph", "Button", "TagList", "Image"]`；Columns 的 `columns[].content` 是 `allow: ["Heading", "Paragraph", "Button", "Card", "TagList", "Image"]`。
  - Paragraph 的 `body` 是 `richText({ features: ["bold", "italic", "link", "bulletList", "orderedList", "hardBreak"] })`。Heading 的 `text` 加 `"x-inline": true`。
  - Paragraph `body` 的預設值是「請輸入內文。」，但寫成 `fitRichTextToTypes(textToRichText("請輸入內文。"), richTextFeaturesToTypes(BODY_FEATURES))`，也就是驗證器清理過的形狀。原因：zod 4 的 `.default()` 直接回傳預設值，不經過 `richText()` 的 `.overwrite()` 清理（facts/zod-ajv.md §4.5 第 480 行的實測：`.overwrite(...).default(...)` 的預設值不經 overwrite）。所以寫在規格裡的富文字預設值必須已是 `richText()` 輸出的形狀，Task 7 測試專用規格的 KitchenSink `body` 也是同一個寫法。依 C.1，`textAlign: false` 會移除 paragraph 的 `attrs.textAlign`（attrs 變空就整個拿掉），所以預設值是沒有 `attrs` 的段落，與編輯器 `getJSON()` 同形，`uses the defaults of spec §8` 寫死這個形狀。若直接用 `textToRichText(...)`，第一次驗證存下的段落帶 `attrs.textAlign: null`，第二次驗證被移除，存下的資料就不一樣了，違反 Review Focus #1 的「補齊預設值後再驗證一次，結果相同」。測試 `accepts a … that has only an id` 對 6 種區塊都驗證兩次並比對結果；改回 `textToRichText(...)` 時，這一筆與 `uses the defaults of spec §8` 都會失敗（已實測）。
  - 根節點有 `title`（1–80 字，預設「未命名頁面」）與 `description`（最多 160 字，`x-field: "textarea"`），`label` 用 `definePageRoot` 的預設「頁面」。
- **每個選項都有中文標籤（`x-labels`）**：
  - Heading 層級 `h1`–`h4` →「標題 1」到「標題 4」。對齊 `start`／`center`／`end` →「靠左」「置中」「靠右」，Paragraph 相同。
  - Button 樣式 →「主要」「次要」「外框」，大小 →「小」「中」「大」。
  - Card 樣式 `default`／`secondary` →「預設」「次要」。
  - TagList 顏色 `default`／`accent`／`success` →「預設」「強調」「成功」，樣式 `secondary`／`soft` →「次要」「柔和」。
  - Section 背景 `transparent`／`default`／`secondary` →「無背景」「白色」「淺灰」。依據是 uikit facts §3.5 與 §4：`surface--default` 是 `bg-surface`，tzuchi 主題把 `--surface` 設成 `--tc-color-white`；`surface--secondary` 用的 `--surface-secondary` 沒有被 tzuchi 主題對應（uikit C13），沿用 HeroUI 預設值 `oklch(0.9524 0.0013 286.37)`，是很淺的中性灰（`vendor/uikit/heroui/styles/themes/default/variables.css` 第 75 行；Task 6 的 vendor 快照用 `grep -n surface-secondary` 實測是第 75 行，第 74 行是空行）。這三個名稱描述的是公開頁使用的淺色主題 `data-theme="tzuchi"`。
  - Section 上下留白 `16`／`32`／`48`／`64` →「小」「中」「大」「特大」。Columns 欄距 `16`／`24`／`32` →「小」「中」「大」。
  - Image 比例 `auto` →「原始比例」，其餘三個比例照原樣顯示。
  - 這些標籤只用在畫面，不存進資料庫（規格 §4.4）。測試 `labels every option of every choice field` 檢查每個選項都有標籤。
- **欄位的 `description` 只加在標籤說不清規則的地方**：按鈕與卡片的連結網址、圖片、比例、頁面標題與說明。這些說明會進入 MCP 目錄與 Storybook 文件。區塊的 `description` 一律是中文，會顯示在編輯器、Storybook 與 MCP 目錄。
- **類型名稱長度**：最長的是 `Paragraph`，9 字元，符合 `BLOCK_TYPE_PATTERN`（最多 27 字元，更正 #1）。編輯器產生的 id 是 `${type}-${uuid}`，最長 46 字元，在 64 以內（core-puck-api §10.3）。測試 `uses type names that fit the ids the editor generates` 實際產生 uuid 並比對 `NODE_ID_PATTERN`。
- **範例（每個區塊至少一個）**：
  - Card 範例的內容區放一個段落和一個按鈕；Section 範例放標題、段落、按鈕；Columns 範例兩欄都有子區塊；Image 範例使用示範圖 `demo-1`（純裝飾範例用 1:1 的 `demo-3`，見 C.3 的 DEMO_ASSETS）。
  - 子區塊只放一層，讓範例保持簡短。子區塊不寫 id，由 `exampleToPageData(spec, index)` 補上（Task 7 的 `withIds` 依形狀辨認放置區，任何深度都會補 id）。
  - Heading、Paragraph、TagList 各有一個 `props: {}` 的範例，名稱是「只用預設值」，不叫「預設」：Task 12 的產生器會為每個區塊另外產生名為「預設」的 `Default` story，同名的話 Storybook 側欄會出現兩個「預設」。範例數維持 13 個，Task 12 實測的 story id（例如 `blocks-tag-list--example-2`）不變。
  - 範例裡的富文字寫成編輯器 `editor.getJSON()` 的形式，和測試的 `EDITED_BODY` 一樣：paragraph 沒有 `attrs`，link 帶完整 attrs（`href`、`target`、`rel`、`class: null`、`title: null`）。C.1 的 `textAlign: false` 會移除 `attrs.textAlign`，所以這就是驗證器存下的形狀。子區塊裡用 `textToRichText(...)` 寫的段落帶 `attrs: { textAlign: null }`，存下時被移除；Task 9 判定 `richtext_cleaned` 前，兩邊都先去掉值為 null 的屬性與空的 attrs／content／marks 再比較（C.2 的富文字清理比較），所以範例驗證時不產生 `richtext_cleaned`，測試也要求範例的 `notices` 為空。
- **`spec.ts` 從 `@tzuchi/tceditor/rules` import `textToRichText`（Paragraph 另外 import `fitRichTextToTypes`、`richTextFeaturesToTypes`）**：C.4 對 `spec.ts` 只禁止 `@tzuchi/tceditor` 主入口（`no-restricted-imports` 的 `paths` 精確比對名稱）。rules 入口不含 React，公開頁與 Edge 單檔本來就會用到它。
- **Review Focus #1 的實測結果**（在套用 Task 1–3 的 core 上，用 jest 與真的 Tiptap Editor 實測）：
  - Paragraph 欄位的選項來自 `richTextFeaturesToOptions`，其中 `textAlign: false`，所以 Tiptap 不註冊 TextAlign。`editor.getJSON()` 的 paragraph **完全沒有 `attrs`**。測試裡的 `EDITED_BODY` 就是當時輸出的原文。
  - 驗證器存下的 body，是 `richText()` 清理後的結果：先 `normalizeRichText`，再依 Paragraph 的功能清單 `fitRichTextToTypes`（textAlign 關閉，C.1：移除 `attrs.textAlign`，attrs 變空就拿掉）。`EDITED_BODY` 本來就是這個形狀，所以原樣存下；測試寫死預期值，不用 rules 入口的函式算，因此也鎖定了 C.1 的寫法：rules 入口若改成「把 textAlign 設為 null」，`uses the defaults of spec §8` 與 `accepts data exactly as the editor emits it` 會失敗（已實測）。
  - 頁面裡另有一個段落（在 Section 裡），body 是 `textToRichText(...)` 的輸出，帶 `attrs.textAlign: null`，代表 Review Focus #1 所說「含 `attrs.textAlign: null` 這類預設屬性」的資料，例如舊版預設值或用 `textToRichText` 寫入的資料。驗證器存下的是去掉 attrs 的段落（測試的 `STORED_DEFAULT_BODY`），但這兩種寫法都必須不產生提示，靠的是 Task 9 比較前的正規化（C.2 的富文字清理比較：兩邊先去掉值為 null 的屬性與空的 attrs／content／marks，再比 `stableStringify`）。
  - 若不做這個正規化、直接比較輸入與輸出的 `stableStringify`，`accepts data exactly as the editor emits it` 與 `is idempotent` 都會失敗，已實測。
- **`validator-cases.json`**（Task 13 會用 Edge 單檔重跑）：
  - 共 32 筆：7 筆正例，25 筆反例，涵蓋 `too_large`、`invalid_json`、`too_deep`、`too_many_blocks` 以外的 10 種錯誤碼。這 4 種由 Task 9 的測試負責：2 MB 與 5,001 個區塊的資料太大，不適合放進共用案例檔；33 層的反例只能用測試專用規格做出來（更正 #21）。`richtext_cleaned` 是提示而不是錯誤，也由 Task 9 測試。
  - 最後 5 筆是資安反例（Review Focus #3、規格 §13.1）：props 有 `__proto__`、清單項目有 `constructor`、區塊類型是 `__proto__`、前面有空白且大小寫混用的 `javascript:`、中間夾 tab 的 `javascript:`。Task 9 用測試專用規格測過這些情況；放進共用案例檔，是為了讓 Task 13 的 Edge 單檔也被這些情況檢查到（規格 §6.4「同一組測試資料」）。
  - 這個檔案只能用 `JSON.parse` 讀取：jest 載入 `.json` 模組時就是用 `JSON.parse`，Task 13 也是讀檔後 `JSON.parse`。`JSON.parse` 會把 `"__proto__"` 當成一般的 own key；若改成會把 JSON 轉成 JS 物件字面值的讀法，這個 key 會變成設定原型，案例就失去作用。
  - 每筆反例只會產生一個錯誤。測試把錯誤的 `code` 與 `pathText` 排序後完整比對。
  - 路徑慣例與 Task 9 的實作相同：`unknown_type` 是 `<節點路徑>.type`（例如 `content[0].type`）；`not_allowed_here` 是子區塊的節點路徑，不加 `.type`（例如 `content[0].props.columns[0].content[0]`）；`invalid_id`、`duplicate_id` 是 `<節點路徑>.props.id`，id 重複時回報第二次出現的那一個；`legacy_zones` 是 `zones`；`content` 不是陣列時是 `content` 的 `invalid_shape`；根節點是 `root.props.<欄位>`；富文字內部的問題截到欄位本身（`content[0].props.body`）。
- **jest 設定必須限定 `testMatch`**：jest 預設的 `**/?(*.)+(spec|test).[jt]s?(x)` 會把每個區塊的 `spec.ts` 當成測試檔。實測未設定時，12 個 suite 都失敗，訊息是 `Your test suite must contain at least one test.`。改成只收 `src/**/__tests__/**/*.spec.ts?(x)`。
- **其他設定**：jest 照 core 的 ts-jest ESM 寫法，`testEnvironment: "node"`。tsconfig 依 C.3，用 `moduleResolution: "bundler"`、`resolveJsonModule`（測試 import JSON 案例）、`types: ["node", "jest"]`。
- **`package.json` 的取捨**：

建立 `packages/blocks/src/__tests__/specs.spec.ts`：

```ts
import {
  BLOCK_TYPE_PATTERN,
  checkSpecRules,
  eachField,
  toJsonSchema,
} from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";
import type { AnyBlockSpec, JsonSchema } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";
import { NODE_ID_PATTERN } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec/validator";
import { CATEGORIES, blockSpecs, pageRootSpec } from "../specs";
import { blockTypes } from "../validator";

/** Each top-level field's JSON Schema `default` (prefault included). */
const defaultsOf = (spec: AnyBlockSpec | typeof pageRootSpec) => {
  const properties = toJsonSchema(spec).properties as Record<
    string,
    JsonSchema
  >;

  return Object.fromEntries(
    Object.keys(properties).map((name) => [name, properties[name].default])
  );
};

describe("block specs", () => {
  it("registers the 8 blocks in editor order", () => {
    const types = blockSpecs.map((spec) => spec.type);
    // spec §8; a block added later may go anywhere in the list
    const demoBlocks = [
      "Heading",
      "Paragraph",
      "Button",
      "Card",
      "TagList",
      "Section",
      "Columns",
      "Image",
    ];

    expect(types.filter((type) => demoBlocks.includes(type))).toEqual(
      demoBlocks
    );
    expect(blockTypes).toEqual(types);
  });

  it("follows the spec writing rules", () => {
    expect(checkSpecRules({ blocks: blockSpecs, root: pageRootSpec })).toEqual(
      []
    );
  });

  it("uses type names that fit the ids the editor generates", () => {
    for (const { type } of blockSpecs) {
      expect(type).toMatch(BLOCK_TYPE_PATTERN);
      // The editor's ids are `${type}-${uuid}`: the type plus 37 characters
      expect(type.length + 37).toBeLessThanOrEqual(64);
      expect(`${type}-${crypto.randomUUID()}`).toMatch(NODE_ID_PATTERN);
    }
  });

  it("puts every block in one of the editor categories", () => {
    const titles: readonly string[] = CATEGORIES.map(({ title }) => title);
    const categoryOf = Object.fromEntries(
      blockSpecs.map((spec) => [spec.type, spec.category])
    );

    for (const spec of blockSpecs) {
      expect([spec.type, titles.includes(spec.category)]).toEqual([
        spec.type,
        true,
      ]);
    }
    // spec §7.3; a block added later only has to name one of the categories
    expect(categoryOf).toMatchObject({
      Heading: "文字",
      Paragraph: "文字",
      Button: "互動",
      Card: "內容",
      TagList: "內容",
      Image: "內容",
      Section: "版面",
      Columns: "版面",
    });
    expect(CATEGORIES.map(({ key }) => key)).toEqual([
      "text",
      "interactive",
      "content",
      "layout",
    ]);
  });

  it("has a positive integer version, a boolean deprecated flag and a description", () => {
    for (const spec of blockSpecs) {
      // A compatible change raises `version` and a retired block sets
      // `deprecated: true`, so neither is pinned to its first value
      expect(Number.isInteger(spec.version)).toBe(true);
      expect(spec.version).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
      expect(typeof spec.deprecated).toBe("boolean");
      expect(spec.description.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(spec.description.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(4096);
      expect(spec.examples.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    }
  });

  it("labels every option of every choice field", () => {
    for (const spec of blockSpecs) {
      eachField(toJsonSchema(spec), ({ path, node }) => {
        if (!Array.isArray(node.enum)) return;

        const field = `${spec.type}.${path.join(".")}`;
        const labels = (node["x-labels"] ?? {}) as Record<string, string>;

        // The field name is part of the expectation so a failure names it
        expect([field, Object.keys(labels).sort()]).toEqual([
          field,
          [...(node.enum as string[])].sort(),
        ]);
        for (const value of node.enum as string[]) {
          expect([field, value, labels[value]]).toEqual([
            field,
            value,
            expect.stringMatching(/\S/),
          ]);
        }
      });
    }
  });

  it("uses the defaults of spec §8", () => {
    const byType = new Map<string, unknown>(
      blockSpecs.map((spec) => [spec.type, defaultsOf(spec)])
    );
    const [heading, paragraph, button, card, tagList, section, columns, image] =
      [
        "Heading",
        "Paragraph",
        "Button",
        "Card",
        "TagList",
        "Section",
        "Columns",
        "Image",
      ].map((type) => byType.get(type));

    expect(heading).toEqual({ text: "標題文字", level: "h2", align: "start" });
    expect(paragraph).toEqual({
      // The text of spec §8 in the shape richText() stores: textAlign is off,
      // so the paragraph has no attrs, as in the editor's getJSON()
      body: {
        type: "doc",
        content: [
          {
            type: "paragraph",
            content: [{ type: "text", text: "請輸入內文。" }],
          },
        ],
      },
      align: "start",
    });
    expect(button).toEqual({
      label: "立即報名",
      href: "",
      variant: "primary",
      size: "md",
      fullWidth: false,
    });
    expect(card).toEqual({
      title: "卡片標題",
      summary: "",
      href: "",
      variant: "default",
      content: [],
    });
    expect(tagList).toEqual({
      tags: [{ label: "志工" }, { label: "環保" }],
      color: "default",
      variant: "secondary",
    });
    expect(section).toEqual({
      background: "transparent",
      paddingY: "48",
      content: [],
    });
    expect(columns).toEqual({
      columns: [{ content: [] }, { content: [] }],
      gap: "24",
    });
    expect(image).toEqual({
      image: { assetId: "", alt: "", decorative: false },
      ratio: "auto",
      caption: "",
    });
    expect(defaultsOf(pageRootSpec)).toEqual({
      title: "未命名頁面",
      description: "",
    });
    expect(pageRootSpec.label).toBe("頁面");
  });
});
```

```ts
import { exampleToPageData } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";
import { textToRichText } from "@tzuchi/tceditor/rules";
import type { RichTextDoc } from "@tzuchi/tceditor/rules";
import cases from "../__fixtures__/validator-cases.json";

import { validatePage, validatePageJson } from "../validator";
import type { IssueCode, ValidateResult } from "../validator";

type Case = {
  name: string;
  input: unknown;
  expect:
    | { ok: true }
    | { ok: false; errors: { code: IssueCode; pathText: string }[] };
};

const byPath = (a: { pathText: string; code: string }, b: typeof a) =>
  a.pathText === b.pathText
    ? a.code.localeCompare(b.code)
    : a.pathText.localeCompare(b.pathText);

/** code + pathText of each error, sorted, or { ok: true } */
const summarize = (result: ValidateResult): Case["expect"] =>
  result.ok
    ? { ok: true }
    : {
        ok: false,
        errors: result.errors
          .map(({ code, pathText }) => ({ code, pathText }))
          .sort(byPath),
      };

const expectOk = (result: ValidateResult) => {
  if (!result.ok) throw new Error(JSON.stringify(result.errors, null, 2));

  return result;
};

const singleBlockPage = (type: string, props: Record<string, unknown>) => ({
  root: { props: {} },
  content: [{ type, props: { id: `${type}-1`, ...props } }],
});

// returns it. The Paragraph field turns textAlign off (richTextFeaturesToOptions),
```

建立 `packages/blocks/src/__tests__/json-schema.spec.ts`：

```ts
import Ajv2020 from "ajv/dist/2020";
import type { ValidateFunction } from "ajv/dist/2020";
import {
  X_KEYS,
  exampleToPageData,
  slotLocations,
  toJsonSchema,
} from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";
import type { AnyBlockSpec, BlockNode } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";
import { blockSpecs, pageRootSpec } from "../specs";
import { validatePage } from "../validator";

const ajv = new Ajv2020({ strict: true, allErrors: true });

ajv.addVocabulary([...X_KEYS]);

const specs = new Map<string, AnyBlockSpec>(
  blockSpecs.map((spec) => [spec.type, spec])
);
const blockSchemas = new Map<string, ValidateFunction>(
  blockSpecs.map((spec) => [spec.type, ajv.compile(toJsonSchema(spec))])
);
const rootSchema = ajv.compile(toJsonSchema(pageRootSpec));

/** Every node of a validated page, slot children included. */
const allNodes = (content: BlockNode[]): BlockNode[] => {
  const nodes: BlockNode[] = [];
  const stack = [...content];

  while (stack.length > 0) {
    const node = stack.pop() as BlockNode;

    nodes.push(node);

    for (const { path } of slotLocations(
      specs.get(node.type) as AnyBlockSpec
    )) {
      const value = node.props[path[0]];

      if (path.length === 1) {
        stack.push(...(value as BlockNode[]));
      } else {
        for (const item of value as Record<string, BlockNode[]>[]) {
          stack.push(...item[path[2]]);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return nodes;
};

const examples = blockSpecs.flatMap((spec) =>
  spec.examples.map((example, index) => ({
    name: `${spec.type}: ${example.name}`,
    spec,
    index,
  }))
);

describe("JSON Schema of the blocks (Ajv 2020-12)", () => {
  it.each(examples)(
    "accepts every node the validator accepts in $name",
    ({ spec, index }) => {
      const result = validatePage(exampleToPageData(spec, index));

      if (!result.ok) throw new Error(JSON.stringify(result.errors));

      for (const node of allNodes(result.data.content)) {
        const { id: _id, ...props } = node.props;
        const validate = blockSchemas.get(node.type) as ValidateFunction;

        // The type is in the expectation so a failure names the block
        expect([node.type, validate(props), validate.errors ?? null]).toEqual([
          node.type,
          true,
          null,
        ]);
      }

      expect(rootSchema(result.data.root.props)).toBe(true);
    }
  );
});
```

```ts
import * as z from "zod";
import { defineBlockSpec, style } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";
import type { BlockProps } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";

export const headingSpec = defineBlockSpec({
  type: "Heading",
  label: "標題",
  category: "文字",
  description:
    "頁面或段落的標題。層級同時決定 HTML 標籤（h1–h4），一頁通常只放一個標題 1。",
  version: 1,
  props: z.strictObject({
    text: z
      .string()
      .min(1)
      .max(120)
      .default("標題文字")
      .meta({ title: "標題文字", "x-inline": true }),
    level: style("typography", "type", ["h1", "h2", "h3", "h4"])
      .default("h2")
      .meta({
        title: "層級",
        "x-labels": { h1: "標題 1", h2: "標題 2", h3: "標題 3", h4: "標題 4" },
      }),
    align: style("typography", "align", ["start", "center", "end"])
      .default("start")
      .meta({
        title: "對齊",
        "x-labels": { start: "靠左", center: "置中", end: "靠右" },
      }),
  }),
  examples: [
    { name: "只用預設值", props: {} },
    {
      name: "置中的頁面主標題",
      props: { text: "2026 年淨灘活動", level: "h1", align: "center" },
    },
  ],
});

export type HeadingProps = BlockProps<typeof headingSpec>;
```

建立 `packages/blocks/src/paragraph/spec.ts`：

```ts
import * as z from "zod";
import {
  fitRichTextToTypes,
  richTextFeaturesToTypes,
  textToRichText,
} from "@tzuchi/tceditor/rules";
import { defineBlockSpec, richText, style } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";
import type { BlockProps } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";

const BODY_FEATURES = [
  "bold",
  "italic",
  "link",
  "bulletList",
  "orderedList",
  "hardBreak",
] as const;

export const paragraphSpec = defineBlockSpec({
  type: "Paragraph",
  label: "段落",
  category: "文字",
  description:
    "一段內文，可以在畫布上直接編輯。可用粗體、斜體、連結、項目清單、編號清單與換行；對齊方式由區塊設定，不在文字裡設定。",
  version: 1,
  props: z.strictObject({
    body: richText({ features: BODY_FEATURES })
      // zod returns a default as it is, without richText()'s cleanup, so the
      // default is cleaned here: validating it a second time changes nothing
      .default(() =>
        fitRichTextToTypes(
          textToRichText("請輸入內文。"),
          richTextFeaturesToTypes(BODY_FEATURES)
        )
      )
      .meta({ title: "內文" }),
    align: style("typography", "align", ["start", "center", "end"])
      .default("start")
      .meta({
        title: "對齊",
        "x-labels": { start: "靠左", center: "置中", end: "靠右" },
      }),
  }),
  examples: [
    { name: "只用預設值", props: {} },
    {
      name: "含格式與清單",
      props: {
        body: {
          type: "doc",
          content: [
            {
              type: "paragraph",
              content: [
                { type: "text", text: "活動當天請" },
                { type: "text", marks: [{ type: "bold" }], text: "準時報到" },
                { type: "text", text: "，並攜帶：" },
              ],
            },
            {
              type: "bulletList",
              content: [
                {
                  type: "listItem",
                  content: [
                    {
                      type: "paragraph",
                      content: [{ type: "text", text: "環保杯與餐具" }],
                    },
                  ],
                },
                {
                  type: "listItem",
                  content: [
                    {
                      type: "paragraph",
                      content: [{ type: "text", text: "防曬用品" }],
                    },
                  ],
                },
              ],
            },
            {
              type: "paragraph",
              content: [
                { type: "text", text: "詳細資訊請見" },
                {
                  type: "text",
                  marks: [
                    {
                      type: "link",
                      attrs: {
                        href: "/activity",
                        target: "_blank",
                        rel: "noopener noreferrer nofollow",
                        class: null,
                        title: null,
                      },
                    },
                  ],
                  text: "活動說明",
                },
                { type: "text", text: "。" },
              ],
            },
          ],
        },
      },
    },
  ],
});

export type ParagraphProps = BlockProps<typeof paragraphSpec>;
```

```ts
import * as z from "zod";
import { defineBlockSpec, link, style } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";
import type { BlockProps } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";

export const buttonSpec = defineBlockSpec({
  type: "Button",
  label: "按鈕",
  category: "互動",
  description:
    "導向其他頁面或網站的按鈕。新加入的按鈕沒有連結網址，填好網址才能發布。",
  version: 1,
  props: z.strictObject({
    label: z
      .string()
      .min(1)
      .max(40)
      .default("立即報名")
      .meta({ title: "按鈕文字" }),
    href: link().meta({
      title: "連結網址",
      description: "必填。只接受 http、https、mailto、tel 或站內路徑。",
    }),
    variant: style("button", "variant", ["primary", "secondary", "outline"])
      .default("primary")
      .meta({
        title: "樣式",
        "x-labels": { primary: "主要", secondary: "次要", outline: "外框" },
      }),
    size: style("button", "size", ["sm", "md", "lg"])
      .default("md")
      .meta({ title: "大小", "x-labels": { sm: "小", md: "中", lg: "大" } }),
    fullWidth: z.boolean().default(false).meta({ title: "滿版寬度" }),
  }),
  examples: [
    { name: "主要按鈕", props: { label: "立即報名", href: "/register" } },
    {
      name: "外框、滿版",
      props: {
        label: "了解更多",
        href: "/about",
        variant: "outline",
        fullWidth: true,
      },
    },
  ],
});

export type ButtonProps = BlockProps<typeof buttonSpec>;
```

```ts
import * as z from "zod";
import { textToRichText } from "@tzuchi/tceditor/rules";
import { defineBlockSpec, link, slot, style } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";
import type { BlockProps } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";

export const cardSpec = defineBlockSpec({
  type: "Card",
  label: "卡片",
  category: "內容",
  description:
    "有標題、摘要與內容區的卡片。填了連結網址時，標題會變成連結；內容區可以放段落、按鈕、標籤列與圖片。",
  version: 1,
  props: z.strictObject({
    title: z
      .string()
      .min(1)
      .max(80)
      .default("卡片標題")
      .meta({ title: "標題" }),
    summary: z
      .string()
      .max(200)
      .default("")
      .meta({ title: "摘要", "x-field": "textarea" }),
    href: link({ optional: true }).meta({
      title: "連結網址",
      description:
        "選填。填寫時標題變成連結；只接受 http、https、mailto、tel 或站內路徑。",
    }),
    variant: style("card", "variant", ["default", "secondary"])
      .default("default")
      .meta({
        title: "樣式",
        "x-labels": { default: "預設", secondary: "次要" },
      }),
    content: slot({ allow: ["Paragraph", "Button", "TagList", "Image"] }).meta({
      title: "內容",
    }),
  }),
  examples: [
    {
      name: "含段落與按鈕",
      props: {
        title: "淨灘志工招募",
        summary: "每月第一個週六上午，在福隆海灘集合。",
        href: "/activity",
        content: [
          {
            type: "Paragraph",
            props: {
              body: textToRichText("不需要經驗，現場有志工說明。"),
            },
          },
          {
            type: "Button",
            props: { label: "立即報名", href: "/register", size: "sm" },
          },
        ],
      },
    },
  ],
});

export type CardProps = BlockProps<typeof cardSpec>;
```

```ts
import { buttonSpec } from "./button/spec";

  headingSpec,
  paragraphSpec,
  buttonSpec,
  cardSpec,
  tagListSpec,
  sectionSpec,
  columnsSpec,
  imageSpec,
] as const;

/**
 * Editor categories, in display order. `title` equals the `category` of the
 * specs it holds. createEditorConfig adds a hidden "deprecated" category.
 */

  { key: "text", title: "文字" },
  { key: "interactive", title: "互動" },
  { key: "content", title: "內容" },
```

```ts
import { createPageValidator } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec/validator";
import type { PageValidator } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec/validator";
import { blockSpecs, pageRootSpec } from "./specs";

const validator = createPageValidator({
  blocks: blockSpecs,
  root: pageRootSpec,
});

/** Validates a parsed page against the 8 blocks and the page root. */
export const validatePage: PageValidator["validatePage"] = (data) =>
  validator.validatePage(data);

/** Checks the UTF-8 size, parses the JSON, then runs validatePage. */
export const validatePageJson: PageValidator["validatePageJson"] = (raw) =>
  validator.validatePageJson(raw);

export const blockTypes: readonly string[] = validator.blockTypes;

export {
  DEFAULT_LIMITS,
  ISSUE_CODES,
  formatPathText,
} from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec/validator";

  Issue,
  IssueCode,
  ValidateResult,
} from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec/validator";
```

### Task 11: 畫面、樣式、render／editor 設定、圖片挑選器

目的：為 Task 10 的 8 個區塊與頁面根節點寫出畫面（`view.tsx`）。畫面是不帶 `'use client'` 的伺服器元件，只用 `@heroui/styles` 的 tv 函式畫出一般 HTML 元素，不用 inline style。間距等 token 值對應到 `src/blocks.css` 的 `tcb-*` class。另外完成下列項目：
- `packages/blocks/styles.css`：示範站與 Storybook 共用的唯一 CSS 入口。
- `AssetSource` 介面與 6 張示範圖。
- `src/views.ts`：區塊類型對應畫面的表 `views`，每個區塊一行。
- `buildRenderConfig({ blocks, views, assets })`：伺服器安全，依每個規格的 JSON Schema 自動把 props 對應到畫面（規格 §3.3、§7.1）。`createRenderConfig({ assets })` 是它套用 `blockSpecs` 與 `views` 的結果，給公開頁與 Storybook 的 `Render` 使用。新增區塊因此只要寫 `spec.ts` 與 `view.tsx`、在 `blockSpecs` 與 `views` 各加一行、執行 `pnpm gen:blocks`，不必改 render 設定（規格 §1 成功標準第 1 項）。
- `createEditorConfig`：`'use client'`，給 `<Puck>` 使用，欄位、預設值與分類都由規格產生，圖片欄位用自訂的挑選介面。分類由匯出的純函式 `editorCategories(blocks)` 產生。

測試證明下列幾點：
- 每個區塊範例經過驗證器後，用 RSC `Render` 產生的 HTML 含有它的文字與連結，而且沒有 inline style。要比對的文字與連結依規格的欄位種類找出，不逐一列出區塊。
- `buildRenderConfig` 只靠一份測試專用的規格與畫面，就能對應一個新區塊：放置區的子區塊、清單項目裡的放置區、圖片與文字都正確，畫面只收到規格的欄位。少了畫面時，TypeScript 與執行期都會擋下。
- 標題層級決定 HTML 標籤；按鈕輸出 `<a href>`。
- 多欄被清空或缺少 `content` 時照常顯示（Review Focus #4）。
- 公開頁與編輯器的 interactive 預覽（client `Render`）都維持區塊之間的垂直間距。
- 圖片沒選或素材已刪除時顯示占位框，純裝飾圖片輸出 `alt=""`（Review Focus #5）。
- 每個 token 值都是 tokens.css 裡存在的變數，也都有對應的 class；多欄的斷點與 tokens 一致。
- 示範圖的檔案存在、尺寸相符，也不引用外部資源。
- 編輯器設定的欄位與規格一致；每個區塊都在規格指定的分類，deprecated 區塊只出現在隱藏分類。
- 圖片挑選器能列圖、選圖、編輯替代文字、切換純裝飾，唯讀時不送出任何修改。

**執行位置**：主工作目錄 `/Users/kaellim/Desktop/projects/puck`，分支 `s2/block-spec`。

**設計決定與說明**：

**畫面**
- **只用 `@heroui/styles` 的 tv 函式，不用 `@heroui/react`**（規格 §18 #14）。
  - `typographyVariants`、`buttonVariants`、`cardVariants`、`chipVariants`、`surfaceVariants` 都只 import `tailwind-variants`，在伺服器端渲染沒有問題（facts/uikit.md §10，SSR 實測）。
  - 公開頁因此不送任何畫面的 JS（facts/preflight.md §4.5：`/activity` 的 chunk 裡沒有 `buttonVariants`）。
  - 每個 `view.tsx` 只 import `@heroui/styles`、`react` 的型別、`../token-classes`，以及自己 `spec.ts` 的型別（`import type`）。
- **各區塊的畫面**：
  - **Heading**：`level` 的值（`h1`–`h4`）就是 HTML 標籤，`typographyVariants({ type: level, align }).base()` 放在同一個元素上。這個 tv 的 variant 只套在 `base` slot（facts/uikit.md §3.2）。
  - **Paragraph**：外層 `<div>` 同時帶 `base()`（字級與對齊）與 `prose()`（`typography-prose`，負責內層 `p`、`ul`、`a` 的樣式）。富文字由 core 的共用渲染器轉成 React，`p + p` 的間距由 `.tcb-paragraph p + p` 補上。
  - **Button**：輸出 `<a href class={buttonVariants({ variant, size, fullWidth })}>`（規格 §7.1；`<a>` 也能拿到 hover、active、focus 樣式，facts/uikit.md §3.1）。
    - `href` 為空字串時（編輯器裡新加入、還沒填網址的按鈕），輸出不帶 `href` 的 `<a>`，避免連回目前頁面。
    - 不包外層元素：`.button` 帶 `w-fit`（`heroui/styles/components/button.css`），放在垂直排列的 flex 容器裡也不會被拉寬。
  - **Card**：`cardVariants({ variant })` 的 `base`、`header`、`title`、`description`、`content` 五個 slot。
    - `href` 不是空字串時，標題文字包成 `<a class="tcb-card-link">`。
    - 摘要是空字串時不輸出 `<p>`。
  - **TagList**：`<ul class="tcb-tag-list">`，每個 `<li>` 是 chip 的 `base`，文字放在 `label` slot 的 `<span>`。
  - **Section**：`surfaceVariants({ variant: background })` 加上 `tokenClass("space", "padding-y", paddingY)`。有背景色時加 `tcb-section--inset` 補左右留白；透明背景時和頁面其他區塊左右對齊。
  - **Columns**：每欄包一層 `tcb-columns-column`；欄數 class（`tcb-columns--2`／`--3`）依陣列長度決定；欄距用 `tokenClass("space", "gap", gap)`。
  - **Image**：輸出 `<figure>`。
    - 有圖時是 `<img width height loading="lazy" alt>`。比例不是 `auto` 時加 `tcb-ratio-*`（`aspect-ratio`）與 `tcb-image-img--cover`（`object-fit: cover`）。
    - 純裝飾時 `alt=""`。
    - 沒選圖（`empty`）或素材查不到（`missing`）時，輸出 `role="img"` 加 `aria-label` 的占位框，框內顯示同一段文字（「尚未選擇圖片」／「圖片已不存在」）。占位框同樣套比例 class。
    - 兩種占位框用 modifier class 區分外觀：`tcb-image-placeholder--empty` 是虛線框，`--missing` 是警告色框。兩個名稱寫在 `PLACEHOLDER_CLASS` 表裡，不用 `` `tcb-image-placeholder--${status}` `` 組合，class 檢查測試才看得到它們。多欄的 `tcb-columns--2`／`--3` 也同樣逐字寫出。
    - 有圖說時輸出 `<figcaption>`，樣式用 `typographyVariants({ type: "body-sm" })`。
- **畫面接受 `ReactNode`**：標題的 `text` 在編輯器是 inline 編輯元件，富文字的 `body` 是 `RichTextContent` 或 inline 編輯器（facts/core-puck-api.md §5.2、§5.3）。按鈕的 `label` 依 C.3 也宣告成 `ReactNode`。

**render 與 editor 設定**
- **`buildRenderConfig({ blocks, views, assets })` 依規格自動對應畫面**（規格 §1 成功標準第 1 項、§3.3、§7.1）：
  - 先用 `toJsonSchema` 與 `eachField` 把每個規格整理成欄位樹。清單項目的欄位掛在清單底下，例如 `["columns", "[]", "content"]` 屬於 `columns`。
  - 再依 `fieldKindOf` 決定每個欄位怎麼交給畫面：
    - `slot` → `<Slot className="tcb-stack" />`；
    - `richtext` → React 元素（`asNode`）；
    - `image` → 用 `assets.get` 解析出的 `ResolvedImage`；
    - 項目裡有上述欄位的清單（多欄的 `columns[].content`）→ 逐項只挑出規格的欄位再轉換；群組（object）同理；
    - 其他欄位原樣傳入：文字、連結、選項、布林、數字，以及項目裡沒有上述欄位的清單（TagList 的 `tags`）。
  - 頂層只挑規格的欄位，而且只讀 own property，不把 Puck 的 props 整包展開（規格 §7.1）。Puck 的 props 裡有 `puck.renderDropZone` 這類函式，以及 `id`、`editMode`。
  - 轉換方式在建立 config 時依規格算好一次，`render` 只負責套用。
  - `views` 用 `Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call` 查詢。某個區塊沒有畫面時拋 `TypeError('buildRenderConfig: block "<type>" has no view')`。
  - `createRenderConfig({ assets })` 的簽名與輸出依共用介面 C.3，內容是 `buildRenderConfig({ blocks: blockSpecs, views, assets })`。
- **型別**：
  - `ViewValue<V>` 把規格的輸出型別換成畫面收到的型別：放置區（`SlotItem[]`）與富文字（`RichTextDoc`）變成 `ReactNode`，圖片（`ImageValue`）變成 `ResolvedImage`，清單與群組逐欄位換。`ViewProps<S>` 是規格每個欄位的 `ViewValue`。
  - `BlockViews<B>` 以區塊的 `type` 為 key，值是 `ComponentType<ViewProps<該區塊的規格>>`。`src/views.ts` 寫成 `export const views = { … } satisfies BlockViews<typeof blockSpecs>`。登記了規格卻沒有畫面、畫面的 props 和規格對不上、多出沒有登記的類型，三種情況 `tsc` 都會失敗（實測）。
  - 畫面的參數可以比 `ViewProps` 寬。可以 inline 編輯的文字在型別上是 `string`，編輯器裡卻是 React 元素（facts/core-puck-api.md §4.2），所以畫面把它宣告成 `ReactNode`。
  - Puck 的 config 不用泛型對應：依規格寫的 mapped type `ComponentConfig<…[K]>` 會因為泛型條件型別而編譯失敗（實測）。所以每筆設定是預設型別參數的 `ComponentConfig`，規格與畫面的型別對應改由 `BlockViews` 負責。
  - `viewOf` 把畫面當成 `ComponentType<Record<string, unknown>>` 呼叫，這是唯一的轉型：傳入的值在執行期由同一份規格組出，型別由 `views.ts` 的 `satisfies` 把關。
  - 型別與 `buildRenderConfig` 都在 `render-config.tsx`。`views.ts` 只 `import type` 它們，執行期沒有循環引用。
- **`src/views.ts`** 只 import 各區塊的 `view.tsx`，和畫面一樣是伺服器安全的。它被 `render-config.tsx` import，所以 ESLint 的 `PUBLIC_IMPORTS` 也套用到它（Step 2 (c)）。
- **config 帶 `fields`**（共用介面 C.3 的 `buildRenderConfig`）：
  - 圖片欄位在這裡用一個什麼都不畫的 `custom` 欄位。`toPuckFields` 遇到圖片欄位卻沒有 `factories.image` 時會拋錯（C.2），而 `Render` 本來就不顯示欄位。
  - 富文字欄位在 `Render` 裡一律變成 React 元素，`asNode` 只放行 `isValidElement` 的值。萬一收到原始 JSON，會什麼都不畫，而不是讓 React 拋出「Objects are not valid as a React child」。
- **放置區**：
  - `render` 收到的 slot 是元件。依 `<Slot className="tcb-stack" />` 渲染，`Render` 與編輯器都會在外面包一層 `<div>`（facts/core-puck-api.md §0 第 3 點、§4.3），`className` 會加在這一層。
  - 多欄的項目缺 `content` 時不會被補成元件（`walkField` 只對頂層的 slot 補空陣列，`lib/data/default-slots.ts`），所以 `slotNode` 先確認是函式。
- **垂直間距（`tcb-stack`）**：
  - 頁面與每個放置區都用 flex 直排加 `gap`。區塊在 `Render` 裡直接是子元素；在編輯器裡外面各包一層 `<div>`（拖曳用），兩種情況都是放置區容器的直接子元素，所以間距一致。
  - 編輯器的根節點例外，`root.render` 收到的 `children` 不是區塊本身，而且無法設定 `className`：
    - 一般編輯模式：`children` 是 Puck 的根放置區（`<div data-puck-dropzone>`），用 `.tcb-page > [data-puck-dropzone]` 套用同樣的直排。`data-puck-*` 屬於 CLAUDE.md 列出的公開名稱。
    - interactive 預覽（快速鍵切換，`lib/use-preview-mode-hotkeys.ts`）：預覽改用 client `Render`，它在根內容外多包一層沒有 class 的 `<div>`（`components/Render/index.tsx` 的 `DropZoneRenderPure`、`components/DropZone/index.tsx:621-631`；facts/core-puck-api.md §0 第 3 點、§6.1），用 `.tcb-page > div:not([class])` 套用直排。
    - 區塊畫面最外層的 `div`（Paragraph、Columns）都帶 class，不會被第二條選到。`render.spec.tsx` 的 `stacks the page's blocks in the client Render too (interactive preview)` 用 client `Render` 實際渲染，鎖定這層沒有 class 的 `<div>`，並確認 `blocks.css` 有這條 selector。
- **圖片**：在 `render-config.tsx` 用同步的 `assets.get` 換成 `ResolvedImage`（規格 §7.3），所以這一步在伺服器端完成。
  - `assetId` 是空字串時是 `empty`。
  - 查不到時是 `missing`，不拋錯（Review Focus #5）。
  - 純裝飾時（或資料裡的 `alt` 不是字串時）`alt` 是空字串。
- **`createEditorConfig`**：
  - 以 `createRenderConfig` 的元件為基礎，`render` 與公開頁共用（規格 §7.3）。每個區塊再換上 `toPuckFields(spec, { image: createImagePickerField(assets) })` 與 `toDefaultProps(spec)`。
  - `categories` 由匯出的純函式 `editorCategories(blocks)` 產生：依 `CATEGORIES` 的順序，用 `spec.category === title` 分組，排除 deprecated 區塊。另外加隱藏分類 `deprecated: { title: "已停用", visible: false, components: […] }`。
    - 設 `visible: false` 的分類，元件不會落到「其他」（facts/core-puck-api.md §2.2）。`components` 照常包含 deprecated 區塊，所以已經用到它的頁面仍能選取與編輯。
    - 寫成純函式，測試才能用 deprecated 的規格實際走過這段邏輯：8 個區塊都不是 deprecated。
  - `root` 加上 `pageRootSpec` 的欄位與預設值。
  - Puck 依 render 函式 memo 自訂欄位，所以 config 要建立一次就重複使用，JSDoc 有寫明（gaps #35）。

**圖片挑選器（`src/image/editor.tsx`，`'use client'`）**
- **欄位結構**：
  - `createImagePickerField(assets)` 回傳 `({ name, label }) => CustomField<ImageValue>`。`render` 在每次呼叫時建立一次，之後不再改變。Puck 依 `[field.type, field.key, render]` memo（facts/core-puck-api.md §3.3）。
  - Puck 不替 `custom` 欄位加標籤，所以外層用 `<fieldset>`，`<legend>` 放欄位的 `title`（`label`）。
  - `readOnly` 時設 `fieldset disabled`，`update` 也直接略過，不送出修改。
- **圖片清單**：
  - 在 effect 裡呼叫 `assets.list()`，有「正在載入圖片…」、載入失敗、沒有圖片三種狀態。
  - 每張圖是帶 `aria-pressed` 的 `<button>`。
  - 目前選的圖已不在清單時，顯示「目前選的圖片已不存在，請重新選擇。」。
- **替代文字與純裝飾**：
  - 替代文字是 `<input maxLength={IMAGE_ALT_MAX_LENGTH}>`（200），並有說明文字。
  - 「純裝飾（不需要替代文字）」是原生 checkbox（fork 沒有 checkbox 欄位，gaps #35）。勾選時停用替代文字輸入框，但保留原本的文字，取消勾選後可以繼續用。
- **每次修改都送出完整的 `ImageValue`**。資料不完整時（例如舊資料缺 key），先由 `toImageValue` 補齊。
- **樣式**：只用 `blocks.css` 的 `tcb-picker-*` class（編輯器版面引入 `styles.css`，facts/preflight.md §4.1），顏色用基礎色 token。編輯器的 host `<html>` 不設 `data-theme`（更正 #19），HeroUI 主題變數會是預設主題的值；基礎色 token 不受影響。

**樣式**
- **`packages/blocks/styles.css` 的順序**：tokens → `@heroui/styles` → 慈濟主題（不包 layer）→ `./src/blocks.css`，再加 `@source "./src"`。
  - 前三行和 facts/preflight.md §1.4 實測可用的檔案相同（更正 #9）。不另外 `@import "tailwindcss"`，因為 `@heroui/styles` 本身就是 Tailwind 入口，再 import 一次會輸出兩份 preflight。
  - `blocks.css` 不包 layer，排在最後，所以會蓋過 HeroUI 的 `@layer components`。以 `@tailwindcss/cli@4.3.3` 編譯確認：`.tcb-*` 規則不在任何 `@layer` 裡，`.button--primary` 在 `@layer components`。編譯結果的 `url(` 與 `@import` 都是 0 次。
- **`src/blocks.css` 的顏色**只用 HeroUI 主題變數（`--border`、`--default`、`--default-foreground`、`--warning`、`--focus`）或基礎色 token（`--tc-color-gray-*`、`--tc-color-blue-*`、`--tc-color-amber-700`、`--tc-color-white`）。
  - 語意色 `--tc-color-text-*` 這類 token 在作業系統深色模式下會翻轉（Global Constraints、facts/uikit.md C14）。測試用正規表示式檢查 `--tc-color-*` 只出現基礎色名稱。
  - 尺寸用 `--tc-space-*`、`--tc-radius-*`。
- **token class**：
  - `tokenClass("space", "padding-y", "48")` → `tcb-py-48`（`padding-block: var(--tc-space-48)`）；`tokenClass("space", "gap", "24")` → `tcb-gap-24`。
  - 測試從每個區塊的 JSON Schema 找出所有 `x-token` 欄位，逐一確認每個值都是 `vendor/uikit/packages/tokens/dist/tokens.css` 裡存在的 `--tc-<group>-<值>`（規格 §4.2：值是 `@tzuchi/tokens` 的名稱），而且 class 存在、設定的就是同名 token。
  - uikit 改了 token 名稱，或規格加了 tokens 沒有的值時，class 會指向不存在的變數而靜默失效。這時測試會失敗（實測：把 `--tc-space-64` 改名後失敗）。
- **多欄的斷點**：`@media (max-width: 767.98px)` 時改成一欄。tokens 的 `--tc-breakpoint-tablet` 是 `768px`（facts/uikit.md C7），但 media query 讀不到 CSS 變數，所以寫成 768 − 0.02。測試讀 `vendor/uikit/packages/tokens/dist/tokens.css` 確認兩者一致。
- **`<img>` 與 ESLint**：`eslint-config-next` 的 `@next/next/no-img-element` 會對 `<img>` 發出 warning（實測）。區塊畫面也在 Storybook 與編輯器使用，不能換成 `next/image`，所以 `image/view.tsx` 與 `image/editor.tsx` 的兩個 `<img>` 前加上 `eslint-disable-next-line`，並寫明理由（CLAUDE.md：不得新增 warning）。

**素材與示範圖**
- **`createStaticAssetSource`**：
  - `get` 用 `Object.create(null)` 的表查詢，所以 `get("constructor")`、`get("__proto__")` 都是 `undefined`（CLAUDE.md 的安全規則）。
  - `list()` 每次回傳新陣列，項目已 `Object.freeze`。
  - 建立時檢查每個素材，不合格時拋 `TypeError`（共用介面 C.3 的 `createStaticAssetSource`）。
- **6 張示範圖**：用幾何圖形與色塊手繪的 SVG（規格 §10.4），尺寸與 C.3 相同，色票取自 tokens 的基礎色。
  - 檔案沒有文字、字型、`href`、`<image>` 或 `url(`。
  - 唯一的 `http` 是 `xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"`。獨立的 SVG 檔必須宣告這個命名空間，否則 `<img>` 不會把它當成 SVG 顯示。它只是識別字，不會發出請求，測試明確只允許這一處。

**測試、turbo 與依賴**
- **伺服器渲染測試**：`render.spec.tsx` 在 node 環境用 `react-dom/server` 的 `renderToStaticMarkup` 渲染 `@tzuchi/tceditor/rsc` 的 `Render`。
  - RSC `Render` 是同步的函式元件，只用 `useMemo`（facts/core-puck-api.md §6.2）。jest 依 `require` 條件解析到 `dist/rsc.js`，它的 `@tiptap/static-renderer/json/react` 有 CJS 版本，不需要額外的 transform。
  - 資料先經過 `validatePage`，和發布後公開頁看到的資料相同；`Render` 不會補預設值（facts/core-puck-api.md §2.1）。
- **挑選器測試**：用 `/** @jest-environment jsdom */` 切換環境，`jest-environment-jsdom` 與 `@testing-library/react` 的版本與 core 相同。每個測試都等 `list()` resolve 之後才結束，避免 act 警告；實測沒有任何 console 輸出。
- **編輯器設定用的是挑選器**：render config 的替身欄位同樣是 `{ type: "custom", label }`，只比 `type` 與 `label` 分不出兩者。`editor-config.spec.ts` 的 `uses the image picker for the image field` 因此用 `renderToStaticMarkup` 實際渲染兩個 config 的圖片欄位：editor config 畫出挑選器（含「正在載入圖片…」與「替代文字」），render config 畫出空字串。實測：把 `createEditorConfig` 的 `fields` 換成 `base.components[spec.type].fields` 時這個測試失敗。
- **範例的 HTML 比對依規格產生**：`render.spec.tsx` 的 `expectedFragments` 不逐一列出區塊，而是用 `toJsonSchema` 與 `fieldKindOf` 走訪欄位。
  - 文字欄位的值、連結的 `href`、富文字的文字與連結、圖片的 `src` 與 `alt` 都要出現在 HTML。放置區遞迴到子區塊，清單與群組逐欄位走訪。選項、數字與布林只決定 class，不比對。
  - 新增區塊時，它的範例自動納入這個測試，不必改測試（實測：13 個範例共比對 42 個片段）。
- **新區塊的對應**：`render.spec.tsx` 在測試檔裡定義測試專用的 `Feature` 規格與畫面，欄位有文字、圖片、放置區，以及項目含放置區的清單。
  - 它和 8 個區塊一起交給 `buildRenderConfig`，用 RSC `Render` 比對完整的 HTML，並記錄畫面收到的 props key：只有規格的 4 個欄位，沒有 `id`、`puck`、`editMode`。
  - 另一個測試用 `// @ts-expect-error` 傳入缺少畫面的 `views`：`tsc` 確認型別會擋下，執行期確認拋 `TypeError`。`@ts-expect-error` 沒有用到時 `tsc` 會報錯，所以 `BlockViews` 變寬鬆時 `pnpm typecheck` 會失敗。
- **隱藏分類**：8 個區塊都不是 deprecated，直接檢查編輯器設定時，隱藏分類只會比對到空陣列。所以 `editor-config.spec.ts` 把 `Image` 換成 deprecated 的副本再交給 `editorCategories`，確認它只出現在 `deprecated` 分類（實測：拿掉 `!spec.deprecated` 條件時這個測試失敗）。編輯器設定本身的分類測試則依 `blockSpecs` 與 `CATEGORIES` 比對，不逐一列出區塊；各區塊屬於哪個分類由 Task 10 的 `specs.spec.ts` 鎖定。
- **class 名稱檢查**：`names only classes that blocks.css defines` 從 `.tsx` 原始碼收集逐字寫出的 `tcb-*` 名稱，逐一確認 `blocks.css` 有規則。用樣板字串組出的名稱（例如 `` `tcb-columns--${count}` ``）只會被抓到前綴，所以同一個測試也要求原始碼裡沒有 `tcb-…${` 這種寫法。`token-classes.ts` 不是 `.tsx`，不在掃描範圍內，它組出的 class 由 `styles.spec.ts` 逐值檢查。
- **ESLint（C.4 標題寫的「Task 11 補充」）**：Task 7 的 `PUBLIC_IMPORTS` 禁止 `../editor-config` 與 `./editor`，這兩個相對路徑只在 `src/<block>/view.tsx` 有意義。`src/render-config.tsx` 要 import 的會是 `./editor-config` 與 `./image/editor`，所以本 task 在 `PUBLIC_IMPORTS.paths` 加這兩項（共用介面 C.4）。`no-restricted-imports` 的 `paths` 只比對 import 字串本身，兩項對所有套用 `PUBLIC_IMPORTS` 的檔案都生效。`src/views.ts` 也被 `render-config.tsx` import，同樣不得帶進編輯器程式，所以本 task 也把它加進套用 `PUBLIC_IMPORTS` 的檔案清單。Step 11 用 `eslint --stdin` 探測規則，不必寫入暫存檔。
- **turbo**：
  - `@tzuchi/tceditor-blocks#test` 的 `inputs` 加入 `$TURBO_ROOT$/vendor/uikit/**` 與 `$TURBO_ROOT$/apps/showcase/public/demo-assets/**`（C.5），因為測試讀這兩處的檔案；不列時 turbo 會重播過期的快取結果（CLAUDE.md）。
  - 同一個項目要自己寫 `"dependsOn": ["^build"]`（`<套件>#<task>` 會整個取代通用設定，見共用介面 C.5）。
- **package.json**：
  - `exports` 加 `./render`、`./editor`、`./assets`、`./demo-assets`、`./styles.css`，`sideEffects` 已是 `["*.css"]`（gaps #34）。

建立 `packages/blocks/src/__tests__/styles.spec.ts`：

```ts
/** @jest-environment node */
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { eachField, toJsonSchema } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";
import { blockSpecs } from "../specs";
import { tokenClass } from "../token-classes";

const packageRoot = join(__dirname, "..", "..");
const repoRoot = join(packageRoot, "..", "..");
const blocksCss = readFileSync(join(packageRoot, "src", "blocks.css"), "utf8");
const tokensCss = readFileSync(
  join(repoRoot, "vendor/uikit/packages/tokens/dist/tokens.css"),
  "utf8"
);

/** tokenClass purpose of each x-token field. A new token field must be added here and to blocks.css. */
const TOKEN_PURPOSES = new Map<string, "padding-y" | "gap">([
  ["paddingY", "padding-y"],
  ["gap", "gap"],
]);

function tokenFields() {
  const found: {
    field: string;
    name: string;
    group: unknown;
    values: string[];
  }[] = [];
  for (const spec of blockSpecs) {
    eachField(toJsonSchema(spec), ({ name, node }) => {
      const token = node["x-token"] as { group?: unknown } | undefined;
      if (token === undefined) return;
      found.push({
        field: `${spec.type}.${name}`,
        name,
        group: token.group,
        values: (node.enum as string[] | undefined) ?? [],
      });
    });
  }
  return found;
}

describe("blocks.css", () => {
  it("maps token values to tcb- classes", () => {
    expect(tokenClass("space", "padding-y", "48")).toBe("tcb-py-48");
    expect(tokenClass("space", "gap", "24")).toBe("tcb-gap-24");
    expect(tokenClass("space", "gap", "24 tcb-page")).toBe("");
  });

  it("finds the token fields of the blocks", () => {
    expect(tokenFields().map((field) => field.field)).toEqual([
      "Section.paddingY",
      "Columns.gap",
    ]);
  });

  it.each(tokenFields())(
    "$field: every value has its class, set from the token",
    ({ name, group, values }) => {
      const purpose = TOKEN_PURPOSES.get(name);
      if (!purpose) throw new Error(`add ${name} to TOKEN_PURPOSES`);
      expect(group).toBe("space");
      expect(values.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      for (const value of values) {
        // A token() value is a @tzuchi/tokens name (spec §4.2)
        expect(tokensCss).toContain(`--tc-${group}-${value}:`);
        const className = tokenClass("space", purpose, value);
        const property = purpose === "gap" ? "gap" : "padding-block";
        expect(blocksCss).toContain(
          `.${className} {\n  ${property}: var(--tc-space-${value});\n}`
        );
      }
    }
  );

  it("stacks the columns below the tokens' tablet breakpoint", () => {
    const tablet = /--tc-breakpoint-tablet:\s*(\d+)px;/.exec(tokensCss);
    if (!tablet) throw new Error("--tc-breakpoint-tablet not found");
    expect(tablet[1]).toBe("768");
    const queries = blocksCss.match(/@media[^{]*\{/g);
    expect(queries).toEqual([
      `@media (max-width: ${Number(tablet[1]) - 0.02}px) {`,
    ]);
    expect(queries?.[0]).toBe("@media (max-width: 767.98px) {");
  });

  it("uses only primitive --tc-color-* tokens (semantic ones flip in OS dark mode)", () => {
    const used = [...blocksCss.matchAll(/--tc-color-([a-z0-9-]+)/g)].map(
      (match) => match[1]
    );
    expect(used.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    for (const name of used) {
      expect(name).toMatch(/^(white|(gray|blue|red|green|amber)-\d+)$/);
    }
  });

  it("loads nothing and sets no styles from outside the file", () => {
    expect(blocksCss).not.toMatch(/url\(|@import/);
  });
});

describe("styles.css", () => {
  it("loads tokens, HeroUI, the Tzu Chi theme, then the blocks' classes", () => {
    const entry = readFileSync(join(packageRoot, "styles.css"), "utf8");
    expect(
      [...entry.matchAll(/@import\s+"([^"]+)"/g)].map((match) => match[1])
    ).toEqual([
      "@tzuchi/tokens/tokens.css",
      "@heroui/styles",
      "@heroui/styles/themes/tzuchi/index.css",
      "./src/blocks.css",
    ]);
    expect(entry).toContain('@source "./src";');
  });
});
```

建立 `packages/blocks/src/__tests__/demo-assets.spec.ts`：

```ts
/** @jest-environment node */
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { createStaticAssetSource, type Asset } from "../asset-source";
import { DEMO_ASSETS, demoAssetSource } from "../demo-assets";

const publicDir = join(
  __dirname,
  "..",
  "..",
  "..",
  "..",
  "apps/showcase/public"
);
const SVG_NAMESPACE = 'xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"';

const assetCases = DEMO_ASSETS.map((asset) => [asset.id, asset] as const);

function readSvg(asset: Asset): string {
  return readFileSync(join(publicDir, asset.src), "utf8");
}

describe("demo assets", () => {
  it("lists the 6 pictures of spec §10.4", () => {
    expect(
      DEMO_ASSETS.map((asset) => [asset.id, asset.width, asset.height])
    ).toEqual([
      ["demo-1", 1600, 900],
      ["demo-2", 1200, 900],
      ["demo-3", 1200, 1200],
      ["demo-4", 900, 1200],
      ["demo-5", 1600, 1000],
      ["demo-6", 800, 1200],
    ]);
  });

  it.each(assetCases)(
    "%s: the file exists and its size matches",
    (id, asset) => {
      expect(asset.src).toBe(`/demo-assets/${id}.svg`);
      expect(existsSync(join(publicDir, asset.src))).toBe(true);
      const root = /^<svg\b[^>]*>/.exec(readSvg(asset))?.[0] ?? "";
      expect(root).toContain(`width="${asset.width}"`);
      expect(root).toContain(`height="${asset.height}"`);
      expect(root).toContain(`viewBox="0 0 ${asset.width} ${asset.height}"`);
    }
  );

  it.each(assetCases)(
    "%s: refers to nothing outside the file",
    (_id, asset) => {
      const svg = readSvg(asset);
      expect(svg.split(SVG_NAMESPACE)).toHaveLength(2);
      // The namespace is an identifier, not a request; nothing else may name a URL.
      expect(svg.replace(SVG_NAMESPACE, "")).not.toMatch(
        /http|\/\/|href|url\(|@import|<image|<script|<text|<foreignObject|font/i
      );
      expect(Buffer.byteLength(svg)).toBeLessThan(4096);
    }
  );
});

describe("createStaticAssetSource", () => {
  it("looks ids up without the prototype chain", () => {
    expect(demoAssetSource.get("demo-2")).toEqual(DEMO_ASSETS[1]);
    expect(demoAssetSource.get("demo-9")).toBeUndefined();
    expect(demoAssetSource.get("constructor")).toBeUndefined();
    expect(demoAssetSource.get("__proto__")).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("lists a copy of every asset, in order", async () => {
    const listed = await demoAssetSource.list();
    expect(listed).toEqual(DEMO_ASSETS);
    listed.pop();
    expect(await demoAssetSource.list()).toHaveLength(6);
  });

  it("rejects duplicate or malformed assets", () => {
    const asset: Asset = {
      id: "a",
      src: "/a.svg",
      width: 1,
      height: 1,
      label: "A",
    };
    expect(() => createStaticAssetSource([asset, asset])).toThrow(TypeError);
    expect(() => createStaticAssetSource([{ ...asset, id: "a b" }])).toThrow(
      TypeError
    );
    expect(() => createStaticAssetSource([{ ...asset, width: 0 }])).toThrow(
      TypeError
    );
    expect(() => createStaticAssetSource([{ ...asset, src: "" }])).toThrow(
      TypeError
    );
    expect(() => createStaticAssetSource([{ ...asset, label: "" }])).toThrow(
      TypeError
    );
  });
});
```
