建立 `packages/blocks/src/token-classes.ts`：

```ts
/**
 * Token values in block props become CSS classes, never inline styles, so the
 * public page can run under a strict CSP. Every class is defined in
 * blocks.css; a test checks every value of every x-token field.
 */
const PREFIX = { "padding-y": "py", gap: "gap" } as const;

/** Token values are token names such as "16" or "48" (--tc-space-48). */
const TOKEN_VALUE = /^[0-9]{1,3}$/;

/**
 * tokenClass("space", "padding-y", "48") → "tcb-py-48" (padding-block: var(--tc-space-48)).
 * A value that is not a token name gives "" rather than an arbitrary class.
 */
export function tokenClass(
  group: "space",
  purpose: "padding-y" | "gap",
  value: string
): string {
  if (group !== "space" || !TOKEN_VALUE.test(value)) return "";
  return `tcb-${PREFIX[purpose]}-${value}`;
}
```

建立 `packages/blocks/src/blocks.css`：

```css
/*
 * tceditor blocks: every tcb-* class the block views use, and the
 * editor-only tcb-picker-* classes of the image picker.
 *
 * - No inline styles: token values in block props map to classes here
 *   (token-classes.ts), so the public page can run under a strict CSP.
 * - Colours come only from HeroUI theme variables (var(--border), ...) or
 *   primitive tokens (var(--tc-color-gray-300), ...), never from the semantic
 *   --tc-color-* tokens: tokens.css flips those under an OS dark mode even
 *   inside data-theme="tzuchi".
 * - Imported unlayered after HeroUI, so these rules win over its layers.
 */

/* Page and vertical rhythm ------------------------------------------------ */

.tcb-page {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 1120px;
  margin-inline: auto;
  padding: var(--tc-space-32) var(--tc-space-16);
}

/* The page and every slot stack their blocks with one gap. In the editor the
   page's blocks sit in Puck's root drop zone, or (interactive preview, client
   Render) in an unclassed wrapper div. No block view's outer element is an
   unclassed div. */
.tcb-stack,
.tcb-page > [data-puck-dropzone],
.tcb-page > div:not([class]) {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--tc-space-24);
}

/* Token classes (token-classes.ts): space tokens 16/32/48/64 and 16/24/32 */

.tcb-py-16 {
  padding-block: var(--tc-space-16);
}

.tcb-py-32 {
  padding-block: var(--tc-space-32);
}

.tcb-py-48 {
  padding-block: var(--tc-space-48);
}

.tcb-py-64 {
  padding-block: var(--tc-space-64);
}

.tcb-gap-16 {
  gap: var(--tc-space-16);
}

.tcb-gap-24 {
  gap: var(--tc-space-24);
}

.tcb-gap-32 {
  gap: var(--tc-space-32);
}

/* Paragraph ---------------------------------------------------------------- */

.tcb-paragraph p + p {
  margin-block-start: var(--tc-space-16);
}

/* Card ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */

.tcb-card-link {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.tcb-card-link:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
}

.tcb-card-link:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--focus);
  outline-offset: 2px;
  border-radius: var(--tc-radius-sm);
}

/* Tag list ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

.tcb-tag-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--tc-space-8);
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

/* Section ------------------------------------------------------------------- */

.tcb-section {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: 100%;
}

.tcb-section--inset {
  padding-inline: var(--tc-space-24);
  border-radius: var(--tc-radius-lg);
}

/* Columns ------------------------------------------------------------------- */

.tcb-columns {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
}

.tcb-columns--2 {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
}

.tcb-columns--3 {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
}

.tcb-columns-column {
  min-width: 0;
}

/* Below the tablet breakpoint (--tc-breakpoint-tablet: 768px) the columns
   stack. Media queries cannot read custom properties; a test keeps this
   value in step with tokens.css. */
@media (max-width: 767.98px) {
  .tcb-columns--2,
  .tcb-columns--3 {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
}

/* Image --------------------------------------------------------------------- */

.tcb-image {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--tc-space-8);
  margin: 0;
}

.tcb-image-img {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  border-radius: var(--tc-radius-md);
}

.tcb-image-img--cover {
  object-fit: cover;
}

.tcb-image-placeholder {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
  padding: var(--tc-space-16);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--tc-radius-md);
  background-color: var(--default);
  color: var(--default-foreground);
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  text-align: center;
}

/* Not chosen yet: a dashed box. Chosen but gone: a warning-coloured one. */
.tcb-image-placeholder--empty {
  border-style: dashed;
}

.tcb-image-placeholder--missing {
  border-color: var(--warning);
}

/* After the placeholder: a ratio class overrides its default 16 / 9. */
.tcb-ratio-16-9 {
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
}

.tcb-ratio-4-3 {
  aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
}

.tcb-ratio-1-1 {
  aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
}

/* Image picker (editor side panel only) -------------------------------------- */

.tcb-picker {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  color: var(--tc-color-gray-900);
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.tcb-picker-legend {
  margin-block-end: var(--tc-space-8);
  padding: 0;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.tcb-picker-body {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--tc-space-8);
}

.tcb-picker-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: var(--tc-space-8);
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.tcb-picker-option {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--tc-space-4);
  width: 100%;
  padding: var(--tc-space-4);
  border: 1px solid var(--tc-color-gray-300);
  border-radius: var(--tc-radius-md);
  background-color: var(--tc-color-white);
  color: inherit;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 12px;
  text-align: start;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.tcb-picker-option:hover {
  border-color: var(--tc-color-blue-500);
}

.tcb-picker-option:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--tc-color-blue-500);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.tcb-picker-option[aria-pressed="true"] {
  border-color: var(--tc-color-blue-900);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--tc-color-blue-900);
}

.tcb-picker-option:disabled {
  cursor: default;
  opacity: 0.6;
}

.tcb-picker-thumb {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
  object-fit: cover;
  border-radius: var(--tc-radius-sm);
  background-color: var(--tc-color-gray-100);
}

.tcb-picker-name {
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.tcb-picker-status,
.tcb-picker-hint {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--tc-color-gray-750);
}

.tcb-picker-hint {
  font-size: 12px;
}

.tcb-picker-alert {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--tc-color-amber-700);
}

.tcb-picker-label {
  display: block;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.tcb-picker-input {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: 100%;
  padding: var(--tc-space-8) var(--tc-space-12);
  border: 1px solid var(--tc-color-gray-300);
  border-radius: var(--tc-radius-sm);
  background-color: var(--tc-color-white);
  color: inherit;
  font: inherit;
}

.tcb-picker-input:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--tc-color-blue-500);
  outline-offset: 1px;
}

.tcb-picker-input:disabled {
  background-color: var(--tc-color-gray-100);
  color: var(--tc-color-gray-750);
}

.tcb-picker-check {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--tc-space-8);
  cursor: pointer;
}
```

建立 `packages/blocks/src/asset-source.ts`：

```ts
import { ASSET_ID_PATTERN } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";

/** One picture the image field can point to (spec §7.3). */
export type Asset = {
  id: string;
  src: string;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  label: string;
};

/**
 * Where pictures come from. S2 uses a fixed list; S3 replaces it with the
 * media library. `get` is synchronous because the public page looks pictures
 * up while rendering.
 */
export type AssetSource = {
  list(): Promise<Asset[]>;
  get(id: string): Asset | undefined;
};

function assertAsset(asset: Asset): void {
  if (!ASSET_ID_PATTERN.test(asset.id)) {
    throw new TypeError(
      `asset id "${asset.id}" must match ${ASSET_ID_PATTERN}`
    );
  }
  for (const key of ["width", "height"] as const) {
    if (!Number.isInteger(asset[key]) || asset[key] <= 0) {
      throw new TypeError(
        `asset "${asset.id}": ${key} must be a positive integer`
      );
    }
  }
  if (asset.src === "" || asset.label === "") {
    throw new TypeError(`asset "${asset.id}": src and label must not be empty`);
  }
}

/** An AssetSource over a fixed list. Looks ids up in a null-prototype table. */
export function createStaticAssetSource(assets: readonly Asset[]): AssetSource {
  const byId: Record<string, Asset> = Object.create(null);
  const ordered: Asset[] = [];
  for (const asset of assets) {
    assertAsset(asset);
    if (asset.id in byId) {
      throw new TypeError(`duplicate asset id "${asset.id}"`);
    }
    const copy = Object.freeze({ ...asset });
    byId[copy.id] = copy;
    ordered.push(copy);
  }
  return {
    list: () => Promise.resolve(ordered.slice()),
    get: (id) => (typeof id === "string" && id in byId ? byId[id] : undefined),
  };
}
```

建立 `packages/blocks/src/__tests__/render.spec.tsx`（Review Focus #4、#5 的測試在這個檔）：

```tsx
/** @jest-environment node */
import { readdirSync, readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { Render as ClientRender, type Data } from "@tzuchi/tceditor";
import { Render } from "@tzuchi/tceditor/rsc";
import {
  defineBlockSpec,
  exampleToPageData,
  fieldKindOf,
  image,
  isJsonSchemaNode,
  slot,
  toJsonSchema,
} from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";
import type { BlockNode, JsonSchema, PageData } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from "react-dom/server";
import * as z from "zod";
import { demoAssetSource } from "../demo-assets";
import { createEditorConfig } from "../editor-config";
import type { ResolvedImage } from "../image/view";
import { buildRenderConfig, createRenderConfig } from "../render-config";
import { blockSpecs } from "../specs";
import { validatePage } from "../validator";
import { views } from "../views";

const renderConfig = createRenderConfig({ assets: demoAssetSource });

/** Server-renders a page the way the public page does (RSC Render). */
function html(data: PageData, config = renderConfig): string {
  const page: Data = { root: data.root, content: data.content, zones: {} };
  return renderToStaticMarkup(<Render config={config} data={page} />);
}

/** Runs the page through the validator, as publishing does, and returns the stored data. */
function validated(data: unknown): PageData {
  const result = validatePage(data);
  if (!result.ok) throw new Error(JSON.stringify(result.errors, null, 2));
  return result.data;
}

function onePage(...content: BlockNode[]): unknown {
  return { root: { props: {} }, content };
}

/** React's escaping of text and attribute values. */
function escapeHtml(text: string): string {
  return text
    .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
    .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
    .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
    .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
    .replace(/'/g, "&#x27;");
}

const str = (value: unknown): string =>
  typeof value === "string" ? value : "";
const list = (value: unknown): unknown[] => (Array.isArray(value) ? value : []);
const children = (value: unknown): BlockNode[] => list(value) as BlockNode[];

/** Every text node and every link href in a richtext document. */
function richTextParts(node: unknown): { texts: string[]; hrefs: string[] } {
  const texts: string[] = [];
  const hrefs: string[] = [];
  const visit = (value: unknown) => {
    if (typeof value !== "object" || value === null) return;
    const record = value as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (typeof record.text === "string") texts.push(record.text);
    for (const mark of list(record.marks)) {
      const attrs = (mark as { attrs?: { href?: unknown } }).attrs;
      if (typeof attrs?.href === "string") hrefs.push(attrs.href);
    }
    list(record.content).forEach(visit);
  };
  visit(node);
  return { texts, hrefs };
}

const text = (value: unknown) =>
  str(value) === "" ? [] : [escapeHtml(str(value))];
const href = (value: unknown) =>
  str(value) === "" ? [] : [`href="${escapeHtml(str(value))}"`];
const field = (record: unknown, name: string): unknown =>
  typeof record === "object" && record !== null
    ? (record as Record<string, unknown>)[name]
    : undefined;

/**
 * The pieces of HTML a field's stored value must produce, read from the
 * field's kind in the spec: texts and links show up, slots bring their
 * children's pieces, lists and groups their fields'. Choices, numbers and
 * booleans only pick classes, so they add nothing.
 */
function fragmentsOf(node: JsonSchema, value: unknown): string[] {
  switch (fieldKindOf(node)) {
    case "text":
    case "textarea":
      return text(value);
    case "link":
      return href(value);
    case "richtext": {
      const { texts, hrefs } = richTextParts(value);
      return [...texts.flatMap(text), ...hrefs.flatMap(href)];
    }
    case "slot":
      return children(value).flatMap(expectedFragments);
    case "image": {
      const assetId = str(field(value, "assetId"));
      const asset = demoAssetSource.get(assetId);
      if (!asset) throw new Error(`example uses unknown asset ${assetId}`);
      const decorative = field(value, "decorative") === true;
      const alt = decorative ? "" : escapeHtml(str(field(value, "alt")));
      return [`src="${asset.src}"`, `alt="${alt}"`];
    }
    case "array": {
      const items = node.items;
      return isJsonSchemaNode(items)
        ? list(value).flatMap((item) => fragmentsOf(items, item))
        : [];
    }
    case "object": {
      const properties = isJsonSchemaNode(node.properties)
        ? node.properties
        : {};
      return Object.keys(properties).flatMap((name) => {
        const child = properties[name];
        return isJsonSchemaNode(child)
          ? fragmentsOf(child, field(value, name))
          : [];
      });
    }
    default:
      return [];
  }
}

/** The pieces of HTML a block's stored props must produce, children included. */
function expectedFragments(node: BlockNode): string[] {
  const spec = blockSpecs.find((candidate) => candidate.type === node.type);
  if (!spec) throw new Error(`${node.type} is not in blockSpecs`);
  return fragmentsOf(toJsonSchema(spec), node.props);
}

const exampleCases = blockSpecs.flatMap((spec) =>
  spec.examples.map((example, index) => ({
    title: `${spec.type}：${example.name}`,
    spec,
    index,
  }))
);

describe("block views through RSC Render", () => {
  it.each(exampleCases)(
    "$title renders its texts and links without inline styles",
    ({ spec, index }) => {
      const data = validated(exampleToPageData(spec, index));
      const markup = html(data);
      for (const fragment of data.content.flatMap(expectedFragments)) {
        expect(markup).toContain(fragment);
      }
      expect(markup).not.toMatch(/\sstyle=/);
    }
  );

  it.each(["h1", "h2", "h3", "h4"] as const)(
    "renders Heading level %s as that tag",
    (level) => {
      const markup = html(
        validated(
          onePage({
            type: "Heading",
            props: {
              id: "Heading-1",
              text: "淨灘活動",
              level,
              align: "center",
            },
          })
        )
      );
      expect(markup).toBe(
        `<main class="tcb-page tcb-stack"><${level} class="typography typography--align-center typography--color-default typography--${level}">淨灘活動</${level}></main>`
      );
    }
  );

  it("renders Button as a link with uikit's button classes", () => {
    const markup = html(
      validated(
        onePage(
          {
            type: "Button",
            props: { id: "Button-1", label: "立即報名", href: "/register" },
          },
          {
            type: "Button",
            props: {
              id: "Button-2",
              label: "了解更多",
              href: "https://www.tzuchi.org.tw/",
              variant: "outline",
              size: "lg",
              fullWidth: true,
            },
          }
        )
      )
    );
    expect(markup).toContain(
      '<a href="/register" class="button button--md button--primary">立即報名</a>'
    );
    expect(markup).toContain(
      '<a href="https://www.tzuchi.org.tw/" class="button button--full-width button--lg button--outline">了解更多</a>'
    );
    expect(markup).not.toContain("<button");
  });

  it("renders Section and Columns with token classes, not inline styles", () => {
    const markup = html(
      validated(
        onePage({
          type: "Section",
          props: {
            id: "Section-1",
            background: "default",
            paddingY: "64",
            content: [
              {
                type: "Columns",
                props: { id: "Columns-1", gap: "32" },
              },
            ],
          },
        })
      )
    );
    expect(markup).toBe(
      '<main class="tcb-page tcb-stack"><section class="surface surface--default tcb-py-64 tcb-section tcb-section--inset"><div class="tcb-stack"><div class="tcb-columns tcb-columns--2 tcb-gap-32"><div class="tcb-columns-column"><div class="tcb-stack"></div></div><div class="tcb-columns-column"><div class="tcb-stack"></div></div></div></div></section></main>'
    );
  });

  it("renders columns whose content was emptied", () => {
    const data = validated(
      onePage({
        type: "Columns",
        props: {
          id: "Columns-1",
          columns: [
            {
              content: [
                { type: "Heading", props: { id: "Heading-1", text: "左欄" } },
              ],
            },
            { content: [] },
            {},
          ],
        },
      })
    );
    const columns = data.content[0].props.columns as { content: unknown[] }[];
    expect(columns.map((column) => column.content)).toEqual([
      [expect.objectContaining({ type: "Heading" })],
      [],
      [],
    ]);
    const markup = html(data);
    expect(markup).toContain(
      '<div class="tcb-columns tcb-columns--3 tcb-gap-24">'
    );
    expect(markup.match(/class="tcb-columns-column"/g)).toHaveLength(3);
    expect(markup).toContain("左欄");
    expect(
      markup.match(
        /<div class="tcb-columns-column"><div class="tcb-stack"><\/div><\/div>/g
      )
    ).toHaveLength(2);
  });

  it("renders a column that reaches Render without content", () => {
    const raw: PageData = {
      root: { props: {} },
      content: [
        {
          type: "Columns",
          props: { id: "Columns-1", columns: [{}, { content: [] }], gap: "16" },
        },
      ],
    };
    expect(html(raw)).toBe(
      '<main class="tcb-page tcb-stack"><div class="tcb-columns tcb-columns--2 tcb-gap-16"><div class="tcb-columns-column"></div><div class="tcb-columns-column"><div class="tcb-stack"></div></div></div></main>'
    );
  });

  it("shows placeholders for a missing or unselected image", () => {
    // Unselected: the editor's default value. The validator rejects it, but
    // the editor canvas and Storybook render it.
    const unselected: PageData = {
      root: { props: {} },
      content: [
        {
          type: "Image",
          props: {
            id: "Image-1",
            image: { assetId: "", alt: "", decorative: false },
            ratio: "auto",

          },
        },

    };
    expect(html(unselected)).toBe(
      '<main class="tcb-page tcb-stack"><figure class="tcb-image"><div role="img" aria-label="尚未選擇圖片" class="tcb-image-placeholder tcb-image-placeholder--empty">尚未選擇圖片</div></figure></main>'
    );

    // Missing: the asset was removed after the page was published.
    const missing = html(
      validated(
        onePage({
          type: "Image",
          props: {
            id: "Image-2",
            image: {
              assetId: "removed-1",
              alt: "已刪除的圖",
              decorative: false,
            },
            ratio: "4:3",
            caption: "活動照片",
          },
        })
      )
    );
    expect(missing).toBe(
      '<main class="tcb-page tcb-stack"><figure class="tcb-image"><div role="img" aria-label="圖片已不存在" class="tcb-image-placeholder tcb-image-placeholder--missing tcb-ratio-4-3">圖片已不存在</div><figcaption class="typography typography--align-start typography--color-default typography--body-sm">活動照片</figcaption></figure></main>'
    );
  });

  it('renders a picture with its size and lazy loading, and alt="" when decorative', () => {
    const markup = html(
      validated(
        onePage(
          {
            type: "Image",
            props: {
              id: "Image-1",
              image: {
                assetId: "demo-2",
                alt: "海面與夕陽",
                decorative: false,
              },
            },
          },
          {
            type: "Image",
            props: {
              id: "Image-2",
              image: {
                assetId: "demo-3",
                alt: "不該出現的文字",
                decorative: true,
              },
              ratio: "1:1",
            },
          }
        )
      )
    );
    expect(markup).toContain(
      '<img class="tcb-image-img" src="/demo-assets/demo-2.svg" width="1200" height="900" alt="海面與夕陽" loading="lazy"/>'
    );
    expect(markup).toContain(
      '<img class="tcb-image-img tcb-ratio-1-1 tcb-image-img--cover" src="/demo-assets/demo-3.svg" width="1200" height="1200" alt="" loading="lazy"/>'
    );
    expect(markup).not.toContain("不該出現的文字");
  });

  it("stacks the page's blocks in the client Render too (interactive preview)", () => {
    const data = validated(
      onePage(
        {
          type: "Heading",
          props: { id: "Heading-1", text: "淨灘活動", level: "h2" },
        },
        {
          type: "Button",
          props: { id: "Button-1", label: "立即報名", href: "/register" },
        }
      )
    );
    const page: Data = { root: data.root, content: data.content, zones: {} };
    const markup = renderToStaticMarkup(
      <ClientRender config={renderConfig} data={page} />
    );
    // The client Render wraps the page's blocks in an unclassed <div>
    expect(markup).toMatch(/^<main class="tcb-page tcb-stack"><div><h2 /);
    const css = readFileSync(join(__dirname, "..", "blocks.css"), "utf8");
    expect(css).toContain(
      ".tcb-stack,\n.tcb-page > [data-puck-dropzone],\n.tcb-page > div:not([class]) {\n  display: flex;\n  flex-direction: column;"
    );
  });

  it("renders the same HTML with the editor config (spec §7.3)", () => {
    const editorConfig = createEditorConfig({ assets: demoAssetSource });
    for (const { spec, index } of exampleCases) {
      const data = validated(exampleToPageData(spec, index));
      expect(html(data, editorConfig)).toBe(html(data));
    }
  });
});

describe("buildRenderConfig", () => {
  /** A block that exists only in this test: a new spec, a new view, nothing else. */
  const featureSpec = defineBlockSpec({
    type: "Feature",
    label: "特色",
    category: "內容",
    description: "只在測試中使用：證明新區塊只要規格與畫面。",
    version: 1,
    props: z.strictObject({
      heading: z.string().max(80).default("特色").meta({ title: "標題" }),
      picture: image().meta({ title: "圖片" }),
      body: slot({ allow: ["Heading"] }).meta({ title: "內容" }),
      notes: z
        .array(
          z.strictObject({
            content: slot({ allow: ["Heading"] }).meta({ title: "內容" }),
          })
        )
        .default(() => [])
        .meta({ title: "附註" }),
    }),
    examples: [{ name: "預設", props: {} }],
  });

  const received: string[][] = [];

  function FeatureView(props: {
    heading: ReactNode;
    picture: ResolvedImage;
    body: ReactNode;
    notes: { content: ReactNode }[];
  }) {
    received.push(Object.keys(props).sort());
    const { heading, picture, body, notes } = props;
    return (
      <section>
        <h2>{heading}</h2>
        <p>
          {picture.status === "ok"
            ? `${picture.src} ${picture.width}x${picture.height} ${picture.alt}`
            : picture.status}
        </p>
        {body}
        {notes.map((note, index) => (
          <aside key={index}>{note.content}</aside>
        ))}
      </section>
    );
  }

  beforeEach(() => {
    received.length = 0;
  });

  it("maps a new block from its spec, with no other code", () => {
    const config = buildRenderConfig({
      blocks: [...blockSpecs, featureSpec],
      views: { ...views, Feature: FeatureView },
      assets: demoAssetSource,
    });
    const heading = (id: string, text: string) => ({
      type: "Heading",
      props: { id, text, level: "h3", align: "start" },
    });
    const markup = html(
      {
        root: { props: {} },
        content: [
          {
            type: "Feature",
            props: {
              id: "Feature-1",
              heading: "淨灘 & 植樹",
              picture: { assetId: "demo-3", alt: "同心圓", decorative: false },
              body: [heading("Heading-1", "活動內容")],
              notes: [{ content: [heading("Heading-2", "附註一")] }, {}],
            },
          },
        ],
      },
      config
    );
    const h3 = (text: string) =>
      `<h3 class="typography typography--align-start typography--color-default typography--h3">${text}</h3>`;
    expect(markup).toBe(
      `<main class="tcb-page tcb-stack"><section><h2>淨灘 &amp; 植樹</h2><p>/demo-assets/demo-3.svg 1200x1200 同心圓</p><div class="tcb-stack">${h3(
        "活動內容"
      )}</div><aside><div class="tcb-stack">${h3(
        "附註一"
      )}</div></aside><aside></aside></section></main>`
    );
    // Exactly the spec's fields: no id, no puck, no editMode
    expect(received).toEqual([["body", "heading", "notes", "picture"]]);
    expect(config.components.Feature.label).toBe("特色");
  });

  it("needs a view for every block", () => {
    expect(() =>
      buildRenderConfig({
        blocks: [featureSpec],
        // @ts-expect-error -- Feature has no view, which TypeScript rejects too
        views: {},
        assets: demoAssetSource,
      })
    ).toThrow(new TypeError('buildRenderConfig: block "Feature" has no view'));
  });
});

describe("tcb- classes", () => {
  it("names only classes that blocks.css defines", () => {
    const src = join(__dirname, "..");
    const css = readFileSync(join(src, "blocks.css"), "utf8");
    const files = readdirSync(src, { recursive: true })
      .map(String)
      .filter(
        (file) =>
          file.endsWith(".tsx") &&
          !file.includes("__tests__") &&
          !file.endsWith(".stories.tsx")
      );
    const names = new Set<string>();
    const built: string[] = [];
    for (const file of files) {
      const source = readFileSync(join(src, file), "utf8");
      for (const match of source.matchAll(/\btcb-[a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9]\b/g)) {
        names.add(match[0]);
      }
      // A class name built in a template literal would escape this check
      if (/tcb-[a-z0-9-]*\$\{/.test(source)) built.push(file);
    }
    expect(built).toEqual([]);
    expect(names.size).toBeGreaterThan(20);
    const undefinedNames = [...names].filter(
      (name) => !new RegExp(`\\.${name}(?![\\w-])`).test(css)
    );
    expect(undefinedNames).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

建立 `packages/blocks/src/__tests__/editor-config.spec.ts`：

```ts
/** @jest-environment node */
import type { Config, CustomField } from "@tzuchi/tceditor";
import { toDefaultProps } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";
import type { ImageValue } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";
import { createElement } from "react";
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from "react-dom/server";
import { demoAssetSource } from "../demo-assets";
import { createEditorConfig, editorCategories } from "../editor-config";
import { createRenderConfig } from "../render-config";
import { CATEGORIES, blockSpecs, pageRootSpec } from "../specs";

const editorConfig = createEditorConfig({ assets: demoAssetSource });
const renderConfig = createRenderConfig({ assets: demoAssetSource });
const blockCases = blockSpecs.map((spec) => [spec.type, spec] as const);

/** Server-renders a config's image field widget with an empty value. */
function imageWidget(config: Config): string {
  const field = config.components.Image.fields?.image as
    | CustomField<ImageValue>
    | undefined;
  if (field?.type !== "custom") throw new Error("expected a custom field");
  return renderToStaticMarkup(
    createElement(field.render, {
      field,
      name: "image",
      id: "image",
      value: { assetId: "", alt: "", decorative: false },
      onChange: () => {},
    })
  );
}

describe("createRenderConfig and createEditorConfig", () => {
  it("register every block of blockSpecs, in order", () => {
    const types = blockSpecs.map((spec) => spec.type);
    expect(Object.keys(renderConfig.components)).toEqual(types);
    expect(Object.keys(editorConfig.components)).toEqual(types);
  });

  it.each(blockCases)(
    "%s: fields cover exactly the spec's props, with its label and defaults",
    (type, spec) => {
      const component = editorConfig.components[type];
      expect(component.label).toBe(spec.label);
      expect(Object.keys(component.fields ?? {}).sort()).toEqual(
        Object.keys(spec.props.shape).sort()
      );
      expect(component.defaultProps).toEqual(toDefaultProps(spec));
      expect(renderConfig.components[type].label).toBe(spec.label);
    }
  );

  it("uses the image picker for the image field", () => {
    expect(editorConfig.components.Image.fields?.image?.label).toBe("圖片");
    const picker = imageWidget(editorConfig);
    expect(picker).toContain("正在載入圖片…");
    expect(picker).toContain("替代文字");
    // The render config's image field draws nothing
    expect(imageWidget(renderConfig)).toBe("");
  });

  it("puts every block in the category its spec names", () => {
    const categories = editorConfig.categories ?? {};
    const keys = Object.keys(categories);
    expect(keys).toEqual([
      ...CATEGORIES.map((category) => category.key),
      "deprecated",
    ]);
    expect(categories).toEqual(editorCategories(blockSpecs));
    for (const category of CATEGORIES) {
      expect(categories[category.key].title).toBe(category.title);
    }
    expect(categories.deprecated).toMatchObject({
      title: "已停用",
      visible: false,
    });
    for (const spec of blockSpecs) {
      const holders = keys.filter((key) =>
        (categories[key].components ?? []).includes(spec.type)
      );
      const expected = spec.deprecated
        ? "deprecated"
        : CATEGORIES.find((category) => category.title === spec.category)?.key;
      expect([spec.type, holders]).toEqual([spec.type, [expected]]);
    }
  });

  it("moves a deprecated block to the hidden category and nowhere else", () => {
    const categories = editorCategories(
      blockSpecs.map((spec) =>
        spec.type === "Image" ? { ...spec, deprecated: true } : spec
      )
    );
    expect(categories.deprecated).toEqual({
      title: "已停用",
      visible: false,
      components: ["Image"],
    });
    const shown = CATEGORIES.flatMap(
      (category) => categories[category.key].components ?? []
    );
    expect(shown).not.toContain("Image");
    expect([...shown].sort()).toEqual(
      blockSpecs
        .map((spec) => spec.type)
        .filter((type) => type !== "Image")
        .sort()
    );
  });

  it("gives the page root its fields and defaults", () => {
    expect(Object.keys(editorConfig.root?.fields ?? {})).toEqual(
      Object.keys(pageRootSpec.props.shape)
    );
    expect(editorConfig.root?.defaultProps).toEqual(
      toDefaultProps(pageRootSpec)
    );
    expect(typeof editorConfig.root?.render).toBe("function");
    expect(renderConfig.root?.fields).toBeUndefined();
  });
});
```

建立 `packages/blocks/src/image/__tests__/editor.spec.tsx`：

```tsx
/** @jest-environment jsdom */
import { fireEvent, render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import type { ImageValue } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";
import { createStaticAssetSource, type AssetSource } from "../../asset-source";
import { createImagePickerField } from "../editor";

const assets = createStaticAssetSource([
  { id: "beach", src: "/beach.svg", width: 1600, height: 900, label: "海灘" },
  { id: "team", src: "/team.svg", width: 1200, height: 1200, label: "志工" },
]);

function renderPicker(
  value: ImageValue,
  options: { readOnly?: boolean; source?: AssetSource } = {}
) {
  const field = createImagePickerField(options.source ?? assets)({
    name: "image",
    label: "圖片",
  });
  if (field.type !== "custom") throw new Error("expected a custom field");
  const onChange = jest.fn();
  const Field = field.render;
  render(
    <Field
      field={field}
      name="image"
      id="image"
      value={value}
      onChange={onChange}
      readOnly={options.readOnly}
    />
  );
  return { field, onChange };
}

/** Waits until list() has resolved, so no state update lands after the test. */
async function listed() {
  return screen.findByRole("list", { name: "可選的圖片" });
}

describe("createImagePickerField", () => {
  it("returns a custom field labelled with the spec title", () => {
    const { field } = renderPicker({ assetId: "", alt: "", decorative: false });
    expect(field.type).toBe("custom");
    expect(field.label).toBe("圖片");
    expect(screen.getByRole("group", { name: "圖片" })).toBeTruthy();
    return listed();
  });

  it("shows a loading state, then the assets as toggle buttons", async () => {
    renderPicker({ assetId: "team", alt: "志工合照", decorative: false });
    expect(screen.getByRole("status").textContent).toBe("正在載入圖片…");
    await listed();
    expect(screen.queryByRole("status")).toBeNull();
    const beach = screen.getByRole("button", { name: "海灘" });
    const team = screen.getByRole("button", { name: "志工" });
    expect(beach.getAttribute("aria-pressed")).toBe("false");
    expect(team.getAttribute("aria-pressed")).toBe("true");
  });

  it("emits the whole value when a picture is selected", async () => {
    const { onChange } = renderPicker({
      assetId: "",
      alt: "海邊",
      decorative: false,
    });
    await listed();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "志工" }));
    expect(onChange).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(onChange).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      assetId: "team",
      alt: "海邊",
      decorative: false,
    });
  });

  it("edits the alt text, up to 200 characters", async () => {
    const { onChange } = renderPicker({
      assetId: "beach",
      alt: "",
      decorative: false,
    });
    await listed();
    const input = screen.getByLabelText("替代文字") as HTMLInputElement;
    expect(input.maxLength).toBe(200);
    fireEvent.change(input, { target: { value: "志工在海灘撿垃圾" } });
    expect(onChange).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith({
      assetId: "beach",
      alt: "志工在海灘撿垃圾",
      decorative: false,
    });
  });

  it("marks the picture decorative", async () => {
    const { onChange } = renderPicker({
      assetId: "beach",
      alt: "海灘",
      decorative: false,
    });
    await listed();
    const checkbox = screen.getByRole("checkbox", {
      name: "純裝飾（不需要替代文字）",
    }) as HTMLInputElement;
    expect(checkbox.checked).toBe(false);
    fireEvent.click(checkbox);
    expect(onChange).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith({
      assetId: "beach",
      alt: "海灘",
      decorative: true,
    });
  });

  it("disables the alt text while decorative, and unchecks it", async () => {
    const { onChange } = renderPicker({
      assetId: "beach",
      alt: "海灘",
      decorative: true,
    });
    await listed();
    const checkbox = screen.getByRole("checkbox", {
      name: "純裝飾（不需要替代文字）",
    }) as HTMLInputElement;
    expect(checkbox.checked).toBe(true);
    expect(
      (screen.getByLabelText("替代文字") as HTMLInputElement).disabled
    ).toBe(true);
    fireEvent.click(checkbox);
    expect(onChange).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith({
      assetId: "beach",
      alt: "海灘",
      decorative: false,
    });
  });

  it("changes nothing when read-only", async () => {
    const { onChange } = renderPicker(
      { assetId: "beach", alt: "海灘", decorative: false },
      { readOnly: true }
    );
    await listed();
    const group = screen.getByRole("group", {
      name: "圖片",
    }) as HTMLFieldSetElement;
    expect(group.disabled).toBe(true);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "志工" }));
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText("替代文字"), {
      target: { value: "改不了" },
    });
    expect(onChange).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("says so when the selected picture no longer exists", async () => {
    renderPicker({ assetId: "removed", alt: "舊圖", decorative: false });
    await listed();
    expect(screen.getByRole("alert").textContent).toBe(
      "目前選的圖片已不存在，請重新選擇。"
    );
  });

  it("says so when the list cannot be loaded", async () => {
    const failing: AssetSource = {
      list: () => Promise.reject(new Error("offline")),
      get: () => undefined,
    };
    renderPicker(
      { assetId: "", alt: "", decorative: false },
      { source: failing }
    );
    expect((await screen.findByRole("alert")).textContent).toBe(
      "無法載入圖片清單，請重新整理頁面。"
    );
  });
});
```

```tsx
/**
 * A link styled as a button (spec §7.1): uikit's Button is a <button> for
 * actions, which cannot navigate. An empty href (a new block in the editor)
 * renders an <a> without href rather than a link to the current page.
 */
export function ButtonView({
  label,
  href,
  variant,
  size,
  fullWidth,
}: {
  label: ReactNode;
  href: string;
  variant: ButtonProps["variant"];
  size: ButtonProps["size"];
  fullWidth: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <a
      href={href === "" ? undefined : href}
      className={buttonVariants({ variant, size, fullWidth })}
    >
      {label}
    </a>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { cardVariants } from "@heroui/styles";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import type { CardProps } from "./spec";

/** The title becomes a link when `href` is set; the summary shows only when it is not empty. */
export function CardView({
  title,
  summary,
  href,
  variant,
  content,
}: {
  title: ReactNode;
  summary: string;
  href: string;
  variant: CardProps["variant"];
  content: ReactNode;
}) {
  const card = cardVariants({ variant });
  return (
    <article className={card.base()}>
      <header className={card.header()}>
        <h3 className={card.title()}>
          {href === "" ? (
            title
          ) : (
            <a href={href} className="tcb-card-link">
              {title}
            </a>
          )}
        </h3>
        {summary === "" ? null : (
          <p className={card.description()}>{summary}</p>
        )}
      </header>
      <div className={card.content()}>{content}</div>
    </article>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { tokenClass } from "../token-classes";
import type { SectionProps } from "./spec";

/** A section with a background gets side padding; a transparent one lines up with the page. */
export function SectionView({
  background,
  paddingY,
  content,
}: {
  background: SectionProps["background"];
  paddingY: SectionProps["paddingY"];
  content: ReactNode;
}) {
  const classes = [
    surfaceVariants({ variant: background }),
    tokenClass("space", "padding-y", paddingY),
    "tcb-section",
    background === "transparent" ? "" : "tcb-section--inset",
  ];
  return (
    <section className={classes.filter(Boolean).join(" ")}>{content}</section>
  );
}
```

建立 `packages/blocks/src/image/view.tsx`：

```tsx
import { typographyVariants } from "@heroui/styles";
import type { ImageProps } from "./spec";

/** The image prop after `assets.get` (render-config.tsx resolves it on the server). */
export type ResolvedImage =
  | { status: "empty" }
  | { status: "missing"; assetId: string }
  | {
      status: "ok";
      src: string;
      width: number;
      height: number;
      alt: string;
      decorative: boolean;
    };

const PLACEHOLDER_TEXT = {
  empty: "尚未選擇圖片",
  missing: "圖片已不存在",
} as const;

/** Written out in full so the class test can find them in blocks.css. */
const PLACEHOLDER_CLASS = {
  empty: "tcb-image-placeholder--empty",
  missing: "tcb-image-placeholder--missing",
} as const;

/** "auto" keeps the picture's own ratio; the others crop it to fill (object-fit: cover). */
function ratioClass(ratio: ImageProps["ratio"]): string {
  switch (ratio) {
    case "16:9":
      return "tcb-ratio-16-9";
    case "4:3":
      return "tcb-ratio-4-3";
    case "1:1":
      return "tcb-ratio-1-1";
    default:
      return "";
  }
}

function Picture({ image, ratio }: { image: ResolvedImage; ratio: string }) {
  if (image.status === "ok") {
    const classes = [
      "tcb-image-img",
      ratio,
      ratio ? "tcb-image-img--cover" : "",
    ];
    return (
      // A plain <img>: the views render the same in Next, Storybook and the editor.
      // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
      <img
        className={classes.filter(Boolean).join(" ")}
        src={image.src}
        width={image.width}
        height={image.height}
        alt={image.decorative ? "" : image.alt}
        loading="lazy"
      />
    );
  }
  const text = PLACEHOLDER_TEXT[image.status];
  const classes = [
    "tcb-image-placeholder",
    PLACEHOLDER_CLASS[image.status],
    ratio,
  ];
  return (
    <div
      role="img"
      aria-label={text}
      className={classes.filter(Boolean).join(" ")}
    >
      {text}
    </div>
  );
}

/** <figure> with the picture (or a placeholder box) and an optional caption (spec §8.8). */
export function ImageView({
  image,
  ratio,
  caption,
}: {
  image: ResolvedImage;
  ratio: ImageProps["ratio"];
  caption: string;
}) {
  return (
    <figure className="tcb-image">
      <Picture image={image} ratio={ratioClass(ratio)} />
      {caption === "" ? null : (
        <figcaption className={typographyVariants({ type: "body-sm" }).base()}>
          {caption}
        </figcaption>
      )}
    </figure>
  );
}
```

建立 `packages/blocks/src/render-config.tsx`（不得加 `'use client'`，不得 import `@tzuchi/tceditor` 主入口的執行期值，C.4 的 ESLint 規則會檢查）：

```tsx
import type {
  ComponentConfig,
  Config,
  CustomField,
  SlotComponent,
} from "@tzuchi/tceditor";
import type { RichTextDoc } from "@tzuchi/tceditor/rules";
import {
  eachField,
  fieldKindOf,
  fieldPathKey,
  toJsonSchema,
  toPuckFields,
} from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";
import type {
  AnyBlockSpec,
  BlockProps,
  FieldFactories,
  FieldKind,
  ImageValue,
  SlotItem,
} from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";
import { isValidElement, type ComponentType, type ReactNode } from "react";
import type { AssetSource } from "./asset-source";
import type { ResolvedImage } from "./image/view";
import { PageRootView } from "./root/view";
import { blockSpecs } from "./specs";
import { views } from "./views";

/**
 * What a view receives for a value of its spec's output type (spec §7.1): a
 * slot or richtext becomes a ReactNode, an image a ResolvedImage, and lists
 * and groups are mapped field by field. Inline-editable text is a ReactNode in
 * the editor although its type stays string, so views declare it ReactNode.
 */
export type ViewValue<V> = V extends readonly SlotItem[]
  ? ReactNode
  : V extends RichTextDoc
  ? ReactNode
  : V extends ImageValue
  ? ResolvedImage
  : V extends readonly (infer Item)[]
  ? ViewValue<Item>[]
  : V extends object
  ? { [K in keyof V]: ViewValue<V[K]> }
  : V;

/** The props of a block's view: exactly the spec's fields, as ViewValue. */
export type ViewProps<S extends AnyBlockSpec> = {
  [K in keyof BlockProps<S>]: ViewValue<BlockProps<S>[K]>;
};

/** One view per block type, keyed by type. A block without a view fails to compile. */
export type BlockViews<B extends readonly AnyBlockSpec[]> = {
  [S in B[number] as S["type"]]: ComponentType<ViewProps<S>>;
};

// Render never shows fields, but it reads their types to turn slots into
// components and richtext into React (useSlots, useRichtextProps), so the
// render config carries the converted fields too. The image field's widget
// is the editor's business (editor-config.tsx); here it renders nothing.
const renderOnlyImageField: NonNullable<FieldFactories["image"]> = ({
  label,
}) => {
  const field: CustomField<ImageValue> = {
    type: "custom",
    label,
    render: () => <></>,
  };
  return field;
};

const factories: FieldFactories = { image: renderOnlyImageField };

/** Turns one stored value (or what Render made of it) into a view's value. */
type Convert = (value: unknown) => unknown;

/** A spec field and the fields inside it (an object's, or a list's items'). */
type SpecField = { name: string; kind: FieldKind; fields: SpecField[] };

const passThrough: Convert = (value) => value;

const isRecord = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> =>
  typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);

/** Richtext arrives as React (RichTextContent, or the inline editor); anything else renders nothing. */
function asNode(value: unknown): ReactNode {
  return isValidElement(value) ? value : null;
}

/** A slot is a component once Render or the editor has mapped it; a list item without its slot renders nothing. */
function slotNode(value: unknown): ReactNode {
  if (typeof value !== "function") return null;
  const Slot = value as SlotComponent;
  return <Slot className="tcb-stack" />;
}

function resolveImage(
  value: unknown,
  assets: Pick<AssetSource, "get">
): ResolvedImage {
  const image: Partial<Record<keyof ImageValue, unknown>> = isRecord(value)
    ? value
    : {};
  if (typeof image.assetId !== "string" || image.assetId === "") {
    return { status: "empty" };
  }
  const asset = assets.get(image.assetId);
  if (!asset) return { status: "missing", assetId: image.assetId };
  const decorative = image.decorative === true;
  return {
    status: "ok",
    src: asset.src,
    width: asset.width,
    height: asset.height,
    alt: decorative || typeof image.alt !== "string" ? "" : image.alt,
    decorative,
  };
}

/** The spec's fields as a tree, read from its JSON Schema. */
function specFields(spec: AnyBlockSpec): SpecField[] {
  const top: SpecField[] = [];
  const children = new Map<string, SpecField[]>([["", top]]);
  // eachField visits a field before the fields inside it. A list item's
  // field belongs to the list: ["columns", "[]", "content"] → "columns".
  eachField(toJsonSchema(spec), ({ path, name, node }) => {
    const field: SpecField = { name, kind: fieldKindOf(node), fields: [] };
    const parent = path.slice(0, path[path.length - 2] === "[]" ? -2 : -1);
    children.get(fieldPathKey(parent))?.push(field);
    children.set(fieldPathKey(path), field.fields);
  });
  return top;
}

/** Picks exactly these fields (own properties only) and converts each value. */
function picker(
  fields: readonly (readonly [string, Convert])[]
): (value: unknown) => Record<string, unknown> {
  return (value) => {
    const record = isRecord(value) ? value : {};
    return Object.fromEntries(
      fields.map(([name, convert]) => [
        name,
        convert(
          Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(record, name)
            ? record[name]
            : undefined
        ),
      ])
    );
  };
}

/** Converts an object's fields, or null when no field inside needs converting. */
function objectConverter(
  fields: readonly SpecField[],
  assets: Pick<AssetSource, "get">
): Convert | null {
  const converters = fields.map(
    (field) => [field.name, converterOf(field, assets)] as const
  );
  if (converters.every(([, convert]) => convert === null)) return null;
  return picker(
    converters.map(([name, convert]) => [name, convert ?? passThrough])
  );
}

/** How a field's value reaches the view (spec §7.1); null passes it through. */
function converterOf(
  field: SpecField,
  assets: Pick<AssetSource, "get">
): Convert | null {
  switch (field.kind) {
    case "slot":
      return slotNode;
    case "richtext":
      return asNode;
    case "image":
      return (value) => resolveImage(value, assets);
    case "object":
      return objectConverter(field.fields, assets);
    case "array": {
      const item = objectConverter(field.fields, assets);
      return item && ((value) => (Array.isArray(value) ? value : []).map(item));
    }
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

function viewOf(
  views: object,
  type: string
): ComponentType<Record<string, unknown>> {
  const view: unknown = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(views, type)
    ? (views as Record<string, unknown>)[type]
    : undefined;
  if (typeof view !== "function") {
    throw new TypeError(`buildRenderConfig: block "${type}" has no view`);
  }
  // BlockViews ties each view's props to its spec (ViewProps); the values
  // built by the converters follow the same spec at run time.
  return view as ComponentType<Record<string, unknown>>;
}

/**
 * The Puck config for Render (spec §7.1), built from the specs alone: each
 * block's render picks exactly the spec's fields (never Puck's props, which
 * hold functions such as renderDropZone), turns slots into <Slot />,
 * richtext into React and images into a ResolvedImage with `assets.get`,
 * passes everything else through, and renders the block's view. Server-safe:
 * no "use client", no runtime import of the main @tzuchi/tceditor entry.
 */
export function buildRenderConfig<
  const B extends readonly AnyBlockSpec[]
>(options: {
  blocks: B;
  views: BlockViews<B>;
  assets: Pick<AssetSource, "get">;
}): Config {
  const { blocks, assets } = options;
  const components = Object.fromEntries(
    blocks.map((spec) => {
      const View = viewOf(options.views, spec.type);
      const pickProps = picker(
        specFields(spec).map((field) => [
          field.name,
          converterOf(field, assets) ?? passThrough,
        ])
      );
      const component: ComponentConfig = {
        label: spec.label,
        fields: toPuckFields(spec, factories),
        render: (props) => <View {...pickProps(props)} />,
      };
      return [spec.type, component];
    })
  );
  return {
    components,
    root: { render: PageRootView },
  };
}

/**
 * The Puck config of the registered blocks (blockSpecs with their views) for
 * the public page, Storybook and, through createEditorConfig, the editor.
 */
export function createRenderConfig(options: {
  assets: Pick<AssetSource, "get">;
}): Config {
  return buildRenderConfig({
    blocks: blockSpecs,
    views,
    assets: options.assets,
  });
}
```

```ts
import { ButtonView } from "./button/view";
import { CardView } from "./card/view";
import { ColumnsView } from "./columns/view";
import { HeadingView } from "./heading/view";
import { ImageView } from "./image/view";
import { ParagraphView } from "./paragraph/view";
import type { BlockViews } from "./render-config";
import { SectionView } from "./section/view";
import type { blockSpecs } from "./specs";
import { TagListView } from "./tag-list/view";

/**
 * The view of every block in blockSpecs, by type (spec §3.3, §7.1). A new
 * block adds one line here. TypeScript fails while a registered block has no
 * view, while a view's props do not match its spec (ViewProps), or for a type
 * that is not registered. Server-safe: views are server components.
 */
export const views = {
  Heading: HeadingView,
  Paragraph: ParagraphView,
  Button: ButtonView,
  Card: CardView,
  TagList: TagListView,
  Section: SectionView,
  Columns: ColumnsView,
  Image: ImageView,
} satisfies BlockViews<typeof blockSpecs>;
```

建立 `packages/blocks/src/image/editor.tsx`：

```tsx
"use client";

import type { CustomField, CustomFieldRender } from "@tzuchi/tceditor";
import { IMAGE_ALT_MAX_LENGTH } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";
import type { FieldFactories, ImageValue } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import type { Asset, AssetSource } from "../asset-source";

type AssetList =
  | { status: "loading" }
  | { status: "ready"; assets: readonly Asset[] }
  | { status: "error" };

/** Whatever the data holds, the picker edits a complete ImageValue. */
function toImageValue(value: unknown): ImageValue {
  const record: Partial<Record<keyof ImageValue, unknown>> =
    typeof value === "object" && value !== null ? value : {};
  return {
    assetId: typeof record.assetId === "string" ? record.assetId : "",
    alt: typeof record.alt === "string" ? record.alt : "",
    decorative: record.decorative === true,
  };
}

function ImagePicker({
  id,
  label,
  assets,
  value,
  onChange,
  readOnly,
}: {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  assets: AssetSource;
  value: unknown;
  onChange: (value: ImageValue) => void;
  readOnly: boolean;
}) {
  const [list, setList] = useState<AssetList>({ status: "loading" });

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    setList({ status: "loading" });
    assets.list().then(
      (items) => {
        if (active) setList({ status: "ready", assets: items });
      },
      () => {
        if (active) setList({ status: "error" });
      }
    );
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [assets]);

  const current = toImageValue(value);
  const update = (patch: Partial<ImageValue>) => {
    if (!readOnly) onChange({ ...current, ...patch });
  };
  const altId = `${id}-alt`;
  const hintId = `${id}-alt-hint`;
  const gone =
    list.status === "ready" &&
    current.assetId !== "" &&
    !list.assets.some((asset) => asset.id === current.assetId);

  return (
    <fieldset className="tcb-picker" disabled={readOnly}>
      <legend className="tcb-picker-legend">{label}</legend>
      <div className="tcb-picker-body">
        {list.status === "loading" ? (
          <p className="tcb-picker-status" role="status">
            正在載入圖片…
          </p>
        ) : null}
        {list.status === "error" ? (
          <p className="tcb-picker-alert" role="alert">
            無法載入圖片清單，請重新整理頁面。
          </p>
        ) : null}
        {list.status === "ready" && list.assets.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="tcb-picker-status">目前沒有可選的圖片。</p>
        ) : null}
        {list.status === "ready" && list.assets.length > 0 ? (
          <ul className="tcb-picker-grid" aria-label="可選的圖片">
            {list.assets.map((asset) => (
              <li key={asset.id}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="tcb-picker-option"
                  aria-pressed={asset.id === current.assetId}
                  onClick={() => update({ assetId: asset.id })}
                >
                  {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element -- a thumbnail in the editor panel, not page content */}
                  <img
                    className="tcb-picker-thumb"
                    src={asset.src}
                    width={asset.width}
                    height={asset.height}
                    alt=""
                    loading="lazy"
                  />
                  <span className="tcb-picker-name">{asset.label}</span>
                </button>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        ) : null}
        {gone ? (
          <p className="tcb-picker-alert" role="alert">
            目前選的圖片已不存在，請重新選擇。
          </p>
        ) : null}
        <label className="tcb-picker-label" htmlFor={altId}>
          替代文字
        </label>
        <input
          id={altId}
          className="tcb-picker-input"
          type="text"
          maxLength={IMAGE_ALT_MAX_LENGTH}
          value={current.alt}
          disabled={current.decorative}
          aria-describedby={hintId}
          onChange={(event) => update({ alt: event.currentTarget.value })}
        />
        <p id={hintId} className="tcb-picker-hint">
          {`說明圖片的內容，給看不到圖片的讀者使用，最多 ${IMAGE_ALT_MAX_LENGTH} 字。`}
        </p>
        <label className="tcb-picker-check">
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={current.decorative}
            onChange={(event) =>
              update({ decorative: event.currentTarget.checked })
            }
          />
          純裝飾（不需要替代文字）
        </label>
      </div>
    </fieldset>
  );
}

/**
 * The image field's editor widget (spec §7.3): pick a picture from `assets`,
 * edit its alt text, or mark it decorative. Every change emits the whole
 * ImageValue. Puck memoises a custom field by [type, key, render] (gaps #35),
 * so each call returns a field whose `render` never changes.
 */
export function createImagePickerField(
  assets: AssetSource
): NonNullable<FieldFactories["image"]> {
  return ({ label }) => {
    const render: CustomFieldRender<ImageValue> = ({
      id,
      value,
      onChange,
      readOnly,
    }) => (
      <ImagePicker
        id={id}
        label={label}
        assets={assets}
        value={value}
        onChange={onChange}
        readOnly={readOnly === true}
      />
    );
    const field: CustomField<ImageValue> = { type: "custom", label, render };
    return field;
  };
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import type { Config } from "@tzuchi/tceditor";
import { toDefaultProps, toPuckFields } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";
import type { AnyBlockSpec } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";
import type { AssetSource } from "./asset-source";
import { createImagePickerField } from "./image/editor";
import { createRenderConfig } from "./render-config";
import { CATEGORIES, blockSpecs, pageRootSpec } from "./specs";

/**
 * The editor's categories (spec §7.3): CATEGORIES in order, each holding the
 * blocks whose `category` is its title, then the hidden "deprecated"
 * category. Deprecated blocks go only there: a category with
 * `visible: false` hides them from the block list and keeps them out of
 * "other", while pages that already use them can still edit them.
 */
export function editorCategories(
  blocks: readonly AnyBlockSpec[]
): NonNullable<Config["categories"]> {
  return Object.fromEntries([
    ...CATEGORIES.map((category) => [
      category.key,
      {
        title: category.title,
        components: blocks
          .filter(
            (spec) => !spec.deprecated && spec.category === category.title
          )
          .map((spec) => spec.type),
      },
    ]),
    [
      "deprecated",
      {
        title: "已停用",
        visible: false,
        components: blocks
          .filter((spec) => spec.deprecated)
          .map((spec) => spec.type),
      },
    ],
  ]);
}

/**
 * The Puck config for <Puck> (spec §7.3): createRenderConfig's components
 * (the same render as the public page) plus fields, default props,
 * categories and the page root's fields. Create it once (module scope or
 * useMemo): Puck memoises custom fields by their render function.
 */
export function createEditorConfig(options: { assets: AssetSource }): Config {
  const base = createRenderConfig({ assets: options.assets });
  const image = createImagePickerField(options.assets);

  const components = Object.fromEntries(
    blockSpecs.map((spec) => [
      spec.type,
      {
        ...base.components[spec.type],
        fields: toPuckFields(spec, { image }),
        defaultProps: toDefaultProps(spec),
      },
    ])
  );

  return {
    components,
    categories: editorCategories(blockSpecs),
    root: {
      ...base.root,
      fields: toPuckFields(pageRootSpec),
      defaultProps: toDefaultProps(pageRootSpec),
    },
  };
}
```

### Task 12: `gen:blocks` 與產生的檔案、§5.5 檢查、相容性

目的：從 Task 10 的 8 個區塊規格產生其餘三種產物並 commit 進 repo：每個區塊一個 Storybook story 檔、給 S4 的 MCP 元件目錄 `generated/catalog.json`、給 S3 的資料庫外殼 schema `generated/page-shell.draft07.json`，以及每個區塊版本一份資料契約快照 `generated/schemas/<Type>.v<version>.json`。`pnpm gen:blocks`（tsx 執行 `packages/blocks/scripts/gen-blocks.ts`）負責寫檔。測試把關規格 §5.5 的四項檢查與 §4.6 的相容性：產生的檔案與重新產生的結果逐位元組相同；規格開放的樣式選項都存在於 uikit 選項快照，uikit 有而沒開放的選項都在 `style-decisions.ts` 寫了理由；編輯器欄位、Storybook 控制項、MCP 目錄與 zod 規格的欄位名稱一致（包括清單項目裡的欄位）；契約沒改版本號就改變、或與舊版不相容時失敗。另外用產生出來的 catalog 與外殼 schema 跑雙層一致性（zod 對 Ajv），並為每個區塊的編輯器欄位留下 jest 快照（規格 §13.1）。

**執行位置**：主工作目錄 `/Users/kaellim/Desktop/projects/puck`，分支 `s2/block-spec`。

**設計決定與說明**：

產生器與檔案
- **產生器是純函式**（`src/generate/`），只回傳檔案內容；寫檔、刪檔只在 `scripts/gen-blocks.ts`。這樣測試可以直接比對「現在重新產生的結果」與 repo 裡的檔案（規格第 18 節更正 #16：§5.5 #1 由 blocks 的 jest 測試 `generated.spec.ts` 檢查，沒有 `check:generated`）。
- **兩類產物**：`regenerate`（stories、catalog、外殼 schema）每次依規格重寫；`snapshot`（資料契約）每個區塊版本寫一次、之後不再改。若 `gen:blocks` 也重寫快照，「契約變了但沒改版本號」就會被它悄悄蓋掉，規格 §4.6 的檢查形同虛設。所以 `gen:blocks` 先跑 `checkContracts`，有 `changed-without-bump`、`incompatible`、`orphan` 任何一種就 exit 1、什麼都不寫；只有 `missing`（新版本還沒有快照）會寫入。
- **JSON 一律 `JSON.stringify(value, null, 2) + "\n"`**。`.json` 不在 `pnpm format:check` 的 glob 內（gaps #18），格式由產生器自己決定。
- **stories 用 Prettier 2 格式化**（gaps #18 的兩個選項中選「產生器呼叫 `prettier.format()`」，story 檔仍受 `format:check` 與 lint 檢查）：
  - `renderStoryFile` 呼叫 `prettier.format(source, { ...prettier.resolveConfig.sync(filepath), filepath })`，`filepath` 是 story 檔的絕對路徑。這樣產生器和 `pnpm format:check` 讀同一份 Prettier 設定（目前 root 的 `.prettierrc.json` 是 `{}`），parser 也由副檔名 `.tsx` 決定。若只寫 `{ parser: "typescript" }`，日後 `.prettierrc.json` 加了任何選項，產生的 story 就通不過 `format:check`；用 `prettier --write` 修好又會讓 `generated.spec.ts` 失敗。實測把 `.prettierrc.json` 暫時改成 `{ "semi": false }` 時，`gen:blocks` 重寫 8 個 story，`prettier --check` 仍然通過。
  - `filepath` 由 `__dirname` 算出：ts-jest 與 tsx 都把 `src/generate/stories.ts` 當成 CommonJS 執行，`__dirname` 存在。這個模組只有 `gen:blocks` 與 jest 會載入（Storybook 載入的 story 檔只 import `story-helpers.tsx`）。
  - lockfile 另有 `prettier@3.9.10`（style-dictionary 帶進來，preflight §0 #5），所以 blocks 自己宣告 `prettier` `2.8.8`，確保產生器與 `format:check` 用同一版。Prettier 2 沒有附型別，另加 `@types/prettier` `2.7.3`（2.x 的最後一版）。
  - 寫成 `import prettier from "prettier"`（default import）。實測 ts-jest（CommonJS，`esModuleInterop: true`）與 tsx（CommonJS 與 ESM 兩種模組格式）都能用；namespace import 在 Node 的 ESM 下拿不到 `format`。
- **`gen:blocks` 用 tsx 執行**：Node 原生的 TS 支援載入不了不帶副檔名的 import（gaps C9），所以 root 加 devDependency `tsx` `4.23.15`。腳本用 `process.argv[1]` 找出套件目錄，實測 tsx 在兩種模組格式下都會把它設成腳本的絕對路徑（`__dirname` 在 ESM 不存在，`import.meta.url` 在 tsx 的 CommonJS 轉譯下是空的）。
- **刪除過期的 story**：`gen:blocks` 只刪第一行是 `GENERATED_HEADER` 的 `*.stories.tsx`（也就是它自己產生的，例如區塊被移除後留下的檔），手寫的 story 只印警告；`generated.spec.ts` 會因為多出這個檔而失敗。區塊不能被移除（規格 §4.6），所以實際上只會發生在改名或寫錯時。

story 檔（規格 §5.3、更正 #5）
- 格式與 frameworks.md §3.5 實測的 CSF3 相同：中文 `title: "區塊/<label>"`、ASCII `id: "blocks-<kebab type>"`、ASCII export 名稱（`Default`、`Example1`…）、`tags: ["autodocs"]`、`parameters.docs.description.component` 取 `spec.description`。
- **兩個和 §3.5 不同的地方**，原因都是 `packages/blocks` 不依賴 Storybook（Storybook 在 Task 14 才裝在 `apps/storybook`）：
  - 不寫 `satisfies Meta<…>`、不 import `@storybook/react-vite` 的型別。CSF3 本來就是一般物件；`render` 的參數型別寫成 `Record<string, unknown>`。
  - 不設 `component`。每個 story 經由 meta 的 `render` 畫出整頁，`argTypes` 全部由 `toArgTypes` 提供（Storybook 設 `reactDocgen: false`，規格 §9）。
- meta 先指定給變數再 `export default meta`：直接 `export default { … }` 會觸發 eslint-config-next 的 `import/no-anonymous-default-export` 警告（實測 8 個 warning；CLAUDE.md 不允許新增 warning）。
- `argTypes` 與 `args` 在產生時寫成 JSON 字面值，而不是執行時呼叫 `toArgTypes`：規格改變時 story 檔的 diff 直接顯示控制項與預設值的變化，審查時看得到。
- `render` 用 `@tzuchi/tceditor/rsc` 的 `Render` 畫出只有這個區塊的頁面（更正 #5）：client `Render` 會在根節點多包一層 `<div>`，RSC 版的輸出才和公開頁相同。preflight §5.3 實測 RSC `Render` 在 Storybook 的瀏覽器端可以執行，而且 HTML 和 `/activity` 逐字相同。
- **範例 story 的 args = 預設值加上範例的 props**（淺層合併，在產生時算好）。
- **`storyPage(type, args)`**（`src/story-helpers.tsx`）：
  - id 直接沿用 `exampleToPageData`：把 args 當成一個暫時的範例傳進去（`{ ...spec, examples: [{ name: "story", props: args }] }`），所以頂層是 `<Type>-ex1`，放置區子區塊是 `<Type>-ex1-content-0` 這類，與 Task 7 的規則完全一致，不另寫一份。
  - 公開頁的 `<Render>` 不補預設值（規格 §6.2 #9），而 Task 10 的範例裡，放置區子區塊只寫了幾個 props（例如 Card 範例裡的 Button 只有 `label`、`href`、`size`）。所以頁面先交給 `validatePage`：通過時用它的輸出（預設值補齊、富文字清理過，等同發布後的資料）；不通過時（新按鈕還沒填網址、或在 Controls 面板改成不合格的值）照原樣畫，讓設計師也看得到未完成的區塊。

- `storyConfig = createRenderConfig({ assets: demoAssetSource })`：與公開頁同一份 render 設定，示範圖由 Task 14 的 `staticDirs` 提供（`/demo-assets/…`）。

§5.5 的檢查
- **#2、#3（`uikit-whitelist.spec.ts`）**：
  - 用 `eachField(toJsonSchema(spec))` 找出每個帶 `x-style` 的欄位（`style()` 的 meta 會攤平到 JSON 節點上，zod-ajv §2 p02c），值取該節點的 `enum`。
  - 選項快照是 Task 6 的 `generated/uikit-options.json`（`components[<component>].variants[<key>]`）。查表一律用 `Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call`。
  - #2：每個開放的選項都要在快照裡。#3：同一個 `<component>.<key>` 在所有規格中開放的選項取聯集，uikit 的每個選項必須「有開放」或「在 `STYLE_DECISIONS` 有理由」。
  - 另外檢查 `STYLE_DECISIONS` 本身：key 必須有規格在用、每個值都存在於 uikit、不和開放的選項重疊、理由不是空字串。這樣日後開放某個選項時，忘記刪掉它的「不開放理由」也會失敗。
  - 測試先斷言用到的 8 個 variant 名稱，避免 `eachField` 一個都沒找到時其他測試空轉通過。
- **`style-decisions.ts` 的內容**依 uikit facts §3、C6、C13 與 Task 10 的白名單：`button.variant`（danger、danger-soft、ghost、tertiary）、`typography.type`（body、body-sm、body-xs、code、h5、h6）、`typography.align`（justify）、`card.variant`（tertiary、transparent）、`chip.color`（danger、warning）、`chip.variant`（primary、tertiary）、`surface.variant`（tertiary）。`button.size` 開放了 uikit 全部三種，所以沒有項目。理由是給設計師看的中文，例如 tertiary 按鈕「慈濟主題沒有對應的設計」（uikit §3.1 的主題對照）。
- **#4（`consistency.spec.ts`）**：
  - 每個區塊的 `toPuckFields(spec, { image })`、`toArgTypes(spec)`、`buildCatalog(...)` 的 `props.properties` 與 `spec.props.shape` 四者 key 完全相同；頁面根節點比對編輯器欄位與 catalog。
  - **清單與群組裡的欄位也要一致**：Puck 的 `arrayFields`／`objectFields` 漏掉或拼錯子欄位時，頂層 key 的比對看不出來。所以另外把三方的欄位全名（`fieldPathKey` 的格式，例如 `tags[].label`、`columns[].content`）列出來比較：規格用 `eachField(toJsonSchema(spec))`；編輯器欄位遞迴 `arrayFields`（加 `[].`）與 `objectFields`（加 `.`）；catalog 也用 `eachField`，但 catalog 去掉了 `x-slot`，`eachField` 會走進放置區的項目（`type`、`props`），所以略過放置區（`slotLocations(spec)` 的 `key`）裡面的名稱。Storybook 的 object 控制項沒有子欄位，不必比對。另有一個測試斷言確實走到了 `tags[].label` 與 `columns[].content`，避免比對空轉。圖片欄位在編輯器是自訂欄位、沒有子欄位，三方都不展開（`eachField` 不進入 `x-image`）。
  - 圖片欄位用回傳 text 欄位的替身 factory，因為這裡只比對名稱，真正的圖片挑選器在 Task 11 的 `image/editor.tsx`（`'use client'`、需要 React）。
  - 這個測試在本 task 實作之前就會通過，因為它只檢查 Task 8 的轉換器與 Task 10 的規格是否一致。實測把 Task 8 的 `arrayFields` 改成空物件時，TagList 與 Columns 兩筆失敗。

編輯器欄位快照（規格 §13.1「轉換器」一列）
- 規格 §13.1 要求「每個區塊的編輯器欄位、argTypes、MCP 目錄條目做快照測試」。argTypes 與 catalog 已經寫進 commit 的 story 檔與 `catalog.json`，由 `generated.spec.ts` 逐位元組比對，等於快照。**編輯器欄位原本沒有任何 task 做快照**：Task 8 只用測試專用規格，Task 11 的 `editor-config.spec.ts` 與本 task 的 `consistency.spec.ts` 只比對名稱。所以 8 個真實區塊的欄位種類、`radio`／`select`、中文標籤、`min`／`max`、`defaultProps` 出現回歸時，沒有測試會失敗。
- `editor-fields.spec.ts` 對 `createEditorConfig({ assets: demoAssetSource })` 的每個區塊與頁面根節點，把 `{ fields, defaultProps }` 轉成 JSON 再 `toMatchSnapshot()`（core 也用 jest 快照，例如 `packages/core/components/Puck/__tests__/__snapshots__`）。函式（`getItemSummary`、圖片挑選器的 `render`）記成 `"[Function]"`，所以另外對 TagList 的 `"{label}"` 與 Columns 的 `"第 {n} 欄"` 各斷言一次：用第一個預設項目呼叫 `getItemSummary`。
- **快照寫入前的每次測試都加 `--ci`**：沒有 `--ci`（而且環境變數 `CI` 沒有設定）時，jest 會自動寫入新快照並讓測試通過，紅燈看不到，也可能 commit 未經檢查的快照。Step 4、6 用 `--ci`，Step 8 先以 `--ci=false` 只跑這個檔寫入 9 個快照、人工檢查，再用 `--ci` 跑全部。
- `.snap` 是 `packages/blocks` 裡 git 追蹤的檔案，`$TURBO_DEFAULT$` 會把它算進 `@tzuchi/tceditor-blocks#test` 的 hash，turbo 不必改。

相容性（規格 §4.6、§13.1）
- `checkContracts(specs, snapshots)` 是純函式，`gen:blocks` 與 `compat.spec.ts` 共用：
  - 目前版本沒有快照 → `missing`（`gen:blocks` 寫入）；
  - 有快照但內容和 `toDataContract(spec)` 不同（以 `stableStringify` 比較）→ `changed-without-bump`；
  - 較舊版本的快照用 `diffContracts(舊版, 目前)` 比對，有任何不相容差異 → `incompatible`；
  - 檔名不合 `<Type>.v<n>.json`、type 已不存在、或版本比規格新 → `orphan`。
- `compat.spec.ts` 除了對真實快照斷言沒有任何問題，也實際模擬三種情況：把按鈕的 `variant` 收窄成兩個選項但不改版本號（`changed-without-bump`）、收窄後把版本號加 1（`incompatible`，`enum-value-removed`）、放寬選項並加版本號（沒有問題）。模擬用 `z.strictObject({ ...buttonSpec.props.shape, variant: style(...) })` 做出改過的規格，不碰真正的規格檔。
- `generated.spec.ts` 另外檢查：目前版本的快照與 `jsonFile(toDataContract(spec))` 逐位元組相同（不同時訊息說明「快照不會改，請加版本號」），以及每個區塊 `v1` 到 `v(version-1)` 的舊快照都還在（`gen:blocks` 無法重建舊版本）。

雙層一致性（`dual-layer.spec.ts`，規格 §13.1）
- 規則與 Task 9 的 `packages/spec/src/validator/__tests__/dual-layer.spec.ts` 相同，只是改用**產生出來的檔案**：Ajv 2020-12 編譯 `generated/catalog.json` 每個區塊的 `props` 與 `root.props`（S4 經 MCP 拿到的就是這份），Ajv draft-07 編譯 `generated/page-shell.draft07.json`（S3 放進 Postgres 的就是這份）。`generated.spec.ts` 保證這兩個檔與規格同步。
- Ajv 設定：`Ajv2020({ strict: true, allErrors: true, useDefaults: true })` 並 `addVocabulary([...X_KEYS])`；外殼用 `new Ajv({ strict: true, allErrors: true })`（zod-ajv §10.1、gaps #21）。
- 判準：
  - zod 接受的資料：輸入的每個區塊 props（去掉 `id`，更正 #8）與根節點 props 必須通過 catalog schema，存檔的 `result.data` 必須同時通過外殼與 catalog schema。
  - zod 拒絕、Ajv 卻接受的資料：每一筆錯誤碼都必須屬於 catalog 宣告的 `x-lost-checks`（`safe-href` → `unsafe_href`、`alt-required` → `alt_required`），或屬於 JSON Schema 無法表達的整頁規則（`duplicate_id`、`not_allowed_here`、`too_deep`、`too_many_blocks`）。後者超出規格 §13.1 的文字（「反方向只允許 x-lost-checks 列出的情況」），是「與規格的差異」#25（已列在計畫開頭的「與規格的差異」）：外殼依 §6.5 只檢查結構，catalog 一次只看一個區塊。
  - `x-lost-checks` 的值以 `Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(LOST_CHECK_CODES, check)` 查表（CLAUDE.md：以資料為 key 查表時不用 `in` 查一般物件，`"constructor" in {}` 是 true）。
- 測試資料：每個區塊的每個範例、每個區塊只有 id 的頁面、`validator-cases.json` 全部 32 筆，加上兩筆針對 lost checks 的資料（含危險連結與標題的富文字、多欄裡的卡片帶 `javascript:` 選填連結）。另外斷言「zod 才擋得下」的錯誤碼確實出現了 `alt_required`、`duplicate_id`、`not_allowed_here`、`unsafe_href`，以及兩層都接受、兩層都拒絕的資料各超過 10 筆，避免測試資料退化成空轉。

建立 `packages/blocks/src/generate/__tests__/generated.spec.ts`：

```ts
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { blockSpecs } from "../../specs";
import { findStoryFiles } from "../disk";
import { generateFiles } from "../files";

const packageDir = join(__dirname, "../../..");
const files = generateFiles();

const readOrNull = (path: string): string | null => {
  const target = join(packageDir, path);

  return existsSync(target) ? readFileSync(target, "utf8") : null;
};

const list = (paths: string[]) => paths.map((path) => `  ${path}`).join("\n");

describe("files generated from the block specs", () => {
  it("match a fresh run of pnpm gen:blocks byte for byte", () => {
    const stale = files
      .filter((file) => file.kind === "regenerate")
      .filter((file) => readOrNull(file.path) !== file.contents)
      .map((file) => file.path);

    if (stale.length > 0) {
      throw new Error(
        `These files are missing or out of date:\n${list(
          stale
        )}\nRun \`pnpm gen:blocks\` and commit the result.`
      );
    }
  });

  it("include an unchanged data contract snapshot for the current version of every block", () => {
    const snapshots = files.filter((file) => file.kind === "snapshot");
    const missing = snapshots
      .filter((file) => readOrNull(file.path) === null)
      .map((file) => file.path);
    const changed = snapshots
      .filter((file) => {
        const current = readOrNull(file.path);

        return current !== null && current !== file.contents;
      })
      .map((file) => file.path);

    expect(snapshots).toHaveLength(blockSpecs.length);

    if (missing.length > 0) {
      throw new Error(
        `Missing data contract snapshots:\n${list(
          missing
        )}\nRun \`pnpm gen:blocks\` and commit the result.`
      );
    }

    if (changed.length > 0) {
      throw new Error(
        `These snapshots differ from the specs' current data contracts:\n${list(
          changed
        )}\nA snapshot never changes once committed. If a spec's contract changed, bump its version (compatible changes only, see compat.spec.ts) and run \`pnpm gen:blocks\`; otherwise restore the file from git.`
      );
    }
  });

  it("keep the snapshots of every older block version", () => {
    const missing = blockSpecs.flatMap((spec) =>
      Array.from(
        { length: spec.version - 1 },
        (_, index) => `generated/schemas/${spec.type}.v${index + 1}.json`
      ).filter((path) => readOrNull(path) === null)
    );

    if (missing.length > 0) {
      throw new Error(
        `Snapshots of older block versions are missing:\n${list(
          missing
        )}\ngen:blocks cannot recreate them; restore them from git.`
      );
    }
  });

  it("are the only stories in the package", () => {
    const generated = new Set(
      files
        .filter((file) => file.path.endsWith(".stories.tsx"))
        .map((file) => file.path)
    );

    expect(generated.size).toBe(blockSpecs.length);
    expect(
      findStoryFiles(packageDir).filter((path) => !generated.has(path))
    ).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

建立 `packages/blocks/src/generate/__tests__/compat.spec.ts`：

```ts
import { join } from "node:path";
import * as z from "zod";
import { style, toDataContract } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";
import type { AnyBlockSpec, JsonSchema } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";
import { buttonSpec } from "../../button/spec";
import { blockSpecs } from "../../specs";
import {
  checkContracts,
  describeContractProblem,
  snapshotFileName,
} from "../contracts";
import { readSnapshots } from "../disk";

const snapshots = readSnapshots(join(__dirname, "../../../generated/schemas"));

/** buttonSpec whose variant no longer offers "outline": an incompatible change. */
const narrowedButton: AnyBlockSpec = {
  ...buttonSpec,
  props: z.strictObject({
    ...buttonSpec.props.shape,
    variant: style("button", "variant", ["primary", "secondary"])
      .default("primary")
      .meta({ title: "樣式" }),
  }),
};

describe("data contracts (spec §4.6)", () => {
  it("every block matches its snapshot and stays compatible with its older versions", () => {
    const problems = checkContracts(blockSpecs, snapshots);

    expect(problems.map(describeContractProblem)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("detects a contract change without a version bump", () => {
    const file = snapshotFileName(buttonSpec);

    expect(
      checkContracts([narrowedButton], { [file]: toDataContract(buttonSpec) })
    ).toEqual([{ kind: "changed-without-bump", file }]);
  });

  it("detects an incompatible change across versions", () => {
    const v1 = snapshotFileName(buttonSpec);
    const bumped: AnyBlockSpec = {
      ...narrowedButton,
      version: buttonSpec.version + 1,
    };
    const problems = checkContracts([bumped], {
      [v1]: toDataContract(buttonSpec),
      [snapshotFileName(bumped)]: toDataContract(bumped),
    });

    expect(problems).toEqual([
      {
        kind: "incompatible",
        file: v1,
        breaks: [expect.objectContaining({ kind: "enum-value-removed" })],
      },
    ]);
  });

  it("accepts a compatible change with a version bump", () => {
    const widened: AnyBlockSpec = {
      ...buttonSpec,
      version: buttonSpec.version + 1,
      props: z.strictObject({
        ...buttonSpec.props.shape,
        variant: style("button", "variant", [
          "primary",
          "secondary",
          "outline",
          "ghost",
        ])
          .default("primary")
          .meta({ title: "樣式" }),
      }),
    };

    expect(
      checkContracts([widened], {
        [snapshotFileName(buttonSpec)]: toDataContract(buttonSpec),
        [snapshotFileName(widened)]: toDataContract(widened),
      })
    ).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("reports missing snapshots and snapshots that belong to no spec version", () => {
    const contract: JsonSchema = toDataContract(buttonSpec);

    expect(
      checkContracts([buttonSpec], {
        "Gone.v1.json": contract,
        "Button.v9.json": contract,
        "button.json": contract,
      })
    ).toEqual([
      { kind: "missing", file: snapshotFileName(buttonSpec) },
      {
        kind: "orphan",
        file: "Button.v9.json",
        reason: `the spec is at version ${buttonSpec.version}`,
      },
      {
        kind: "orphan",
        file: "Gone.v1.json",
        reason:
          'no block spec has type "Gone" (never remove a block type; set deprecated: true instead)',
      },
      {
        kind: "orphan",
        file: "button.json",
        reason: "the name is not <Type>.v<version>.json",
      },
    ]);
  });
});
```
