建立 `packages/blocks/src/__tests__/uikit-whitelist.spec.ts`：

```ts
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { eachField, toJsonSchema } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";
import { blockSpecs, pageRootSpec } from "../specs";
import { STYLE_DECISIONS } from "../style-decisions";

type UikitOptions = {
  components: Record<string, { variants: Record<string, string[]> }>;
};

/** One style() field: which uikit variant it maps to and the options it offers. */
type StyleField = { field: string; styleKey: string; offered: string[] };

const uikit = JSON.parse(
  readFileSync(join(__dirname, "../../generated/uikit-options.json"), "utf8")
) as UikitOptions;

const own = (object: object, key: string) =>
  Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(object, key);

/** The variant's options in the uikit snapshot; [] when uikit has no such variant. */
function uikitOptions(styleKey: string): string[] {
  const [component, key] = styleKey.split(".");

  if (!own(uikit.components, component)) return [];

  const { variants } = uikit.components[component];

  return own(variants, key) ? variants[key] : [];
}

const styleFields: StyleField[] = [];

for (const spec of [...blockSpecs, pageRootSpec]) {
  const owner = spec.kind === "block" ? spec.type : "root";

  eachField(toJsonSchema(spec), ({ path, node }) => {
    const xStyle = node["x-style"] as
      | { component: string; key: string }
      | undefined;

    if (xStyle) {
      styleFields.push({
        field: `${owner}.${path.join(".")}`,
        styleKey: `${xStyle.component}.${xStyle.key}`,
        offered: node.enum as string[],
      });
    }
  });
}

/** Options offered for each uikit variant, over every spec that uses it. */
const offered = new Map<string, Set<string>>();

for (const { styleKey, offered: values } of styleFields) {
  offered.set(styleKey, new Set([...(offered.get(styleKey) ?? []), ...values]));
}

describe("style options against the uikit snapshot (spec §5.5)", () => {
  it("covers the uikit variants that the blocks use", () => {
    expect([...offered.keys()].sort()).toEqual([
      "button.size",
      "button.variant",
      "card.variant",
      "chip.color",
      "chip.variant",
      "surface.variant",
      "typography.align",
      "typography.type",
    ]);
  });

  it("#2: offers only options that exist in uikit", () => {
    const missing = styleFields.flatMap(
      ({ field, styleKey, offered: values }) =>
        values
          .filter((value) => !uikitOptions(styleKey).includes(value))
          .map((value) => `${field}: uikit's ${styleKey} has no "${value}"`)
    );

    expect(missing).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("#3: offers each uikit option or explains in style-decisions.ts why not", () => {
    const undecided = [...offered].flatMap(([styleKey, values]) => {
      const decisions = own(STYLE_DECISIONS, styleKey)
        ? STYLE_DECISIONS[styleKey]
        : {};

      return uikitOptions(styleKey)
        .filter((value) => !values.has(value) && !own(decisions, value))
        .map((value) => `${styleKey}: "${value}"`);
    });

    expect(undecided).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("explains only uikit options that are not offered", () => {
    const problems: string[] = [];

    for (const [styleKey, decisions] of Object.entries(STYLE_DECISIONS)) {
      const values = offered.get(styleKey);

      if (!values) {
        problems.push(`${styleKey}: no spec uses this variant`);
        continue;
      }

      for (const [value, reason] of Object.entries(decisions)) {
        if (values.has(value))
          problems.push(`${styleKey}: "${value}" is offered`);
        if (!uikitOptions(styleKey).includes(value)) {
          problems.push(`${styleKey}: uikit has no "${value}"`);
        }
        if (reason.trim() === "") {
          problems.push(`${styleKey}: "${value}" has no reason`);
        }
      }
    }

    expect(problems).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

建立 `packages/blocks/src/__tests__/consistency.spec.ts`：

```ts
import {
  buildCatalog,
  eachField,
  fieldPathKey,
  slotLocations,
  toArgTypes,
  toJsonSchema,
  toPuckFields,
} from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";
import type { FieldFactories, JsonSchema } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";
import { blockSpecs, pageRootSpec } from "../specs";

// Only the field names matter here; the real picker is in image/editor.tsx
const image: NonNullable<FieldFactories["image"]> = ({ label }) => ({
  type: "text",
  label,
});

const catalog = buildCatalog({ blocks: blockSpecs, root: pageRootSpec });
const blockCases = blockSpecs.map((spec) => [spec.type, spec] as const);

const sortedKeys = (object: object | undefined) =>
  Object.keys(object ?? {}).sort();

/** The parts of a Puck field that hold nested fields. */
type EditorField = {
  arrayFields?: Record<string, EditorField>;
  objectFields?: Record<string, EditorField>;
};

/** Every editor field name, nested ones as "tags[].label" (fieldPathKey's format). */
const editorNames = (
  fields: Record<string, EditorField>,
  prefix = ""
): string[] =>
  Object.entries(fields).flatMap(([name, field]) => [
    `${prefix}${name}`,
    ...editorNames(field.arrayFields ?? {}, `${prefix}${name}[].`),
    ...editorNames(field.objectFields ?? {}, `${prefix}${name}.`),
  ]);

/**
 * Every field name of a props schema. The catalog drops x-slot, so eachField
 * would walk into the slot items of the catalog; names inside a slot are left out.
 */
const schemaNames = (
  schema: JsonSchema,
  slotKeys: readonly string[]
): string[] => {
  const names: string[] = [];

  eachField(schema, ({ path }) => {
    const key = fieldPathKey(path);

    if (!slotKeys.some((slot) => key.startsWith(`${slot}[]`))) names.push(key);
  });

  return names.sort();
};

describe("field names agree across the artifacts (spec §5.5 #4)", () => {
  it.each(blockCases)(
    "%s: editor fields, Storybook argTypes and the catalog match the spec",
    (type, spec) => {
      const expected = sortedKeys(spec.props.shape);
      const entry = catalog.blocks.find((block) => block.type === type);

      expect({
        editor: sortedKeys(toPuckFields(spec, { image })),
        storybook: sortedKeys(toArgTypes(spec)),
        catalog: sortedKeys(entry?.props.properties as object | undefined),
      }).toEqual({ editor: expected, storybook: expected, catalog: expected });
    }
  );

  it.each(blockCases)(
    "%s: the fields inside lists and groups match too",
    (type, spec) => {
      const slots = slotLocations(spec).map((slot) => slot.key);
      const expected = schemaNames(toJsonSchema(spec), slots);
      const entry = catalog.blocks.find((block) => block.type === type);

      expect({
        editor: editorNames(
          toPuckFields(spec, { image }) as Record<string, EditorField>
        ).sort(),
        catalog: entry ? schemaNames(entry.props, slots) : [],
      }).toEqual({ editor: expected, catalog: expected });
    }
  );

  it("reaches the fields inside the lists of TagList and Columns", () => {
    const names = blockSpecs.flatMap((spec) =>
      schemaNames(toJsonSchema(spec), [])
    );

    expect(names).toEqual(
      expect.arrayContaining(["tags[].label", "columns[].content"])
    );
  });

  it("page root: editor fields and the catalog match the spec", () => {
    const expected = sortedKeys(pageRootSpec.props.shape);

    expect({
      editor: sortedKeys(toPuckFields(pageRootSpec)),
      catalog: sortedKeys(catalog.root.props.properties as object | undefined),
    }).toEqual({ editor: expected, catalog: expected });
  });
});
```

```ts
import type { ArrayField } from "@tzuchi/tceditor";
import { demoAssetSource } from "../demo-assets";
import { createEditorConfig } from "../editor-config";
import { blockSpecs } from "../specs";

const config = createEditorConfig({ assets: demoAssetSource });

/** JSON with every function (render, getItemSummary, the image picker) as "[Function]". */
const asJson = (value: unknown): unknown =>
  JSON.parse(
    JSON.stringify(value, (_key, item: unknown) =>
      typeof item === "function" ? "[Function]" : item
    )
  );

/** The getItemSummary of a list field, applied to the first default item. */
const firstItemSummary = (type: string, name: string) => {
  const { fields, defaultProps } = config.components[type];
  const items: unknown = defaultProps?.[name];

  if (fields?.[name]?.type !== "array" || !Array.isArray(items)) {
    throw new TypeError(`${type}.${name} is not a list field`);
  }

  const field = fields[name] as ArrayField;

  return field.getItemSummary?.(items[0], 0);
};

});
```

建立 `packages/blocks/src/__tests__/dual-layer.spec.ts`：

```ts
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";
import Ajv from "ajv";
import type { ValidateFunction } from "ajv";
import Ajv2020 from "ajv/dist/2020";
import {
  X_KEYS,
  exampleToPageData,
  slotLocations,
} from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";
import type { AnyBlockSpec, Catalog, JsonSchema } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";
import cases from "../__fixtures__/validator-cases.json";
import { blockSpecs } from "../specs";
import { validatePage } from "../validator";
import type { IssueCode } from "../validator";

// The generated files exactly as S3 (the shell, in Postgres) and S4 (the
// catalog, over MCP) receive them; generated.spec.ts keeps them in sync.
const readGenerated = (name: string): unknown =>
  JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(__dirname, "../../generated", name), "utf8"));
const catalog = readGenerated("catalog.json") as Catalog;
const shell = readGenerated("page-shell.draft07.json") as JsonSchema;

// Ajv as S3 and S4 will run it: strict, every x-* keyword registered, and
// defaults filled in like zod does (facts zod-ajv §10.1, gaps #21). Same
// setup and rules as packages/spec/src/validator/__tests__/dual-layer.spec.ts.
const ajv2020 = new Ajv2020({
  strict: true,
  allErrors: true,
  useDefaults: true,
});
ajv2020.addVocabulary([...X_KEYS]);

const propsSchemas = new Map<string, ValidateFunction>(
  catalog.blocks.map((block) => [block.type, ajv2020.compile(block.props)])
);
const rootSchema = ajv2020.compile(catalog.root.props);
const shellSchema = new Ajv({ strict: true, allErrors: true }).compile(shell);
const specs = new Map<string, AnyBlockSpec>(
  blockSpecs.map((spec) => [spec.type, spec])
);

type AnyRecord = Record<string, unknown>;

const isRecord = (value: unknown): value is AnyRecord =>
  typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);

/** The values at a slot path such as ["columns", "[]", "content"]. */
const valuesAt = (value: unknown, segments: readonly string[]): unknown[] => {
  let found = [value];

  for (const segment of segments) {
    found = found.flatMap((item) =>
      segment === "[]"
        ? Array.isArray(item)
          ? item
          : []
        : isRecord(item) && segment in item
        ? [item[segment]]
        : []
    );
  }

  return found;
};

/** Every block node in a content array, including the ones in slots. */
const blocksOf = (content: unknown): AnyRecord[] => {
  const found: AnyRecord[] = [];
  const queue: unknown[] = [content];

  while (queue.length > 0) {
    const list = queue.pop();

    if (!Array.isArray(list)) continue;

    for (const node of list) {
      if (!isRecord(node) || !isRecord(node.props)) continue;

      found.push(node);

      const spec =
        typeof node.type === "string" ? specs.get(node.type) : undefined;

      for (const slot of spec ? slotLocations(spec) : []) {
        queue.push(...valuesAt(node.props, slot.path));
      }
    }
  }

  return found;
};

/** Each block's props (without id) and the root props against the catalog. */
const propsAccepted = (input: unknown): boolean => {
  const data: unknown = structuredClone(input);

  if (!isRecord(data) || !isRecord(data.root)) return false;
  if (!rootSchema(data.root.props)) return false;

  return blocksOf(data.content).every((node) => {
    const check =
      typeof node.type === "string" ? propsSchemas.get(node.type) : undefined;
    const props = { ...(node.props as AnyRecord) };

    delete props.id;

    return check !== undefined && check(props);
  });
};

/** The draft-07 shell plus the catalog's per-block schemas. */
const ajvAccepts = (input: unknown): boolean =>
  shellSchema(structuredClone(input)) && propsAccepted(input);

type Case = { name: string; input: unknown };

const page = (content: unknown[]) => ({ root: { props: {} }, content });

const corpus: Case[] = [
  ...blockSpecs.flatMap((spec) =>
    spec.examples.map((example, index) => ({
      name: `example ${spec.type} ${example.name}`,
      input: exampleToPageData(spec, index),
    }))
  ),
  ...blockSpecs.map((spec) => ({
    name: `defaults only ${spec.type}`,
    input: page([{ type: spec.type, props: { id: `${spec.type}-1` } }]),
  })),
  ...(cases as Case[]).map(({ name, input }) => ({
    name: `validator-cases ${name}`,
    input,
  })),
  {
    name: "rich text with an unsafe link and a heading",
    input: page([
      {
        type: "Paragraph",
        props: {
          id: "Paragraph-1",
          body: {
            type: "doc",
            content: [
              {
                type: "heading",
                attrs: { level: 2 },
                content: [{ type: "text", text: "標題" }],
              },
              {
                type: "paragraph",
                content: [
                  {
                    type: "text",
                    text: "連結",
                    marks: [
                      { type: "link", attrs: { href: "javascript:alert(1)" } },
                    ],
                  },
                ],
              },
            ],
          },
        },
      },
    ]),
  },
  {
    name: "unsafe optional link in a card inside columns",
    input: page([
      {
        type: "Columns",
        props: {
          id: "Columns-1",
          columns: [
            {
              content: [
                {
                  type: "Card",
                  props: { id: "Card-1", href: "javascript:alert(1)" },
                },
              ],
            },
            { content: [] },
          ],
        },
      },
    ]),
  },
];

// x-lost-checks entries that the validator reports as a rejection
const LOST_CHECK_CODES: Record<string, IssueCode> = {
  "safe-href": "unsafe_href",
  "alt-required": "alt_required",
};

// Whole-page rules that no JSON Schema layer checks: the shell only checks
// structure (spec §6.5) and the catalog schemas see one block at a time.
const PAGE_RULE_CODES: IssueCode[] = [
  "duplicate_id",
  "not_allowed_here",
  "too_deep",
  "too_many_blocks",
];

/** Codes of the x-lost-checks that the catalog declares anywhere. */
const lostCheckCodes = (): IssueCode[] => {
  const codes = new Set<IssueCode>();
  const stack: unknown[] = [catalog];

  while (stack.length > 0) {
    const node = stack.pop();

    if (Array.isArray(node)) {
      stack.push(...node);
    } else if (isRecord(node)) {
      const checks = node["x-lost-checks"];

      if (Array.isArray(checks)) {
        for (const check of checks) {
          if (
            typeof check === "string" &&
            Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(LOST_CHECK_CODES, check)
          ) {
            codes.add(LOST_CHECK_CODES[check]);
          }
        }
      }

      stack.push(...Object.values(node));
    }
  }

  return [...codes].sort();
};

describe("dual-layer consistency with the generated files (spec §13.1)", () => {
  it("never accepts with zod what Ajv rejects", () => {
    const failures: string[] = [];

    for (const { name, input } of corpus) {
      const result = validatePage(structuredClone(input));

      if (!result.ok) continue;

      // MCP checks the block props it sends; the database checks what is stored
      if (!propsAccepted(input)) failures.push(`${name}: input props`);
      if (!ajvAccepts(result.data)) failures.push(`${name}: stored data`);
    }

    expect(failures).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("only rejects what Ajv accepts for x-lost-checks and whole-page rules", () => {
    const allowed = new Set<IssueCode>([
      ...lostCheckCodes(),
      ...PAGE_RULE_CODES,
    ]);
    const seen = new Set<IssueCode>();
    const unexpected: string[] = [];

    for (const { name, input } of corpus) {
      const result = validatePage(structuredClone(input));

      if (result.ok || !ajvAccepts(input)) continue;

      for (const issue of result.errors) {
        seen.add(issue.code);
        if (!allowed.has(issue.code)) unexpected.push(`${name}: ${issue.code}`);
      }
    }

    expect(lostCheckCodes()).toEqual(["alt_required", "unsafe_href"]);
    expect(unexpected).toEqual([]);
    // the corpus reaches every rule that only the zod validator checks,
    // except depth and block count (Task 9 covers them with test specs)
    expect([...seen].sort()).toEqual([
      "alt_required",
      "duplicate_id",
      "not_allowed_here",
      "unsafe_href",
    ]);
  });

  it("covers both outcomes", () => {
    const outcomes = corpus.map(({ input }) => ({
      zod: validatePage(structuredClone(input)).ok,
      ajv: ajvAccepts(input),
    }));

    expect(outcomes.filter((o) => o.zod && o.ajv).length).toBeGreaterThan(10);
    expect(outcomes.filter((o) => !o.zod && !o.ajv).length).toBeGreaterThan(10);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { join } from "node:path";
import prettier from "prettier";
import { toArgTypes, toStoryArgs } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";
import type { AnyBlockSpec } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";

/** First line of every generated story file. gen:blocks only deletes files that start with it. */
export const GENERATED_HEADER =
  "// Generated by `pnpm gen:blocks` from the block's spec.ts. Do not edit.";

/** "TagList" → "tag-list": the block's folder under src/ and the story id suffix. */
export function blockFolder(type: string): string {
  return type.replace(/([a-z0-9])([A-Z])/g, "$1-$2").toLowerCase();
}

/** Path of the block's story file, relative to packages/blocks. */
export function storyFilePath(spec: AnyBlockSpec): string {
  return `src/${blockFolder(spec.type)}/${spec.type}.stories.tsx`;
}

/** ASCII Storybook id, so story URLs stay stable when the Chinese title changes. */
export function storyId(spec: AnyBlockSpec): string {
  return `blocks-${blockFolder(spec.type)}`;
}

const literal = (value: unknown): string => JSON.stringify(value);

/**
 * A CSF3 story file for one block: a "預設" story with the spec's defaults
 * and one story per example. Every story renders a one-block page with the
 * RSC Render, so Storybook shows the same HTML as the public page.
 * The output is formatted with Prettier 2 and the repo's Prettier config for
 * the file's path, the same as `pnpm format:check`.
 */
export function renderStoryFile(spec: AnyBlockSpec): string {
  const defaults = toStoryArgs(spec);
  const examples = spec.examples.map(
    (example, index) =>
      `export const Example${index + 1} = { name: ${literal(
        example.name
      )}, args: ${literal({ ...defaults, ...example.props })} };`
  );
  const source = [
    GENERATED_HEADER,
    'import { Render } from "@tzuchi/tceditor/rsc";',
    'import { storyConfig, storyPage } from "../story-helpers";',
    "",
    "const meta = {",
    `title: ${literal(`區塊/${spec.label}`)},`,
    `id: ${literal(storyId(spec))},`,
    'tags: ["autodocs"],',
    `parameters: { docs: { description: { component: ${literal(
      spec.description
    )} } } },`,
    `argTypes: ${literal(toArgTypes(spec))},`,
    `args: ${literal(defaults)},`,
    `render: (args: Record<string, unknown>) => <Render config={storyConfig} data={storyPage(${literal(
      spec.type
    )}, args)} />,`,
    "};",
    "",
    "export default meta;",
    "",
    'export const Default = { name: "預設" };',
    ...examples.flatMap((story) => ["", story]),
  ].join("\n");

  // packages/blocks/<story path>: the config that format:check uses for it
  const filepath = join(__dirname, "../..", storyFilePath(spec));

  return prettier.format(source, {
    ...prettier.resolveConfig.sync(filepath),
    filepath,
  });
}
```

建立 `packages/blocks/src/generate/contracts.ts`：

```ts
import { stableStringify } from "@tzuchi/tceditor/rules";
import { diffContracts, toDataContract } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";
import type {
  AnyBlockSpec,
  ContractBreak,
  JsonSchema,
} from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";

/** File name of a data contract snapshot in generated/schemas. */
export const SNAPSHOT_FILE_PATTERN =
  /^([A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]{0,26})\.v([1-9][0-9]*)\.json$/;

export function snapshotFileName(spec: AnyBlockSpec): string {
  return `${spec.type}.v${spec.version}.json`;
}

export type ContractProblem =
  /** No snapshot for the spec's current version yet: gen:blocks writes it. */
  | { kind: "missing"; file: string }
  /** The contract differs from the snapshot of the same version. */
  | { kind: "changed-without-bump"; file: string }
  /** An older version's contract accepts data the current one rejects. */
  | { kind: "incompatible"; file: string; breaks: ContractBreak[] }
  /** A snapshot that belongs to no spec version. */
  | { kind: "orphan"; file: string; reason: string };

/**
 * Compares each spec's current data contract with the committed snapshots
 * (file name → parsed JSON). Snapshots are written once per block version and
 * never change: a contract change needs a version bump, and every older
 * version's contract must stay compatible with the current one (spec §4.6).
 */
export function checkContracts(
  specs: readonly AnyBlockSpec[],
  snapshots: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>
): ContractProblem[] {
  const has = (file: string) =>
    Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(snapshots, file);
  const specsByType: Record<string, AnyBlockSpec> = Object.create(null);
  const current: Record<string, JsonSchema> = Object.create(null);
  const problems: ContractProblem[] = [];

  for (const spec of specs) {
    specsByType[spec.type] = spec;
    current[spec.type] = toDataContract(spec);

    const file = snapshotFileName(spec);

    if (!has(file)) {
      problems.push({ kind: "missing", file });
    } else if (
      stableStringify(snapshots[file]) !== stableStringify(current[spec.type])
    ) {
      problems.push({ kind: "changed-without-bump", file });
    }
  }

  for (const file of Object.keys(snapshots).sort()) {
    const match = SNAPSHOT_FILE_PATTERN.exec(file);

    if (!match) {
      problems.push({
        kind: "orphan",
        file,
        reason: "the name is not <Type>.v<version>.json",
      });
      continue;
    }

    const [, type, versionText] = match;
    const version = Number(versionText);
    const spec = type in specsByType ? specsByType[type] : undefined;

    if (!spec) {
      problems.push({
        kind: "orphan",
        file,
        reason: `no block spec has type "${type}" (never remove a block type; set deprecated: true instead)`,
      });
    } else if (version > spec.version) {
      problems.push({
        kind: "orphan",
        file,
        reason: `the spec is at version ${spec.version}`,
      });
    } else if (version < spec.version) {
      const breaks = diffContracts(
        snapshots[file] as JsonSchema,
        current[type]
      );

      if (breaks.length > 0)
        problems.push({ kind: "incompatible", file, breaks });
    }
  }

  return problems;
}

/** One line per problem, for gen:blocks and test failures. */
export function describeContractProblem(problem: ContractProblem): string {
  switch (problem.kind) {
    case "missing":
      return `${problem.file}: no snapshot yet (pnpm gen:blocks writes it)`;
    case "changed-without-bump":
      return `${problem.file}: the data contract changed but the version did not. Bump the spec's version (compatible changes only, spec §4.6), then run pnpm gen:blocks. Never edit generated/schemas by hand.`;
    case "incompatible":
      return `${
        problem.file
      }: the current spec rejects data this version accepted: ${problem.breaks
        .map((item) => `${item.kind} at ${item.path} (${item.detail})`)
        .join("; ")}. Add a new block type and deprecate this one instead.`;
    case "orphan":
      return `${problem.file}: ${problem.reason}`;
  }
}
```

建立 `packages/blocks/src/generate/files.ts`：

```ts
import {
  buildCatalog,
  buildPageShellSchema,
  toDataContract,
} from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";
import { blockSpecs, pageRootSpec } from "../specs";
import { snapshotFileName } from "./contracts";
import { renderStoryFile, storyFilePath } from "./stories";

export type GeneratedFile = {
  /** Relative to packages/blocks, with "/" separators. */
  path: string;
  contents: string;
  /**
   * "regenerate": gen:blocks rewrites it whenever the specs change.
   * "snapshot": a data contract, written once per block version and never changed.
   */
  kind: "regenerate" | "snapshot";
};

/** How every generated JSON file is written. */
export function jsonFile(value: unknown): string {
  return `${JSON.stringify(value, null, 2)}\n`;
}

/** Every file gen:blocks writes, sorted by path. */
export function generateFiles(): GeneratedFile[] {
  const files: GeneratedFile[] = [
    {
      path: "generated/catalog.json",
      contents: jsonFile(
        buildCatalog({ blocks: blockSpecs, root: pageRootSpec })
      ),
      kind: "regenerate",
    },
    {
      path: "generated/page-shell.draft07.json",
      contents: jsonFile(buildPageShellSchema({ blocks: blockSpecs })),
      kind: "regenerate",
    },
  ];

  for (const spec of blockSpecs) {
    files.push(
      {
        path: storyFilePath(spec),
        contents: renderStoryFile(spec),
        kind: "regenerate",
      },
      {
        path: `generated/schemas/${snapshotFileName(spec)}`,
        contents: jsonFile(toDataContract(spec)),
        kind: "snapshot",
      }
    );
  }

  return files.sort((a, b) => (a.path < b.path ? -1 : a.path > b.path ? 1 : 0));
}
```

建立 `packages/blocks/src/generate/disk.ts`：

```ts
import { existsSync, readFileSync, readdirSync } from "node:fs";
import { join, sep } from "node:path";

/** generated/schemas as file name → parsed JSON (a null-prototype object). */
export function readSnapshots(dir: string): Record<string, unknown> {
  const snapshots: Record<string, unknown> = Object.create(null);

  if (!existsSync(dir)) return snapshots;

  for (const name of readdirSync(dir).sort()) {
    if (name.endsWith(".json")) {
      snapshots[name] = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(dir, name), "utf8"));
    }
  }

  return snapshots;
}

/** Every *.stories.tsx under packages/blocks/src, as "src/…" paths with "/" separators. */
export function findStoryFiles(packageDir: string): string[] {
  return readdirSync(join(packageDir, "src"), {
    recursive: true,
    encoding: "utf8",
  })
    .filter((path) => path.endsWith(".stories.tsx"))
    .map((path) => `src/${path.split(sep).join("/")}`)
    .sort();
}
```

建立 `packages/blocks/src/story-helpers.tsx`：

```tsx
import { exampleToPageData } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";
import type { AnyBlockSpec, PageData } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-spec";
import { demoAssetSource } from "./demo-assets";
import { createRenderConfig } from "./render-config";
import { blockSpecs } from "./specs";
import { validatePage } from "./validator";

/** The config every generated story renders with: the public page's config and the demo images. */
export const storyConfig = createRenderConfig({ assets: demoAssetSource });

const specsByType: Record<string, AnyBlockSpec> = Object.create(null);

for (const spec of blockSpecs) specsByType[spec.type] = spec;

/**
 * A page that holds one block with the story's args as its props.
 *
 * Ids come from exampleToPageData, so the block and the blocks in its slots
 * get the same stable ids an example would get. When the page passes the
 * validator, its output is used: it fills in the defaults that the nested
 * blocks of an example usually leave out, as publishing does. Otherwise (a
 * block that is not ready to publish yet, such as a new Button without a link,
 * or args edited in the Controls panel) the props are rendered as given.
 */
export function storyPage(
  type: string,
  args: Record<string, unknown>
): PageData {
  const spec = type in specsByType ? specsByType[type] : undefined;

  if (!spec) throw new TypeError(`storyPage: unknown block type "${type}"`);

  const page = exampleToPageData(
    { ...spec, examples: [{ name: "story", props: args }] },
    0
  );
  const result = validatePage(page);

  return result.ok ? result.data : page;
}
```

建立 `packages/blocks/scripts/gen-blocks.ts`：

```ts
// Writes the files generated from the block specs: one story per block, the
// MCP catalog, the database page shell and a data contract snapshot per block
// version. Run from the repo root with `pnpm gen:blocks`; commit the result.
//
// generated.spec.ts and compat.spec.ts fail when these files are out of date.
import {
  existsSync,
  mkdirSync,
  readFileSync,
  rmSync,
  writeFileSync,
} from "node:fs";
import { dirname, join, resolve } from "node:path";
import {
  checkContracts,
  describeContractProblem,
} from "../src/generate/contracts";
import { findStoryFiles, readSnapshots } from "../src/generate/disk";
import { generateFiles } from "../src/generate/files";
import { GENERATED_HEADER } from "../src/generate/stories";
import { blockSpecs } from "../src/specs";

// process.argv[1] is this script's path under tsx in both module formats
const packageDir = resolve(dirname(process.argv[1]), "..");

const problems = checkContracts(
  blockSpecs,
  readSnapshots(join(packageDir, "generated/schemas"))
).filter((problem) => problem.kind !== "missing");

if (problems.length > 0) {
  console.error("gen:blocks: nothing written; fix the specs first:");
  for (const problem of problems) {
    console.error(`  ${describeContractProblem(problem)}`);
  }
  process.exit(1);
}

const files = generateFiles();
let written = 0;

for (const file of files) {
  const target = join(packageDir, file.path);
  const current = existsSync(target) ? readFileSync(target, "utf8") : null;

  // Unchanged files are left alone. An existing snapshot can only differ in
  // formatting here: checkContracts above stops on any change to a contract.
  if (current === file.contents) continue;

  mkdirSync(dirname(target), { recursive: true });
  writeFileSync(target, file.contents);
  written++;
  console.log(`gen:blocks: wrote ${file.path}`);
}

const expected = new Set(files.map((file) => file.path));
let deleted = 0;

for (const path of findStoryFiles(packageDir)) {
  if (expected.has(path)) continue;

  const target = join(packageDir, path);

  if (readFileSync(target, "utf8").startsWith(GENERATED_HEADER)) {
    rmSync(target);
    deleted++;
    console.log(`gen:blocks: deleted ${path} (its block is gone)`);
  } else {
    console.warn(
      `gen:blocks: ${path} was not generated; stories are generated from the specs, so remove it`
    );
  }
}

console.log(
  `gen:blocks: ${files.length} files checked, ${written} written, ${deleted} deleted`
);
```

### Task 13: Edge 單檔驗證器與 `check:edge`

目的：S3 的存檔 API 要在 Supabase Edge Function 裡驗證頁面資料，那裡不能用 workspace 的 TypeScript 原始碼。本 task 用 esbuild 把綁定 8 個區塊的整頁驗證器（`packages/blocks/src/validator.ts`，連同 zod、`packages/spec` 的驗證器與 `@tzuchi/tceditor/rules`）打包成單一 ES module `packages/blocks/dist/validator.edge.mjs`，成為 blocks 的 `build` script；再加上 root script `pnpm check:edge`，在 `pnpm build` 之後做規格 §6.4 的三項檢查：不 import 任何模組、不含 React／Tiptap／`node:` 模組；gzip 後不超過 60 KB；用同一組資料（Task 10 的 `validator-cases.json` 加上大小、JSON 與區塊數上限的原始輸入）跑原始碼版（tsx 載入）與打包版，兩邊的完整結果必須相同。

**執行位置**：主工作目錄 `/Users/kaellim/Desktop/projects/puck`，分支 `s2/block-spec`。

**設計決定與說明**：

打包（`packages/blocks/scripts/build-edge.mjs`）
- esbuild `0.27.7`，加成 blocks 的 devDependency（lockfile 已有這一版，是 tsup 的依賴；zod-ajv §9 的量測也用它）。設定：`bundle`、`format: "esm"`、`platform: "neutral"`、`target: "es2022"`、`minify`、`metafile`。
- **`platform: "neutral"`**：不假設瀏覽器或 Node，也不帶 `browser`／`node` 條件；Edge Function（Deno）兩者都不是。neutral 預設沒有 main fields，所以明確寫 `mainFields: ["module", "main"]`，給沒有 `exports` 的套件用；`conditions: []` 讓 esbuild 不自動加入 `module` 條件。實際走到的套件都有 `exports`，esbuild 依 `import`／`default` 條件解析。實測 metafile 的 inputs：
  - `@tzuchi/tceditor/rules` → `../core/dist/rules.mjs`（Task 5 的 rules 入口；core 要先 build，turbo 的 `^build` 會先建 core）；
  - zod → `zod@4.6.5` 的 `index.js` 與 `v4/**/*.js`，輸出用到 21 個檔，全部是 ESM 的 `.js`，沒有 `.cjs`（zod 的 `@zod/source` 條件也沒有啟用）；
  - `packages/spec/src/**` 與 `packages/blocks/src/**/spec.ts` 的原始碼。
  - 64 個 zod 語系檔都被解析，但 tree-shaking 後輸出只含 `en`，因為所有 zod 匯入都寫成 `import * as z from "zod"`（Global Constraints、zod-ajv §9；ESLint 由 Task 7 把關）。
- **`absWorkingDir` 設成套件目錄**：metafile 的路徑一律相對於 `packages/blocks`（輸出 key 固定是 `dist/validator.edge.mjs`），不論從哪個目錄執行；`check:edge` 依這個 key 找輸出。
- **metafile 寫在 bundle 旁邊**（`dist/validator.edge.meta.json`）：`check:edge` 讀它的 `imports`，大小超標時也可以丟進 https://esbuild.github.io/analyze/ 看是什麼佔了空間。兩個檔都在 `dist/`，`.gitignore` 的 `dist` 規則會忽略（gaps C7），turbo 的 `build.outputs` 已有 `dist/**`，cache 會一起還原。
- **大小**：實測（含 Task 9 的驗證器與 Task 10 的 8 個區塊）142,349 bytes、gzip -9 為 42,886 bytes。60 KB 的門檻留有約 18 KB 餘裕。超過門檻通常代表誤把 view、編輯器或 zod 語系打包進來（規格 §6.4）。
- turbo：`packages/spec` 是 blocks 的 workspace 依賴，turbo 會把它的檔案算進 `@tzuchi/tceditor-blocks#build` 的 hash。實測改了 `packages/spec/src` 之後，blocks 的 build 從 cache hit 變成 cache miss，不必另加 `inputs`。
- audit gate：bundle 打包的是 blocks 的 dependencies（`zod`、`@tzuchi/tceditor-spec`、`@tzuchi/tceditor`），已經依 `GATED_IMPORTERS` 檢查；esbuild 只是建置工具，沒有被打包進去，所以 `BUNDLED_DEV_DEPENDENCIES` 不必改。

檢查（`scripts/check-edge.mjs`，root script `check:edge`）
- 放在 root、排在 `verify` 的 `pnpm build` 之後（規格第 18 節更正 #16），因為要讀 build 產物。寫法照 `packages/core/scripts/check-bundle-imports.mjs`：純函式 export 出來給 `node:test`（`scripts/check-edge.test.mjs`），`isMain` 比對 realpath 後才執行檢查。
- **第 1 項（不 import 任何模組）以 metafile 為準**：esbuild 在 `outputs[…].imports` 列出輸出檔仍保留的每一個 import（外部模組或 chunk），必須是空陣列。另外檢查 metafile 記錄的輸出大小等於檔案大小，避免讀到別次 build 的 metafile。
- **再用 regex 掃原始碼**，抓 metafile 管不到的情況（手動改過的檔、esbuild 為 CommonJS 依賴產生的 `require()` shim）：靜態 import、動態 `import(`、`export … from`、`require(`，以及引入 `node:` 模組的寫法（見下一點）。前四種在比對前面要求不是識別字或屬性的一部分（`(?:^|[^\w$.])`），所以 `x.import`、`"imports"` 不算。壓縮後的輸出沒有註解；字串內容剛好像 import 時會誤報，但誤報只會讓檢查失敗並印出前後文，不會漏報。實測真實 bundle 的 `import`、`require` 出現 0 次。
- **`react`、`@tiptap` 用字面比對**（實測 0 次）。**`node:` 只比對引入模組的寫法**（與 `check:bundle` 相同）：
  - bundle 裡有數處（目前 7 處）`{node:e,path:[]}` 這類物件 key（`eachField` 與驗證器的走訪，壓縮不改屬性名稱），字面比對一定失敗；理由同規格第 18 節更正 #12。
  - regex 不另寫一份：`check-edge.mjs` 直接 import Task 5 `packages/core/scripts/check-bundle-imports.mjs` 匯出的 `NODE_IMPORT`，用它的 `pattern` 當作 `MODULE_SYNTAX` 的 `"node: module"` 規則，所以 `check:bundle` 的 rules 入口與 `check:edge` 對 `node:` 的判斷永遠相同。那個檔的主程式包在 `isMain` 之下，import 它不會執行 `check:bundle`。
  - `NODE_IMPORT` 只比對 `from "node:…"`、`import("node:…")`、`import "node:…"`（`import` 後面要有空白）與 `require("node:…")`；一般字串 `"node:fs"` 不算。壓縮後沒有空白的 `import"node:fs"` 由同一組規則裡的 `"static import"` 擋下，metafile 也會列出它。`check-edge.test.mjs` 斷言 `"node: module"` 規則就是 `NODE_IMPORT.pattern`，並鎖定這幾種寫法的結果。
  - 這和規格 §6.4 的文字不同，是「與規格的差異」#26（列在計畫開頭）。
- **第 2 項**：`zlib.gzipSync(bytes, { level: 9 })` 的長度 ≤ 61,440，並印出原始與 gzip 後的大小。
- **第 3 項：原始碼版與打包版的完整結果相同**（規格 §6.4「用同一組測試資料跑原始碼版與打包版，結果必須相同」）：
  - 原始碼版用 `tsx/esm/api` 的 `tsImport` 載入 `packages/blocks/src/validator.ts`（tsx 是 Task 12 加進 root 的 devDependency；它照 workspace 的 `exports` 解析 `@tzuchi/tceditor-spec` 的 `.ts` 與 core 的 `dist/rules.mjs`），打包版用 `import()`。
  - `compareWithSource` 對每一筆輸入在兩邊各跑一次，用 `isDeepStrictEqual` 比較**整個結果**：`ok`、`data`（補齊的預設值、清理過的富文字，S3 會存下的就是它）、`notices`（`richtext_cleaned`）與中文 `message`。只比 code 不夠：`validator.spec.ts` 的 `summarize` 也只取 `code` 與 `pathText`，打包版若把預設值補錯，兩邊的 code 仍然相同。實測把打包版裡根節點的預設標題「未命名頁面」改成別的字（位元組數不變）時，`compareCases` 沒有發現；`compareWithSource` 對沒有填標題的 5 個正例（各兩個函式）與「剛好 2,097,152 bytes」那筆原始輸入共報出 11 筆差異。
  - 輸入：`validator-cases.json` 的每一筆，同時跑 `validatePage(structuredClone(input))` 與 `validatePageJson(JSON.stringify(input))`；加上 `rawInputs(DEFAULT_LIMITS)` 產生的 6 筆原始輸入，只跑 `validatePageJson`。這 6 筆是 JSON 檔放不下的情況（規格 §6.2 #1、#2、#7；Review Focus #2），S3 的 Edge Function 收到的就是這種原始請求：約 70 萬個中文字（超過 2,097,152 bytes，但字元數不到）的字串與 `Uint8Array`、剛好 2,097,152 bytes、`"{"`、不是 UTF-8 的位元組、5,001 個區塊。長度依打包版匯出的 `DEFAULT_LIMITS` 計算。
  - 兩邊一起壞掉時比較看不出來，所以另外保留兩種對預期值的檢查：`compareCases` 把打包版的 `{ code, pathText }` 和 `validator-cases.json` 的 `expect` 比較（與 `validator.spec.ts` 相同）；`checkRawCodes` 斷言 6 筆原始輸入依序得到 `too_large`、`too_large`、通過、`invalid_json`、`invalid_json`、`too_many_blocks`。
  - `too_deep` 不在這裡：33 層的反例只能用測試專用的規格做出來（「與規格的差異」#21），由 Task 9 的測試涵蓋。
- 任何一項失敗都把所有問題列出來再 exit 1；`import()` 失敗也記成一筆問題，不讓前兩項的結果被例外吞掉。

```js
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { test } from "node:test";

import { NODE_IMPORT } from "../packages/core/scripts/check-bundle-imports.mjs";
import {
  MODULE_SYNTAX,
  checkRawCodes,
  compareCases,
  compareWithSource,
  findSourceProblems,
  gzipSize,
  metafileImports,
  rawInputs,
  summarize,
} from "./check-edge.mjs";

const labels = (source) =>
  findSourceProblems(source).map((problem) => problem.split(" at ")[0]);

test("findSourceProblems accepts a self-contained minified bundle", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(
    findSourceProblems(
      'var e={node:1,path:[]},t=x.import,n="imports",i="node:fs";function r(o){return o.require}export{r as validatePage};'
    ),
    []
  );
});

test("findSourceProblems finds every form of module syntax", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(labels('import"./a.js";'), ["static import"]);
  assert.deepEqual(labels('import{z as a}from"zod";'), ["static import"]);
  assert.deepEqual(labels('import * as z from "zod";'), ["static import"]);
  assert.deepEqual(labels('let a=await import("./b.js");'), ["dynamic import"]);
  assert.deepEqual(labels('export*from"./a.js";'), ["export from"]);
  assert.deepEqual(labels('export{a as b}from"./a.js";'), ["export from"]);
  assert.deepEqual(labels('var a=require("zod");'), ["require"]);
  // node: modules: the NODE_IMPORT pattern of check:bundle
  assert.equal(
    MODULE_SYNTAX.find(([label]) => label === "node: module")[1],
    NODE_IMPORT.pattern
  );
  assert.deepEqual(labels('import{readFileSync as r}from"node:fs";'), [
    "static import",
    "node: module",
  ]);
  assert.deepEqual(labels('let a=await import("node:fs");'), [
    "dynamic import",
    "node: module",
  ]);
  assert.deepEqual(labels('var a=require("node:fs");'), [
    "require",
    "node: module",
  ]);
  assert.deepEqual(labels('import "node:fs";'), [
    "static import",
    "node: module",
  ]);
  // Minified, with no space after import: still caught as a static import
  assert.deepEqual(labels('import"node:fs";'), ["static import"]);
});

test("findSourceProblems finds React and Tiptap", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(labels('var a="react-dom";'), ['"react"']);
  assert.deepEqual(labels('var a="@tiptap/core";'), ['"@tiptap"']);
});

test("metafileImports lists the imports left in each output", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(
    metafileImports({
      outputs: {
        "dist/a.mjs": {
          imports: [{ path: "zod", kind: "import-statement", external: true }],
        },
        "dist/b.mjs": { imports: [] },
      },
    }),
    ["dist/a.mjs imports zod (import-statement)"]
  );
});

test("gzipSize measures gzip -9", () => {
  assert.ok(gzipSize(Buffer.alloc(100_000)) < 1_000);
  assert.ok(gzipSize(Buffer.from("x")) > 1);
});

test("summarize keeps code and pathText, sorted by path", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(summarize({ ok: true, data: {}, notices: [] }), {
    ok: true,
  });
  assert.deepEqual(
    summarize({
      ok: false,
      errors: [
        { code: "unknown_prop", pathText: "content[1].props.x", message: "…" },
        { code: "invalid_value", pathText: "content[0].props.a", message: "…" },
      ],
    }),
    {
      ok: false,
      errors: [
        { code: "invalid_value", pathText: "content[0].props.a" },
        { code: "unknown_prop", pathText: "content[1].props.x" },
      ],
    }
  );
});

test("compareCases reports each function whose result differs", () => {
  const rejectsEverything = {
    validatePage: () => ({
      ok: false,
      errors: [{ code: "invalid_shape", pathText: "content", message: "" }],
    }),
    validatePageJson: () => ({ ok: true, data: {}, notices: [] }),
  };
  const cases = [
    {
      name: "valid",
      input: { root: { props: {} }, content: [] },
      expect: { ok: true },
    },
    {
      name: "invalid",
      input: { content: 1 },
      expect: {
        ok: false,
        errors: [{ code: "invalid_shape", pathText: "content" }],
      },
    },
  ];

  assert.deepEqual(
    compareCases(rejectsEverything, cases).map(
      ({ name, fn }) => `${name} ${fn}`
    ),
    ["valid validatePage", "invalid validatePageJson"]
  );
});

test("compareWithSource reports results that differ beyond the codes", () => {
  const validator = (data) => ({
    validatePage: () => ({ ok: true, data, notices: [] }),
    validatePageJson: () => ({ ok: true, data, notices: [] }),
  });
  const source = validator({ root: { props: { title: "未命名頁面" } } });
  const bundle = validator({ root: { props: {} } });
  const cases = [
    {
      name: "valid",
      input: { root: { props: {} }, content: [] },
      expect: { ok: true },
    },
  ];
  const raws = [{ name: "raw", raw: "{}", code: null }];

  // The codes agree, so comparing with the expectations finds nothing
  assert.deepEqual(compareCases(bundle, cases), []);
  assert.deepEqual(
    compareWithSource(source, bundle, cases, raws).map(
      ({ name, fn }) => `${name} ${fn}`
    ),
    ["valid validatePage", "valid validatePageJson", "raw validatePageJson"]
  );
  assert.deepEqual(compareWithSource(source, source, cases, raws), []);
});

test("rawInputs builds bodies at the byte and block limits", () => {
  const limits = { maxBytes: 2_097_152, maxBlocks: 5000 };
  const raws = rawInputs(limits);
  const bytes = (raw) =>
    typeof raw === "string" ? new TextEncoder().encode(raw).length : raw.length;

  assert.deepEqual(
    raws.map(({ code }) => code),
    [
      "too_large",
      "too_large",
      null,
      "invalid_json",
      "invalid_json",
      "too_many_blocks",
    ]
  );
  // Over the limit in UTF-8 bytes, under it in characters (Review Focus #2)
  assert.ok(bytes(raws[0].raw) > limits.maxBytes);
  assert.ok(raws[0].raw.length < limits.maxBytes);
  assert.ok(raws[1].raw instanceof Uint8Array);
  assert.equal(bytes(raws[1].raw), bytes(raws[0].raw));
  assert.equal(bytes(raws[2].raw), limits.maxBytes);
  assert.equal(JSON.parse(raws[5].raw).content.length, limits.maxBlocks + 1);
});

test("checkRawCodes reports a result other than the expected code", () => {
  const validator = {
    validatePageJson: (raw) =>
      raw === "{"
        ? {
            ok: false,
            errors: [{ code: "invalid_json", pathText: "", message: "" }],
          }
        : { ok: true, data: {}, notices: [] },
  };

  assert.deepEqual(
    checkRawCodes(validator, [
      { name: "broken", raw: "{", code: "invalid_json" },
      { name: "fine", raw: "{}", code: null },
      { name: "huge", raw: "[]", code: "too_large" },
    ]),
    ['raw input "huge": expected too_large, got ok']
  );
});
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 實作檢查腳本**

建立 `scripts/check-edge.mjs`：

```js
// Checks the single-file page validator that S3's Edge Function will run
// (spec §6.4). packages/blocks/scripts/build-edge.mjs writes it during
// `pnpm build`, so run this after the build:
//   1. the bundle imports no other module (node: modules included) and
//      never mentions React or Tiptap;
//   2. gzip -9 keeps it within 60 KB;
//   3. it returns exactly the same results as the source (loaded with tsx)
//      for the shared cases in packages/blocks/src/__fixtures__/
//      validator-cases.json and for generated raw inputs (size, JSON and
//      block count limits), and the expected codes for both.
//
// Usage: node scripts/check-edge.mjs
import { existsSync, readFileSync, realpathSync } from "node:fs";
import { dirname, join, resolve } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
import { isDeepStrictEqual } from "node:util";
import { gzipSync } from "node:zlib";
import { NODE_IMPORT } from "../packages/core/scripts/check-bundle-imports.mjs";

export const GZIP_LIMIT = 61_440;

// Plain substrings. Not "node:": property names such as `node:` in `{node:e}`
// survive minification, so node: modules are matched as imports below
export const FORBIDDEN_NAMES = ["react", "@tiptap"];

// The metafile check is the authority on imports. These patterns catch a
// bundle that does not match its metafile, and an esbuild require() shim. The
// minified output has no comments, and a false alarm only fails loudly.
// "node: module" is check:bundle's own NODE_IMPORT pattern, so both checks
// treat node: alike; it needs a space after a bare import, and a minified
// `import"node:fs"` fails as a static import instead.
export const MODULE_SYNTAX = [
  ["static import", /(?:^|[^\w$.])import\s*(?:[\w$*{][^;]*?from\s*)?["'`]/],
  ["dynamic import", /(?:^|[^\w$.])import\s*\(/],
  ["export from", /(?:^|[^\w$.])export\s*(?:\*|\{[^}]*\})[^;]*?from\s*["'`]/],
  ["require", /(?:^|[^\w$.])require\s*\(/],
  ["node: module", NODE_IMPORT.pattern],
];

const excerpt = (source, index) =>
  JSON.stringify(source.slice(Math.max(0, index - 30), index + 50));

/** Each import that esbuild's metafile says an output still has. */
export function metafileImports(metafile) {
  return Object.entries(metafile.outputs).flatMap(([output, { imports }]) =>
    imports.map((item) => `${output} imports ${item.path} (${item.kind})`)
  );
}

/** Module syntax and forbidden names found in the bundle's source. */
export function findSourceProblems(source) {
  const problems = [];

  for (const [label, pattern] of MODULE_SYNTAX) {
    const match = pattern.exec(source);

    if (match) problems.push(`${label} at ${excerpt(source, match.index)}`);
  }

  for (const name of FORBIDDEN_NAMES) {
    const index = source.indexOf(name);

    if (index !== -1) problems.push(`"${name}" at ${excerpt(source, index)}`);
  }

  return problems;
}

export function gzipSize(bytes) {
  return gzipSync(bytes, { level: 9 }).length;
}

const byPath = (a, b) =>
  a.pathText === b.pathText
    ? a.code.localeCompare(b.code)
    : a.pathText.localeCompare(b.pathText);

/** { ok: true }, or the code and pathText of each error, sorted (as in validator.spec.ts). */
export function summarize(result) {
  return result.ok
    ? { ok: true }
    : {
        ok: false,
        errors: result.errors
          .map(({ code, pathText }) => ({ code, pathText }))
          .sort(byPath),
      };
}

/** Runs each case through validatePage and validatePageJson; returns where the codes differ from the case's expect. */
export function compareCases(validator, cases) {
  const failures = [];

  for (const { name, input, expect: expected } of cases) {
    const wanted = expected.ok
      ? { ok: true }
      : { ok: false, errors: [...expected.errors].sort(byPath) };
    const results = {
      validatePage: summarize(validator.validatePage(structuredClone(input))),
      validatePageJson: summarize(
        validator.validatePageJson(JSON.stringify(input))
      ),
    };

    for (const [fn, actual] of Object.entries(results)) {
      if (!isDeepStrictEqual(actual, wanted)) {
        failures.push({ name, fn, expected: wanted, actual });
      }
    }
  }

  return failures;
}

const utf8Length = (text) => new TextEncoder().encode(text).length;

/**
 * Raw request bodies that validator-cases.json cannot hold (spec §6.2 #1, #2,
 * #7; Review Focus #2), built from the validator's limits. `code` is the one
 * error code expected, or null when the page is valid.
 */
export function rawInputs({ maxBytes, maxBlocks }) {
  const page = (content) => JSON.stringify({ root: { props: {} }, content });
  const heading = (id, text) => ({ type: "Heading", props: { id, text } });
  // 3 bytes per character in UTF-8: over maxBytes bytes, yet a third as
  // many characters
  const tooLarge = page([
    heading("Heading-1", "中".repeat(Math.ceil(maxBytes / 3))),
  ]);
  const small = page([heading("Heading-1", "淨灘")]);

  return [
    {
      name: `over ${maxBytes} bytes of Chinese text`,
      raw: tooLarge,
      code: "too_large",
    },
    {
      name: `over ${maxBytes} bytes of Chinese text as a Uint8Array`,
      raw: new TextEncoder().encode(tooLarge),
      code: "too_large",
    },
    {
      name: `exactly ${maxBytes} bytes`,
      raw: small + " ".repeat(maxBytes - utf8Length(small)),
      code: null,
    },
    { name: "invalid JSON", raw: "{", code: "invalid_json" },
    {
      name: "bytes that are not UTF-8",
      raw: new Uint8Array([0x7b, 0xff, 0x7d]),
      code: "invalid_json",
    },
    {
      name: `${maxBlocks + 1} blocks`,
      raw: page(
        Array.from({ length: maxBlocks + 1 }, (_, index) =>
          heading(`Heading-${index}`, "標題")
        )
      ),
      code: "too_many_blocks",
    },
  ];
}

/** The raw inputs whose result is not the expected code (or ok). */
export function checkRawCodes(validator, raws) {
  const problems = [];

  for (const { name, raw, code } of raws) {
    const result = validator.validatePageJson(raw);
    const codes = result.ok ? [] : result.errors.map((issue) => issue.code);

    if (!isDeepStrictEqual(codes, code === null ? [] : [code])) {
      problems.push(
        `raw input "${name}": expected ${code ?? "ok"}, got ${
          result.ok ? "ok" : codes.join(", ")
        }`
      );
    }
  }

  return problems;
}

/**
 * Runs every case and raw input through the source and the bundle, and
 * returns where the whole results differ: ok, data (filled-in defaults,
 * cleaned rich text), notices and the Chinese messages (spec §6.4).
 */
export function compareWithSource(source, bundle, cases, raws) {
  const failures = [];
  const check = (name, fn, run) => {
    const expected = run(source);
    const actual = run(bundle);

    if (!isDeepStrictEqual(actual, expected)) {
      failures.push({ name, fn, expected, actual });
    }
  };

  for (const { name, input } of cases) {
    check(name, "validatePage", (validator) =>
      validator.validatePage(structuredClone(input))
    );
    check(name, "validatePageJson", (validator) =>
      validator.validatePageJson(JSON.stringify(input))
    );
  }

  for (const { name, raw } of raws) {
    check(name, "validatePageJson", (validator) =>
      validator.validatePageJson(raw)
    );
  }

  return failures;
}

const short = (value) => JSON.stringify(value).slice(0, 300);

// Node runs the real path of a symlinked script, so compare real paths
const isMain =
  process.argv[1] !== undefined &&
  realpathSync(process.argv[1]) ===
    realpathSync(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));

if (isMain) {
  const root = resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");
  const dist = join(root, "packages/blocks/dist");
  const bundlePath = join(dist, "validator.edge.mjs");
  const metaPath = join(dist, "validator.edge.meta.json");

  if (!existsSync(bundlePath) || !existsSync(metaPath)) {
    console.error(
      `check:edge: ${bundlePath} or its metafile not found. Run pnpm build first.`
    );
    process.exit(1);
  }

  const bytes = readFileSync(bundlePath);
  const source = bytes.toString("utf8");
  const metafile = JSON.parse(readFileSync(metaPath, "utf8"));
  const problems = [];

  // 1. no imports, no React, Tiptap or node: modules
  const output = metafile.outputs["dist/validator.edge.mjs"];

  if (!output || output.bytes !== bytes.length) {
    problems.push(
      "the metafile does not describe this bundle; run pnpm build again"
    );
  }

  problems.push(...metafileImports(metafile), ...findSourceProblems(source));

  // 2. size
  const gzipped = gzipSize(bytes);

  console.log(
    `check:edge: validator.edge.mjs is ${bytes.length} bytes, ${gzipped} bytes gzipped (limit ${GZIP_LIMIT})`
  );

  if (gzipped > GZIP_LIMIT) {
    problems.push(
      `gzipped size ${gzipped} exceeds ${GZIP_LIMIT} bytes; check the metafile for code that does not belong in the validator (views, the editor, zod locales)`
    );
  }

  // 3. same results as the source
  const cases = JSON.parse(
    readFileSync(
      join(root, "packages/blocks/src/__fixtures__/validator-cases.json"),
      "utf8"
    )
  );
  let bundle;
  let original;

  try {
    bundle = await import(pathToFileURL(bundlePath).href);
  } catch (error) {
    problems.push(`importing the bundle failed: ${error.message}`);
  }

  try {
    // tsx (a root devDependency) loads the TypeScript source with its
    // workspace imports, the way jest runs it in validator.spec.ts
    const { tsImport } = await import("tsx/esm/api");

    original = await tsImport(
      join(root, "packages/blocks/src/validator.ts"),
      import.meta.url
    );
  } catch (error) {
    problems.push(`loading the source with tsx failed: ${error.message}`);
  }

  const usable = (validator) =>
    typeof validator?.validatePage === "function" &&
    typeof validator?.validatePageJson === "function" &&
    typeof validator?.DEFAULT_LIMITS === "object";
  let raws = [];

  if (bundle && !usable(bundle)) {
    problems.push(
      "the bundle does not export validatePage, validatePageJson and DEFAULT_LIMITS"
    );
  } else if (bundle) {
    raws = rawInputs(bundle.DEFAULT_LIMITS);

    for (const failure of compareCases(bundle, cases)) {
      problems.push(
        `case "${failure.name}" (${failure.fn}): expected ${short(
          failure.expected
        )}, got ${short(failure.actual)}`
      );
    }

    problems.push(...checkRawCodes(bundle, raws));

    if (original && usable(original)) {
      for (const failure of compareWithSource(original, bundle, cases, raws)) {
        problems.push(
          `"${failure.name}" (${
            failure.fn
          }) differs from the source: source ${short(
            failure.expected
          )}, bundle ${short(failure.actual)}`
        );
      }
    } else if (original) {
      problems.push("src/validator.ts does not export the validator");
    }
  }

  if (problems.length > 0) {
    console.error("check:edge: the edge validator bundle failed:");
    for (const problem of problems) console.error(`  ${problem}`);
    process.exit(1);
  }

  console.log(
    `check:edge: OK (no imports, ${cases.length} cases and ${raws.length} generated inputs match the source)`
  );
}
```

建立 `packages/blocks/scripts/build-edge.mjs`：

```js
// Bundles the page validator (the 8 block specs, packages/spec's validator,
// zod and @tzuchi/tceditor/rules) into dist/validator.edge.mjs: one ES module
// with no imports, for the Edge Function in S3 (spec §6.4). Needs core's dist
// (turbo builds core first). `pnpm check:edge` checks the result.
//
// Usage: node scripts/build-edge.mjs (the package's "build" script)
import { build } from "esbuild";
import { writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { dirname, join } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const packageDir = join(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");

const result = await build({
  absWorkingDir: packageDir,
  entryPoints: ["src/validator.ts"],
  outfile: "dist/validator.edge.mjs",
  bundle: true,
  format: "esm",
  platform: "neutral",
  target: "es2022",
  minify: true,
  // "neutral" sets no main fields and no platform conditions. Every package
  // in the bundle has an exports map, which esbuild reads with the "import"
  // and "default" conditions: zod resolves to its ESM index.js and
  // @tzuchi/tceditor/rules to core's dist/rules.mjs (see the metafile). The
  // empty list keeps esbuild from adding the "module" condition.
  mainFields: ["module", "main"],
  conditions: [],
  metafile: true,
  logLevel: "warning",
});

// Kept next to the bundle: `pnpm check:edge` reads its imports, and
// https://esbuild.github.io/analyze/ shows what takes up the size
writeFileSync(
  join(packageDir, "dist/validator.edge.meta.json"),
  `${JSON.stringify(result.metafile, null, 2)}\n`
);
```

把 `build` 加成 blocks 的第一個 script：

```bash
const file = "packages/blocks/package.json";
const pkg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8"));
pkg.scripts = { build: "node scripts/build-edge.mjs", ...pkg.scripts };
fs.writeFileSync(file, JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2) + "\n");
'
node -p 'JSON.stringify(require("./packages/blocks/package.json").scripts)'
```

- [ ] **Step 10: 失敗時怎麼處理**（只在 Step 8 或 Step 11 失敗時看）
- `case "<名稱>" (validatePage): expected …, got …`：打包版的 code 與案例的 `expect` 不同。先跑 `pnpm --filter @tzuchi/tceditor-blocks test -t "validator-cases.json"`：原始碼版也失敗，表示 Task 9／10 的行為與案例不一致（路徑慣例見共用介面 C.2）；原始碼版通過，則比對 metafile 的 inputs 是否解析到過期的 `packages/core/dist`（重跑 `pnpm build`）。
- `"<名稱>" (<函式>) differs from the source: source …, bundle …`：兩邊的結果不同（可能只差在 `data`、`notices` 或 `message`）。通常是 bundle 用了過期的 `packages/core/dist/rules.mjs`（重跑 `pnpm build`），或兩邊解析到不同版本的 zod（`pnpm why zod`；整個 lockfile 只能有一份 `zod@4.6.5`，見 Global Constraints 的 override）。
- `raw input "<名稱>": expected …, got …`：打包版處理原始請求的方式不對（大小以 UTF-8 位元組計、`Uint8Array` 的解碼、區塊數上限）。原始碼版通常也一樣錯，因為上一種問題沒有出現；回到 Task 9 的 `validatePageJson` 修正。
- `loading the source with tsx failed: …`：root 沒有安裝 `tsx`（Task 12 Step 2），或 `src/validator.ts` 的 import 解析不到；先執行 `pnpm install`。
- `<output> imports <module>`：某個依賴被當成外部模組留下來。用 metafile 找出是哪個檔 import 它；不要在 `build-edge.mjs` 加 `external`。
- `"react" at …`／`"@tiptap" at …`：`src/validator.ts` 的依賴鏈碰到了 view、render 設定或 core 主入口。
- `node: module at …`：bundle 裡有 import／require Node 內建模組的寫法（判斷與 `check:bundle` 的 `NODE_IMPORT` 相同）。用 metafile 找出是哪個依賴帶進來的；Edge Function 沒有這些模組。

### Task 14: 區塊 Storybook 與 `storybook:smoke`

目的：新增 `apps/storybook`（`@tzuchi/tceditor-storybook`）。它用 Storybook 10.6.0（react-vite）載入 Task 12 在 `packages/blocks` 產生的 stories，套用慈濟主題，工具列可以切換「慈濟」與「慈濟深色」。示範圖片取自示範站的 `public/demo-assets`。`pnpm storybook` 在 `127.0.0.1:6010` 啟動，`pnpm storybook:build` 只 build Storybook，`pnpm build` 會一併產生 `apps/storybook/storybook-static`。另外新增 root script `pnpm storybook:smoke`：在 `127.0.0.1:6008` 提供 build 產物，用 puppeteer 逐一開啟每個 story 與文件頁，再用深色主題開一次第一個 story。任何頁面錯誤、console error、Storybook 錯誤畫面、缺少的區塊或 story、主題樣式沒有套用（含深色主題），以及對其他網域的請求，都會讓它失敗。它不需要瀏覽器的判斷邏輯由 `scripts/storybook-smoke.test.mjs` 測試，放在 `pnpm test` 裡。從本 task 起，`pnpm verify` 也會執行 smoke。Storybook CLI 一律在 `HOME=apps/storybook/.home` 下執行，也不送出遙測、錯誤回報、版本檢查與「新功能」請求。

**執行位置**：主工作目錄 `/Users/kaellim/Desktop/projects/puck`，分支 `s2/block-spec`。需要網路的步驟：Step 7 的 `pnpm install`，以及 Step 14 `pnpm verify` 裡的 `pnpm audit:gate`。

**設計決定與說明**：

- **版本與設定檔以預檢為準**：
  - `storybook`、`@storybook/react-vite`、`@storybook/addon-docs`、`@storybook/addon-a11y` 都是 `10.6.0`。其他版本：`vite` `7.3.5`、`@vitejs/plugin-react` `5.2.0`、`@tailwindcss/vite` 與 `tailwindcss` `4.3.3`、react 與 react-dom `19.2.6`（Global Constraints）。
  - `main.ts`、`preview.tsx`、`tsconfig.json` 以 facts/preflight.md §5.1 實測可用的版本為基礎。該版本的 build 與瀏覽器檢查都通過（§5.2、§5.3）。
  - stories 用 `@tzuchi/tceditor/rsc` 的 `Render`，由 Task 12 產生（規格 §18 #5）。預檢已證實它在 Storybook 的瀏覽器端可以運作，畫出的 HTML 和公開頁逐字相同（facts/preflight.md §0 #7）。
- **路徑以 `.storybook/` 為基準**：
  - stories 寫成 `../../../packages/blocks/src/**/*.stories.tsx`。如果寫成 `../../packages/...`，會解析成 `apps/packages/...`。這時 build 仍然 exit 0，只印出 `No story files found`（facts/preflight.md §0 #2），所以 smoke 第一件事就是檢查 `index.json`。
  - `staticDirs` 同樣以 configDir 為基準（Storybook 的 `copyAllStaticFilesRelativeToMain`）。build 時印出 `Copying static files: ../showcase/public/demo-assets`，路徑是相對 `apps/storybook`。
  - `staticDirs` 只對應 `apps/showcase/public/demo-assets` → `/demo-assets`，和示範站的網址相同（`DEMO_ASSETS` 的 `src` 是 `/demo-assets/demo-<n>.svg`，C.3）。
- **`viteFinal` 加入 `react()` 與 `tailwindcss()`**（規格 §18 #11）：
  - react-vite 不會自己加 `@vitejs/plugin-react`。缺少它時，sibling 套件裡的 stories 會以 classic JSX 編譯，執行時出現 `React is not defined`（facts/frameworks.md §0.2、§3.2）。
  - `@tailwindcss/vite` 負責處理 `@tzuchi/tceditor-blocks/styles.css`。這個入口在 app 目錄之外，實測也會被處理（facts/preflight.md §0 #6）。少了它 build 會失敗（postcss-import 錯誤），不必靠 smoke 把關。
- **`typescript.reactDocgen: false`**（規格 §9）：argTypes 由規格產生（Task 12），docgen 讀不到中文標籤。
- **不對外連線**：
  - 設定 `core.disableTelemetry`、`disableWhatsNewNotifications: true`、`enableCrashReports: false`。wrapper 另外設 `STORYBOOK_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1`（Global Constraints；gaps #39）。
  - 用一個記錄 Node `fetch` 的 `--import` 預載檔實測，發現兩個請求：
    - **版本檢查**：`storybook dev` 不加參數時，啟動就會 fetch `https://storybook.js.org/versions.json?current=10.6.0`。這是 `storybook/dist/core-server/index.js` 的 `updateCheck`，每天一次。
    - **新功能資料**：打開 Storybook UI 時，dev 伺服器會 fetch `https://storybook.js.org/whats-new/v1`。`core-server/presets/common-preset.js` 的 `initializeWhatsNew` 先送出請求，之後才讀 `disableWhatsNewNotifications`，所以這個設定只會隱藏通知，擋不住請求。
  - 對應的處理：
    - dev 指令加 `--no-version-updates`。
    - `main.ts` 的 `experimental_serverChannel` 先移除 Storybook 的 whats-new 處理函式，再改成在本機直接回 `{ status: "ERROR" }`，UI 只是不顯示「新功能」通知。main.ts 本身是最後一個 preset，所以它在 Storybook 註冊自己的處理函式之後才執行。
    - 實測結果：重新啟動 dev 並打開 UI 之後，記錄檔是空的。`storybook build` 本來就沒有任何對外請求（實測）。
  - `experimental_serverChannel` 與 `storybook/internal/*` 是 Storybook 的內部介面，`StorybookConfig` 沒有宣告，所以 `main.ts` 自己補上型別。版本鎖定在 10.6.0；升級時要重新驗證。萬一失效，只會恢復那一個 GET 請求，不影響功能。
- **`HOME` 隔離**（規格 §9、Global Constraints）：
  - `apps/storybook/scripts/storybook.mjs` 只對 Storybook CLI 這個子程序設定 `HOME=apps/storybook/.home` 與 `STORYBOOK_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1`。
  - 規格 §9 的 `pnpm storybook` 與 `pnpm storybook:build` 都是 root script，各自呼叫 app 的 `dev`、`build`，也就是都經過 wrapper。`pnpm build`（turbo）呼叫的也是 app 的 `build`。
  - 實測：build 只寫入 `.home/.storybook/settings.json`，dev 另外加上 `checklist`。使用者的 `~/.storybook/settings.json` 修改時間不變。
  - puppeteer 要用真正的 `HOME`，才找得到 `~/.cache/puppeteer` 裡的 Chrome 148（facts/frameworks.md §0.9）。所以 smoke 是 root script，不經過 wrapper。
  - turbo 2.9 會把 `HOME` 傳給 task：實測在 `turbo run` 底下執行的 task 印出 `HOME=/Users/kaellim`（gaps #38 關閉）。在 turbo 底下 build Storybook 時，wrapper 一樣會把它改成 `.home`。
- **dev 用 port 6010**（規格 §18 #11）：
  - wrapper 先用 `lsof -nP -iTCP:6010 -sTCP:LISTEN` 檢查。已經有程式在監聽時，印出 lsof 的輸出並 exit 1，不會改用別的 port。
  - Storybook 帶 `--ci` 時，若 port 被佔用，會**默默改用下一個 port**（`buildDevStandalone` 只在非 CI 模式才詢問）。所以另外加 `--exact-port` 當第二道防線，沒有 lsof 的環境也有效。實測 port 被佔用時 exit 1。
  - 帶 `--host 127.0.0.1` 時，lsof 只看到 `127.0.0.1:6010`。banner 仍然印出 `Local: http://localhost:6010/`（facts/frameworks.md §5.3）。
  - wrapper 會轉送 SIGINT 與 SIGTERM。`kill` wrapper 或 `pnpm storybook` 的 PID，都會停掉 Storybook 並釋放 port（實測兩種都可以）。
  - Storybook 失敗時，會在 cwd 留下 `debug-storybook.log`（以 `--exact-port` 測試時出現），所以 `.gitignore` 也要忽略它。
- **主題與語言**：
  - preview 的 decorator 在 render 時直接設定 `<html data-theme>` 與 `lang="zh-Hant"`，第一次繪製就有主題。切換工具列會重新 render story，decorator 會再執行一次，所以不需要 `useEffect`。docs 頁也會執行 decorator。
  - 工具列的項目是 `tzuchi`「慈濟」與 `tzuchi-dark`「慈濟深色」，`initialGlobals` 是 `tzuchi`（facts/frameworks.md §3.3）。`&globals=theme:tzuchi-dark` 可以切換主題（facts/preflight.md §5.3）。
  - `preview.tags: ["autodocs"]`，每個區塊都有文件頁（規格 §5.3）。
- **`storybook:smoke` 的做法**（規格 §13.1、§13.3 #4、§18 #16）：
  - **執行時機**：它是 root script，排在 `verify` 的 `pnpm build` 之後，檢查 build 產物。位置在 `check:edge` 之後、`audit:gate` 之前。
  - **先檢查 build 產物**：
    - `index.json` 不存在：還沒 build，立刻 exit 1。
    - `iframe.html` 不存在：上一次 Storybook build 失敗。Storybook 會先寫 manager 與 `index.json`，preview 失敗時沒有 `iframe.html`；不先擋下來，每個 entry 都要等到逾時，29 個 entry 約 10 分鐘（實測）。實測擋下後 0.2 秒結束。
  - **靜態伺服器**：
    - 自帶靜態伺服器，只綁 `127.0.0.1:6008`（facts/frameworks.md §5.1），並檢查要求的路徑不能跳出 `storybook-static`。
    - port 被佔用時，先由 lsof 檢查擋下，再由 `listen` 的 `EADDRINUSE` 擋下。
    - `/favicon.ico` 回 204。`iframe.html` 沒有 favicon，Chrome 會自己去要，回 404 就會變成 console error（facts/frameworks.md §0.4）。回 204 之後，其餘所有 404 與 console error 都算失敗，不必另外處理例外。
  - **比對 `index.json` 與 catalog**：和 `packages/blocks/generated/catalog.json`（Task 12）比對。
    - 每個區塊都要有 `blocks-<kebab>--docs`（title 為 `區塊/<label>`，規格 §5.3）與 `blocks-<kebab>--default`。
    - 每個區塊的 story 至少要有 1 + 範例數個，story 總數至少是 8 + 範例總數。
    - 區塊清單取自 catalog，不在腳本裡另外寫一份。
  - **逐一開啟 entry**：每個 entry 開 `iframe.html?id=…&viewMode=story|docs`，用 Storybook 的 channel 事件判斷是否完成（facts/frameworks.md §5.2）。只看 body class 不夠：facts/frameworks.md §0.3 指出，拋錯的 story 也會送出 `storyRendered`，docs 頁裡拋錯的 story 也不會改變 body class。
    - 頁面本身回 HTTP ≥ 400 時，直接記一筆 `could not load …: HTTP <status>`，不再等待。
    - 等待條件：story 等 `storyFinished`（或 `storyErrored`、`storyMissing`）。docs 等 `docsRendered`，再等到 `storyFinished` 的次數不少於頁面上 `.sb-story` 的數量。最多等 20 秒，之後再等 300 ms，收集最後送出的 console error。
    - 失敗條件：
      - `pageerror`、任何 console error、任何 HTTP ≥ 400、逾時。
      - `storyThrewException`、`storyErrored`、`storyMissing`、`playFunctionThrewException` 事件。
      - `body.sb-show-errordisplay` 或 `sb-show-nopreview`。
      - docs 頁出現 `.sb-story > pre`：Storybook 會把 inline story 的錯誤畫成這個元素（facts/frameworks.md §5）。
      - `<html data-theme>` 不是開啟時指定的主題，或 `<html lang>` 不是 `zh-Hant`。
      - **主題樣式沒有套用**：`data-theme` 是 decorator 自己設的，只檢查屬性永遠會通過（實測：刪掉 `preview.tsx` 的 styles.css import，build 仍然成功，畫面卻完全沒有樣式）。所以在頁面裡讀 `<html>` 的 `--accent`：
        - 空字串：主題樣式表沒有載入。
        - 和移除 `data-theme` 之後的值相同：沒有任何主題規則對應這個 `data-theme`（例如 vendor 更新後 selector 改名），畫面用的是 HeroUI 的預設主題。HeroUI 預設主題把 `--accent` 放在 `:root`（`vendor/uikit/heroui/styles/themes/default/variables.css`），慈濟主題放在 `[data-theme="tzuchi"]` 與 `[data-theme="tzuchi-dark"]`（`…/themes/tzuchi/variables.css`）。
        - 腳本只比較「有沒有改變」，不寫死色碼，所以調整主題顏色時不必改它。
    - **深色主題**：主迴圈之後，用 `&globals=theme:tzuchi-dark` 再開一次第一個 story（排序後是 `blocks-button--default`），套用同樣的檢查。另外深色的 `--accent` 不能和淺色那次相同。結果印成一行 `theme switch (blocks-button--default, tzuchi-dark): ok`，不算進表格與總結行的 entry 數；失敗時總結行仍然是 `0 failed`，但最後印出 `storybook:smoke FAILED`。
    - 對外請求：攔截頁面的所有請求。`http://127.0.0.1:6008/`、`data:`、`blob:` 以外的請求一律中止，並記為失敗，所以 smoke 本身也不會連到第三方。
    - 區塊內容：
      - story 頁從 `storyPrepared` 事件的 `args` 取出所有含中文的字串。Storybook 10.6.0 的 `preview/runtime.js` 會送出 `{ id, parameters, initialArgs, argTypes, args }`。
      - `alt` 不算：圖片不存在或是純裝飾時，替代文字不會顯示。
      - 這些字串至少要有一個出現在 `#storybook-root` 的文字，或 `alt`、`title`、`aria-label` 屬性中。
      - args 沒有中文時（例如區段、多欄、圖片的預設值），`#storybook-root` 不能是空的。
      - docs 頁的 `h1` 要等於 title 的最後一段，也就是區塊的中文名稱，而且頁面上至少要有一個 story。
    - 這只是「畫得出來、沒有錯誤、主題有套用」的冒煙檢查。畫面細節由 Task 11 的 `render.spec.tsx` 負責。
  - **可測試的結構**：和 `scripts/check-edge.mjs`（Task 13）、`packages/core/scripts/check-bundle-imports.mjs` 一樣，不需要瀏覽器的判斷都是 export 的純函式：`kebab`、`checkIndex`、`chineseTexts`、`pageProblems`（判斷 `readPage()` 讀到的頁面資訊）、`createStaticServer`。主程式包在 `isMain`（比對 realpath）之下，puppeteer 在主程式裡才動態 import，所以 `node --test` 載入它時不會開瀏覽器、不會綁 6008。`scripts/storybook-smoke.test.mjs` 有 11 個測試，放進 root `test`，`checkIndex` 之類的檢查退化時 `pnpm verify` 就會失敗（以 4 種刻意的退化實測，每種都讓測試失敗）。
  - **結果輸出**：每個 entry 印一行表格，然後是深色主題那一行，最後印出總結；有任何失敗就 exit 1。瀏覽器與伺服器一律在 `finally` 中關閉。
  - **實測**（真正的 Task 12 stories：8 個區塊、13 個範例、29 個 entry）：每個 entry 約 0.7 秒，全部約 23 秒。下列情況都會失敗，並指出原因：會拋錯、載入外站圖片、載入不存在圖片的 story；少一個區塊；glob 寫錯；主題錯誤；主題樣式表沒載入；淺色或深色主題的 selector 對不上；上一次 build 失敗。
- **turbo**：
  - `build.outputs` 加入 `storybook-static/**`（C.5）。快取命中時，turbo 會還原 `storybook-static`（實測：刪掉後重跑是 `cache hit`，檔案也回來了）。
  - turbo 的 task hash 只包含套件本身的檔案，以及它所依賴 task 的 hash。`packages/spec` 沒有 build task，`vendor/uikit` 與 `apps/showcase/public/demo-assets` 也不屬於任何依賴套件。這些檔案改了，Storybook 的 build 仍會命中舊快取。
  - 所以新增 `@tzuchi/tceditor-storybook#build`，在 `inputs` 加入上述路徑，以及 `packages/blocks/src/**`、`packages/blocks/styles.css`。turbo 的套件專屬設定不會繼承 `build`，所以 `dependsOn` 與 `outputs` 要再寫一次。
  - 實測：在 vendor 加一個檔，結果變成 `cache miss`；`--dry=json` 顯示 inputs 不含 `node_modules`、`.home`、`storybook-static`。
- **忽略設定**：
  - ESLint 的全域忽略 `**/storybook-static/**`、`apps/storybook/.home/**` 已由 Task 7 加入（C.4），所以 `eslint .` 只檢查 `.storybook/main.ts`、`.storybook/preview.tsx`、`scripts/storybook.mjs` 這三個檔（實測）。
  - 本 task 修改 `.gitignore`（`.home/`、`debug-storybook.log`、`storybook-static/`）與 `.prettierignore`（`storybook-static/`）（gaps #40）。Prettier 的 glob 涵蓋 `.storybook/` 這種點開頭的目錄（實測）。
- **workspace**：`pnpm-workspace.yaml` 的 `packages` 加入 `apps/storybook`。
- **lint 與型別檢查**：
  - `lint` 是 `eslint .`，用 root 的 flat config（gaps C1）。devDependencies 照 Task 7 的 `packages/spec`，宣告 `eslint` `9.39.4` 與 `eslint-config-custom`。
  - `typecheck` 是 `tsc --noEmit`，只檢查 `.storybook/*`。stories 由 blocks 自己的 typecheck 檢查（Task 12）。
- **文件**：`apps/storybook/README.md` 先寫最小說明，由 Task 17 整檔改寫。和 tceditor 自己寫的其他 README（root、`CONTRIBUTING.md`、`apps/demo`、`infra/supabase`）一樣用繁體中文。`CHANGELOG.md` 加一行。

**Files:**
- Create: `apps/storybook/package.json`
- Create: `apps/storybook/.storybook/main.ts`
- Create: `apps/storybook/.storybook/preview.tsx`
- Create: `apps/storybook/scripts/storybook.mjs`
- Create: `apps/storybook/tsconfig.json`

  - `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 的 `packages`（Task 14 之後）：`  - "apps/demo"`、`  - "apps/storybook"`、`  - "packages/*"` 三行。Task 15 在 `apps/demo` 之後插入 `  - "apps/showcase"`。

```js
import assert from "node:assert/strict";

test("createStaticServer serves the build and refuses paths outside it", async () => {
  const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "storybook-smoke-"));
  const root = join(dir, "static");
  mkdirSync(join(root, "demo-assets"), { recursive: true });
  writeFileSync(join(root, "index.html"), "<p>index</p>");
  writeFileSync(join(root, "demo-assets", "demo-1.svg"), "<svg/>");
  writeFileSync(join(dir, "secret.txt"), "secret");
  const server = createStaticServer(root);
  await new Promise((done) => server.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", done));
  const { port } = server.address();
  const get = (path) =>
    new Promise((done, reject) => {
      http
        .get({ host: "127.0.0.1", port, path }, (res) => {
          let body = "";
          res.setEncoding("utf8");
          res.on("data", (chunk) => (body += chunk));
          res.on("end", () =>
            done({
              status: res.statusCode,
              type: res.headers["content-type"],
              body,
            })
          );
        })
        .on("error", reject);
    });

  try {
    assert.deepEqual(await get("/"), {
      status: 200,
      type: "text/html; charset=utf-8",
      body: "<p>index</p>",
    });
    assert.equal((await get("/demo-assets/demo-1.svg")).type, "image/svg+xml");
    assert.equal((await get("/favicon.ico")).status, 204);
    assert.equal((await get("/missing.svg")).status, 404);
    assert.equal((await get("/demo-assets")).status, 404);
    assert.equal((await get("/..%2fsecret.txt")).status, 403);
    assert.equal((await get("/%E0%A4%A")).status, 400);
  } finally {
    server.closeAllConnections();
    await new Promise((done) => server.close(done));
    rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
});
```
