建立 `scripts/storybook-smoke.mjs`：

```js
// Opens every entry of the built block Storybook in Chrome and fails when a
// story or docs page errors, a block or story is missing, the Tzu Chi theme
// is not applied, or a page requests anything from another origin. Needs a
// build first (pnpm build builds apps/storybook); it is part of pnpm verify.
//
//   pnpm storybook:smoke
//
// It serves apps/storybook/storybook-static itself on http://127.0.0.1:6008,
// so no Storybook has to be running. Run it with the real HOME: puppeteer
// looks for its browser in ~/.cache/puppeteer. The checks that need no
// browser are exported for scripts/storybook-smoke.test.mjs.
import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import {
  createReadStream,
  existsSync,
  readFileSync,
  realpathSync,
  statSync,
} from "node:fs";
import http from "node:http";
import { dirname, extname, join, normalize, resolve, sep } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const HOST = "127.0.0.1";
const PORT = 6008;
const BASE = `http://${HOST}:${PORT}`;
const EXPECTED_THEME = "tzuchi";
const SWITCHED_THEME = "tzuchi-dark";
const EXPECTED_LANG = "zh-Hant";
const WAIT_MS = 20000;

const CONTENT_TYPES = {
  ".css": "text/css; charset=utf-8",
  ".html": "text/html; charset=utf-8",
  ".js": "text/javascript; charset=utf-8",
  ".json": "application/json; charset=utf-8",
  ".mjs": "text/javascript; charset=utf-8",
  ".png": "image/png",
  ".svg": "image/svg+xml",
  ".woff2": "font/woff2",
};

// Storybook channel events recorded on every page.
const EVENTS = [
  "storyPrepared",
  "storyRendered",
  "storyFinished",
  "storyErrored",
  "storyMissing",
  "storyThrewException",
  "playFunctionThrewException",
  "docsRendered",
];
const FAILURE_EVENTS = [
  "storyErrored",
  "storyMissing",
  "storyThrewException",
  "playFunctionThrewException",
];
const CHINESE = /[㐀-鿿豈-﫿]/;

function short(text) {
  return String(text).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().slice(0, 200);
}

/** "TagList" → "tag-list", the way the generated stories name their meta id. */
export function kebab(type) {
  return type.replace(/([a-z0-9])([A-Z])/g, "$1-$2").toLowerCase();
}

/** Compares index.json with the block catalog; returns the problems found. */
export function checkIndex(entries, catalog) {
  const problems = [];
  if (entries.length === 0) {
    problems.push(
      "index.json has no entries: check the stories glob in apps/storybook/.storybook/main.ts"
    );
  }
  const byId = new Map(entries.map((entry) => [entry.id, entry]));
  const storyIds = entries
    .filter((entry) => entry.type === "story")
    .map((entry) => entry.id);
  let expectedStories = 0;
  for (const block of catalog.blocks) {
    const prefix = `blocks-${kebab(block.type)}`;
    const wanted = 1 + block.examples.length;
    expectedStories += wanted;
    const docs = byId.get(`${prefix}--docs`);
    if (docs?.type !== "docs") {
      problems.push(`${block.type}: no docs entry ${prefix}--docs`);
    } else if (docs.title !== `區塊/${block.label}`) {
      problems.push(
        `${block.type}: title is "${docs.title}", expected "區塊/${block.label}"`
      );
    }
    if (byId.get(`${prefix}--default`)?.type !== "story") {
      problems.push(`${block.type}: no story ${prefix}--default`);
    }
    const count = storyIds.filter((id) => id.startsWith(`${prefix}--`)).length;
    if (count < wanted) {
      problems.push(
        `${block.type}: ${count} stories, expected at least ${wanted} (default + ${block.examples.length} examples)`
      );
    }
  }
  if (storyIds.length < expectedStories) {
    problems.push(
      `${storyIds.length} stories in total, expected at least ${expectedStories}`
    );
  }
  return problems;
}

/**
 * Every string in the story's args that contains Chinese text, except image
 * alt texts: those are not shown while the image is missing or decorative.
 */
export function chineseTexts(value, found = []) {
  if (typeof value === "string") {
    const text = value.trim();
    if (CHINESE.test(text)) found.push(text);
  } else if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    for (const item of value) chineseTexts(item, found);
  } else if (value !== null && typeof value === "object") {
    for (const [key, item] of Object.entries(value)) {
      if (key !== "alt") chineseTexts(item, found);
    }
  }
  return found;
}

/**
 * Judges what readPage() found on one entry; returns the problems and a short
 * note for the table. `theme` is the theme the page was opened with and
 * `title` the entry's title from index.json.
 */
export function pageProblems(info, { viewMode, theme, title }) {
  const problems = [];
  let note = "";
  for (const name of FAILURE_EVENTS) {
    if (info.events.includes(name)) problems.push(`Storybook event ${name}`);
  }
  if (/\bsb-show-(errordisplay|nopreview)\b/.test(info.bodyClass)) {
    problems.push(
      `Storybook error screen: ${short(info.errorMessage) || info.bodyClass}`
    );
  }
  if (info.theme !== theme) {
    problems.push(`<html data-theme> is ${info.theme}, not ${theme}`);
  }
  if (info.lang !== EXPECTED_LANG) {
    problems.push(`<html lang> is "${info.lang}", not ${EXPECTED_LANG}`);
  }
  // The decorator sets data-theme itself, so also check that the theme's CSS
  // applies: --accent must be set, and differ from HeroUI's default theme.
  if (info.accent === "") {
    problems.push(
      "the theme stylesheet is not applied: --accent is empty on <html>"
    );
  } else if (info.accent === info.unthemedAccent) {
    problems.push(
      `data-theme="${theme}" does not change --accent (${info.accent}): no theme rule matches it`
    );
  }

  if (viewMode === "story") {
    const texts = chineseTexts(info.args);
    const shown = [info.rootText, ...info.rootAttributes].join("\n");
    const seen = texts.find((text) => shown.includes(text));
    if (info.args === null) {
      problems.push("no storyPrepared event, so the args are unknown");
    } else if (seen !== undefined) {
      note = `shows "${short(seen).slice(0, 24)}"`;
    } else if (texts.length > 0) {
      problems.push(
        `none of the texts in the args is shown: ${texts
          .slice(0, 3)
          .map((text) => `"${short(text).slice(0, 24)}"`)
          .join(", ")}`
      );
    } else if (info.rootElements === 0) {
      problems.push("#storybook-root is empty");
    } else {
      note = "rendered (no Chinese text in the args)";
    }
  } else {
    const heading = title.split("/").pop();
    if (info.docsTitle !== heading) {
      problems.push(`docs heading is "${info.docsTitle}", not "${heading}"`);
    }
    if (info.docsStories === 0) problems.push("docs page shows no stories");
    for (const text of info.docsErrors) {
      problems.push(`story error on the docs page: ${short(text)}`);
    }
    note = `"${info.docsTitle}", ${info.docsStories} stories`;
  }
  return { problems, note };
}

/**
 * A static file server for the Storybook build. It answers /favicon.ico with
 * 204 (iframe.html links no favicon, so Chrome asks for it) so that every
 * remaining 404 is a real problem, and refuses paths outside `root`.
 */
export function createStaticServer(root) {
  return http.createServer((req, res) => {
    const url = new URL(req.url ?? "/", BASE);
    if (url.pathname === "/favicon.ico") {
      res.writeHead(204).end();
      return;
    }
    let pathname;
    try {
      pathname = decodeURIComponent(url.pathname);
    } catch {
      res.writeHead(400).end();
      return;
    }
    if (pathname.endsWith("/")) pathname += "index.html";
    const file = normalize(join(root, pathname));
    if (!file.startsWith(root + sep)) {
      res.writeHead(403).end();
      return;
    }
    let stat;
    try {
      stat = statSync(file);
    } catch {
      res.writeHead(404).end();
      return;
    }
    if (!stat.isFile()) {
      res.writeHead(404).end();
      return;
    }
    res.writeHead(200, {
      "content-length": stat.size,
      "content-type":
        CONTENT_TYPES[extname(file)] ?? "application/octet-stream",
    });
    createReadStream(file).pipe(res);
  });
}

// The functions below run inside the page (page.evaluate).

function storySettled() {
  const done = ["storyFinished", "storyErrored", "storyMissing"];
  return (window.__smokeEvents ?? []).some((event) =>
    done.includes(event.name)
  );
}

function docsSettled() {
  const events = window.__smokeEvents ?? [];
  if (!events.some((event) => event.name === "docsRendered")) return false;
  const inline = document.querySelectorAll("#storybook-docs .sb-story").length;
  const finished = events.filter((event) => event.name === "storyFinished");
  return inline > 0 && finished.length >= inline;
}

function readPage() {
  const html = document.documentElement;
  const root = document.querySelector("#storybook-root");
  const docs = document.querySelector("#storybook-docs");
  const events = window.__smokeEvents ?? [];
  const attributes = ["alt", "title", "aria-label"];
  const accentOf = () =>
    getComputedStyle(html).getPropertyValue("--accent").trim();
  // --accent without any data-theme (HeroUI's default theme), read by
  // removing the attribute for a moment.
  const theme = html.getAttribute("data-theme");
  const accent = accentOf();
  html.removeAttribute("data-theme");
  const unthemedAccent = accentOf();
  if (theme !== null) html.setAttribute("data-theme", theme);
  return {
    events: events.map((event) => event.name),
    args: events.find((event) => event.name === "storyPrepared")?.args ?? null,
    bodyClass: document.body.className,
    errorMessage: document.querySelector("#error-message")?.textContent ?? "",
    theme,
    lang: html.lang,
    accent,
    unthemedAccent,
    rootText: root?.textContent ?? "",
    rootAttributes: root
      ? [...root.querySelectorAll("[alt], [title], [aria-label]")].flatMap(
          (element) =>
            attributes.map((name) => element.getAttribute(name) ?? "")
        )
      : [],
    rootElements: root?.childElementCount ?? 0,
    docsTitle: docs?.querySelector("h1")?.textContent?.trim() ?? null,
    docsStories: docs ? docs.querySelectorAll(".sb-story").length : 0,
    docsErrors: docs
      ? [...docs.querySelectorAll(".sb-story > pre")].map(
          (element) => element.textContent
        )
      : [],
  };
}

/** The lsof lines for a listener on the port, "" when free, null without lsof. */
function listenerOn(port) {
  const result = spawnSync("lsof", ["-nP", `-iTCP:${port}`, "-sTCP:LISTEN"], {
    encoding: "utf8",
  });
  if (result.error) return null;
  return result.status === 0 ? result.stdout.trim() : "";
}

function listen(server) {
  return new Promise((resolveListen, reject) => {
    server.once("error", reject);
    server.listen(PORT, HOST, () => {
      server.off("error", reject);
      resolveListen();
    });
  });
}

async function checkEntry(browser, entry, theme = EXPECTED_THEME) {
  const problems = [];
  const page = await browser.newPage();
  try {
    await page.setRequestInterception(true);
    page.on("request", (request) => {
      const url = request.url();
      if (
        url.startsWith(`${BASE}/`) ||
        url.startsWith("data:") ||
        url.startsWith("blob:")
      ) {
        request.continue();
      } else {
        problems.push(`request to another origin: ${short(url)}`);
        request.abort();
      }
    });
    page.on("pageerror", (error) =>
      problems.push(`page error: ${short(error.message)}`)
    );
    page.on("console", (message) => {
      if (message.type() === "error") {
        problems.push(`console error: ${short(message.text())}`);
      }
    });
    page.on("response", (response) => {
      if (response.status() >= 400) {
        problems.push(`HTTP ${response.status()}: ${short(response.url())}`);
      }
    });
    await page.evaluateOnNewDocument((names) => {
      window.__smokeEvents = [];
      const timer = setInterval(() => {
        const channel = window.__STORYBOOK_ADDONS_CHANNEL__;
        if (!channel) return;
        clearInterval(timer);
        for (const name of names) {
          channel.on(name, (payload) => {
            window.__smokeEvents.push({
              name,
              args: name === "storyPrepared" ? payload?.args ?? null : null,
            });
          });
        }
      }, 5);
    }, EVENTS);

    const viewMode = entry.type === "docs" ? "docs" : "story";
    const globals = theme === EXPECTED_THEME ? "" : `&globals=theme:${theme}`;
    const pageUrl = `${BASE}/iframe.html?id=${encodeURIComponent(
      entry.id
    )}&viewMode=${viewMode}${globals}`;
    let response;
    try {
      response = await page.goto(pageUrl, {
        waitUntil: "load",
        timeout: WAIT_MS,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      problems.push(`could not load ${pageUrl}: ${short(error.message)}`);
      return { problems, note: "", accent: "" };
    }
    if (!response || response.status() >= 400) {
      problems.push(
        `could not load ${pageUrl}: HTTP ${response?.status() ?? "no response"}`
      );
      return { problems, note: "", accent: "" };
    }
    const settled = await page
      .waitForFunction(viewMode === "docs" ? docsSettled : storySettled, {
        timeout: WAIT_MS,
      })
      .then(
        () => true,
        () => false
      );
    if (!settled) {
      problems.push(`not rendered within ${WAIT_MS / 1000} s`);
    }
    // Let trailing console errors arrive.
    await new Promise((resolveWait) => setTimeout(resolveWait, 300));
    const info = await page.evaluate(readPage);
    const judged = pageProblems(info, { viewMode, theme, title: entry.title });
    problems.push(...judged.problems);
    return { problems, note: judged.note, accent: info.accent };
  } finally {
    await page.close();
  }
}

function printTable(rows) {
  const width = Math.max(...rows.map((row) => row.id.length));
  console.log(`${"entry".padEnd(width)}  type     ms  result`);
  for (const row of rows) {
    const result = row.problems.length === 0 ? "ok  " : "FAIL";
    console.log(
      `${row.id.padEnd(width)}  ${row.type.padEnd(5)}  ${String(
        row.ms
      ).padStart(5)}  ${result}  ${row.note}`
    );
    for (const problem of row.problems) console.log(`    - ${problem}`);
  }
}

function fail(message) {
  console.error(message);
  process.exit(1);
}

async function main() {
  const repoRoot = resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");
  const staticDir = join(repoRoot, "apps", "storybook", "storybook-static");
  const catalogFile = join(
    repoRoot,
    "packages",
    "blocks",
    "generated",
    "catalog.json"
  );

  if (!existsSync(join(staticDir, "index.json"))) {
    fail(
      "apps/storybook/storybook-static/index.json is missing. Run pnpm build first."
    );
  }
  // A failed build still writes the manager and index.json, but no preview.
  if (!existsSync(join(staticDir, "iframe.html"))) {
    fail(
      "apps/storybook/storybook-static/iframe.html is missing: the last Storybook build failed. Run pnpm build again."
    );
  }
  if (!existsSync(catalogFile)) {
    fail(
      "packages/blocks/generated/catalog.json is missing. Run pnpm gen:blocks first."
    );
  }
  const catalog = JSON.parse(readFileSync(catalogFile, "utf8"));

  const listener = listenerOn(PORT);
  if (listener) {
    fail(
      `Port ${PORT} is already in use:\n${listener}\nStop that process first.`
    );
  }
  const server = createStaticServer(staticDir);
  try {
    await listen(server);
  } catch (error) {
    fail(`Cannot listen on ${BASE}: ${error.message}`);
  }

  const { default: puppeteer } = await import("puppeteer");
  let browser;
  let failures = 0;
  try {
    const index = await (await fetch(`${BASE}/index.json`)).json();
    const entries = Object.values(index.entries ?? {}).sort((a, b) =>
      a.id < b.id ? -1 : a.id > b.id ? 1 : 0
    );
    const indexProblems = checkIndex(entries, catalog);
    for (const problem of indexProblems) console.log(`index.json: ${problem}`);
    failures += indexProblems.length;

    browser = await puppeteer.launch({ headless: true });
    const rows = [];
    for (const entry of entries) {
      const started = Date.now();
      const result = await checkEntry(browser, entry);
      rows.push({
        id: entry.id,
        type: entry.type,
        ms: Date.now() - started,
        ...result,
      });
      if (result.problems.length > 0) failures += 1;
    }
    if (rows.length > 0) printTable(rows);

    // The toolbar's dark theme: open the first story again with it.
    const first = rows.find((row) => row.type === "story");
    if (first) {
      const entry = entries.find((item) => item.id === first.id);
      const dark = await checkEntry(browser, entry, SWITCHED_THEME);
      if (dark.accent !== "" && dark.accent === first.accent) {
        dark.problems.push(
          `--accent is ${dark.accent} in both ${EXPECTED_THEME} and ${SWITCHED_THEME}`
        );
      }
      console.log(
        `theme switch (${first.id}, ${SWITCHED_THEME}): ${
          dark.problems.length === 0 ? "ok" : "FAIL"
        }`
      );
      for (const problem of dark.problems) console.log(`    - ${problem}`);
      if (dark.problems.length > 0) failures += 1;
    }

    const stories = rows.filter((row) => row.type === "story").length;
    const failed = rows.filter((row) => row.problems.length > 0).length;
    console.log(
      `${catalog.blocks.length} blocks, ${
        rows.length
      } entries (${stories} stories, ${
        rows.length - stories
      } docs pages): ${failed} failed, ${
        indexProblems.length
      } index.json problems`
    );
  } finally {
    await browser?.close();
    server.closeAllConnections();
    await new Promise((resolveClose) => server.close(resolveClose));
  }

  if (failures > 0) fail("storybook:smoke FAILED");
  console.log("storybook:smoke OK");
}

// Node runs the real path of a symlinked script, so compare real paths.
const isMain =
  process.argv[1] !== undefined &&
  realpathSync(process.argv[1]) ===
    realpathSync(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));

if (isMain) await main();
```

建立 `apps/storybook/.storybook/main.ts`：

```ts
import type { StorybookConfig } from "@storybook/react-vite";
import tailwindcss from "@tailwindcss/vite";
import react from "@vitejs/plugin-react";
import type { ChannelLike } from "storybook/internal/channels";
import {
  REQUEST_WHATS_NEW_DATA,
  RESULT_WHATS_NEW_DATA,
} from "storybook/internal/core-events";

// experimental_serverChannel is a preset hook that StorybookConfig does not
// declare; main.ts is itself the last preset, so it runs after Storybook's own.
type Config = StorybookConfig & {
  experimental_serverChannel(channel: ChannelLike): Promise<ChannelLike>;
};

const config: Config = {
  // Paths here are relative to this .storybook directory, so the repo root is
  // three levels up. A wrong glob still builds, with no stories (the smoke
  // check catches that).
  stories: ["../../../packages/blocks/src/**/*.stories.tsx"],
  // The demo images live in the showcase's public folder; serve the same files
  // at the same URL (/demo-assets/demo-<n>.svg) as the showcase does.
  staticDirs: [
    { from: "../../showcase/public/demo-assets", to: "/demo-assets" },
  ],
  addons: ["@storybook/addon-docs", "@storybook/addon-a11y"],
  framework: { name: "@storybook/react-vite", options: {} },
  // argTypes come from the block specs; docgen cannot read their labels.
  typescript: { reactDocgen: false },
  core: {
    disableTelemetry: true,
    disableWhatsNewNotifications: true,
    enableCrashReports: false,
  },
  // In dev, opening the Storybook UI makes the server fetch
  // https://storybook.js.org/whats-new/v1 even with
  // disableWhatsNewNotifications. Answer that request locally instead.
  async experimental_serverChannel(channel) {
    channel.removeAllListeners(REQUEST_WHATS_NEW_DATA);
    channel.on(REQUEST_WHATS_NEW_DATA, () => {
      channel.emit(RESULT_WHATS_NEW_DATA, { data: { status: "ERROR" } });
    });
    return channel;
  },
  async viteFinal(viteConfig) {
    // @storybook/react-vite does not add the React plugin: without it the
    // stories in packages/blocks compile to classic JSX and fail with
    // "React is not defined". @tailwindcss/vite builds the blocks stylesheet.
    viteConfig.plugins = [
      ...(viteConfig.plugins ?? []),
      react(),
      tailwindcss(),
    ];
    return viteConfig;
  },
};

export default config;
```

建立 `apps/storybook/.storybook/preview.tsx`：

```tsx
import type { Decorator, Preview } from "@storybook/react-vite";
import "@tzuchi/tceditor-blocks/styles.css";

const DEFAULT_THEME = "tzuchi";

// Runs during render, so the first paint already has the theme; switching the
// toolbar re-renders the story and runs it again.
const withDocumentSettings: Decorator = (Story, context) => {
  const theme =
    typeof context.globals.theme === "string"
      ? context.globals.theme
      : DEFAULT_THEME;
  document.documentElement.dataset.theme = theme;
  document.documentElement.lang = "zh-Hant";
  return <Story />;
};

const preview: Preview = {
  decorators: [withDocumentSettings],
  globalTypes: {
    theme: {
      description: "主題",
      toolbar: {
        title: "主題",
        icon: "paintbrush",
        items: [
          { value: "tzuchi", title: "慈濟" },
          { value: "tzuchi-dark", title: "慈濟深色" },
        ],
        dynamicTitle: true,
      },
    },
  },
  initialGlobals: { theme: DEFAULT_THEME },
  tags: ["autodocs"],
};

export default preview;
```

```js
// Runs the Storybook CLI for the block Storybook.
//
//   node scripts/storybook.mjs dev     serve on http://127.0.0.1:6010
//   node scripts/storybook.mjs build   write storybook-static/
//
// The CLI writes ~/.storybook/settings.json, so it runs with HOME pointed at
// apps/storybook/.home (git-ignored). Only the CLI gets that HOME; puppeteer
// (pnpm storybook:smoke) needs the real one to find its browser.
import { spawn, spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import { mkdirSync } from "node:fs";
import { dirname, join } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const HOST = "127.0.0.1";
const PORT = 6010;

const appDir = join(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");
const home = join(appDir, ".home");
const cli = join(appDir, "node_modules", ".bin", "storybook");

/** The lsof lines for a listener on the port, "" when free, null without lsof. */
function listenerOn(port) {
  const result = spawnSync("lsof", ["-nP", `-iTCP:${port}`, "-sTCP:LISTEN"], {
    encoding: "utf8",
  });
  if (result.error) return null;
  return result.status === 0 ? result.stdout.trim() : "";
}

const mode = process.argv[2];
let args;
if (mode === "dev") {
  const listener = listenerOn(PORT);
  if (listener) {
    console.error(
      `Port ${PORT} is already in use, so the block Storybook was not started:\n` +
        `${listener}\n` +
        "Stop that process (if it is yours) and run the command again."
    );
    process.exit(1);
  }
  args = [
    "dev",
    "--host",
    HOST,
    "--port",
    String(PORT),
    // Without lsof the check above is skipped; this still refuses a taken port
    // instead of moving to another one.
    "--exact-port",
    "--no-open",
    "--ci",
    // Skip the daily request to storybook.js.org/versions.json.
    "--no-version-updates",
  ];
} else if (mode === "build") {
  args = ["build", "--output-dir", "storybook-static"];
} else {
  console.error("Usage: node scripts/storybook.mjs <dev|build>");
  process.exit(2);
}

mkdirSync(home, { recursive: true });
const child = spawn(cli, args, {
  cwd: appDir,
  stdio: "inherit",
  env: { ...process.env, HOME: home, STORYBOOK_DISABLE_TELEMETRY: "1" },
});
for (const signal of ["SIGINT", "SIGTERM"]) {
  process.on(signal, () => child.kill(signal));
}
child.on("error", (error) => {
  console.error(`Could not run ${cli}: ${error.message}. Run pnpm install.`);
  process.exit(1);
});
child.on("exit", (code, signal) => {
  process.exit(code ?? (signal ? 1 : 0));
});
```

### Task 15: 示範站：編輯器、發布 API、公開頁、發布檢查面板

目的：新增 `apps/showcase`（`@tzuchi/tceditor-showcase`，Next.js 16.2.6、Turbopack），模擬 S3 的存檔流程（規格 §10，以第 18 節更正 #19、#20 為準）。示範站有以下內容：
- `/activity/edit`：編輯器。使用 8 個區塊的 `createEditorConfig`、heading-analyzer 外掛、新的「發布檢查」面板，以及 375／768／1024 px 三個預覽寬度。
- `POST /api/activity`：只接受同源的 `application/json` 請求。以串流讀取請求內容，超過 2 MB 就停止，接著跑整頁驗證器，通過才以「寫暫存檔再改名」的方式寫入 `apps/showcase/.data/activity.json`。`GET /api/activity` 回傳目前的頁面。
- `/activity`：伺服器端用 `@tzuchi/tceditor/rsc` 的 `Render` 產生 HTML，`<title>` 與 meta description 取自頁面根節點。

範例活動頁 `content/activity.preset.json` 用上 8 個區塊。測試證明：
- 範例頁通過驗證、沒有提示，而且已經是存檔後的形式。
- 發布 API 的 200 寫檔、422、413（含 Review Focus #2 的中文內容）、415、403（含 DNS rebinding），以及寫檔失敗時保留舊檔。
- 發布結果轉換與錯誤定位的純函式。

**執行位置**：主工作目錄 `/Users/kaellim/Desktop/projects/puck`，分支 `s2/block-spec`。需要網路的步驟：Step 2 的 `pnpm install`，以及 Step 11 `pnpm verify` 裡的 `pnpm audit:gate`。

**設計決定與說明**：

**套件與 Next 設定**
- **檔案以預檢實測可用的版本為基礎**（facts/preflight.md §4.1、§4.2）：
  - `postcss.config.mjs` 與 `tsconfig.json` 照抄預檢版本，`tsconfig.json` 只多了 `"types": ["node", "jest"]`。
  - `next.config.mjs` 只設 `reactStrictMode`。
  - 不需要 `transpilePackages` 與 `turbopack.root`：Turbopack 與 webpack 都實測過，不設也能 build（facts/frameworks.md §7.2）。
  - core 一律經由 `workspace:*` 取用 `dist`（Global Constraints），不設 tsconfig `paths`。
- **`tsconfig.json` 的 `include` 同時列 `.next/types/**/*.ts` 與 `.next/dev/types/**/*.ts`**：否則 `next build` 會改寫 tsconfig（facts/frameworks.md §7.3）。實測 build、dev 各跑一次，tsconfig 都沒有被改。
- **scripts**：
  - 全部帶 `NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1`（Global Constraints、gaps #39）。
  - dev 與 start 綁 `127.0.0.1:3010`。
  - `lint` 和 demo 一樣是 `eslint`。示範站沒有自己的 ESLint 設定，從 app 目錄執行時用 root 的 flat config（gaps C1），C.4 對 `apps/showcase/app/(public)/**` 的 import 限制才會生效。實測：在公開頁 import `Puck` 時，lint 報 `no-restricted-imports`。
  - `typecheck` 是 `next typegen && tsc --noEmit --incremental false`：`next-env.d.ts` 與 `.next/types` 是 gitignored 的產物，沒有它們 `*.module.css` 的型別宣告不存在；`--incremental false` 讓 tsc 不在 app 目錄留下 `tsconfig.tsbuildinfo`。
- **依賴**：`@tzuchi/tceditor`、`@tzuchi/tceditor-blocks`、`@tzuchi/tceditor-plugin-heading-analyzer`、next、react、react-dom。不列 `@tzuchi/tceditor-spec`：示範站沒有直接 import 它（blocks 用到時從 blocks 自己的 `node_modules` 解析；turbo 的 `inputs` 另外列出 `packages/spec` 的檔案）。
- **兩個 route group 各有自己的根 layout**（更正 #19；facts/preflight.md §4.1；gaps C5），沒有 `app/layout.tsx`：
  - `(public)/layout.tsx`：`<html lang="zh-Hant" data-theme="tzuchi">`，import `@tzuchi/tceditor-blocks/styles.css`。
  - `(editor)/layout.tsx`：`<html lang="zh-Hant">`，**不設 `data-theme`**，也 import 同一份 `styles.css`。Puck 的 CopyHostStyles 會把它鏡像到預覽 iframe。
  - 規格 §16 擔心 Tailwind 的 preflight 會影響編輯器畫面。實測截圖確認：側欄、欄位、按鈕群組都正常。preflight 在 `@layer base`，優先度低於 core 在執行期注入的樣式。
- **編輯器預覽的主題**：`overrides.iframe` 在 iframe 的 `<html>` 設 `data-theme="tzuchi"` 與 `lang="zh-Hant"`（facts/core-puck-api.md §7.2 的 `RenderFunc<{ children; document? }>`）。用 puppeteer 實測：host 的 `data-theme` 是 `null`，iframe 是 `tzuchi`，按鈕底色 `rgb(27, 45, 88)`，和公開頁相同。

**公開頁與資料**
- **公開頁是伺服器元件，`dynamic = "force-dynamic"`**：每次請求都重新讀檔，發布後立刻看得到。
  - `generateMetadata` 與頁面共用 `react` 的 `cache(loadActivity)`，每次請求只讀一次檔。
  - 只 import `@tzuchi/tceditor/rsc`、`@tzuchi/tceditor-blocks/render`、`/demo-assets`。C.4 的 ESLint 規則禁止 import `@tzuchi/tceditor` 主入口的執行期值。
  - 預檢的 chunk 掃描顯示，公開頁的瀏覽器端沒有任何區塊或 HeroUI 的程式碼（facts/preflight.md §4.5）；Task 16 會把這一點變成自動檢查。
- **`lib/activity-store.ts` 不再驗證一次**：發布的檔案在寫入前已經驗證過，範例頁則由測試驗證。
  - `getDataDir()`：`SHOWCASE_DATA_DIR`（相對於工作目錄解析）或 `<cwd>/.data`。`pnpm dev:showcase`、`next start` 與 jest 的工作目錄都是 `apps/showcase`。
  - 實測 Turbopack build 沒有出現任何 file tracing 警告。
- **範例頁 `content/activity.preset.json`**（規格 §10.4）：
  - 結構：標題、首圖、段落（粗體與 `mailto:` 連結）、標籤列；接著是區段，裡面有標題與多欄，兩欄各一張卡片：「時間與地點」放段落與標籤列，「報名方式」放段落、按鈕與標籤列；最後是兩欄圖片。8 個區塊都用上，圖片用 `demo-1`、`demo-2`、`demo-4`。
  - id 是固定的 `<Type>-<名稱>`。Puck 不會替 content 補 id（facts/core-puck-api.md §7.1）。
  - 檔案內容就是驗證器的輸出：預設值全部寫出，富文字是清理後的形式。測試以「驗證結果等於檔案本身」確認這一點，所以公開頁直接讀檔也和發布後的資料一致；RSC `Render` 不會補預設值（facts/core-puck-api.md §2.1）。
  - 比對是逐值的深度相等，不忽略任何屬性。富文字的段落沒有 `attrs`：`richText()` 清理時以 `textAlign: false` 移除段落與標題的 `attrs.textAlign`，`attrs` 變空就整個拿掉（Task 2）；link 的 `class: null`、`title: null` 是 `normalizeRichText` 的輸出，照寫。存下的資料若多出 `attrs: { textAlign: null }`，這個測試會失敗，表示 Task 2 的清理不對。

**發布 API（`lib/activity-api.ts`，`app/api/activity/route.ts` 只負責接線）**
- **同源檢查**（規格 §10.2、更正 #20）：
  - 要求 `Origin === "http://" + Host`，不用 `req.url`：在 `next start -H 127.0.0.1` 下，`req.url` 是 `localhost`（facts/frameworks.md §6、§0 #10）。
  - 另外要求 Host 的主機名稱是 `127.0.0.1` 或 `localhost`，用來擋 DNS rebinding（`createActivityHandlers` 的選填參數 `allowedHostnames`，預設 `["127.0.0.1", "localhost"]`；只比主機名稱、不比 port）。
  - 測試涵蓋：缺 Origin、外站、別的 port、https，以及 Host 與 Origin 都是外站名稱。
- **Content-Type**：取 `;` 之前的部分，比對 `application/json`（不分大小寫），所以接受 `application/json; charset=utf-8`（gaps #54 的決定）。
- **2 MB 上限以位元組計算**（Review Focus #2；facts/frameworks.md §6 的串流探針，2,097,152 bytes 通過、多 1 byte 就 413）：
  - `Content-Length` 已經超過上限時，不讀內容，直接回 413。
  - 其餘情況逐塊讀取，累計超過 `MAX_BODY_BYTES`（就是 `DEFAULT_LIMITS.maxBytes`）就 `cancel()` 並回 413。
  - 測試：約 70 萬個中文字（210 萬 bytes，字元數卻少於 2,097,152）得到 413；剛好 2,097,152 bytes 得到 200；無限串流讀到約 32 塊（64 KB 一塊）就停止。
- **驗證**：把讀到的位元組交給 `validatePageJson`，它會再量一次大小並解碼 UTF-8（Task 9）。
  - 失敗時回 422 `{ errors }`。
  - 成功時寫入 `result.data`，也就是只含 `root` 與 `content`、已補預設值、已清理富文字的資料，然後回 200 `{ notices }`。
- **原子寫入**：在資料目錄內以 `flag: "wx"` 寫 `.activity.json.<uuid>.tmp`，再 `rename` 成 `activity.json`。
  - 任何一步失敗都會刪掉暫存檔，並回 500 `write_failed`，舊檔不受影響。
  - 測試用 `jest.mock("node:fs/promises")` 讓 `rename` 失敗一次，確認舊檔內容不變，目錄裡只剩 `activity.json`。
- **`route.ts` 的接線也有測試**：設定 `SHOWCASE_DATA_DIR` 後，用 `jest.isolateModules` 載入 `route.ts`，確認發布寫進那個目錄、`GET` 讀回同一份資料。

**編輯器與「發布檢查」面板**
- **傳給 `<Puck>` 的 `config`、`plugins`、`viewports`、`overrides` 都放在 module scope**：這些值換了 identity，Puck 就會重建 store（facts/core-puck-api.md §7.1 最後一點）；`createEditorConfig` 也要求只建立一次（Task 11）。
- **不需要 demo 那種 mount guard**：預檢的編輯器頁直接 SSR `<Puck>`，沒有出錯（facts/preflight.md §4.1）。編輯器頁本身是伺服器元件，先讀資料，再交給 `'use client'` 的 `client.tsx`。
- **`?blank=1`**：從 `{ root: { props: {} }, content: [] }` 開始，Puck 會補上 `config.root.defaultProps`（facts/core-puck-api.md §7.1）。冒煙測試靠它從空白頁開始。
- **預覽寬度**：375「手機」、768「平板」、1024「桌面」（規格 §10.5），icon 用 Puck 內建的 `Smartphone`、`Tablet`、`Monitor`。
- **發布按鈕維持 Puck 的英文「Publish」**：中文介面是 S7 的範圍（規格 §14）。
- **「發布檢查」面板**（規格 §10.3）：
  - 外掛物件 `{ name: "publish-check", label: "發布檢查", icon, render }`。plugin 的 `render` 不接收 props（facts/core-puck-api.md §8.1、§0 #8），所以發布結果放在 module 層級的小型 store，用 `useSyncExternalStore` 讀取。
  - `onPublish` 是 `publishActivity`：先記「發布中…」，再呼叫 `publishPage` 把回應轉成 `PublishResult`；回應比較舊的請求不會蓋掉較新的結果。
  - 結果出來後，面板用 `dispatch({ type: "setUi", ui: { plugin: { current: "publish-check" }, leftSideBarVisible: true } })` 自己切到前景。每個 plugin 的 render 都一直掛載著，只用 CSS 切換顯示（facts/core-puck-api.md §8.2）。
  - 顯示的狀態：「尚未發布」、「發布中…」、「沒有錯誤，已發布」（有提示時加上提示數）、「有 N 個錯誤，沒有發布」，以及 413、403 這類失敗的中文訊息。
  - 每筆錯誤依序顯示：區塊名稱與欄位名稱（例如「按鈕 › 連結網址」，規格 §10.3 的「區塊名稱、欄位名稱」）、中文說明，最後是給工程師與 AI 看的 `pathText`。
  - 名稱由純函式 `describeIssue(config, issue)`（`lib/publish-result.ts`，有測試）取得：path 中最後一組「索引, `"props"`」之後的 key 就是欄位，所以巢狀區塊取最深那一層的欄位；陣列項目與圖片物件的成員（`tags[2].label`、`image.alt`）以頂層欄位的 label 顯示，細節由中文說明交代。
  - label 只查自有屬性（`Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call`，CLAUDE.md 的安全規則），因為 type 與 key 都來自頁面資料。`root` 開頭的錯誤顯示「頁面」與根節點欄位的 label；查不到 label 時區塊顯示 type，欄位不顯示（例如 `unknown_prop`、`duplicate_id`）。
  - 關於整個區塊的錯誤只顯示區塊名稱：`not_allowed_here`、`too_deep`、`too_many_blocks` 的 path 指到區塊本身，`unknown_type` 指到它的 `type`（Task 9 的 path 慣例）。這時 path 上最後一個欄位屬於外層區塊，例如區段被放進卡片的「內容」時是卡片的 `content`；拿它查區段的欄位會得到區段自己的「內容」，所以不查。說明文字已經寫出外層區塊與欄位。
- **點錯誤就選取出錯的區塊**（facts/core-puck-api.md §9）：
  - `findIssueBlockId(page, issue.path)` 沿著 path 走訪**當初送出的那份資料**，取路徑上最深的區塊 id，只走自有屬性。用 id 而不是當下的索引，是因為發布之後使用者可能已經移動或新增區塊，舊的索引會指到別的區塊；id 則仍然找得到原本那一個。這是規格 §10.3 的細化。
  - 接著 `getSelectorForId(id)`，再 `dispatch({ type: "setUi", ui: { itemSelector, rightSideBarVisible: true } })`。
  - 區塊已被刪除時，`getSelectorForId` 回傳 `undefined`，什麼都不做。`root` 開頭的錯誤選取頁面根節點（`itemSelector: null`），右側會顯示頁面標題與說明。
  - 用 puppeteer 實測：發布只有標題與一個網址空白的按鈕的頁面，面板列出「按鈕 › 連結網址／按鈕的『連結網址』不能空白。／content[1].props.href」；先選取標題再點這筆錯誤，可見的 `input[name="href"]` 由 0 個變成 1 個，也就是右側切回按鈕的欄位。
- **面板樣式**：CSS Module、SUIT 命名（`PublishCheck-*`）。只用 core 公開的 `--puck-*` 變數（CLAUDE.md 列為公開名稱），不依賴全域樣式。

**turbo、ESLint 與忽略設定**：見共用介面 C.4（全域忽略 `apps/showcase/.next/**`）與 C.5（`@tzuchi/tceditor-showcase#build`、`#test`、`#typecheck`）。`#build` 排在同套件的 `typecheck` 之後，因為 `next build` 會清空 `.next`，和並行的 `next typegen` 互相干擾。`.gitignore` 加 `apps/showcase/.data/`（C.5）。`.next/`、`next-env.d.ts`、`.turbo` 已經被 root `.gitignore` 忽略（gaps C7）。

建立 `apps/showcase/lib/__tests__/route.spec.ts`（Review Focus #2 的 `returns 413 for a body over 2 MB of Chinese text` 在這個檔）：

```ts
import { mkdtempSync, readdirSync, readFileSync, rmSync } from "node:fs";
import { rename } from "node:fs/promises";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { validatePageJson } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-blocks/validator";
import { createActivityHandlers, MAX_BODY_BYTES } from "../activity-api";

// Lets a test make the rename step of the atomic write fail.
jest.mock("node:fs/promises", () => {
  const actual =
    jest.requireActual<typeof import("node:fs/promises")>("node:fs/promises");

  return { ...actual, rename: jest.fn(actual.rename) };
});

const PRESET_PATH = join(__dirname, "../../content/activity.preset.json");
const ORIGIN = "http://127.0.0.1:3010";
const ENDPOINT = `${ORIGIN}/api/activity`;

let dataDir: string;

beforeEach(() => {
  dataDir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "showcase-api-"));
});

afterEach(() => {
  jest.restoreAllMocks();
  rmSync(dataDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
});

const handlers = () =>
  createActivityHandlers({
    dataDir,
    presetPath: PRESET_PATH,
    validatePageJson,
  });

const publishedFile = () => join(dataDir, "activity.json");

function post(
  body: BodyInit,
  headers: Record<string, string> = {},
  init: { duplex?: "half" } = {}
) {
  return new Request(ENDPOINT, {
    method: "POST",
    body,
    headers: {
      host: "127.0.0.1:3010",
      origin: ORIGIN,
      "content-type": "application/json",
      ...headers,
    },
    ...init,
  } as RequestInit);
}

/** A valid page: a heading and a button. */
const page = (href = "/register", text = "淨灘報名") => ({
  root: { props: { title: "測試頁" } },
  content: [
    { type: "Heading", props: { id: "Heading-1", text } },
    { type: "Button", props: { id: "Button-1", label: "報名", href } },
  ],
  zones: {},
});

describe("GET /api/activity", () => {
  it("returns the preset while nothing is published", async () => {
    const response = await handlers().GET();

    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    expect(response.headers.get("cache-control")).toBe("no-store");
    expect(await response.json()).toEqual(
      JSON.parse(readFileSync(PRESET_PATH, "utf8"))
    );
  });

  it("returns the published page after a publish", async () => {
    const api = handlers();

    expect((await api.POST(post(JSON.stringify(page())))).status).toBe(200);

    const data = await (await api.GET()).json();

    expect(data.root.props.title).toBe("測試頁");
    expect(data.content[1].props.href).toBe("/register");
  });
});

describe("POST /api/activity", () => {
  it("validates, fills defaults and writes the page", async () => {
    const response = await handlers().POST(post(JSON.stringify(page())));

    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    expect(await response.json()).toEqual({ notices: [] });

    const written = JSON.parse(readFileSync(publishedFile(), "utf8"));

    expect(Object.keys(written).sort()).toEqual(["content", "root"]);
    expect(written.root.props).toEqual({ title: "測試頁", description: "" });
    expect(written.content[1].props).toEqual({
      id: "Button-1",
      label: "報名",
      href: "/register",
      variant: "primary",
      size: "md",
      fullWidth: false,
    });
  });

  it("returns notices for richtext it had to clean", async () => {
    const data = {
      root: { props: {} },
      content: [
        {
          type: "Paragraph",
          props: {
            id: "Paragraph-1",
            body: {
              type: "doc",
              content: [
                {
                  type: "heading",
                  attrs: { level: 2, textAlign: null },
                  content: [{ type: "text", text: "段落裡的標題" }],
                },
              ],
            },
          },
        },
      ],
    };

    const response = await handlers().POST(post(JSON.stringify(data)));
    const body = await response.json();

    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    expect(body.notices).toEqual([
      expect.objectContaining({
        code: "richtext_cleaned",
        path: ["content", 0, "props", "body"],
      }),
    ]);

    const written = JSON.parse(readFileSync(publishedFile(), "utf8"));

    expect(written.content[0].props.body.content[0].type).toBe("paragraph");
  });

  it("returns 422 with the issues for a javascript: link and writes nothing", async () => {
    const response = await handlers().POST(
      post(JSON.stringify(page("javascript:alert(1)")))
    );

    expect(response.status).toBe(422);
    expect((await response.json()).errors).toEqual([
      expect.objectContaining({
        code: "unsafe_href",
        path: ["content", 1, "props", "href"],
        pathText: "content[1].props.href",
        blockType: "Button",
      }),
    ]);
    expect(() => readFileSync(publishedFile())).toThrow();
  });

  it("returns 413 for a body over 2 MB of Chinese text", async () => {
    // 700,000 Chinese characters are 2,100,000 UTF-8 bytes, although the
    // string is shorter than 2,097,152 characters.
    const body = JSON.stringify(page("/register", "淨".repeat(700_000)));

    expect(body.length).toBeLessThan(MAX_BODY_BYTES);
    expect(Buffer.byteLength(body)).toBeGreaterThan(MAX_BODY_BYTES);

    const response = await handlers().POST(post(body));

    expect(response.status).toBe(413);
    expect((await response.json()).error).toBe("too_large");
    expect(() => readFileSync(publishedFile())).toThrow();
  });

  it("stops reading a body as soon as it passes 2 MB", async () => {
    const chunk = new Uint8Array(64 * 1024).fill(0x20);
    let pulled = 0;
    const endless = new ReadableStream<Uint8Array>({
      pull(controller) {
        pulled += 1;
        controller.enqueue(chunk);
      },
    });

    const response = await handlers().POST(
      post(endless, {}, { duplex: "half" })
    );

    expect(response.status).toBe(413);
    // 2 MB is 32 chunks of 64 KB; the stream may have queued one more.
    expect(pulled).toBeLessThanOrEqual(34);
  });

  it("rejects a declared Content-Length over 2 MB before reading", async () => {
    const response = await handlers().POST(
      post(JSON.stringify(page()), {
        "content-length": String(MAX_BODY_BYTES + 1),
      })
    );

    expect(response.status).toBe(413);
  });

  it("accepts a body of exactly 2,097,152 bytes", async () => {
    const json = JSON.stringify(page());
    const body = json + " ".repeat(MAX_BODY_BYTES - Buffer.byteLength(json));

    expect(Buffer.byteLength(body)).toBe(MAX_BODY_BYTES);
    expect((await handlers().POST(post(body))).status).toBe(200);
  });

  it("accepts application/json with a charset", async () => {
    const response = await handlers().POST(
      post(JSON.stringify(page()), {
        "content-type": "application/json; charset=utf-8",
      })
    );

    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
  });

  it.each(["text/plain", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded", ""])(
    "returns 415 for Content-Type %j",
    async (contentType) => {
      const response = await handlers().POST(
        post(JSON.stringify(page()), { "content-type": contentType })
      );

      expect(response.status).toBe(415);
      expect((await response.json()).error).toBe("unsupported_media_type");
      expect(() => readFileSync(publishedFile())).toThrow();
    }
  );

  it.each([
    ["Origin is missing", { origin: undefined }],
    ["Origin is another site", { origin: "http://evil.example" }],
    ["Origin is another port", { origin: "http://127.0.0.1:3000" }],
    ["Origin uses https", { origin: "https://127.0.0.1:3010" }],
    [
      "Host is another site's name (DNS rebinding)",
      { origin: "http://evil.example:3010", host: "evil.example:3010" },
    ],
  ])("returns 403 when %s", async (_label, headers) => {
    const request = post(JSON.stringify(page()));

    for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(headers)) {
      if (value === undefined) request.headers.delete(name);
      else request.headers.set(name, value);
    }

    const response = await handlers().POST(request);

    expect(response.status).toBe(403);
    expect((await response.json()).error).toBe("forbidden_origin");
    expect(() => readFileSync(publishedFile())).toThrow();
  });

  it.each(["localhost:3010", "127.0.0.1:3019"])(
    "accepts a same-origin publish to %s",
    async (host) => {
      const response = await handlers().POST(
        post(JSON.stringify(page()), { host, origin: `http://${host}` })
      );

      expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    }
  );

  it("keeps the previous page when the write fails", async () => {
    const api = handlers();

    expect((await api.POST(post(JSON.stringify(page("/first"))))).status).toBe(
      200
    );

    const before = readFileSync(publishedFile(), "utf8");

    jest
      .mocked(rename)
      .mockRejectedValueOnce(Object.assign(new Error("EIO"), { code: "EIO" }));
    jest.spyOn(console, "error").mockImplementation(() => undefined);

    const response = await api.POST(post(JSON.stringify(page("/second"))));

    expect(response.status).toBe(500);
    expect((await response.json()).error).toBe("write_failed");
    expect(readFileSync(publishedFile(), "utf8")).toBe(before);
    expect(JSON.parse(before).content[1].props.href).toBe("/first");
    // The temporary file was removed.
    expect(readdirSync(dataDir)).toEqual(["activity.json"]);
  });

  it("creates the data directory on the first publish", async () => {
    rmSync(dataDir, { recursive: true, force: true });

    const response = await handlers().POST(post(JSON.stringify(page())));

    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    expect(JSON.parse(readFileSync(publishedFile(), "utf8")).root).toEqual({
      props: { title: "測試頁", description: "" },
    });
  });
});

describe("app/api/activity/route.ts", () => {
  const savedDataDir = process.env.SHOWCASE_DATA_DIR;

  afterEach(() => {
    if (savedDataDir === undefined) delete process.env.SHOWCASE_DATA_DIR;
    else process.env.SHOWCASE_DATA_DIR = savedDataDir;
  });

  it("publishes into SHOWCASE_DATA_DIR and serves the page from there", async () => {
    process.env.SHOWCASE_DATA_DIR = dataDir;

    type RouteModule = typeof import("../../app/api/activity/route");
    let route: RouteModule | undefined;

    // route.ts reads SHOWCASE_DATA_DIR when it is loaded.
    jest.isolateModules(() => {
      route = jest.requireActual<RouteModule>("../../app/api/activity/route");
    });

    if (!route) throw new Error("route.ts did not load");

    expect((await route.POST(post(JSON.stringify(page())))).status).toBe(200);
    expect(readdirSync(dataDir)).toEqual(["activity.json"]);
    expect((await (await route.GET()).json()).root.props.title).toBe("測試頁");
  });
});
```

```ts
import type { Config } from "@tzuchi/tceditor";
import type { Issue, IssueCode } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-blocks/validator";
import {
  createPublishResultStore,
  describeIssue,
  findIssueBlockId,
  publishPage,
} from "../publish-result";

const data = {
  root: { props: { title: "頁面" } },
  content: [
    { type: "Heading", props: { id: "Heading-1", text: "標題" } },
    {
      type: "Columns",
      props: {
        id: "Columns-1",
        columns: [
          { content: [] },
          {
            content: [
              {
                type: "Card",
                props: {
                  id: "Card-1",
                  content: [
                    { type: "Button", props: { id: "Button-1", href: "" } },
                  ],
                },
              },
            ],
          },
        ],
      },
    },
  ],
  zones: {},
};

describe("findIssueBlockId", () => {
  it("finds a top-level block", () => {
    expect(findIssueBlockId(data, ["content", 0, "props", "text"])).toBe(
      "Heading-1"
    );
  });

  it("finds the deepest block on the path", () => {
    expect(
      findIssueBlockId(data, [
        "content",
        1,
        "props",
        "columns",
        1,
        "content",
        0,
        "props",
        "content",
        0,
        "props",
        "href",
      ])
    ).toBe("Button-1");
  });

  it("stops at the last block that still exists", () => {
    expect(
      findIssueBlockId(data, ["content", 1, "props", "columns", 5, "content"])
    ).toBe("Columns-1");
  });

  it("returns null for the page root", () => {
    expect(findIssueBlockId(data, ["root", "props", "title"])).toBeNull();
  });

  it("returns undefined when no block is on the path", () => {
    expect(findIssueBlockId(data, [])).toBeUndefined();
    expect(findIssueBlockId(data, ["zones"])).toBeUndefined();
    expect(findIssueBlockId(data, ["content", 9, "props"])).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("ignores inherited keys", () => {
    expect(
      findIssueBlockId(data, ["content", "__proto__", "constructor"])
    ).toBeUndefined();
    expect(
      findIssueBlockId(data, ["content", 0, "constructor", "prototype"])
    ).toBe("Heading-1");
  });
});

describe("describeIssue", () => {
  const config = {
    root: { fields: { title: { type: "text", label: "頁面標題" } } },
    components: {
      Button: {
        label: "按鈕",
        fields: { href: { type: "text", label: "連結網址" } },
        render: () => null,
      },
      TagList: {
        label: "標籤列",
        fields: {
          tags: {
            type: "array",
            label: "標籤",
            arrayFields: { label: { type: "text", label: "文字" } },
          },
        },
        render: () => null,
      },
      Section: {
        label: "區段",
        fields: { content: { type: "slot", label: "內容" } },
        render: () => null,
      },
    },
  } as unknown as Config;

  const issue = (
    path: (string | number)[],
    blockType?: string,
    code: IssueCode = "invalid_value"
  ): Issue => ({
    path,
    pathText: "",
    ...(blockType === undefined ? {} : { blockType }),
    code,
    message: "",
  });

  it("names the block and the field", () => {
    expect(
      describeIssue(config, issue(["content", 1, "props", "href"], "Button"))
    ).toEqual({ block: "按鈕", field: "連結網址" });
  });

  it("names the deepest block's field on a nested path", () => {
    expect(
      describeIssue(
        config,
        issue(
          [
            "content",
            1,
            "props",
            "columns",
            1,
            "content",
            0,
            "props",
            "content",
            0,
            "props",
            "href",
          ],
          "Button"
        )
      )
    ).toEqual({ block: "按鈕", field: "連結網址" });
  });

  it("names an array item by its array field", () => {
    expect(
      describeIssue(
        config,
        issue(["content", 0, "props", "tags", 2, "label"], "TagList")
      )
    ).toEqual({ block: "標籤列", field: "標籤" });
  });

  it("names the page root's fields", () => {
    expect(describeIssue(config, issue(["root", "props", "title"]))).toEqual({
      block: "頁面",
      field: "頁面標題",
    });
  });

  it("leaves out a field the config does not have", () => {
    expect(
      describeIssue(config, issue(["content", 0, "props", "colour"], "Button"))
    ).toEqual({ block: "按鈕" });
    expect(
      describeIssue(config, issue(["content", 0, "props", "id"], "Button"))
    ).toEqual({ block: "按鈕" });
  });

  it("falls back to the type for blocks and keys the config lacks", () => {
    expect(
      describeIssue(config, issue(["content", 0, "props", "text"], "Quote"))
    ).toEqual({ block: "Quote" });
    expect(
      describeIssue(
        config,
        issue(["content", 0, "props", "constructor"], "constructor")
      )
    ).toEqual({ block: "constructor" });
    expect(
      describeIssue(
        config,
        issue(["content", 0, "props", "toString"], "Button")
      )
    ).toEqual({ block: "按鈕" });
    expect(describeIssue(config, issue(["content", 0]))).toEqual({
      block: "頁面資料",
    });
  });

  it("names only the block for an issue about the whole block", () => {
    // A Section dropped into a Card's 內容: the path ends at the Section, and
    // the Section's own 內容 field is not at fault.
    const path = ["content", 0, "props", "content", 1];

    expect(
      describeIssue(config, issue(path, "Section", "not_allowed_here"))
    ).toEqual({ block: "區段" });
    expect(describeIssue(config, issue(path, "Section", "too_deep"))).toEqual({
      block: "區段",
    });
    expect(
      describeIssue(config, issue([...path, "props", "content"], "Section"))
    ).toEqual({ block: "區段", field: "內容" });
  });
});

describe("publishPage", () => {
  const respond = (status: number, body: unknown) =>
    jest.fn(async () => Response.json(body, { status }));

  it("posts the page as JSON", async () => {
    const fetchImpl = respond(200, { notices: [] });

    await publishPage(data, { fetch: fetchImpl });

    expect(fetchImpl).toHaveBeenCalledWith("/api/activity", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify(data),
    });
  });

  it("maps 200 to published with the notices", async () => {
    const notice = {
      path: [],
      pathText: "",
      code: "richtext_cleaned",
      message: "已清理",
    };

    expect(
      await publishPage(data, { fetch: respond(200, { notices: [notice] }) })
    ).toEqual({ status: "published", notices: [notice], page: data });
  });

  it("maps 422 to invalid with the errors", async () => {
    const error = {
      path: ["content", 0, "props", "href"],
      pathText: "content[0].props.href",
      blockType: "Button",
      code: "unsafe_href",
      message: "按鈕的『連結網址』只接受 http、https、mailto、tel 或站內路徑。",
    };

    expect(
      await publishPage(data, { fetch: respond(422, { errors: [error] }) })
    ).toEqual({ status: "invalid", errors: [error], page: data });
  });

  it("maps other responses to failed with the server's message", async () => {
    expect(
      await publishPage(data, {
        fetch: respond(413, { error: "too_large", message: "太大了" }),
      })
    ).toEqual({ status: "failed", message: "太大了" });
    expect(
      await publishPage(data, {
        fetch: jest.fn(async () => new Response("oops", { status: 502 })),
      })
    ).toEqual({ status: "failed", message: "發布失敗（HTTP 502）。" });
  });

  it("maps a network error to failed", async () => {
    const fetchImpl = jest.fn(async () => {
      throw new TypeError("fetch failed");
    });

    expect(await publishPage(data, { fetch: fetchImpl })).toEqual({
      status: "failed",
      message: "無法連線到伺服器，頁面沒有發布。",
    });
  });
});

describe("createPublishResultStore", () => {
  it("notifies subscribers and returns the latest result", () => {
    const store = createPublishResultStore();
    const listener = jest.fn();
    const unsubscribe = store.subscribe(listener);

    expect(store.getSnapshot()).toEqual({ status: "idle" });

    store.set({ status: "publishing" });
    unsubscribe();
    store.set({ status: "failed", message: "x" });

    expect(listener).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(store.getSnapshot()).toEqual({ status: "failed", message: "x" });
  });
});
```

建立 `apps/showcase/lib/__tests__/preset.spec.ts`：

```ts
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { DEMO_ASSETS } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-blocks/demo-assets";
import { validatePage } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-blocks/validator";

const preset: unknown = JSON.parse(
  readFileSync(join(__dirname, "../../content/activity.preset.json"), "utf8")
);

type Node = { type: string; props: Record<string, unknown> };

/** Every block of the page, depth first, including blocks inside slots. */
function collectBlocks(value: unknown, found: Node[] = []): Node[] {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    value.forEach((item) => collectBlocks(item, found));
  } else if (typeof value === "object" && value !== null) {
    const record = value as Record<string, unknown>;

    if (typeof record.type === "string" && typeof record.props === "object") {
      found.push(record as Node);
    }

    Object.values(record).forEach((item) => collectBlocks(item, found));
  }

  return found;
}

/** Every mark type used in a richtext document. */
function markTypes(value: unknown, found = new Set<string>()): Set<string> {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    value.forEach((item) => markTypes(item, found));
  } else if (typeof value === "object" && value !== null) {
    const record = value as Record<string, unknown>;

    if (Array.isArray(record.marks)) {
      record.marks.forEach((mark: { type?: unknown }) => {
        if (typeof mark.type === "string") found.add(mark.type);
      });
    }

    Object.values(record).forEach((item) => markTypes(item, found));
  }

  return found;
}

describe("content/activity.preset.json", () => {
  it("passes the page validator without notices", () => {
    const result = validatePage(preset);

    expect(result).toEqual(expect.objectContaining({ ok: true, notices: [] }));
  });

  it("is already in the stored form (defaults filled, richtext clean)", () => {
    const result = validatePage(preset);

    if (!result.ok) throw new Error(JSON.stringify(result.errors, null, 2));
    // The validator removes textAlign from paragraphs (Task 2), so the
    // preset's paragraphs have no attrs at all.
    expect(result.data).toEqual(preset);
  });

  it("uses the eight demo block types", () => {
    // Spec §10.4. Written out instead of taken from blockTypes, so that
    // registering a new block never requires editing the preset.
    const demoBlockTypes = [
      "Heading",
      "Paragraph",
      "Button",
      "Card",
      "TagList",
      "Section",
      "Columns",
      "Image",
    ];
    const types = new Set(collectBlocks(preset).map((node) => node.type));

    expect([...types].sort()).toEqual([...demoBlockTypes].sort());
  });

  it("nests a Card with a Button and a TagList inside Columns inside a Section", () => {
    const section = collectBlocks(preset).find(
      (node) => node.type === "Section"
    );
    const inSection = collectBlocks(section?.props.content);
    const card = inSection.find(
      (node) =>
        node.type === "Card" &&
        collectBlocks(node.props.content).some((n) => n.type === "Button") &&
        collectBlocks(node.props.content).some((n) => n.type === "TagList")
    );

    expect(inSection.some((node) => node.type === "Columns")).toBe(true);
    expect(card).toBeDefined();
  });

  it("formats a paragraph with bold text and a link", () => {
    const marks = markTypes(
      collectBlocks(preset)
        .filter((node) => node.type === "Paragraph")
        .map((node) => node.props.body)
    );

    expect([...marks]).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(["bold", "link"]));
  });

  it("only uses demo assets that exist", () => {
    const ids = new Set(DEMO_ASSETS.map((asset) => asset.id));
    const used = collectBlocks(preset)
      .filter((node) => node.type === "Image")
      .map((node) => (node.props.image as { assetId: string }).assetId);

    expect(used.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    used.forEach((id) => expect(ids.has(id)).toBe(true));
  });
});
```

```ts
import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import { join, resolve } from "node:path";
import type { Data } from "@tzuchi/tceditor";

/** The published page, inside the data directory. */
export const ACTIVITY_FILE_NAME = "activity.json";

/**
 * Where published pages are stored: `SHOWCASE_DATA_DIR` (resolved against the
 * working directory) or `.data` in the working directory. `pnpm dev:showcase`,
 * `next start` and jest all run in `apps/showcase`, so the default is
 * `apps/showcase/.data` (gitignored).
 */
export function getDataDir(): string {
  const fromEnv = process.env.SHOWCASE_DATA_DIR;

  return fromEnv ? resolve(fromEnv) : join(process.cwd(), ".data");
}

/** The sample activity page shown until something is published. */
export function getPresetPath(): string {
  return join(process.cwd(), "content", "activity.preset.json");
}

export type ActivitySource = "published" | "preset";

const isNotFound = (error: unknown) =>
  typeof error === "object" &&
  error !== null &&
  (error as { code?: unknown }).code === "ENOENT";

/**
 * Reads the published page, or the preset while nothing is published. The
 * publish API validated the published file before writing it, and a test
 * validates the preset, so neither is validated again here.
 */
export async function readActivity(options: {
  dataDir: string;
  presetPath: string;
}): Promise<{ data: Data; source: ActivitySource }> {
  try {
    const raw = await readFile(
      join(options.dataDir, ACTIVITY_FILE_NAME),
      "utf8"
    );

    return { data: JSON.parse(raw) as Data, source: "published" };
  } catch (error) {
    if (!isNotFound(error)) throw error;
  }

  const raw = await readFile(options.presetPath, "utf8");

  return { data: JSON.parse(raw) as Data, source: "preset" };
}

/** readActivity with the default locations. */
export function loadActivity() {
  return readActivity({ dataDir: getDataDir(), presetPath: getPresetPath() });
}
```

建立 `apps/showcase/lib/activity-api.ts`：

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { mkdir, rename, rm, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import { join } from "node:path";
import {
  DEFAULT_LIMITS,
  type ValidateResult,
} from "@tzuchi/tceditor-blocks/validator";
import { ACTIVITY_FILE_NAME, readActivity } from "./activity-store";

/** 2 MB counted in UTF-8 bytes: the page validator's limit. */
export const MAX_BODY_BYTES = DEFAULT_LIMITS.maxBytes;

/** Host names the showcase is served under (it only listens on 127.0.0.1). */
export const DEFAULT_ALLOWED_HOSTNAMES: readonly string[] = [
  "127.0.0.1",
  "localhost",
];

export type ActivityHandlerOptions = {
  /** Directory of the published file; created on the first publish. */
  dataDir: string;
  /** JSON file served while nothing is published. */
  presetPath: string;
  validatePageJson: (raw: string | Uint8Array) => ValidateResult;
  /** Host names a publish may arrive under. Default: DEFAULT_ALLOWED_HOSTNAMES. */
  allowedHostnames?: readonly string[];
};

export type ActivityHandlers = {
  GET(): Promise<Response>;
  POST(req: Request): Promise<Response>;
};

const NO_STORE = { "Cache-Control": "no-store" };

const fail = (status: number, error: string, message: string) =>
  Response.json({ error, message }, { status, headers: NO_STORE });

/** Content-Type must be application/json; parameters such as charset are allowed. */
const isJsonContentType = (value: string | null) =>
  value !== null &&
  value.split(";")[0].trim().toLowerCase() === "application/json";

/** The host name of a Host header ("127.0.0.1:3010" → "127.0.0.1"), or null. */
const hostnameOf = (host: string) => {
  try {
    return new URL(`http://${host}`).hostname;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
};

/**
 * Same-origin check (spec §10.2). The expected origin comes from the Host
 * header, not from req.url: under `next start -H 127.0.0.1`, req.url still
 * says localhost. The Host must also name this machine, so that a page on
 * another site cannot get in by pointing its own host name at 127.0.0.1
 * (DNS rebinding), where its Origin and Host would agree.
 */
const isSameOrigin = (req: Request, allowedHostnames: readonly string[]) => {
  const origin = req.headers.get("origin");
  const host = req.headers.get("host");

  if (origin === null || host === null) return false;

  const hostname = hostnameOf(host);

  return (
    hostname !== null &&
    allowedHostnames.includes(hostname) &&
    origin === `http://${host}`
  );
};

/**
 * Reads the body as bytes and stops as soon as it is larger than `max`.
 * Returns null when it is too large.
 */
async function readBodyWithLimit(
  req: Request,
  max: number
): Promise<Uint8Array | null> {
  const declared = Number(req.headers.get("content-length"));

  if (Number.isFinite(declared) && declared > max) return null;
  if (!req.body) return new Uint8Array(0);

  const reader = req.body.getReader();
  const chunks: Uint8Array[] = [];
  let total = 0;

  for (;;) {
    const { done, value } = await reader.read();

    if (done) break;

    total += value.byteLength;

    if (total > max) {
      await reader.cancel();
      return null;
    }

    chunks.push(value);
  }

  const bytes = new Uint8Array(total);
  let offset = 0;

  for (const chunk of chunks) {
    bytes.set(chunk, offset);
    offset += chunk.byteLength;
  }

  return bytes;
}

/**
 * Replaces `file` in one step: writes a temporary file in the same directory,
 * then renames it over the target. A failed write leaves the previous file
 * untouched and removes the temporary file.
 */
async function writeFileAtomically(dir: string, file: string, text: string) {
  await mkdir(dir, { recursive: true });

  const temporary = join(dir, `.${ACTIVITY_FILE_NAME}.${randomUUID()}.tmp`);

  try {
    await writeFile(temporary, text, { encoding: "utf8", flag: "wx" });
    await rename(temporary, file);
  } catch (error) {
    await rm(temporary, { force: true });
    throw error;
  }
}

/**
 * The showcase's publish API, a stand-in for S3's save API: GET returns the
 * current page, POST validates a page and publishes it.
 */
export function createActivityHandlers(
  options: ActivityHandlerOptions
): ActivityHandlers {
  const file = join(options.dataDir, ACTIVITY_FILE_NAME);
  const allowedHostnames =
    options.allowedHostnames ?? DEFAULT_ALLOWED_HOSTNAMES;

  return {
    async GET() {
      const { data } = await readActivity(options);

      return Response.json(data, { headers: NO_STORE });
    },

    async POST(req) {
      if (!isSameOrigin(req, allowedHostnames)) {
        return fail(403, "forbidden_origin", "只接受從本站送出的發布請求。");
      }

      if (!isJsonContentType(req.headers.get("content-type"))) {
        return fail(
          415,
          "unsupported_media_type",
          "發布請求的 Content-Type 必須是 application/json。"
        );
      }

      const bytes = await readBodyWithLimit(req, MAX_BODY_BYTES);

      if (bytes === null) {
        return fail(
          413,
          "too_large",
          "頁面資料超過 2 MB（2,097,152 bytes，以 UTF-8 計算）的上限，沒有發布。"
        );
      }

      const result = options.validatePageJson(bytes);

      if (!result.ok) {
        return Response.json(
          { errors: result.errors },
          { status: 422, headers: NO_STORE }
        );
      }

      try {
        await writeFileAtomically(
          options.dataDir,
          file,
          `${JSON.stringify(result.data, null, 2)}\n`
        );
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("Failed to write the published page:", error);

        return fail(500, "write_failed", "頁面沒有存檔成功，請再發布一次。");
      }

      return Response.json(
        { notices: result.notices },
        { status: 200, headers: NO_STORE }
      );
    },
  };
}
```

建立 `apps/showcase/lib/publish-result.ts`：

```ts
import type { Config } from "@tzuchi/tceditor";
import type { Issue, IssueCode } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-blocks/validator";

/**
 * The outcome of the last publish, shown by the 發布檢查 panel. `page` is the
 * data that was sent: the issue paths point into it.
 */
export type PublishResult =
  | { status: "idle" }
  | { status: "publishing" }
  | { status: "published"; notices: Issue[]; page: unknown }
  | { status: "invalid"; errors: Issue[]; page: unknown }
  | { status: "failed"; message: string };

export type PublishResultStore = {
  getSnapshot(): PublishResult;
  subscribe(listener: () => void): () => void;
  set(result: PublishResult): void;
};

/** A minimal external store for useSyncExternalStore. */
export function createPublishResultStore(): PublishResultStore {
  let current: PublishResult = { status: "idle" };
  const listeners = new Set<() => void>();

  return {
    getSnapshot: () => current,
    subscribe(listener) {
      listeners.add(listener);

      return () => {
        listeners.delete(listener);
      };
    },
    set(result) {
      current = result;
      listeners.forEach((listener) => listener());
    },
  };
}

type UnknownRecord = Record<string, unknown>;

const isRecord = (value: unknown): value is UnknownRecord =>
  typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);

/**
 * Sends the page to the publish API and turns the response into a
 * PublishResult. Never throws.
 */
export async function publishPage(
  page: unknown,
  options: { endpoint?: string; fetch?: typeof fetch } = {}
): Promise<PublishResult> {
  const { endpoint = "/api/activity", fetch: fetchImpl = fetch } = options;
  let response: Response;

  try {
    response = await fetchImpl(endpoint, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify(page),
    });
  } catch {
    return { status: "failed", message: "無法連線到伺服器，頁面沒有發布。" };
  }

  const body: unknown = await response.json().catch(() => null);

  if (
    response.status === 200 &&
    isRecord(body) &&
    Array.isArray(body.notices)
  ) {
    return { status: "published", notices: body.notices as Issue[], page };
  }

  if (response.status === 422 && isRecord(body) && Array.isArray(body.errors)) {
    return { status: "invalid", errors: body.errors as Issue[], page };
  }

  return {
    status: "failed",
    message:
      isRecord(body) && typeof body.message === "string"
        ? body.message
        : `發布失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`,
  };
}

const isBlock = (
  value: unknown
): value is { type: string; props: { id: string } } =>
  isRecord(value) &&
  typeof value.type === "string" &&
  isRecord(value.props) &&
  typeof value.props.id === "string";

/**
 * Finds the block an issue points at by following `path` through `page`.
 * Returns the id of the deepest block on the path, null for the page root
 * (`["root", ...]`), and undefined when the path reaches no block. Only own
 * properties are followed.
 */
export function findIssueBlockId(
  page: unknown,
  path: readonly (string | number)[]
): string | null | undefined {
  if (path[0] === "root") return null;
  if (path[0] !== "content") return undefined;

  let current: unknown = page;
  let found: string | undefined;

  for (const segment of path) {
    if (
      (!isRecord(current) && !Array.isArray(current)) ||
      !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(current, segment)
    ) {
      break;
    }

    current = (current as UnknownRecord)[segment];

    if (isBlock(current)) found = current.props.id;
  }

  return found;
}

/** What the 發布檢查 panel names for an issue: the block and the field. */
export type IssueLocation = { block: string; field?: string };

/** `object[key]` when it is an own property, else undefined. */
const own = (object: unknown, key: string | number): unknown =>
  isRecord(object) && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(object, key)
    ? object[key]
    : undefined;

const labelOf = (value: unknown): string | undefined => {
  const label = own(value, "label");

  return typeof label === "string" && label !== "" ? label : undefined;
};

/**
 * The field an issue is about: the key after the last `<index>, "props"`
 * (or `"root", "props"`) of its path, so a nested block's field wins.
 */
function fieldNameOf(path: readonly (string | number)[]): string | undefined {
  for (let i = path.length - 2; i >= 1; i -= 1) {
    const blockProps =
      path[i] === "props" &&
      (typeof path[i - 1] === "number" || (i === 1 && path[0] === "root"));

    if (blockProps) {
      const name = path[i + 1];

      return typeof name === "string" ? name : undefined;
    }
  }

  return undefined;
}

/**
 * Issues about a whole block. Their path ends at the block itself (or at its
 * `type`), so the last field on the path belongs to the block around it and
 * must not be named.
 */
const BLOCK_ISSUES: ReadonlySet<IssueCode> = new Set<IssueCode>([
  "unknown_type",
  "not_allowed_here",
  "too_deep",
  "too_many_blocks",
]);

/**
 * The block label and the field label of an issue, read from the editor
 * config (spec §10.3). An array item or object member is named by its
 * top-level field; a key the config does not know, or an issue about the
 * whole block, gets no field label. Only own properties are read, since
 * types and keys come from page data.
 */
export function describeIssue(config: Config, issue: Issue): IssueLocation {
  const name = BLOCK_ISSUES.has(issue.code)
    ? undefined
    : fieldNameOf(issue.path);
  let block: string;
  let fields: unknown;

  if (issue.path[0] === "root") {
    block = "頁面";
    fields = own(config.root, "fields");
  } else if (issue.blockType === undefined) {
    return { block: "頁面資料" };
  } else {
    const component = own(config.components, issue.blockType);

    block = labelOf(component) ?? issue.blockType;
    fields = own(component, "fields");
  }

  const field = name === undefined ? undefined : labelOf(own(fields, name));

  return field === undefined ? { block } : { block, field };
}
```

```ts
import { validatePageJson } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-blocks/validator";
import { createActivityHandlers } from "../../../lib/activity-api";
import { getDataDir, getPresetPath } from "../../../lib/activity-store";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const handlers = createActivityHandlers({
  dataDir: getDataDir(),
  presetPath: getPresetPath(),
  validatePageJson,
});

export function GET() {
  return handlers.GET();
}

export function POST(req: Request) {
  return handlers.POST(req);
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6: 執行測試，確認通過**

Run: `pnpm --filter @tzuchi/tceditor-showcase test`

Expected：`Test Suites: 3 passed, 3 total`、`Tests: 48 passed, 48 total`，包括：
- `GET /api/activity` › `returns the preset while nothing is published`、`returns the published page after a publish`
- `POST /api/activity` › `validates, fills defaults and writes the page`、`returns notices for richtext it had to clean`、`returns 422 with the issues for a javascript: link and writes nothing`、`returns 413 for a body over 2 MB of Chinese text`、`stops reading a body as soon as it passes 2 MB`、`rejects a declared Content-Length over 2 MB before reading`、`accepts a body of exactly 2,097,152 bytes`、`accepts application/json with a charset`、3 個 `returns 415 for Content-Type …`、5 個 `returns 403 when …`（含 `Host is another site's name (DNS rebinding)`）、2 個 `accepts a same-origin publish to …`、`keeps the previous page when the write fails`、`creates the data directory on the first publish`
- `app/api/activity/route.ts` › `publishes into SHOWCASE_DATA_DIR and serves the page from there`
- `content/activity.preset.json` › 6 個測試
- `findIssueBlockId` › 6 個、`describeIssue` › 7 個（`names the block and the field`、`names the deepest block's field on a nested path`、`names an array item by its array field`、`names the page root's fields`、`leaves out a field the config does not have`、`falls back to the type for blocks and keys the config lacks`、`names only the block for an issue about the whole block`）、`publishPage` › 5 個、`createPublishResultStore` › 1 個

若 `preset.spec.ts` 的 `passes the page validator without notices` 或 `is already in the stored form` 失敗：
- 先看 jest 印出的差異。
- 差異是段落或標題多出 `attrs: { textAlign: null }`（或其他 `textAlign`）時，表示 Task 2 的 `fitRichTextToTypes` 在 `textAlign: false` 下沒有移除這個屬性：停止並回報，不要改寫範例頁。
- 差異只在其他富文字的形狀（例如 link 的 attrs）時，表示 Task 1–3 的清理結果和範例頁撰寫時不同。用下面的指令把範例頁改寫成目前驗證器的輸出，再確認 `git diff` 只動到富文字：

```bash

cat > canon.tmp.mts <<'TS'
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { validatePage } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-blocks/validator";
const file = "content/activity.preset.json";
const result = validatePage(JSON.parse(readFileSync(file, "utf8")));
if (!result.ok) throw new Error(JSON.stringify(result.errors, null, 2));
writeFileSync(file, JSON.stringify(result.data, null, 2) + "\n");
```

- 錯誤是 `invalid_value` 或 `unknown_prop` 時，表示 Task 10 的規格和範例頁不一致：停止並回報，不要改測試。

建立 `apps/showcase/app/(public)/activity/page.tsx`（伺服器元件；C.4 的 ESLint 規則禁止 import `@tzuchi/tceditor` 主入口的執行期值）：

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { cache } from "react";
import { Render } from "@tzuchi/tceditor/rsc";
import { demoAssetSource } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-blocks/demo-assets";
import { createRenderConfig } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-blocks/render";
import { loadActivity } from "../../../lib/activity-store";

// The page is read from disk on every request, so a publish shows up at once.
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const config = createRenderConfig({ assets: demoAssetSource });

// generateMetadata and the page share one read per request.
const getActivity = cache(loadActivity);

const text = (value: unknown) =>
  typeof value === "string" && value !== "" ? value : undefined;

export async function generateMetadata(): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { data } = await getActivity();
  const props: Record<string, unknown> = data.root.props ?? {};

  return { title: text(props.title), description: text(props.description) };
}

export default async function ActivityPage() {
  const { data } = await getActivity();

  return <Render config={config} data={data} />;
}
```
