```tsx
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import type { Data } from "@tzuchi/tceditor";
import { loadActivity } from "../../../../lib/activity-store";
import { ActivityEditor } from "./client";

// Always load the latest published page.
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "編輯活動頁" };

/** `?blank=1` starts from an empty page (used by the showcase smoke test). */
const BLANK_PAGE: Data = { root: { props: {} }, content: [] };

export default async function ActivityEditPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
}) {
  const { blank } = await searchParams;
  const data = blank === "1" ? BLANK_PAGE : (await loadActivity()).data;

  return <ActivityEditor initialData={data} />;
}
```

建立 `apps/showcase/app/(editor)/activity/edit/client.tsx`：

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";
import {
  Puck,
  type Data,
  type Overrides,
  type Viewports,
} from "@tzuchi/tceditor";
import headingAnalyzer from "@tzuchi/tceditor-plugin-heading-analyzer";
import { demoAssetSource } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-blocks/demo-assets";
import { createEditorConfig } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-blocks/editor";
import {
  publishActivity,
  publishCheckPlugin,
} from "../../../../lib/publish-check";

// Puck rebuilds its store whenever these change identity, so they live at
// module scope.
const config = createEditorConfig({ assets: demoAssetSource });

const plugins = [headingAnalyzer, publishCheckPlugin];

// The breakpoints of the Tzu Chi tokens.
const viewports: Viewports = [
  { width: 375, height: "auto", icon: "Smartphone", label: "手機" },
  { width: 768, height: "auto", icon: "Tablet", label: "平板" },
  { width: 1024, height: "auto", icon: "Monitor", label: "桌面" },
];

// Gives the preview iframe the public page's theme and language. The editor
// layout's <html> has no data-theme, so nothing overwrites these.
const ThemedIframe: Overrides["iframe"] = ({ children, document }) => {
  useEffect(() => {
    const html = document?.documentElement;

    if (!html) return;

    html.setAttribute("data-theme", "tzuchi");
    html.setAttribute("lang", "zh-Hant");
  }, [document]);

  return <>{children}</>;
};

const overrides: Partial<Overrides> = { iframe: ThemedIframe };

export function ActivityEditor({ initialData }: { initialData: Data }) {
  return (
    <Puck
      config={config}
      data={initialData}
      onPublish={publishActivity}
      plugins={plugins}
      viewports={viewports}
      overrides={overrides}
      headerTitle="活動頁"
      headerPath="/activity"
    />
  );
}
```

建立 `apps/showcase/lib/publish-check.tsx`：

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";
import {
  createUsePuck,
  useGetPuck,
  type Data,
  type Plugin,
} from "@tzuchi/tceditor";
import type { Issue } from "@tzuchi/tceditor-blocks/validator";
import styles from "./publish-check.module.css";
import {
  createPublishResultStore,
  describeIssue,
  findIssueBlockId,
  publishPage,
  type PublishResult,
} from "./publish-result";

const PLUGIN_NAME = "publish-check";

// A plugin panel's render function takes no props, so the publish result
// reaches the panel through this module-level store.
const store = createPublishResultStore();

let latestPublish = 0;

/** The <Puck onPublish> handler: posts the page and records the result. */
export async function publishActivity(data: Data): Promise<void> {
  const publish = ++latestPublish;

  store.set({ status: "publishing" });

  const result = await publishPage(data);

  // A slower, older request must not overwrite a newer result.
  if (publish === latestPublish) store.set(result);
}

const usePuck = createUsePuck();

function IssueList({ issues, page }: { issues: Issue[]; page: unknown }) {
  const config = usePuck((s) => s.config);
  const getPuck = useGetPuck();

  // The path points into the page that was published; its block id still
  // finds the block after later edits moved it. A deleted block is a no-op.
  const select = (issue: Issue) => {
    const id = findIssueBlockId(page, issue.path);

    if (id === undefined) return;

    const { dispatch, getSelectorForId } = getPuck();
    // null selects the page root, whose fields are the title and description.
    const itemSelector = id === null ? null : getSelectorForId(id);

    if (itemSelector === undefined) return;

    dispatch({
      type: "setUi",
      ui: { itemSelector, rightSideBarVisible: true },
    });
  };

  return (
    <ul className={styles["PublishCheck-list"]}>
      {issues.map((issue, index) => {
        const { block, field } = describeIssue(config, issue);

        return (
          <li key={`${issue.pathText}-${issue.code}-${index}`}>
            <button
              type="button"
              className={styles["PublishCheck-issue"]}
              onClick={() => select(issue)}
            >
              <span className={styles["PublishCheck-block"]}>
                {field === undefined ? block : `${block} › ${field}`}
              </span>
              <span>{issue.message}</span>
              <span className={styles["PublishCheck-path"]}>
                {issue.pathText}
              </span>
            </button>
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ul>
  );
}

const statusText = (result: PublishResult) => {
  switch (result.status) {
    case "idle":
      return "尚未發布";
    case "publishing":
      return "發布中…";
    case "published":
      return result.notices.length === 0
        ? "沒有錯誤，已發布"
        : `沒有錯誤，已發布（${result.notices.length} 個提示）`;
    case "invalid":
      return `有 ${result.errors.length} 個錯誤，沒有發布`;
    case "failed":
      return result.message;
  }
};

function PublishCheckPanel() {
  const result = useSyncExternalStore(
    store.subscribe,
    store.getSnapshot,
    store.getSnapshot
  );
  const getPuck = useGetPuck();

  // Bring the panel forward when a publish finishes.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (result.status === "idle" || result.status === "publishing") return;

    getPuck().dispatch({
      type: "setUi",
      ui: { plugin: { current: PLUGIN_NAME }, leftSideBarVisible: true },
    });
  }, [result, getPuck]);

  const tone =
    result.status === "published"
      ? styles["PublishCheck-status--ok"]
      : result.status === "invalid" || result.status === "failed"
      ? styles["PublishCheck-status--error"]
      : "";

  return (
    <div
      className={styles.PublishCheck}
      data-testid="publish-check"
      data-status={result.status}
    >
      <p className={`${styles["PublishCheck-status"]} ${tone}`} role="status">
        {statusText(result)}
      </p>
      {result.status === "invalid" && (
        <IssueList issues={result.errors} page={result.page} />
      )}
      {result.status === "published" && result.notices.length > 0 && (
        <IssueList issues={result.notices} page={result.page} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function PublishCheckIcon() {
  return (
    <svg
      width="24"
      height="24"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth="2"
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      <path d="m3 7 2 2 4-4" />
      <path d="m3 17 2 2 4-4" />
      <path d="M13 6h8" />
      <path d="M13 12h8" />
      <path d="M13 18h8" />
    </svg>
  );
}

/** The 發布檢查 panel: the result of the last publish and its issues. */
export const publishCheckPlugin: Plugin = {
  name: PLUGIN_NAME,
  label: "發布檢查",
  icon: <PublishCheckIcon />,
  render: PublishCheckPanel,
};
```

````markdown
# @tzuchi/tceditor-showcase

The tceditor showcase (spec §10): an activity page built from the 8 demo
blocks of `@tzuchi/tceditor-blocks`.

| Path                 | What it is                                                              |
| -------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `/activity/edit`     | The editor. Loads the published page, or `content/activity.preset.json` |
| `/activity`          | The public page, rendered on the server with `@tzuchi/tceditor/rsc`     |
| `GET /api/activity`  | The current page data                                                   |
| `POST /api/activity` | Publish: validates the page, then writes it                             |

```sh
pnpm dev:showcase   # http://127.0.0.1:3010/activity/edit (bound to 127.0.0.1)
```

Published pages go to `apps/showcase/.data/activity.json` (gitignored), or to
`$SHOWCASE_DATA_DIR/activity.json`. Delete the file to go back to the preset.
````

### Task 16: 公開頁產物掃描、示範站冒煙測試

目的：把規格 §6.6 的「公開頁不載入編輯器」變成 `pnpm verify` 裡的自動檢查 `pnpm check:public-bundle`。它掃描 `next build` 產物中 `/activity` 的所有瀏覽器端 chunk，不得出現只有編輯器（core 的編輯器畫面、區塊的圖片挑選器）才有的字串，也不得出現 zod 的字串；同時掃描 `/activity/edit` 當對照組，確認這些字串確實存在，以免掃描本身失效卻誤判通過。掃描時也印出 `/activity` 載入的 JS 與 CSS 大小（原始與 gzip -9），這是規格 §16「S2 先接受並記錄大小」的紀錄，不是失敗條件。另外新增獨立的示範站冒煙測試 `scripts/e2e/showcase-smoke.mjs`（更正 #22），流程如下：
- 從空白頁開始，把 8 個區塊各拖一個進頁面。
- 填好按鈕網址與圖片（選圖、替代文字），在段落的富文字欄位打字，按 `Publish`。
- 等待 `POST /api/activity` 回 200 而且沒有任何提示（`notices` 是空陣列），以及面板顯示沒有錯誤。
- 確認 `/activity` 的伺服器端 HTML 含有 8 個區塊的內容、按鈕連結與圖片網址。

任何一步失敗就 exit 1，最後（含 Ctrl-C 或收到 signal 時）把已發布的頁面還原成測試前的狀態。`pnpm smoke` 依序執行既有的 demo 冒煙測試與這個新測試。

**執行位置**：主工作目錄 `/Users/kaellim/Desktop/projects/puck`，分支 `s2/block-spec`。需要網路的步驟：Step 10 `pnpm verify` 裡的 `pnpm audit:gate`。

**設計決定與說明**：

**`check:public-bundle`**
- **掃描邏輯就是預檢實測可用的程式**（facts/preflight.md §4.5、facts/frameworks.md §7.6），改寫成可測試的 export：
  - `listRouteChunks(nextDir, urlPath)`：從 `app-path-routes-manifest.json` 找出 entry key（`/(public)/activity/page`、`/(editor)/activity/edit/page`）。
  - 再從每個 route 的 `build-manifest.json`（`rootMainFiles` 與 `polyfillFiles`）與 `page_client-reference-manifest.js`（用 `vm` 執行，取 `entryJSFiles` 與 `clientModules`）找出 chunk。
  - 最後追蹤 chunk 內文中以 `static/chunks/<名稱>.js` 形式引用的 async chunk，取遞移閉包。
  - Next 16 沒有 `app-build-manifest.json`，所以不能用它（facts/frameworks.md §0 #5）。
  - 只掃 `.next/static`：server bundle 本來就含有編輯器的 SSR 程式碼（facts/frameworks.md §7.4）。
- **三個標記字串**：
  - `"header-toggle-leftsidebar"`：core dictionary 的 key，只有編輯器的 Header 用到，壓縮後仍保留為字串（gaps C6；facts/preflight.md §4.5 實測 `/activity` 0 個、`/activity/edit` 2 個 chunk 含有）。
  - `"tcb-picker-option"`：區塊圖片挑選器（`packages/blocks/src/image/editor.tsx`，只在編輯器使用的 client component）的 class 名稱，壓縮後仍保留為字串。它不帶 core 的 Header；它從 `@tzuchi/tceditor-spec` 只取用常數 `IMAGE_ALT_MAX_LENGTH`，而 spec 是 `sideEffects: false`，zod 可能被 tree-shake 掉。因此只靠另外兩個標記，可能攔不到「挑選器被帶進公開頁」，原本只有 ESLint 一道防線（Task 11 的 `./image/editor` 限制）。實測 `/activity` 0 個、`/activity/edit` 1 個 chunk 含有；在公開頁放一個 import `@tzuchi/tceditor-blocks/editor` 的 client component 時，`header-toggle-leftsidebar` 仍是 0，這個標記與 zod 標記都抓到外洩。
  - `"__zod_globalConfig"`：zod 4.6.5 `v4/core/core.js` 的全域設定 key（`globalThis.__zod_globalConfig`），每一份 zod 都會執行到。編輯器經由區塊規格與 `toPuckFields` 帶進 zod；公開頁的驗證在伺服器端，瀏覽器不該有 zod。實測 `/activity/edit` 有 1 個 chunk 含有。
  - 規則：每個標記在 `/activity` 必須是 0 個 chunk，在 `/activity/edit` 必須至少 1 個。對照組找不到標記時，失敗訊息會請你更新 `MARKERS`（例如 zod 改了內部名稱）。
- **build 產物不存在時清楚失敗**：`apps/showcase/.next/app-path-routes-manifest.json not found. Run pnpm build first.`。`--webpack` 產物的 manifest 格式不同（facts/frameworks.md §7.5），結果同樣是找不到檔案或 manifest 而失敗，不會誤判通過。
- **記錄公開頁的大小**（規格 §16 的風險表：公開頁多出的 JS 與 CSS「S2 先接受並記錄大小」）：
  - `listRouteChunks` 另外回傳 `polyfills` 與 `css`。`polyfills` 是 `build-manifest.json` 的 `polyfillFiles`，HTML 以 `noModule` 載入，支援 ES module 的瀏覽器不會下載。`css` 是 client reference manifest 的 `entryCSSFiles`（Next 16 的格式是 `{ path, inlined }` 物件，也接受字串），加上 chunk 內文以 `static/chunks/<名稱>.css` 引用的檔（`CHUNK_REFERENCE` 因此也比對 `.css`；樣式表本身不再往下追）。
  - `measureFiles(nextDir, files)` 回傳檔數、原始 bytes，以及每個檔各自 `gzipSync(…, { level: 9 })` 後的總和（瀏覽器是逐檔下載的）。`checkPublicBundle` 回傳 `sizes`：`/activity` 的 JS（不含 polyfill）與 CSS。
  - CLI 把 `sizes` 印成兩行 `check:public-bundle: /activity loads …`，排在三行標記報告之前，所以 `passed` 仍是最後一行，而它前面的三行仍是標記報告。大小只是紀錄：不設門檻，也不會讓檢查失敗。
  - 實測（Task 15 的示範站）：JS 5 個檔、514,499 bytes、gzip 後 145,052 bytes；CSS 1 個檔、544,778 bytes、gzip 後 52,336 bytes。和用 `next start` 開啟 `/activity` 時 HTML 實際載入的 `<script>`（不含 `noModule` 的那一個）與 `<link rel="stylesheet">` 相同。JS 全部是 Next.js 與 React 的執行環境：公開頁沒有 client component，`entryJSFiles` 只有 Next 內建的 not-found。規格 §16 估計的「約 37 KB 的 JS」來自 `@heroui/react`，S2 不 vendor 它（更正 #14），所以公開頁沒有區塊或 HeroUI 的 JS。CSS 是 tokens、`@heroui/styles`、慈濟主題與 `blocks.css` 編譯成的一個檔，規格估計約 63 KB（gzip）。Task 17 把這兩組數字記進 `apps/showcase/README.md`。
- **測試**：`scripts/check-public-bundle.test.mjs`（node:test）用臨時目錄做一份假的 `.next`，manifest 格式和 Next 16 相同。測試涵蓋：
  - chunk 清單，含 async chunk 的追蹤，以及 polyfill 與樣式表（`entryCSSFiles` 與 chunk 內引用的 `.css`）。
  - 公開頁 JS（不含 polyfill）與 CSS 的大小。
  - 只有編輯器 route 含標記時通過。
  - 標記經由 async chunk 進到公開頁時失敗，訊息指出是哪個檔。
  - 對照組缺標記時失敗。
  - CLI 先印兩行大小，再印三行標記報告，最後一行是 `passed`，exit 0。
  - CLI 在 build 產物不存在時 exit 1。
- **真實 build 的反例**（Step 5）：在公開頁暫時放一個 import `Puck` 的 client component，重新 build 之後，掃描指出 2 個公開頁 chunk 含 `header-toggle-leftsidebar` 並 exit 1；還原後再 build 就通過。這個反例同時說明 ESLint 規則與產物掃描是兩道各自獨立的防線。`Puck` 不帶進挑選器與 zod，所以那兩行在反例中仍是 `/activity 0/…`。
- **位置**：root script，排在 `verify` 的 `pnpm build` 之後（更正 #16）、`check:edge` 之後（計畫開頭 Global Constraints 的 verify 組成）。turbo 在 cache hit 時會還原 `.next`（Task 15 的 `outputs`），實測刪掉 `.next` 再 build 也能掃描。

**`showcase-smoke.mjs`**
- **獨立的腳本，失敗時 exit 1**（更正 #22）。既有的 `smoke()` 不會因失敗而以非 0 結束，所以不使用它；只沿用 `scripts/e2e/utils` 的 `setup`、`dragAndDrop`、`getBox`、`pause`（facts/repo-infra.md §3）。
- **先確認伺服器可連線**：`GET /api/activity` 連不上時，印出「先 `pnpm dev:showcase`」並 exit 1。網址預設 `http://127.0.0.1:3010`，可以用 `SHOWCASE_URL` 改。不寫死 `localhost`，因為伺服器只綁 127.0.0.1。
- **不留下副作用**：測試開始前讀取 `<資料目錄>/activity.json`（`SHOWCASE_DATA_DIR` 以 `apps/showcase` 為基準解析，或預設的 `apps/showcase/.data`，規則和伺服器相同）。結束時（含失敗）寫回原本的內容；原本沒有檔案就刪除。`.data/` 資料夾本身會留下（發布時由 API 建立），裡面不會有 `activity.json`。
  - 發布之後會確認這個檔案真的收到新資料。伺服器若用了別的 `SHOWCASE_DATA_DIR`，測試會失敗並說明原因，不會默默改掉別處的檔案又沒有還原。
  - **Ctrl-C 與 signal**：`try/finally` 在 `SIGINT`、`SIGTERM`、`SIGHUP` 時不會執行（puppeteer 對 `SIGINT` 的處理是關掉 Chrome 後直接 `process.exit(130)`）。腳本在啟動 puppeteer 之前註冊 `process.once(signal)`：先 `restore()`，再以 `128 + 訊號編號` 結束；puppeteer 在 process `exit` 時會關掉 Chrome。實測：在發布寫檔之後立刻送 `SIGTERM` 與 `SIGINT`，exit 分別是 143 與 130，檔案與測試前逐位元組相同，沒有殘留的 Chrome。
- **從空白頁開始**：開啟 `/activity/edit?blank=1`（Task 15），先確認畫布上沒有區塊，以及預覽 iframe 的 `data-theme` 是 `tzuchi`（更正 #19 的執行期檢查）。
- **拖放**：
  - 選擇器用 gaps C12 與 #48：`[data-testid="drawer-item:<Type>"]`、`[data-testid="dropzone:root:default-zone"]`。
  - 拖放順序是 Heading、Paragraph、Button、TagList、Image、Card、Columns、Section：先放沒有放置區的區塊。第一個放在根放置區中央，其餘用 `dragAndDrop` 的 `"top"` 模式。實測 8 個區塊都落在根層，沒有掉進卡片、多欄或區段的放置區。
  - 每次拖放後，等畫布上的 `[data-puck-component]` 數量增加。
- **填欄位**：Puck 插入區塊後會選取它（facts/core-puck-api.md §9 的 `insert-component`），右側就是它的欄位。
  - 按鈕：在可見的 `input[name="href"]` 輸入 `/activity/smoke-register`（gaps C12）。Puck 的欄位有一份在右側欄、一份在隱藏的手機面板，所以要挑可見的那一個。
  - 圖片：在挑選器點 `button:has(img[src="/demo-assets/demo-1.svg"])`（Task 11 的 `tcb-picker-option`），再在最近的文字輸入框輸入替代文字「冒煙測試圖片」。
  - 段落：在右側欄可見的富文字欄位 `.ProseMirror[contenteditable="true"]` 連點三下選取整段，輸入「冒煙測試段落」。這個欄位是 Tiptap 編輯器，送出的 `body` 就是 Tiptap `getJSON()` 的結果，所以冒煙測試涵蓋 Review Focus #1 的端到端情境：編輯器實際產生的富文字，驗證器不必清理。畫布 iframe 裡的行內編輯器不在主文件，不會被這個選擇器選到。
- **發布與檢查**：
  - 用 `::-p-text(Publish)` 點 header 的發布按鈕（core dictionary 的 `header-publish`）。
  - 等 `POST /api/activity` 回 200，而且回應的 `notices` 是空陣列：有任何 `richtext_cleaned` 之類的提示，表示驗證器改動了編輯器送出的資料（Review Focus #1）。只看 200 不夠，因為有提示時面板仍顯示「沒有錯誤，已發布（1 個提示）」，`data-status` 仍是 `published`。
  - 再等 `[data-testid="publish-check"][data-status="published"]` 出現並可見，也就是面板顯示「沒有錯誤，已發布」。
  - 再用 `GET /api/activity` 確認存下的頁面恰好有 8 種區塊類型。
  - 最後抓 `/activity` 的 HTML，確認含有：`<title>未命名頁面</title>`、「標題文字」「立即報名」「卡片標題」「志工」「環保」（Task 10 的預設值）、「冒煙測試段落」（輸入的段落）、`href="/activity/smoke-register"`、`tcb-section`、`tcb-columns tcb-columns--2`（Task 11 的 class，區段與多欄沒有預設文字）、`src="/demo-assets/demo-1.svg"`、`alt="冒煙測試圖片"`。
  - 編輯器頁面若有任何 `pageerror`，也算失敗。
- **puppeteer 使用真正的 `HOME`**，才找得到 `~/.cache/puppeteer` 裡的 Chrome（Global Constraints）。
- **`pnpm smoke` = `node scripts/e2e/smoke.mjs && node scripts/e2e/showcase-smoke.mjs`**（C.5）：需要 demo（:3000）與示範站（:3010）都在執行，不在 `pnpm verify` 內。

建立 `scripts/check-public-bundle.test.mjs`：

```js
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import {
  mkdirSync,
  mkdtempSync,
  readFileSync,
  rmSync,
  writeFileSync,
} from "node:fs";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import { dirname, join } from "node:path";
import { after, test } from "node:test";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { gzipSync } from "node:zlib";

import {
  MARKERS as REAL_MARKERS,
  checkPublicBundle,
  listRouteChunks,
} from "./check-public-bundle.mjs";

const SCRIPT = fileURLToPath(
  new URL("./check-public-bundle.mjs", import.meta.url)
);
const MARKERS = [{ name: "the editor", value: "EDITOR_ONLY" }];

const roots = [];
after(() => {
  for (const root of roots) rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
});

const write = (root, file, text) => {
  mkdirSync(dirname(join(root, file)), { recursive: true });
  writeFileSync(join(root, file), text);
};

const route = (root, entryKey, { main, clientChunks, css }) => {
  write(
    root,
    `server/app/${entryKey}/build-manifest.json`,
    JSON.stringify({
      rootMainFiles: main,
      polyfillFiles: ["static/chunks/polyfill.js"],
    })
  );
  // Same shape as Next 16's page_client-reference-manifest.js.
  write(
    root,
    `server/app/${entryKey}_client-reference-manifest.js`,
    "globalThis.__RSC_MANIFEST = globalThis.__RSC_MANIFEST || {};\n" +
      `globalThis.__RSC_MANIFEST[${JSON.stringify(entryKey)}] = ` +
      JSON.stringify({
        clientModules: {
          "[project]/app/x.tsx": {
            id: 1,
            name: "*",
            chunks: clientChunks.map((c) => `/_next/${c}`),
            async: false,
          },
        },
        entryJSFiles: { [`[project]/app/${entryKey}`]: clientChunks },
        entryCSSFiles: {
          [`[project]/app/${entryKey}`]: css.map((path) => ({
            path,
            inlined: false,
          })),
        },
      }) +
      ";\n"
  );
};

/**
 * A fake `.next` directory with both routes. The editor page loads
 * editor.js, which loads lazy.js and lazy.css on demand; `publicExtra` adds
 * text to the public page's client chunk.
 */
function fakeBuild({ publicExtra = "", lazy = "EDITOR_ONLY" } = {}) {
  const root = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "check-public-bundle-"));
  roots.push(root);

  write(
    root,
    "app-path-routes-manifest.json",
    JSON.stringify({
      "/(editor)/activity/edit/page": "/activity/edit",
      "/(public)/activity/page": "/activity",
      "/api/activity/route": "/api/activity",
    })
  );
  write(root, "static/chunks/main.js", 'load("static/chunks/runtime.js")');
  write(root, "static/chunks/runtime.js", "runtime");
  write(root, "static/chunks/polyfill.js", "polyfill");
  write(root, "static/chunks/public.js", `public ${publicExtra}`);
  write(
    root,
    "static/chunks/editor.js",
    'e=>t.l("static/chunks/lazy.js"),t.l("static/chunks/lazy.css")'
  );
  write(root, "static/chunks/lazy.js", lazy);
  write(root, "static/chunks/public.css", ".public{color:red}");
  write(root, "static/chunks/editor.css", ".editor{color:red}");
  write(root, "static/chunks/lazy.css", ".lazy{color:red}");
  route(root, "/(public)/activity/page", {
    main: ["static/chunks/main.js"],
    clientChunks: ["static/chunks/public.js"],
    css: ["static/chunks/public.css"],
  });
  route(root, "/(editor)/activity/edit/page", {
    main: ["static/chunks/main.js"],
    clientChunks: ["static/chunks/editor.js"],
    css: ["static/chunks/editor.css"],
  });

  return root;
}

test("listRouteChunks follows the manifests and chunk references", () => {
  const root = fakeBuild();

  assert.deepEqual(listRouteChunks(root, "/activity"), {
    entryKey: "/(public)/activity/page",
    chunks: [
      "static/chunks/main.js",
      "static/chunks/polyfill.js",
      "static/chunks/public.js",
      "static/chunks/runtime.js",
    ],
    polyfills: ["static/chunks/polyfill.js"],
    css: ["static/chunks/public.css"],
  });

  const control = listRouteChunks(root, "/activity/edit");

  assert.deepEqual(control.chunks, [
    "static/chunks/editor.js",
    "static/chunks/lazy.js",
    "static/chunks/main.js",
    "static/chunks/polyfill.js",
    "static/chunks/runtime.js",
  ]);
  assert.deepEqual(control.css, [
    "static/chunks/editor.css",
    "static/chunks/lazy.css",
  ]);
});

test("measures the public route's JS without the polyfills, and its CSS", () => {
  const root = fakeBuild();
  const gzipped = (...files) =>
    files.reduce(
      (sum, file) =>
        sum + gzipSync(readFileSync(join(root, file)), { level: 9 }).length,
      0
    );

  // main.js 32 + public.js 7 + runtime.js 7 bytes; public.css 18 bytes.
  assert.deepEqual(checkPublicBundle(root, MARKERS).sizes, {
    js: {
      files: 3,
      bytes: 46,
      gzipped: gzipped(
        "static/chunks/main.js",
        "static/chunks/public.js",
        "static/chunks/runtime.js"
      ),
    },
    css: {
      files: 1,
      bytes: 18,
      gzipped: gzipped("static/chunks/public.css"),
    },
  });
});

test("passes when only the editor route contains the markers", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(checkPublicBundle(fakeBuild(), MARKERS).problems, []);
});

test("fails when a marker reaches the public route", () => {
  const { problems } = checkPublicBundle(
    fakeBuild({ publicExtra: 'x=>t.l("static/chunks/lazy.js")' }),
    MARKERS
  );

  assert.deepEqual(problems, [
    '/activity ships the editor: "EDITOR_ONLY" is in static/chunks/lazy.js',
  ]);
});

test("fails when the control route lacks a marker", () => {
  const { problems } = checkPublicBundle(fakeBuild({ lazy: "" }), MARKERS);

  assert.equal(problems.length, 1);
  assert.match(problems[0], /is in no \/activity\/edit chunk/);
});

test("the CLI prints the public route's sizes before the marker report", () => {
  const root = fakeBuild({
    lazy: REAL_MARKERS.map(({ value }) => value).join(" "),
  });
  const { status, stdout } = spawnSync(process.execPath, [SCRIPT, root], {
    encoding: "utf8",
  });
  const { js, css } = checkPublicBundle(root).sizes;
  const lines = stdout.trimEnd().split("\n");

  assert.equal(status, 0);
  assert.deepEqual(lines.slice(0, 2), [
    `check:public-bundle: /activity loads 3 JS files (${js.bytes} bytes, ${js.gzipped} bytes gzipped; nomodule polyfills not counted)`,
    `check:public-bundle: /activity loads 1 CSS file (${css.bytes} bytes, ${css.gzipped} bytes gzipped)`,
  ]);
  assert.equal(lines.length, 6);
  assert.equal(
    lines[5],
    "check:public-bundle passed: /activity ships no editor code."
  );
});

test("the CLI fails clearly when the build output is missing", () => {
  const missing = join(tmpdir(), "check-public-bundle-missing", ".next");
  const { status, stderr } = spawnSync(process.execPath, [SCRIPT, missing], {
    encoding: "utf8",
  });

  assert.equal(status, 1);
  assert.match(
    stderr,
    /app-path-routes-manifest\.json not found\. Run pnpm build first\./
  );
});
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 實作掃描**

建立 `scripts/check-public-bundle.mjs`：

```js
// Checks that the showcase's public page (/activity) ships none of the
// editor's browser code (spec §6.6). It lists the browser chunks of each
// route in the Turbopack `next build` output and searches them for strings
// that only the editor contains. /activity/edit is the control: every marker
// must be found there, or the scan itself is broken. It also prints the size
// of the JS and CSS that /activity loads, for the record (spec §16); the
// sizes are not checked.
//
// Usage: node scripts/check-public-bundle.mjs [<.next dir>] (after pnpm build)
import { existsSync, readFileSync, realpathSync } from "node:fs";
import { dirname, join, resolve } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import vm from "node:vm";
import { gzipSync } from "node:zlib";

export const PUBLIC_ROUTE = "/activity";
export const CONTROL_ROUTE = "/activity/edit";

export const MARKERS = [
  // A dictionary key that only the editor header uses (core lib/dictionary.ts);
  // minifiers keep string literals.
  { name: "the editor", value: "header-toggle-leftsidebar" },
  // A class name of the blocks' image picker (packages/blocks/src/image/
  // editor.tsx), an editor-only client component; minifiers keep it as a
  // string. It needs neither the editor header nor zod.
  { name: "the image picker", value: "tcb-picker-option" },
  // The global config key of zod 4 (zod/v4/core/core.js). The editor config
  // reaches zod through the block specs; the public page must not.
  { name: "zod", value: "__zod_globalConfig" },
];

const CHUNK_REFERENCE = /static\/chunks\/[A-Za-z0-9_~.-]+\.(?:js|css)/g;

const readJson = (file) => JSON.parse(readFileSync(file, "utf8"));

/**
 * The browser files of an App Router page in a Turbopack build: the
 * bootstrap and polyfill files, the page's client components, the
 * stylesheets of its layouts and page, and every file those load later
 * (async chunks are only referenced inside chunks). `chunks` are the
 * JavaScript files, `polyfills` the ones of them that only browsers without
 * ES modules load (`nomodule`), and `css` the stylesheets.
 */
export function listRouteChunks(nextDir, urlPath) {
  const routesFile = join(nextDir, "app-path-routes-manifest.json");

  if (!existsSync(routesFile)) {
    throw new Error(`${routesFile} not found. Run pnpm build first.`);
  }

  const routes = readJson(routesFile);
  const entryKey = Object.keys(routes).find(
    (key) => routes[key] === urlPath && key.endsWith("/page")
  );

  if (!entryKey) {
    throw new Error(`${routesFile} has no page for ${urlPath}.`);
  }

  const files = new Set();
  const buildManifest = readJson(
    join(nextDir, "server/app", entryKey, "build-manifest.json")
  );

  for (const file of [
    ...buildManifest.rootMainFiles,
    ...buildManifest.polyfillFiles,
  ]) {
    files.add(file);
  }

  // The client reference manifest is a script that assigns
  // globalThis.__RSC_MANIFEST[entryKey].
  const sandbox = { self: {} };
  sandbox.globalThis = sandbox.self;
  vm.runInNewContext(
    readFileSync(
      join(nextDir, "server/app", `${entryKey}_client-reference-manifest.js`),
      "utf8"
    ),
    sandbox
  );

  const manifest = sandbox.self.__RSC_MANIFEST?.[entryKey];

  if (!manifest) {
    throw new Error(`No client reference manifest for ${entryKey}.`);
  }

  for (const list of Object.values(manifest.entryJSFiles ?? {})) {
    for (const file of list) files.add(file);
  }

  for (const clientModule of Object.values(manifest.clientModules ?? {})) {
    for (const chunk of clientModule.chunks) {
      files.add(chunk.replace(/^\/_next\//, ""));
    }
  }

  // Next 16 lists { path, inlined } objects; plain paths are accepted too.
  for (const list of Object.values(manifest.entryCSSFiles ?? {})) {
    for (const entry of list) {
      files.add(typeof entry === "string" ? entry : entry.path);
    }
  }

  const queue = [...files];

  while (queue.length > 0) {
    const file = queue.pop();
    const path = join(nextDir, file);

    if (!file.endsWith(".js") || !existsSync(path)) continue;

    for (const [reference] of readFileSync(path, "utf8").matchAll(
      CHUNK_REFERENCE
    )) {
      if (!files.has(reference)) {
        files.add(reference);
        queue.push(reference);
      }
    }
  }

  const existing = [...files]
    .filter((file) => existsSync(join(nextDir, file)))
    .sort();
  const chunks = existing.filter((file) => file.endsWith(".js"));

  if (chunks.length === 0) {
    throw new Error(`No browser chunks found for ${urlPath} in ${nextDir}.`);
  }

  return {
    entryKey,
    chunks,
    polyfills: chunks.filter((file) =>
      buildManifest.polyfillFiles.includes(file)
    ),
    css: existing.filter((file) => file.endsWith(".css")),
  };
}

/** The number of files and their total size, raw and gzipped at level 9. */
export function measureFiles(nextDir, files) {
  let bytes = 0;
  let gzipped = 0;

  for (const file of files) {
    const content = readFileSync(join(nextDir, file));

    bytes += content.length;
    gzipped += gzipSync(content, { level: 9 }).length;
  }

  return { files: files.length, bytes, gzipped };
}

/** The chunks that contain `marker`. */
export function findMarker(nextDir, chunks, marker) {
  return chunks.filter((file) =>
    readFileSync(join(nextDir, file), "utf8").includes(marker)
  );
}

/**
 * Scans both routes; returns the public route's sizes, one report line per
 * marker and the problems. The sizes are what a browser with ES modules
 * downloads; they are recorded, never a problem.
 */
export function checkPublicBundle(nextDir, markers = MARKERS) {
  const publicRoute = listRouteChunks(nextDir, PUBLIC_ROUTE);
  const controlRoute = listRouteChunks(nextDir, CONTROL_ROUTE);
  const report = [];
  const problems = [];

  for (const { name, value } of markers) {
    const leaked = findMarker(nextDir, publicRoute.chunks, value);
    const control = findMarker(nextDir, controlRoute.chunks, value);

    report.push(
      `"${value}" (${name}): ${PUBLIC_ROUTE} ${leaked.length}/${publicRoute.chunks.length} chunks, ` +
        `${CONTROL_ROUTE} ${control.length}/${controlRoute.chunks.length} chunks`
    );

    if (leaked.length > 0) {
      problems.push(
        `${PUBLIC_ROUTE} ships ${name}: "${value}" is in ${leaked.join(", ")}`
      );
    }

    if (control.length === 0) {
      problems.push(
        `"${value}" is in no ${CONTROL_ROUTE} chunk, so the scan cannot see ${name}; update MARKERS`
      );
    }
  }

  const sizes = {
    js: measureFiles(
      nextDir,
      publicRoute.chunks.filter((file) => !publicRoute.polyfills.includes(file))
    ),
    css: measureFiles(nextDir, publicRoute.css),
  };

  return { sizes, report, problems };
}

const describeSize = (kind, { files, bytes, gzipped }, note = "") =>
  `check:public-bundle: ${PUBLIC_ROUTE} loads ${files} ${kind} file${
    files === 1 ? "" : "s"
  } (${bytes} bytes, ${gzipped} bytes gzipped${note})`;

// Node runs the real path of a symlinked script, so compare real paths.
const isMain =
  process.argv[1] !== undefined &&
  realpathSync(process.argv[1]) ===
    realpathSync(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));

if (isMain) {
  const nextDir = resolve(
    process.argv[2] ??
      join(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "../apps/showcase/.next")
  );

  try {
    const { sizes, report, problems } = checkPublicBundle(nextDir);

    console.log(
      describeSize("JS", sizes.js, "; nomodule polyfills not counted")
    );
    console.log(describeSize("CSS", sizes.css));
    for (const line of report) console.log(line);

    if (problems.length > 0) {
      for (const problem of problems) console.error(problem);
      console.error("check:public-bundle FAILED");
      process.exit(1);
    }

    console.log(
      `check:public-bundle passed: ${PUBLIC_ROUTE} ships no editor code.`
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(`check:public-bundle FAILED: ${error.message}`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: 示範站冒煙測試**

建立 `scripts/e2e/showcase-smoke.mjs`：

```js
// Showcase smoke test (spec §13.1): starting from an empty page, drags each of
// the 8 blocks into the editor, fills the required fields, types a paragraph
// in the richtext field editor, publishes, and checks that the publish API
// returned no notices and that the server-rendered /activity HTML contains
// the blocks.
//
// Needs the showcase running on http://127.0.0.1:3010 (pnpm dev:showcase, or
// pnpm --filter @tzuchi/tceditor-showcase build, then … start). Set
// SHOWCASE_URL to test another address.
//
// Publishing replaces the showcase's published page. The script backs up
// <data dir>/activity.json first and puts it back at the end (or deletes the
// file again when there was none), also when it is stopped with Ctrl-C or a
// signal. The data dir is SHOWCASE_DATA_DIR resolved against apps/showcase, or
// apps/showcase/.data: run the script with the same SHOWCASE_DATA_DIR as the
// server.
//
// Exits with 1 on any failure.
import {
  existsSync,
  readFileSync,
  renameSync,
  rmSync,
  writeFileSync,
} from "node:fs";
import { constants } from "node:os";
import { dirname, join, resolve } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { dragAndDrop } from "./utils/drag-and-drop.mjs";
import { getBox } from "./utils/get-box.mjs";
import { pause } from "./utils/pause.mjs";
import { setup } from "./utils/setup.mjs";

const BASE = process.env.SHOWCASE_URL ?? "http://127.0.0.1:3010";
const SHOWCASE_DIR = join(
  dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)),
  "../../apps/showcase"
);
const DATA_FILE = join(
  process.env.SHOWCASE_DATA_DIR
    ? resolve(SHOWCASE_DIR, process.env.SHOWCASE_DATA_DIR)
    : join(SHOWCASE_DIR, ".data"),
  "activity.json"
);
const TIMEOUT = 15_000;

// The header button's text: core's dictionary key "header-publish".
const PUBLISH_LABEL = "Publish";

const ROOT_ZONE = '[data-testid="dropzone:root:default-zone"]';
const BUTTON_HREF = "/activity/smoke-register";
const IMAGE_ALT = "冒煙測試圖片";
const PARAGRAPH_TEXT = "冒煙測試段落";

// The Paragraph's richtext field in the right sidebar: a Tiptap editor, so
// the published body is what Tiptap's getJSON() returns (Review Focus #1).
const RICHTEXT_FIELD = '.ProseMirror[contenteditable="true"]';

// The image picker (packages/blocks/src/image/editor.tsx) shows every asset
// as a button with its thumbnail, above a text input for the alt text.
const IMAGE_PICKER_DEMO_1 = 'button:has(img[src="/demo-assets/demo-1.svg"])';

// Blocks without drop zones first. Every block after the first is dropped at
// the top edge of the page's drop zone, so none lands inside a drop zone of
// a block already on the page.
const BLOCKS = [
  "Heading",
  "Paragraph",
  "Button",
  "TagList",
  "Image",
  "Card",
  "Columns",
  "Section",
];

// The defaults of the blocks (packages/blocks/src/*/spec.ts), the values this
// script types, and the classes of the blocks without text
// (packages/blocks/src/*/view.tsx), as they must appear in the public HTML.
const EXPECTED_HTML = [
  "<title>未命名頁面</title>",
  "標題文字",
  PARAGRAPH_TEXT,
  "立即報名",
  `href="${BUTTON_HREF}"`,
  "卡片標題",
  "志工",
  "環保",
  " tcb-section",
  "tcb-columns tcb-columns--2",
  'src="/demo-assets/demo-1.svg"',
  `alt="${IMAGE_ALT}"`,
];

class SmokeError extends Error {}

const check = (condition, message) => {
  if (!condition) throw new SmokeError(message);
};

async function waitFor(description, probe) {
  const start = Date.now();

  for (;;) {
    const value = await probe();

    if (value) return value;
    if (Date.now() - start > TIMEOUT) {
      throw new SmokeError(`Timed out waiting for ${description}`);
    }

    await pause(200);
  }
}

/** Reads the preview iframe's document (the canvas). */
const inFrame = (page, read) => page.evaluate(read).catch(() => null);

/** Number of blocks on the canvas. */
const countBlocks = (page) =>
  inFrame(
    page,
    () =>
      document
        .querySelector("#preview-frame")
        ?.contentDocument?.querySelectorAll("[data-puck-component]").length ?? 0
  );

/** Collects the block types of a page, including blocks inside slots. */
function blockTypes(value, found = []) {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    for (const item of value) blockTypes(item, found);
  } else if (typeof value === "object" && value !== null) {
    if (typeof value.type === "string" && typeof value.props === "object") {
      found.push(value.type);
    }

    for (const item of Object.values(value)) blockTypes(item, found);
  }

  return found;
}

/**
 * The fields of the selected block. Puck renders them twice, in the right
 * sidebar and in a hidden mobile panel, so pick the visible copy.
 */
const visible = (page, selector) =>
  waitFor(`a visible ${selector}`, async () => {
    for (const handle of await page.$$(selector)) {
      if (await handle.isVisible()) return handle;
    }

    return null;
  });

/** The text input closest to `element`: the image picker's alt text box. */
const nearestTextInput = async (element) =>
  (
    await element.evaluateHandle((start) => {
      for (let node = start.parentElement; node; node = node.parentElement) {
        const input = node.querySelector('input[type="text"]');

        if (input) return input;
      }

      return null;
    })
  ).asElement();

async function typeText(input, text) {
  await input.click({ count: 3 });
  await input.type(text);
  // Puck applies field changes asynchronously.
  await pause(500);
}

async function run() {
  try {
    const response = await fetch(`${BASE}/api/activity`);

    check(response.ok, `GET ${BASE}/api/activity returned ${response.status}`);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof SmokeError) throw error;
    throw new SmokeError(
      `The showcase is not reachable at ${BASE}. Start it first (pnpm dev:showcase).`
    );
  }

  const before = existsSync(DATA_FILE) ? readFileSync(DATA_FILE, "utf8") : "";
  const { browser, page } = await setup(`${BASE}/activity/edit?blank=1`);
  const pageErrors = [];

  page.on("pageerror", (error) => pageErrors.push(error.message));

  try {
    await page.setViewport({ width: 1440, height: 900 });
    await waitFor("the editor canvas", () => getBox(page, ROOT_ZONE));
    check((await countBlocks(page)) === 0, "?blank=1 did not start empty");

    const theme = await inFrame(page, () =>
      document
        .querySelector("#preview-frame")
        ?.contentDocument?.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme")
    );

    check(theme === "tzuchi", `the canvas has data-theme=${theme}`);

    for (const [index, type] of BLOCKS.entries()) {
      const source = `[data-testid="drawer-item:${type}"]`;

      await waitFor(`the ${type} drawer item`, () => getBox(page, source));
      await dragAndDrop(
        page,
        source,
        ROOT_ZONE,
        index === 0 ? undefined : "top"
      );
      await waitFor(`the ${type} block on the canvas`, async () =>
        (await countBlocks(page)) >= index + 1 ? true : null
      );
      console.log(` ├ dropped ${type}`);

      // A new block is selected, so its fields are in the right sidebar.
      if (type === "Paragraph") {
        await typeText(await visible(page, RICHTEXT_FIELD), PARAGRAPH_TEXT);
      }

      if (type === "Button") {
        await typeText(await visible(page, 'input[name="href"]'), BUTTON_HREF);
      }

      if (type === "Image") {
        const asset = await visible(page, IMAGE_PICKER_DEMO_1);

        await asset.click();
        await pause(500);

        const alt = await nearestTextInput(asset);

        check(alt !== null, "the image picker has no alt text input");
        await typeText(alt, IMAGE_ALT);
      }
    }

    check(
      (await countBlocks(page)) === BLOCKS.length,
      `expected ${
        BLOCKS.length
      } blocks on the canvas, found ${await countBlocks(page)}`
    );

    const published = page.waitForResponse(
      (r) =>
        r.url() === `${BASE}/api/activity` && r.request().method() === "POST",
      { timeout: TIMEOUT }
    );

    await page.locator(`::-p-text(${PUBLISH_LABEL})`).click();

    const response = await published;

    check(
      response.status() === 200,
      `publish returned ${response.status()}: ${await response.text()}`
    );

    // The validator had nothing to clean in what the editor sent.
    const { notices } = await response.json();

    check(
      Array.isArray(notices) && notices.length === 0,
      `publish returned notices: ${JSON.stringify(notices)}`
    );
    console.log(" ├ published (POST /api/activity 200, no notices)");
    await page.waitForSelector(
      '[data-testid="publish-check"][data-status="published"]',
      { visible: true, timeout: TIMEOUT }
    );
    console.log(" ├ 發布檢查: 沒有錯誤");

    const after = existsSync(DATA_FILE) ? readFileSync(DATA_FILE, "utf8") : "";

    check(
      after !== before && after.includes(BUTTON_HREF),
      `${DATA_FILE} did not receive the page; start the server with the same SHOWCASE_DATA_DIR as this script`
    );

    const stored = await (await fetch(`${BASE}/api/activity`)).json();
    const storedTypes = [...new Set(blockTypes(stored.content))].sort();

    check(
      JSON.stringify(storedTypes) === JSON.stringify([...BLOCKS].sort()),
      `published block types: ${storedTypes.join(", ")}`
    );

    const html = await (await fetch(`${BASE}/activity`)).text();
    const missing = EXPECTED_HTML.filter((text) => !html.includes(text));

    check(missing.length === 0, `/activity HTML lacks: ${missing.join(" | ")}`);
    console.log(" ├ /activity shows the 8 blocks");
    check(pageErrors.length === 0, `page errors: ${pageErrors.join(" | ")}`);
  } finally {
    await browser.close();
  }
}

const backup = existsSync(DATA_FILE) ? readFileSync(DATA_FILE) : null;

/** Puts the published page back the way it was before the test. */
function restore() {
  if (backup === null) {
    rmSync(DATA_FILE, { force: true });
    return;
  }

  const temporary = `${DATA_FILE}.smoke-restore`;

  writeFileSync(temporary, backup);
  renameSync(temporary, DATA_FILE);
}

// Ctrl-C or a signal skips the finally below, so restore here too. Puppeteer
// closes Chrome on process exit.
for (const signal of ["SIGINT", "SIGTERM", "SIGHUP"]) {
  process.once(signal, () => {
    restore();
    process.exit(128 + constants.signals[signal]);
  });
}

try {
  await run();
  console.log("✅ Showcase smoke test passed.");
} catch (error) {
  console.error(`❌ Showcase smoke test failed: ${error.message}`);
  process.exitCode = 1;
} finally {
  restore();
}
```

### Task 17: 文件與最終驗收

目的：把 S2 的成果寫進文件，再對整個分支做最終驗收（規格 §13.2、§13.3）。文件包括：改寫 `CLAUDE.md`（新套件與 app、新指令與 `verify` 組成、Blocks and specs、Vendored uikit、本機伺服器的 port 與 Storybook 的 `HOME` 隔離、資安規則的新增條目）；更新 root `README.md` 與 `CONTRIBUTING.md`；寫好 `packages/spec`、`packages/blocks`、`apps/showcase`、`apps/storybook` 四份 README；確認 `CHANGELOG.md` 記錄了每一項修改；驗收通過後在路線圖標記 S2 完成。驗收依 §13.3 逐項進行：主工作目錄與乾淨 clone 各跑一次完整的 `pnpm verify`；同時啟動 demo 與示範站後跑 `pnpm smoke`；檢查 `/activity` 的原始 HTML 與發布 API；發布不合格的頁面，確認「發布檢查」面板列出中文錯誤、點錯誤會選取區塊；檢查區塊 Storybook 與交給 S3、S4 的三個檔案。

**設計決定與說明**：

- **文件的檢查方式**（取代 TDD 的失敗測試，沿用 S1 Task 14 的做法）：
  1. `check-docs.mjs`：文件中以反引號標出的 repo 路徑都必須存在（以 `git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard` 為準，所以還沒 commit 的新 README 也算）；inline code 與 code block 裡的 `pnpm <script>` 都必須是真的 script（`--filter` 時查該套件）。

- **最終驗收**：
  - Step 11 在主工作目錄刪掉建置產物與 turbo 快取後重跑 `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` 與 `pnpm verify`；Step 13 再從 `s2/block-spec` clone 一份乾淨的 repo 重跑，抓出「沒 commit、但在工作目錄裡剛好存在」的檔案。
  - Step 14 的 `acceptance.sh` 用 Step 11 建好的 `.next` 以 `next start` 啟動 demo（3000；`scripts/e2e/smoke.mjs` 寫死 `localhost:3000`）與示範站（3010），只綁 `127.0.0.1`，依序跑 `pnpm smoke`（約 13 分鐘）、§13.3 第 2 項（發布範例頁，取 `/activity` 的伺服器輸出逐一比對文字、連結、圖片與標題；再試危險連結、跨來源、DNS rebinding 的主機名稱、錯誤的 Content-Type 與超過 2 MB 的請求，狀態碼必須正好是 Task 15 的 422、403、403、415、413）與第 3 項（`publish-check.mjs`）。伺服器只以腳本記下的 `$!` 停止（以 `exec` 啟動，`$!` 就是 `next` 本身），不找子程序，也不用 `pkill`、`killall` 或名稱比對；kill 之後最多等 10 秒，port 仍被佔用時印出 `lsof` 並以 3 結束，交給使用者處理。示範站的 `apps/showcase/.data/activity.json` 先備份、伺服器停止後還原。
  - `publish-check.mjs` 用 `scripts/e2e/utils` 的 puppeteer 工具把一個按鈕（還沒有網址）與一張圖片（還沒選圖）拖到頁面最上方、按發布，確認 API 回 422、錯誤正好 3 筆（按鈕的 `href`，圖片的 `image.assetId` 與 `image.alt`）、錯誤訊息是中文、面板（`[data-testid="publish-check"]`）的 `data-status` 變成 `invalid`，再點按鈕那筆錯誤，右側欄位必須出現 `href`、沒有 `caption`；點圖片那筆，必須出現 `caption`、沒有 `href`。它找元素只依文字、`data-testid`（Puck 的拖放元素，以及 Task 15 面板的 `data-testid` 與 `data-status`）與 `input[name]`，不依賴 class 名稱。若 Task 15 的實作和腳本的假設不同，可以調整找元素的方式，但不能放寬斷言。
  - Step 15、16 對應 §13.3 第 4、5 項。第 4 項的瀏覽器檢查（每個 story 與文件頁畫得出來、主題是 `tzuchi`、沒有對外請求）已由 `pnpm storybook:smoke` 在 `verify` 裡做過；`storybook-check.mjs` 再確認每個欄位的控制項名稱與選項標籤是中文、每個區塊都有文件頁、`Default` story 與每個範例的 story。
  - Step 17 照文件的寫法重跑 `pnpm gen:blocks` 與 `pnpm sync:uikit`，確認文件教的指令可以用，而且 repo 裡的產物就是它們的輸出；不一致時停下來回報，不 commit。

  - `apps/showcase`、`scripts/check-public-bundle.mjs`、`scripts/e2e/showcase-smoke.mjs`（Task 15–16）：`apps/showcase/package.json` 的 `dev` 與 `start` 都帶 `NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1`、`-H 127.0.0.1 -p 3010`，另有 `lint`、`test`、`typecheck`；路由 `app/(public)/layout.tsx`（`<html lang="zh-Hant" data-theme="tzuchi">`）、`app/(public)/activity/page.tsx`、`app/(editor)/activity/edit/page.tsx`（`?blank=1` 從空白頁開始）、`app/api/activity/route.ts`，範例頁 `content/activity.preset.json`（`lib/__tests__/preset.spec.ts` 的 `uses the eight demo block types` 確認它正好用上規格 §10.4 的 8 個區塊，新增區塊不必修改它），資料寫在 `<SHOWCASE_DATA_DIR 或 apps/showcase/.data>/activity.json`；發布 API 要求 `Origin === "http://" + Host`，且 `Host` 的主機名稱在 `["127.0.0.1", "localhost"]` 內，檢查順序 403 → 415 → 413 → 422，403／415／413／500 回 `{ error, message }`（`forbidden_origin`、`unsupported_media_type`、`too_large`、`write_failed`），422 回 `{ errors }`，200 回 `{ notices }`；面板根元素 `[data-testid="publish-check"]` 與它的 `data-status`；`check:public-bundle` 的三個標記 `header-toggle-leftsidebar`、`tcb-picker-option`、`__zod_globalConfig`，通過時印出 `check:public-bundle passed: /activity ships no editor code.`；`showcase-smoke.mjs` 從 `/activity/edit?blank=1` 開始，通過時印出 `✅ Showcase smoke test passed.`，結束時（含失敗）還原已發布的頁面，網址可用 `SHOWCASE_URL` 改；turbo 的 `@tzuchi/tceditor-showcase#build`（`dependsOn: ["^build", "typecheck"]`）、`#test`、`#typecheck` 與 `@tzuchi/tceditor-storybook#build`（共用介面 C.5、C.6）。

  - 受版控的 `CLAUDE.md`、`README.md`、`CONTRIBUTING.md` 與四份 README：S3 以後的開發指引。
  - S2 完成的紀錄（路線圖、S2 設計規格開頭）。

- [ ] **Step 2: 建立文件檢查工具**

建立 `$T` 與兩個檢查工具（完整內容；兩個 heredoc 都以單引號的 `'EOF'` 開頭，內容不做任何展開）：

````sh
T="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/tceditor-s2-task17"
mkdir -p "$T"
cat > "$T/check-docs.mjs" <<'EOF'
// Checks Markdown files against the repository (run from the repo root):
// 1. every repo path quoted in `backticks` exists (tracked or new, not ignored);
// 2. every `pnpm <script>` in inline code or a code block is a real script,
//    of the root package or of the package named by `--filter`.
// Usage: node check-docs.mjs <file.md>...
import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";
import { existsSync, readdirSync, readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { dirname, join, normalize } from "node:path";

const files = new Set(
  execFileSync(
    "git",
    ["ls-files", "--cached", "--others", "--exclude-standard"],
    {
      encoding: "utf8",
      maxBuffer: 64 * 1024 * 1024,
    }
  )
    .split("\n")
    .filter(Boolean)
);
const dirs = new Set();
for (const file of files) {
  for (let d = dirname(file); d !== "."; d = dirname(d)) dirs.add(d);
}
const exists = (p) => files.has(p) || dirs.has(p);

// Directories a relative path in the docs may be written against.
const BASES = [
  "",
  "packages/core",
  "packages/spec",
  "packages/blocks",
  "apps/showcase",
  "apps/storybook",
  "vendor/uikit",
  "vendor/uikit/heroui/styles",
  "infra/supabase",
  "scripts",
];
// Build outputs and local state: gitignored, so not in the file list.
const IGNORED_SEGMENTS = new Set([
  "dist",
  ".next",
  "storybook-static",
  ".home",
  ".data",
  ".turbo",
  "node_modules",
]);
// Tokens with a slash that are not repo paths.
const NOT_PATHS = new Set([
  "json/react",
  "tzuchi/main",
  "s2/block-spec",
  "spike/heroui-v3",
  "heroui/react",
  "heroui/storybook/.storybook/main.ts",
  "supabase/supabase",
]);
const PACKAGE_SUBPATH = /^(zod|react|react-dom|next|storybook)\//;
const PNPM_BUILTINS = new Set([
  "install",
  "add",
  "remove",
  "exec",
  "dlx",
  "why",
  "audit",
  "update",
  "store",
  "run",
  "list",
]);

const readJson = (p) => JSON.parse(readFileSync(p, "utf8"));
const rootScripts = readJson("package.json").scripts ?? {};
const workspaceScripts = new Map();
for (const parent of ["apps", "packages"]) {
  for (const name of readdirSync(parent)) {
    const manifest = join(parent, name, "package.json");
    if (!existsSync(manifest)) continue;
    const pkg = readJson(manifest);
    const scripts = pkg.scripts ?? {};
    workspaceScripts.set(pkg.name, scripts);
    workspaceScripts.set(`./${parent}/${name}`, scripts);
  }
}

function checkPath(token, mdDir) {
  if (/[<>{}$*:@~\s"'|=]/.test(token.replace(/\/\*+$/, ""))) return null;
  const path = token.replace(/\/\*+$/, "").replace(/\/$/, "");
  // A bare folder name such as `__tests__/` is a name, not a path.
  if (!path.includes("/") || path.startsWith("/") || path.startsWith(".."))
    return null;
  if (NOT_PATHS.has(path) || PACKAGE_SUBPATH.test(path)) return null;
  if (/(^|\/)\.env$/.test(path)) return null;
  if (path.split("/").some((segment) => IGNORED_SEGMENTS.has(segment)))
    return null;
  for (const base of [mdDir, ...BASES]) {
    const candidate = normalize(base ? join(base, path) : path);
    if (exists(candidate)) return null;
  }
  return `missing path: ${token}`;
}

function checkPnpm(code) {
  const problems = [];
  const re = /\bpnpm\s+(?:--filter\s+(\S+)\s+)?([a-z][\w:-]*)/g;
  for (const [, filter, script] of code.matchAll(re)) {
    if (!filter && PNPM_BUILTINS.has(script)) continue;
    if (filter) {
      const scripts = workspaceScripts.get(filter);
      if (!scripts) problems.push(`unknown package: pnpm --filter ${filter}`);
      else if (!(script in scripts))
        problems.push(`no script "${script}" in ${filter}`);
    } else if (!(script in rootScripts)) {
      problems.push(`no root script: pnpm ${script}`);
    }
  }
  return problems;
}

let count = 0;
for (const md of process.argv.slice(2)) {
  const text = readFileSync(md, "utf8");
  const mdDir = dirname(md) === "." ? "" : dirname(md);
  const problems = [];
  const fences = [...text.matchAll(/^```[^\n]*\n([\s\S]*?)^```/gm)];
  for (const [, body] of fences) problems.push(...checkPnpm(body));
  const prose = text.replace(/^```[^\n]*\n[\s\S]*?^```/gm, "");
  for (const [, code] of prose.matchAll(/`([^`\n]+)`/g)) {
    problems.push(...checkPnpm(code));
    const problem = checkPath(code.trim(), mdDir);
    if (problem) problems.push(problem);
  }
  for (const problem of [...new Set(problems)])
    console.log(`${md}: ${problem}`);
  count += new Set(problems).size;
}
console.log(`${count} problem(s)`);
process.exitCode = count ? 1 : 0;
EOF
cat > "$T/check-facts.mjs" <<'EOF'
// Checks that the facts CLAUDE.md and the READMEs state are true of the code.
// Run from the repo root: node check-facts.mjs. Prints one line per check and
// exits with 1 when any check fails.
import { existsSync, readdirSync, readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";

const read = (p) => (existsSync(p) ? readFileSync(p, "utf8") : "");
const json = (p) => (existsSync(p) ? JSON.parse(read(p)) : {});
const same = (a, b) => JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b);

/** The string literals of `NAME = [ ... ]` (also `NAME: T = Object.freeze([ ... ])`). */
function stringArray(source, name) {
  const match = source.match(
    new RegExp(
      `\\b${name}\\b[^=\\n]*=\\s*(?:Object\\.freeze\\()?\\[([^\\]]*)\\]`
    )
  );
  return match ? [...match[1].matchAll(/"([^"]*)"/g)].map((m) => m[1]) : null;
}

/** Every file under `dir` whose name matches `test`. */
function findFiles(dir, test, found = []) {
  if (!existsSync(dir)) return found;
  for (const entry of readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    if (entry.name === "node_modules" || entry.name === ".next") continue;
    const full = join(dir, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) findFiles(full, test, found);
    else if (test(entry.name)) found.push(full);
  }
  return found;
}

const root = json("package.json").scripts ?? {};
const showcase = json("apps/showcase/package.json").scripts ?? {};
const storybook = json("apps/storybook/package.json").scripts ?? {};
const catalog = json("packages/blocks/generated/catalog.json");
const turbo = json("turbo.json").tasks ?? {};
const source = json("vendor/uikit/SOURCE.json");

const VERIFY =
  "pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm build && pnpm check:bundle && pnpm check:edge && pnpm check:public-bundle && pnpm storybook:smoke && pnpm audit:gate";
const ROOT_SCRIPTS = {
  "dev:showcase": "pnpm --filter @tzuchi/tceditor-showcase dev",
  storybook: "pnpm --filter @tzuchi/tceditor-storybook dev",
  "storybook:build": "pnpm --filter @tzuchi/tceditor-storybook build",
  "storybook:smoke": "node scripts/storybook-smoke.mjs",
  "gen:blocks": "tsx packages/blocks/scripts/gen-blocks.ts",
  "sync:uikit": "node scripts/uikit/sync-uikit.mjs",
  "check:edge": "node scripts/check-edge.mjs",
  "check:public-bundle": "node scripts/check-public-bundle.mjs",
};
const BLOCKS = [
  "Heading",
  "Paragraph",
  "Button",
  "Card",

  "Section",
  "Columns",
  "Image",
];
const ISSUE_CODES = [
  "too_large",
  "invalid_json",
  "invalid_shape",
  "legacy_zones",
  "unknown_type",
  "invalid_id",
  "duplicate_id",
  "too_deep",
  "too_many_blocks",
  "unknown_prop",

];
const X_KEYS = [
  "x-labels",

  "x-field",
  "x-item-label",
  "x-style",
  "x-token",
  "x-slot",
  "x-richtext",
  "x-image",
  "x-link",
  "x-lost-checks",
];
const RICHTEXT_FEATURES = [
  "bold",

  "underline",
  "strike",
  "code",
  "link",
  "bulletList",

const lines = (p) =>
  read(p)
    .split("\n")
    .map((line) => line.trim());
// The showcase's build also waits for its own typecheck: `next build` empties
// .next while `next typegen` writes .next/types.
const DEPENDS_ON = {
  "@tzuchi/tceditor-showcase#build": ["^build", "typecheck"],
};
const dependsOnBuild = (task, name) =>
  same(task?.dependsOn, DEPENDS_ON[name] ?? ["^build"]);
const binds = (script, port) =>
  typeof script === "string" &&
  script.includes("-H 127.0.0.1") &&

const checks = [

      same(

        [".", "./validator"]
      ),
  ],
  [
    "core exports ./rules",
    () => "./rules" in (json("packages/core/package.json").exports ?? {}),
  ],
  [
    "RICHTEXT_FEATURES",
    () =>
      same(
        stringArray(
          read("packages/core/lib/richtext/features.ts"),
          "RICHTEXT_FEATURES"
        ),
        RICHTEXT_FEATURES
      ),
  ],
  [
    "public-bundle markers header-toggle-leftsidebar, tcb-picker-option and __zod_globalConfig",
    () => {
      const check = read("scripts/check-public-bundle.mjs");
      return [
        '"header-toggle-leftsidebar"',
        '"tcb-picker-option"',
        '"__zod_globalConfig"',
      ].every((marker) => check.includes(marker));
    },
  ],
  [
    "vendor: source, license, no heroui/react",
    () =>
      source.repository === "puck-tzuchi-poc" &&
      source.branch === "spike/heroui-v3" &&
      /^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(source.commit ?? "") &&
      existsSync("vendor/uikit/heroui/LICENSE") &&
      existsSync("vendor/uikit/heroui/NOTICE.md") &&
      existsSync("vendor/uikit/README.md") &&
      !existsSync("vendor/uikit/heroui/react"),
  ],
  [
    "workspace: apps, zod override",
    () => {
      const ws = read("pnpm-workspace.yaml");
      return (
        ws.includes('"apps/showcase"') &&
        ws.includes('"apps/storybook"') &&
        ws.includes('"zod@^4": "4.6.5"')
      );
    },
  ],
  [
    "audit gate covers core, plugin, spec and blocks",
    () =>
      same(
        [
          ...(stringArray(
            read("scripts/audit-gate-lib.mjs"),
            "GATED_IMPORTERS"
          ) ?? []),
        ].sort(),
        [
          "packages/blocks",
          "packages/core",
          "packages/plugin-heading-analyzer",
          "packages/spec",
        ]
      ),
  ],
  [
    "turbo: ^build and outputs in the generic and package-specific tasks",
    () =>
      [
        "build",
        "test",
        "typecheck",
        "@tzuchi/tceditor-blocks#test",
        "@tzuchi/tceditor-showcase#build",
        "@tzuchi/tceditor-showcase#test",
        "@tzuchi/tceditor-showcase#typecheck",
        "@tzuchi/tceditor-storybook#build",
      ].every((name) => dependsOnBuild(turbo[name], name)) &&
      (turbo["@tzuchi/tceditor-showcase#build"].outputs ?? []).includes(
        ".next/**"
      ) &&
      (turbo["@tzuchi/tceditor-storybook#build"].outputs ?? []).includes(
        "storybook-static/**"
      ),
  ],
  [
    "ignore files",
    () => {
      const git = lines(".gitignore");
      const prettier = lines(".prettierignore");
      const eslint = read("eslint.config.mjs");
      return (
        [
          "!vendor/uikit/packages/tokens/dist/",
          "apps/showcase/.data/",
          "apps/storybook/.home/",
          "storybook-static/",
        ].every((line) => git.includes(line)) &&
        ["vendor/", "storybook-static/"].every((line) =>
          prettier.includes(line)
        ) &&
        eslint.includes("vendor/**") &&
        eslint.includes("zod/v4/locales")
      );
    },
  ],
];

let passed = 0;
for (const [name, check] of checks) {
  let result;
  try {
    result = check();
  } catch (error) {
    result = `threw ${error.message}`;
  }
  if (result === true) {
    passed++;
    console.log(`ok   ${name}`);
  } else {
    console.log(
      `FAIL ${name}${typeof result === "string" ? `: ${result}` : ""}`
    );
  }
}
console.log(`${passed}/${checks.length} checks passed`);
process.exitCode = passed === checks.length ? 0 : 1;
EOF
node --check "$T/check-docs.mjs" && node --check "$T/check-facts.mjs" && echo "tools ok"
````
