````sh
    test: (l) => l.includes("options.textAlign"),
    line: '* a richtext field\'s `options.textAlign` now takes effect instead of being overridden by the default `{ types: ["heading", "paragraph"] }`, and `textAlign` options such as `alignments` keep the default `types` unless they set their own; with `textAlign: false` the editor has no text alignment, so the alignment shortcuts (Mod-Shift-L, E, R and J) stop working, stored alignment is removed the next time the content is edited (published pages show it until then), and `migrateRichTextInData` no longer keeps the alignment of legacy HTML in such a field',
  },
  {
    key: "contentEditable defaults to false",
    test: (l) => l.includes("contentEditable") && l.includes("`false`"),
    line: "* treat an unset `contentEditable` on a richtext field as `false` in the canvas field transform too, as the field documentation says; the transform used to treat it as `true` and wrap the field in the inline editor component, which then showed it as static content anyway, so the canvas looks the same and only `contentEditable: true` puts an inline editor on the canvas",
  },
  {
    key: "A-11 migrateRichTextInData getFields",
    test: (l) => l.includes("migrateRichTextInData") && l.includes("getFields"),
    line: "* `migrateRichTextInData(data, config, options)` accepts `options.getFields(item, { isRoot })`, a synchronous function that returns the fields of the root or of a component; richtext fields that only `resolveFields` adds are not in `config` and were skipped, so pass `getFields` to convert them too (a `getFields` that returns a promise throws a `TypeError`)",
  },
  {
    key: "@tzuchi/tceditor/rules entry",
    test: (l) => l.includes("`@tzuchi/tceditor/rules` entry"),
    line: "* add the React-free `@tzuchi/tceditor/rules` entry for validators and server code, with `normalizeRichText`, `isSafeHref`, `textToRichText`, `RICHTEXT_MAX_DEPTH`, `fitRichTextToTypes`, `RICHTEXT_FEATURES`, `isRichTextFeature`, `richTextFeaturesToOptions`, `richTextFeaturesToTypes`, `stableStringify`, `isComponentAllowed` and their types; `pnpm check:bundle` now also fails when the rules entry or its type declarations mention `react`, `react-dom` or `@tiptap/`, or import a `node:` module",
  },
  {
    key: "vendor/uikit (Task 6)",
    test: (l) => l.includes("vendor/uikit"),
    line: null,
  },
  {

    line: null,
  },

    line: null,
  },
  {
    key: "pnpm gen:blocks (Task 12)",

    line: null,
  },
  {
    key: "edge validator (Task 13)",
    test: (l) => l.includes("validator.edge.mjs"),
    line: null,
  },
  {
    key: "block Storybook (Task 14)",
    test: (l) => l.includes("apps/storybook"),
    line: null,
  },
  {
    key: "showcase (Task 15)",
    test: (l) => l.includes("apps/showcase"),
    line: null,
  },
  {
    key: "check:public-bundle and the showcase smoke test (Task 16)",
    test: (l) => l.includes("check:public-bundle"),
    line: null,
  },
];

let text = readFileSync(FILE, "utf8");
const start = text.indexOf("### Changes from Puck v0.23.0");
const end = text.indexOf(ANCHOR);
if (start < 0 || end < start || text.indexOf(ANCHOR, end + 1) >= 0) {
  console.error(`${FILE}: cannot find the Changes from Puck v0.23.0 list`);
  process.exit(1);
}
const entries = text
  .slice(start, end)
  .split("\n")
  .filter((l) => l.startsWith("* "));

const added = [];
let missing = 0;
for (const topic of TOPICS) {
  if (entries.some(topic.test)) {
    console.log(`found: ${topic.key}`);
  } else if (topic.line) {
    added.push(topic.line);
    console.log(`added: ${topic.key}`);
  } else {
    missing++;
    console.log(`MISSING: ${topic.key}`);
  }
}
if (added.length > 0) {
  text = text.replace(ANCHOR, () => `\n${added.join("\n")}${ANCHOR}`);
  writeFileSync(FILE, text);
}
console.log(
  `${TOPICS.length - missing}/${TOPICS.length} recorded, ${added.length} added`
);
process.exitCode = missing ? 1 : 0;
EOF
````

```sh
test ! -e .turbo && echo "no turbo cache" >> "$T/clone.log"
pnpm verify > "$T/clone-verify.log" 2>&1; echo "verify exit=$?" >> "$T/clone.log"
echo "changed files: $(git status --short | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" >> "$T/clone.log"
cd / && rm -rf "$CLONE" && echo "clone removed" >> "$T/clone.log"
EOF
```

完成後：

```sh
T="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/tceditor-s2-task17"
cat "$T/clone.log"
grep -E "Cached:" "$T/clone-verify.log"
grep -E "^check:edge: OK|^storybook:smoke OK|^audit:gate passed" "$T/clone-verify.log"
```

預期：

```
<hash> docs: document the S2 block specs, packages and apps
install exit=0
no turbo cache
verify exit=0
changed files: 0
clone removed
```

接著是 turbo 的 `Cached:` 行（`test`、`typecheck`、`lint`、`build` 各一次），以及 `check:edge: OK (…)`、`storybook:smoke OK`、`audit:gate passed: …` 三行。

- 第一行 `Cached:`（來自 `turbo run test`）必須是 `0 cached, <N> total`，代表 clone 沒有讀到別處的快取；`no turbo cache` 一行也證明 `verify` 開始前 clone 裡沒有 `.turbo`。區塊開頭的 `unset TURBO_CACHE_DIR` 就是為了這一點。之後幾行可以有非 0 的 cached：那是同一次 `verify` 中前面的 turbo 指令剛建好的 build task（`test`、`typecheck` 與 `build` 都依賴 `^build`，hash 相同就命中）。第一行不是 `0 cached` 時停下來回報。
- `changed files: 0`：clone 跑完 `verify` 也沒有產生未被忽略的檔案。
- `verify exit` 不是 0 時看 `$T/clone-verify.log`：主工作目錄能過、clone 不能過，幾乎都是漏 commit 了檔案。
- clone 的 `storybook:smoke` 也用 `127.0.0.1:6008`；執行期間不要啟動其他用到這個 port 的程式。

- [ ] **Step 14: 驗收 §13.3 第 1–3 項：`pnpm smoke`、公開頁的原始 HTML、「發布檢查」面板**

建立三個檔案（完整內容），然後用背景執行 `acceptance.sh`。它用 Step 11 建好的 `.next` 啟動 demo 與示範站，依序跑 `pnpm smoke`、§13.3 第 2 項與第 3 項，最後一定停止伺服器並還原示範站資料（見設計決定）：

````sh
T="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/tceditor-s2-task17"
cat > "$T/acceptance.sh" <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# S2 acceptance, spec §13.3 items 1-3. Run from the repo root after a build:
#   bash "$T/acceptance.sh" "$T"
# Starts the built demo (127.0.0.1:3000) and showcase (127.0.0.1:3010) with
# `next start`, runs `pnpm smoke`, publishes the preset and checks the HTML of
# /activity and the publish API, then runs publish-check.mjs. The servers are
# stopped by the PIDs this script recorded with $! (nothing else is killed) and
# the published page is restored when the script ends, also on failure; if a
# port is still in use 10 seconds after the kill, it prints lsof and exits 3.
# SKIP_DEMO_SMOKE=1 starts only the showcase and skips `pnpm smoke` (to repeat
# items 2-3 after the smoke test has passed).
set -o pipefail
T="$1"
BASE=http://127.0.0.1:3010
DATA=apps/showcase/.data/activity.json
PRESET=apps/showcase/content/activity.preset.json
PORTS="3010"
[ "${SKIP_DEMO_SMOKE:-}" = 1 ] || PORTS="3000 3010"
fail=0
PIDS=()

for port in $PORTS; do
  if lsof -nP -iTCP:"$port" -sTCP:LISTEN > /dev/null; then
    echo "port $port is busy; stop that program yourself, then run this again:"
    lsof -nP -iTCP:"$port" -sTCP:LISTEN
    exit 2
  fi
done

if [ -e "$DATA" ]; then
  cp "$DATA" "$T/activity.json.before" && echo "published page backed up"
else
  rm -f "$T/activity.json.before" && echo "no published page yet"
fi

cleanup() {
  local pid port busy=0
  for pid in "${PIDS[@]}"; do kill "$pid" 2> /dev/null; done
  for port in $PORTS; do
    for _ in $(seq 1 10); do
      lsof -nP -iTCP:"$port" -sTCP:LISTEN > /dev/null || break
      sleep 1
    done
    if lsof -nP -iTCP:"$port" -sTCP:LISTEN > /dev/null; then
      echo "port $port still in use after kill ${PIDS[*]}:"
      lsof -nP -iTCP:"$port" -sTCP:LISTEN
      busy=1
    else
      echo "port $port free"
    fi
  done
  if [ -e "$T/activity.json.before" ]; then
    cp "$T/activity.json.before" "$DATA" && echo "published page restored"
  else
    rm -f "$DATA" && echo "published page removed (there was none before)"
  fi
  [ "$busy" = 0 ] || exit 3
}
trap cleanup EXIT

if [ "${SKIP_DEMO_SMOKE:-}" != 1 ]; then
  (cd apps/demo && NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 exec ./node_modules/.bin/next start -H 127.0.0.1 -p 3000) > "$T/demo.log" 2>&1 &
  PIDS+=("$!")
fi
(cd apps/showcase && NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 exec ./node_modules/.bin/next start -H 127.0.0.1 -p 3010) > "$T/showcase.log" 2>&1 &
PIDS+=("$!")
echo "started PIDs: ${PIDS[*]}"

for _ in $(seq 1 90); do
  up=1
  for port in $PORTS; do
    curl -s -o /dev/null "http://127.0.0.1:$port/" || up=0
  done
  [ "$up" = 1 ] && break
  sleep 1
done
URLS="$BASE/activity $BASE/activity/edit $BASE/api/activity"
[ "${SKIP_DEMO_SMOKE:-}" = 1 ] || URLS="http://127.0.0.1:3000/test/edit?disableIframe=false $URLS"
for u in $URLS; do
  echo "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "$u") $u"
done
for port in $PORTS; do
  lsof -nP -iTCP:"$port" -sTCP:LISTEN | awk 'NR > 1 { print "listen", $9 }' | sort -u
done

echo "== item 1: pnpm smoke"
if [ "${SKIP_DEMO_SMOKE:-}" = 1 ]; then
  echo "skipped (SKIP_DEMO_SMOKE=1)"
else
  pnpm smoke > "$T/smoke.log" 2>&1
  smoke=$?
  grep -E "tests passed" "$T/smoke.log"
  tail -n 5 "$T/smoke.log"
  echo "smoke exit=$smoke"
  if [ "$smoke" != 0 ] || ! grep -q "4/4 tests passed" "$T/smoke.log" ||
    ! grep -q "Showcase smoke test passed" "$T/smoke.log"; then fail=1; fi
fi

echo "== item 2: the public page shows the published content"
code=$(curl -s -o "$T/publish.json" -w '%{http_code}' -X POST "$BASE/api/activity" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "Origin: $BASE" --data-binary @"$PRESET")
echo "publish preset: $code $(cat "$T/publish.json")"
[ "$code" = 200 ] || fail=1
curl -s "$BASE/activity" > "$T/activity.html"
node "$T/check-activity-html.mjs" "$PRESET" "$T/activity.html" || fail=1
shasum "$DATA" > "$T/published.sha"

printf '%s' '{"root":{"props":{"title":"驗收"}},"content":[{"type":"Button","props":{"id":"Button-accept-1","label":"立即報名","href":"javascript:alert(1)"}}]}' > "$T/invalid.json"
code=$(curl -s -o "$T/invalid-response.json" -w '%{http_code}' -X POST "$BASE/api/activity" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "Origin: $BASE" --data-binary @"$T/invalid.json")
echo "javascript: link: $code"
node -e 'const r = require(process.argv[1]); for (const e of r.errors ?? []) console.log(" ", e.code, e.pathText, e.blockType, e.message);' "$T/invalid-response.json"
[ "$code" = 422 ] || fail=1
grep -q '"unsafe_href"' "$T/invalid-response.json" || fail=1

code=$(curl -s -o "$T/refused.json" -w '%{http_code}' -X POST "$BASE/api/activity" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Origin: http://evil.example' --data-binary @"$PRESET")
echo "other origin: $code $(cat "$T/refused.json")"
[ "$code" = 403 ] || fail=1

# DNS rebinding: another site's host name that resolves to 127.0.0.1, so the
# browser sends matching Origin and Host headers.
code=$(curl -s -o "$T/refused.json" -w '%{http_code}' -X POST "$BASE/api/activity" \
  -H 'Host: evil.example:3010' -H 'Origin: http://evil.example:3010' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @"$PRESET")
echo "rebound host name: $code $(cat "$T/refused.json")"
[ "$code" = 403 ] || fail=1

code=$(curl -s -o "$T/refused.json" -w '%{http_code}' -X POST "$BASE/api/activity" \
  -H 'Content-Type: text/plain' -H "Origin: $BASE" --data-binary @"$PRESET")
echo "text/plain body: $code $(cat "$T/refused.json")"
[ "$code" = 415 ] || fail=1

node -e 'process.stdout.write("\"" + "測".repeat(699051) + "\"")' > "$T/too-large.json"
code=$(curl -s -o "$T/refused.json" -w '%{http_code}' -X POST "$BASE/api/activity" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "Origin: $BASE" --data-binary @"$T/too-large.json")
echo "body of $(wc -c < "$T/too-large.json" | tr -d ' ') bytes: $code $(cat "$T/refused.json")"
[ "$code" = 413 ] || fail=1

shasum -c "$T/published.sha" || fail=1

echo "== item 3: the 發布檢查 panel"
node "$T/publish-check.mjs" "$BASE" || fail=1
shasum -c "$T/published.sha" || fail=1

echo "acceptance fail=$fail"
exit "$fail"
EOF
cat > "$T/check-activity-html.mjs" <<'EOF'
// Checks that the server-rendered HTML of /activity shows a page's content.
// Usage: node check-activity-html.mjs <page.json> <activity.html>
// Every text, link, image and caption of the page must appear in the HTML,
// escaped the way React escapes text and attributes.
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";

const [pageFile, htmlFile] = process.argv.slice(2);
const page = JSON.parse(readFileSync(pageFile, "utf8"));
const html = readFileSync(htmlFile, "utf8");

const escape = (value) =>
  value
    .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
    .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
    .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
    .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
    .replace(/'/g, "&#x27;");
const expected = [];
const text = (where, value) => {
  if (typeof value === "string" && value.trim() !== "") {
    expected.push({ where, needle: escape(value) });
  }
};
const attr = (where, name, value) => {
  if (typeof value === "string" && value !== "") {
    expected.push({ where, needle: `${name}="${escape(value)}"` });
  }
};

function richText(where, node) {
  if (!node || typeof node !== "object") return;
  if (node.type === "text") {
    text(where, node.text);
    for (const mark of node.marks ?? []) {
      if (mark.type === "link") attr(where, "href", mark.attrs?.href);
    }
  }
  for (const child of node.content ?? []) richText(where, child);
}

function block(node, where) {
  const props = node.props ?? {};
  const at = `${where} (${node.type})`;
  switch (node.type) {
    case "Heading":
      text(at, props.text);
      break;
    case "Paragraph":
      richText(at, props.body);
      break;
    case "Button":
      text(at, props.label);
      attr(at, "href", props.href);
      break;
    case "Card":
      text(at, props.title);
      text(at, props.summary);
      attr(at, "href", props.href);
      break;
    case "TagList":
      for (const tag of props.tags ?? []) text(at, tag.label);
      break;
    case "Image":
      if (props.image?.assetId) {
        attr(at, "src", `/demo-assets/${props.image.assetId}.svg`);
        if (!props.image.decorative) attr(at, "alt", props.image.alt);
      }
      text(at, props.caption);
      break;
  }
  (props.content ?? []).forEach((child, i) =>
    block(child, `${where}.content[${i}]`)
  );
  (props.columns ?? []).forEach((column, c) =>
    (column.content ?? []).forEach((child, i) =>
      block(child, `${where}.columns[${c}].content[${i}]`)
    )
  );
}

page.content.forEach((node, i) => block(node, `content[${i}]`));
const { title, description } = page.root?.props ?? {};
if (title)
  expected.push({ where: "root", needle: `<title>${escape(title)}</title>` });
if (description) attr("root (meta description)", "content", description);
expected.push({ where: "<html>", needle: 'lang="zh-Hant"' });
expected.push({ where: "<html>", needle: 'data-theme="tzuchi"' });

const missing = expected.filter(({ needle }) => !html.includes(needle));
for (const { where, needle } of missing)
  console.log(`missing ${where}: ${needle}`);
console.log(`${expected.length - missing.length}/${expected.length} found`);
console.log(`javascript: in html: ${/javascript:/i.test(html)}`);
process.exitCode = missing.length === 0 && !/javascript:/i.test(html) ? 0 : 1;
EOF
cat > "$T/publish-check.mjs" <<'EOF'
// Acceptance check for the 發布檢查 panel (S2 spec §13.3 item 3), against a
// running showcase. Run from the repo root:
//   node publish-check.mjs http://127.0.0.1:3010
// Drags a Button (no link yet) and an Image (no picture yet) to the top of the
// page, publishes, and expects a 422 whose Chinese errors the panel
// ([data-testid="publish-check"], data-status="invalid") lists.
// Clicking the button's error must select the button (its href field shows),
// clicking the image's error must select the image (its caption field shows).
// A rejected publish stores nothing, so the published page stays as it was.
import { join } from "node:path";
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";

const BASE = process.argv[2] ?? "http://127.0.0.1:3010";
const utils = (name) =>
  import(pathToFileURL(join(process.cwd(), "scripts/e2e/utils", name)).href);
const { setup } = await utils("setup.mjs");
const { dragAndDrop } = await utils("drag-and-drop.mjs");
const { getBox } = await utils("get-box.mjs");
const { pause } = await utils("pause.mjs");

const ROOT_ZONE = '[data-testid="dropzone:root:default-zone"]';
const PANEL = '[data-testid="publish-check"]';
const TIMEOUT = 15000;
const CJK = /[\u4e00-\u9fff]/;

async function waitFor(what, probe) {
  const start = Date.now();
  for (;;) {
    const value = await probe();
    if (value) return value;
    if (Date.now() - start > TIMEOUT)
      throw new Error(`timed out waiting for ${what}`);
    await pause(200);
  }
}

const countBlocks = (page) =>
  page.evaluate(() => {
    const frame = document.querySelector("#preview-frame");
    const doc = frame?.contentDocument ?? document;
    return doc.querySelectorAll("[data-puck-component]").length;
  });

/** The visible elements of the editor (not the preview) that match `selector`. */
async function visible(page, selector) {
  const found = [];
  for (const handle of await page.$$(selector)) {
    if (await handle.isVisible()) found.push(handle);
  }
  return found;
}

/** Names of the visible inputs in the editor, e.g. the fields of the selected block. */
async function fieldNames(page) {
  const names = [];
  for (const handle of await visible(page, "input[name]")) {
    names.push(await handle.evaluate((el) => el.getAttribute("name")));
  }
  return [...new Set(names)].sort();
}

/**
 * The panel entry of an issue: the visible button in the panel whose text
 * contains the issue's message, preferring one that also shows its path.
 */
async function findEntry(page, issue) {
  for (const needles of [[issue.message, issue.pathText], [issue.message]]) {
    for (const handle of await visible(page, `${PANEL} button`)) {
      const text = await handle.evaluate((el) => el.textContent ?? "");
      if (needles.every((needle) => text.includes(needle))) return handle;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

/** The panel once it shows a rejected publish, or null while it does not. */
async function invalidPanel(page) {
  const [panel] = await visible(page, `${PANEL}[data-status="invalid"]`);
  return panel ?? null;
}

/** Clicks the smallest visible element whose text is exactly one of `labels`. */
async function clickText(page, labels) {
  for (const label of labels) {
    for (const handle of await page.$$(`::-p-text(${label})`)) {
      const text = await handle.evaluate((el) => (el.textContent ?? "").trim());
      if (text === label && (await handle.isVisible())) {
        await handle.click();
        return true;
      }
    }
  }
  return false;
}

const { browser, page } = await setup(`${BASE}/activity/edit`);
const pageErrors = [];
page.on("pageerror", (error) => pageErrors.push(error.message));

try {
  await page.setViewport({ width: 1440, height: 900 });
  await waitFor("the editor canvas", () => getBox(page, ROOT_ZONE));
  const before = await countBlocks(page);

  for (const [i, type] of ["Button", "Image"].entries()) {
    const source = `[data-testid="drawer-item:${type}"]`;
    await waitFor(`the ${type} drawer item`, () => getBox(page, source));
    await dragAndDrop(page, source, ROOT_ZONE, "top");
    await waitFor(`the new ${type}`, async () =>
      (await countBlocks(page)) >= before + i + 1 ? true : null
    );
  }

  const response = page.waitForResponse(
    (r) =>
      r.url() === `${BASE}/api/activity` && r.request().method() === "POST",
    { timeout: TIMEOUT }
  );
  response.catch(() => {});
  // The header's publish button (dictionary key header-publish).
  if (!(await clickText(page, ["Publish", "發布"]))) {
    throw new Error("no publish button found in the header");
  }
  const result = await response;
  if (result.status() !== 422) {
    throw new Error(`publish returned ${result.status()}, expected 422`);
  }
  const { errors } = await result.json();
  const buttonError = errors.find(
    (e) => e.blockType === "Button" && e.pathText.endsWith(".href")
  );
  const imageError = errors.find(
    (e) => e.blockType === "Image" && e.pathText.includes(".image")
  );
  if (!buttonError || !imageError) {
    throw new Error(`unexpected errors: ${JSON.stringify(errors)}`);
  }
  // One issue per path; the image's object-level check still runs after its
  // assetId fails, so the image also reports its missing alt text.
  const altError = errors.find(
    (e) => e.blockType === "Image" && e.code === "alt_required"
  );
  if (errors.length !== 3 || !altError) {
    throw new Error(`expected 3 errors: ${JSON.stringify(errors)}`);
  }
  for (const error of [buttonError, imageError]) {
    if (!CJK.test(error.message))
      throw new Error(`not Chinese: ${error.message}`);
  }
  console.log(`button error: ${buttonError.pathText} ${buttonError.message}`);
  console.log(`image error: ${imageError.pathText} ${imageError.message}`);

  // The panel brings itself forward after a publish; open it from the plugin
  // rail if it did not.
  let panel = await waitFor("the 發布檢查 panel", () =>
    invalidPanel(page)
  ).catch(() => null);
  if (!panel) {
    await clickText(page, ["發布檢查"]);
    panel = await waitFor("the 發布檢查 panel", () => invalidPanel(page));
  }
  const status = await panel.evaluate(
    (el) => el.querySelector('[role="status"]')?.textContent ?? ""
  );
  console.log(`panel: ${status}`);
  if (!CJK.test(status)) throw new Error(`panel status not Chinese: ${status}`);

  const buttonEntry = await waitFor("the button error in the panel", () =>
    findEntry(page, buttonError)
  );
  await buttonEntry.click();
  await pause(800);
  const afterButton = await fieldNames(page);
  console.log(
    `fields after clicking the button error: ${afterButton.join(",")}`
  );
  if (!afterButton.includes("href") || afterButton.includes("caption")) {
    throw new Error("clicking the button error did not select the button");
  }

  const imageEntry = await waitFor("the image error in the panel", () =>
    findEntry(page, imageError)
  );
  await imageEntry.click();
  await pause(800);
  const afterImage = await fieldNames(page);
  console.log(`fields after clicking the image error: ${afterImage.join(",")}`);
  if (!afterImage.includes("caption") || afterImage.includes("href")) {
    throw new Error("clicking the image error did not select the image");
  }
  if (pageErrors.length > 0)
    throw new Error(`page errors: ${pageErrors.join(" | ")}`);
  console.log("publish check OK");
} catch (error) {
  console.log(`publish check FAILED: ${error.message}`);
  process.exitCode = 1;
} finally {
  await browser.close();
}
EOF
bash -n "$T/acceptance.sh" && node --check "$T/check-activity-html.mjs" && node --check "$T/publish-check.mjs" && echo "ok"
````

預期：`ok`。

執行（約 15 分鐘，背景執行）：

```sh
cd /Users/kaellim/Desktop/projects/puck
T="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/tceditor-s2-task17"
bash "$T/acceptance.sh" "$T" > "$T/acceptance.log" 2>&1; echo "acceptance exit=$?" >> "$T/acceptance.log"
```

完成後：`cat "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/tceditor-s2-task17/acceptance.log"`。預期：

```
no published page yet
started PIDs: <demo 的 PID> <示範站的 PID>
200 http://127.0.0.1:3000/test/edit?disableIframe=false
200 http://127.0.0.1:3010/activity
200 http://127.0.0.1:3010/activity/edit
200 http://127.0.0.1:3010/api/activity
listen 127.0.0.1:3000
listen 127.0.0.1:3010
== item 1: pnpm smoke
4/4 tests passed
 ├ dropped Section
 ├ published (POST /api/activity 200, no notices)
 ├ 發布檢查: 沒有錯誤
 ├ /activity shows the 8 blocks
✅ Showcase smoke test passed.
smoke exit=0
== item 2: the public page shows the published content
publish preset: 200 {"notices":[]}
36/36 found
javascript: in html: false
javascript: link: 422
  unsafe_href content[0].props.href Button 按鈕的『連結網址』只接受 http、https、mailto、tel 或站內路徑。
other origin: 403 {"error":"forbidden_origin","message":"只接受從本站送出的發布請求。"}
rebound host name: 403 {"error":"forbidden_origin","message":"只接受從本站送出的發布請求。"}
text/plain body: 415 {"error":"unsupported_media_type","message":"發布請求的 Content-Type 必須是 application/json。"}
body of 2097155 bytes: 413 {"error":"too_large","message":"頁面資料超過 2 MB（2,097,152 bytes，以 UTF-8 計算）的上限，沒有發布。"}
apps/showcase/.data/activity.json: OK
== item 3: the 發布檢查 panel
button error: content[<i>].props.href 按鈕的『連結網址』不能空白。
image error: content[<j>].props.image.assetId 圖片的『圖片』還沒有選擇圖片。
panel: 有 3 個錯誤，沒有發布
fields after clicking the button error: fullWidth,href,label,size,variant
fields after clicking the image error: caption,ratio
publish check OK
apps/showcase/.data/activity.json: OK

port 3000 free
port 3010 free
published page removed (there was none before)
acceptance exit=0
```

- 開頭是 `port 3000 is busy …`（或 3010）與 `lsof` 的輸出、`acceptance exit=2` 時：有別的程式佔用 port，腳本沒有啟動任何東西。不要停掉別人的程序：回報並請使用者處理，之後重跑。
- 之前發布過時，第一行是 `published page backed up`，倒數第二行是 `published page restored`。
- 結尾是 `port <n> still in use after kill …`、`lsof` 的輸出與 `acceptance exit=3` 時：腳本 kill 了自己記下的 PID，10 秒後 port 仍被佔用。不要再 kill 其他程序：記下 `lsof` 的內容回報，由使用者處理（示範站資料已還原）。
- 第 1 項：demo 段落永遠以 0 結束（facts/repo-infra.md §0 #6），所以要看 `4/4 tests passed`；少於 4 表示有測試超過記憶體門檻，回報數字。`smoke exit` 是示範站段落的結果（`&&` 串接），通過時有 `✅ Showcase smoke test passed.`；不是 0 時看 `$T/smoke.log`。示範站段落結束時會自己還原已發布的頁面，所以第 2 項開始時的狀態和腳本啟動時相同。
- 第 2 項：
  - `36/36 found` 的 36 是 Task 15 範例頁的文字、連結、圖片與標題數；範例頁改過時數字會不同，但兩個數字必須相同；`missing …` 的行指出缺少哪個區塊的哪段文字。這些都是 `curl` 取得的伺服器輸出，也就是「檢視原始 HTML」看到的內容，不需要執行 JavaScript。
  - `notices` 不是空陣列時記下內容回報，不算失敗。
  - 危險連結得到 `422` 與一筆中文的 `unsafe_href`；跨來源得到 `403`；`Host` 與 `Origin` 都是 `evil.example:3010`（模擬 DNS rebinding：別的網域解析到 127.0.0.1，瀏覽器送出的兩個標頭一致）也得到 `403`；`text/plain` 得到 `415`；超過 2 MB 得到 `413`。狀態碼與 `error` 是 Task 15 的發布 API 定下的，`message` 的措辭不同不算失敗。
  - `shasum -c` 的 `OK`：被拒絕的請求都沒有改寫已發布的資料。
- 第 3 項：422 的錯誤正好 3 筆：按鈕的 `href`（`invalid_value`），以及圖片的 `image.assetId`（`invalid_value`）與 `image.alt`（`alt_required`）。同一個路徑只回報一筆，但圖片的物件層檢查在 `assetId` 失敗後仍會執行，所以圖片有兩筆。腳本斷言正好這 3 筆（否則印出 `expected 3 errors: …`，屬於功能問題，回報），再取圖片的第一筆（`assetId`）來點。`publish-check.mjs` 失敗時印出 `publish check FAILED: <原因>`。先判斷是 Task 15 的介面和腳本的假設不同，還是功能真的有問題：
  - `no publish button found in the header`：看編輯器 header 上的實際文字，改 `clickText(page, ["Publish", "發布"])` 的清單。
  - `timed out waiting for the 發布檢查 panel` 或等不到面板裡的錯誤：用 `page.screenshot({ path: "<$T 下的檔名>" })` 確認面板是否出現、`data-status` 是什麼、錯誤是什麼元素，調整 `invalidPanel`、`findEntry` 或打開面板的方式。
  - `not Chinese`、欄位不對（點錯誤後沒有選取區塊）：功能問題，回報。
  只能調整找元素的方式，不能放寬斷言。
- 只想重跑第 2、3 項時：`SKIP_DEMO_SMOKE=1 bash "$T/acceptance.sh" "$T"`（只啟動示範站，不跑 `pnpm smoke`）。

- [ ] **Step 15: 驗收 §13.3 第 4 項：區塊 Storybook 的中文控制面板、文件頁、範例與預設主題**

`pnpm storybook:smoke`（Step 11、13 都跑過）已確認：每個區塊都有文件頁、`Default` story 與每個範例的 story，每個 story 與文件頁都畫得出來、沒有錯誤，主題是 `tzuchi`、語言是 `zh-Hant`，沒有對外請求。這一步再確認控制面板是中文。建立 `$T/storybook-check.mjs`（完整內容）並執行：

````sh
cd /Users/kaellim/Desktop/projects/puck
T="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/tceditor-s2-task17"
cat > "$T/storybook-check.mjs" <<'EOF'
// Acceptance check for the block Storybook (S2 spec §13.3 item 4). Run from
// the repo root after `pnpm build`. For every block of the catalog:
// - the generated story file has the title 區塊/<label>, a Chinese control
//   name for every field (the argTypes `name` is the field's title) and the
//   Chinese option labels;
// - the built Storybook (storybook-static/index.json) has its docs page, the
//   Default story and one story per example.
// pnpm storybook:smoke already opens each of these pages in Chrome and checks
// that they render without errors in the tzuchi theme.
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";

const read = (p) => readFileSync(p, "utf8");
const catalog = JSON.parse(read("packages/blocks/generated/catalog.json"));
const index = JSON.parse(read("apps/storybook/storybook-static/index.json"));
const entries = Object.values(index.entries);
const kebab = (type) =>
  type.replace(/([a-z0-9])([A-Z])/g, "$1-$2").toLowerCase();
const CJK = /[\u4e00-\u9fff]/;

let failed = 0;
for (const block of catalog.blocks) {
  const folder = kebab(block.type);
  const source = read(
    `packages/blocks/src/${folder}/${block.type}.stories.tsx`
  );
  const problems = [];
  if (!source.includes(`title: ${JSON.stringify(`區塊/${block.label}`)}`)) {
    problems.push("title");
  }
  const properties = Object.entries(block.props.properties ?? {});
  for (const [name, field] of properties) {
    if (!CJK.test(field.title ?? ""))
      problems.push(`${name}: title is not Chinese`);
    if (!source.includes(`name: ${JSON.stringify(field.title)}`)) {
      problems.push(`${name}: no control named ${field.title}`);
    }
    for (const label of Object.values(field["x-labels"] ?? {})) {
      if (!source.includes(JSON.stringify(label))) {
        problems.push(`${name}: no option label ${label}`);
      }
    }
  }
  const id = `blocks-${folder}`;
  const own = entries.filter((e) => e.id.startsWith(`${id}--`));
  const stories = own.filter((e) => e.type === "story");
  if (!own.some((e) => e.id === `${id}--docs` && e.type === "docs")) {
    problems.push("no docs page");
  }
  if (!stories.some((e) => e.id === `${id}--default`))
    problems.push("no Default story");
  for (const example of block.examples) {
    if (!stories.some((e) => e.name === example.name)) {
      problems.push(`no story for the example ${example.name}`);
    }
  }
  if (stories.length !== 1 + block.examples.length) {
    problems.push(
      `${stories.length} stories, expected ${1 + block.examples.length}`
    );
  }
  if (problems.length === 0) {
    console.log(
      `ok   區塊/${block.label}: docs page, ${stories.length} stories, ${properties.length} Chinese controls`
    );
  } else {
    failed++;
    console.log(`FAIL 區塊/${block.label}: ${problems.join("; ")}`);
  }
}
console.log(failed === 0 ? "storybook check OK" : `${failed} block(s) failed`);
process.exitCode = failed === 0 ? 0 : 1;
EOF
node "$T/storybook-check.mjs"; echo "exit=$?"
````

預期（依 Task 10 的規格：13 個範例、21 個 story）：

```
ok   區塊/段落: docs page, 3 stories, 2 Chinese controls
ok   區塊/按鈕: docs page, 3 stories, 5 Chinese controls
ok   區塊/卡片: docs page, 2 stories, 5 Chinese controls
ok   區塊/標籤列: docs page, 3 stories, 3 Chinese controls
ok   區塊/區段: docs page, 2 stories, 3 Chinese controls
ok   區塊/多欄: docs page, 2 stories, 2 Chinese controls
ok   區塊/圖片: docs page, 3 stories, 3 Chinese controls
storybook check OK
exit=0
```

- 8 行依 catalog 的順序（`blockSpecs` 的登記順序）。stories 數是 1 加上該區塊的範例數；controls 數是該區塊的欄位數，每個欄位的控制項名稱（argTypes 的 `name`）都是中文 title，有選項的欄位也有中文選項標籤。

- [ ] **Step 16: 驗收 §13.3 第 5 項：交給 S3、S4 的三個檔案**

建立 `$T/handoff-check.mjs`（完整內容）並執行：

````sh
cd /Users/kaellim/Desktop/projects/puck
T="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/tceditor-s2-task17"
cat > "$T/handoff-check.mjs" <<'EOF'
// Acceptance check for the hand-offs to S3 and S4 (S2 spec §13.3 item 5).
// Run from the repo root after `pnpm build`.
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
import { gzipSync } from "node:zlib";

const EDGE = "packages/blocks/dist/validator.edge.mjs";
const SHELL = "packages/blocks/generated/page-shell.draft07.json";
const CATALOG = "packages/blocks/generated/catalog.json";
const PRESET = "apps/showcase/content/activity.preset.json";
let ok = true;
const check = (condition, message) => {
  console.log(`${condition ? "ok  " : "FAIL"} ${message}`);
  ok &&= condition;
};

const edge = readFileSync(EDGE);
const gzipped = gzipSync(edge, { level: 9 }).length;
check(
  gzipped <= 61440,
  `edge validator: ${gzipped} bytes gzipped (limit 61440)`
);
const { validatePageJson, blockTypes } = await import(
  pathToFileURL(join(process.cwd(), EDGE)).href
);
check(
  blockTypes.join(",") ===
    "Heading,Paragraph,Button,Card,TagList,Section,Columns,Image",
  `edge validator block types: ${blockTypes.join(",")}`
);
const preset = validatePageJson(readFileSync(PRESET, "utf8"));
check(preset.ok === true, "edge validator accepts the preset page");
const bad = validatePageJson(
  JSON.stringify({
    root: { props: { title: "驗收" } },
    content: [
      {
        type: "Button",
        props: {
          id: "Button-accept-1",
          label: "立即報名",
          href: "javascript:alert(1)",
        },
      },
    ],
  })
);
const badCodes = bad.ok
  ? "accepted"
  : bad.errors.map((e) => `${e.code} ${e.pathText}`).join(", ");
check(
  badCodes === "unsafe_href content[0].props.href",
  `edge validator on javascript: -> ${badCodes}`
);
if (!bad.ok) console.log(`     message: ${bad.errors[0].message}`);
const large = validatePageJson(`"${"測".repeat(699051)}"`);
check(
  !large.ok && large.errors[0].code === "too_large",
  "edge validator rejects 2 MB + 3 bytes as too_large"
);

const catalog = JSON.parse(readFileSync(CATALOG, "utf8"));
check(
  catalog.catalogVersion === 1 &&
    catalog.blocks.length === 8 &&
    catalog.nodeIdPattern === "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$",
  `catalog: version ${catalog.catalogVersion}, ${
    catalog.blocks.length
  } blocks, limits ${JSON.stringify(catalog.limits)}`
);
const catalogText = readFileSync(CATALOG, "utf8");
check(
  !/"\$ref"|"oneOf"|"anyOf"|"allOf"/.test(catalogText),
  "catalog props have no $ref, oneOf, anyOf or allOf"
);
const shellText = readFileSync(SHELL, "utf8");
const shell = JSON.parse(shellText);
check(
  shell.$schema === "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#" &&
    !/"(oneOf|anyOf|allOf)"/.test(shellText),
  `page shell: ${shell.$schema}, no oneOf, anyOf or allOf`
);
console.log(ok ? "hand-off check OK" : "hand-off check FAILED");
process.exitCode = ok ? 0 : 1;
EOF
git ls-files packages/blocks/generated/catalog.json packages/blocks/generated/page-shell.draft07.json
git check-ignore -q packages/blocks/dist/validator.edge.mjs && echo "the edge bundle is a build output (ignored)"
node "$T/handoff-check.mjs"; echo "exit=$?"
````

- [ ] **Step 18: 在路線圖標記 S2 完成、commit 並收尾**

只有 Step 11–17 全部通過才執行本步驟。建立 `$T/mark-s2-done.mjs`（完整內容）並執行：

````sh
cd /Users/kaellim/Desktop/projects/puck
T="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/tceditor-s2-task17"
cat > "$T/mark-s2-done.mjs" <<'EOF'
// Marks S2 done in the roadmap and in the S2 design spec. Run from the repo root:
//   node mark-s2-done.mjs docs/superpowers/plans/<S2 plan>.md <YYYY-MM-DD>
// Checks every anchor before writing anything; running it again changes nothing.
import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";

const ROADMAP = "docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-08-tzuchi-puck-roadmap.md";
const SPEC = "docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-12-s2-block-spec-design.md";
const OLD_STATUS = "| 規格見 `2026-10-12-s2-block-spec-design.md` |";
const [plan, date] = process.argv.slice(2);

const fail = (message) => {
  console.error(`mark-s2-done: ${message}; nothing was changed`);
  process.exit(1);
};
if (
  !/^docs\/superpowers\/plans\/[^/]+\.md$/.test(plan ?? "") ||
  !existsSync(plan)
) {
  fail(`not a plan file: ${plan}`);
}
if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(date ?? "")) fail(`not a date: ${date}`);

const roadmap = readFileSync(ROADMAP, "utf8").split("\n");
const row = roadmap.findIndex((line) => line.startsWith("| S2 |"));
if (row < 0) fail(`${ROADMAP} has no S2 row`);
let roadmapChanged = false;
if (!roadmap[row].includes("已完成")) {
  if (!roadmap[row].endsWith(OLD_STATUS))
    fail(`unexpected S2 row: ${roadmap[row]}`);
  roadmap[row] =
    roadmap[row].slice(0, -OLD_STATUS.length) +
    `| 已完成（${date}）。規格見 \`2026-10-12-s2-block-spec-design.md\`，實作計畫見 \`${plan}\` |`;
  roadmapChanged = true;
}

const spec = readFileSync(SPEC, "utf8").split("\n");
const header = spec.slice(
  0,
  spec.findIndex((line) => line.startsWith("## "))
);
const status = header.findIndex((line) => line.startsWith("- 狀態："));
if (status < 0) fail(`${SPEC} has no 狀態 line`);
let specChanged = false;
if (!spec[status].includes("實作完成")) {
  spec[status] += `；${date} 實作完成`;
  specChanged = true;
}
if (!header.some((line) => line.startsWith("- 實作計畫："))) {
  spec.splice(status + 1, 0, `- 實作計畫：\`${plan}\``);
  specChanged = true;
}

if (roadmapChanged) writeFileSync(ROADMAP, roadmap.join("\n"));
if (specChanged) writeFileSync(SPEC, spec.join("\n"));
console.log(`${roadmapChanged ? "updated" : "already done"} ${ROADMAP}`);
console.log(`${specChanged ? "updated" : "already done"} ${SPEC}`);
EOF
PLAN=$(git log --format= --name-only --diff-filter=A --grep='^docs: add the S2 implementation plan' -- docs/superpowers/plans | head -n 1)
echo "plan: $PLAN"
node "$T/mark-s2-done.mjs" "$PLAN" "$(date +%F)"
git diff --stat
git diff -U0 -- docs/superpowers/specs | grep -E '^[+-]([^+-]|- )'
````

```
updated docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-08-tzuchi-puck-roadmap.md
updated docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-12-s2-block-spec-design.md
 docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-08-tzuchi-puck-roadmap.md  | 2 +-
 docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-12-s2-block-spec-design.md | 3 ++-
 2 files changed, 3 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)
-| S2 | 元件規格（唯一 schema） | … | S1 | 規格見 `2026-10-12-s2-block-spec-design.md` |
+| S2 | 元件規格（唯一 schema） | … | S1 | 已完成（<日期>）。規格見 `2026-10-12-s2-block-spec-design.md`，實作計畫見 `docs/superpowers/plans/<S2 計畫的檔名>.md` |

+- 實作計畫：`docs/superpowers/plans/<S2 計畫的檔名>.md`
```

- `plan:` 後面是空的時，表示找不到那個 commit（計畫的 commit 訊息不同）：用 `git log --oneline --diff-filter=A -- docs/superpowers/plans` 找出 S2 計畫的檔名，直接傳給腳本。
- 腳本先檢查所有錨點才寫入；錨點找不到時印出 `mark-s2-done: … nothing was changed` 並以 1 結束。S2 設計規格開頭已經有「實作計畫」一行時（例如計畫的 commit 已經加過），腳本不會重複加入，`diff --stat` 會少一行。
- `docs/superpowers/` 不受 Prettier 檢查（`.prettierignore`）。
